jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Software Delivery Lead to direct software architecture, secure engineering, technical delivery, and release readiness for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Software Delivery Lead to direct software architecture, secure engineering, technical delivery, and release readiness for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior position provides technical and delivery leadership across multiple Agile teams responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing, modernizing, deploying, and sustaining secure enterprise software.

The Software Delivery Lead establishes technical direction, facilitates architecture and design reviews, manages cross-team dependencies, and ensures that software increments meet approved functional, security, quality, configuration, documentation, and operational-readiness requirements. The Lead coordinates delivery from requirements development through production deployment and post-release validation.

This role works closely with Government product and mission stakeholders, software architects, developers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, configuration managers, infrastructure and cloud engineers, operations teams, trainers, and program leadership. The Lead ensures continuous feedback among development, testing, operations, security, and end users.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional travel or after-hours support may be required for planning sessions, release activities, production deployments, or critical incident response.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Software Delivery Lead will:

  • Lead technical delivery across multiple Agile software-development teams.
  • Establish and communicate software architecture, engineering, integration, testing, deployment, and release expectations.
  • Facilitate architecture reviews, system-design reviews, interface reviews, code-quality reviews, security reviews, and release-readiness assessments.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are secure, scalable, extensible, supportable, testable, and aligned with current and target enterprise architectures.
  • Review technical designs for consistency with validated requirements, approved baselines, Government standards, and operational priorities.
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt, integration concerns, capacity limitations, and operational dependencies.
  • Develop or oversee corrective plans addressing architectural, engineering, security, quality, and delivery risks.
  • Manage delivery dependencies among software, data, infrastructure, cloud, network, cybersecurity, testing, training, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate technical decisions across teams and ensure decisions, assumptions, constraints, and impacts are documented.
  • Lead software-engineering activities across requirements analysis, design, development, integration, verification, validation, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Ensure teams apply current software-engineering, systems-engineering, Agile, DevSecOps, and secure-development practices.
  • Oversee requirements gathering, technical analysis, decomposition, estimation, prioritization, and documentation.
  • Ensure requirements are complete, clear, actionable, measurable, testable, traceable, and sufficiently detailed for design and development.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of technical user stories, acceptance criteria, requirements-traceability records, interface requirements, and system-design documentation.
  • Support analyses and trade studies involving commercial, Government, custom-developed, cloud, data, software, and infrastructure alternatives.
  • Develop or oversee technical recommendations, concepts of operations, architecture options, implementation approaches, and rough-order-of-magnitude estimates.
  • Direct the establishment and use of development, integration, test, staging, and other preproduction environments.
  • Ensure development and test environments support controlled integration, verification, validation, performance testing, security testing, deployment rehearsal, and decommissioning.
  • Coordinate environment availability, configuration, test data, tools, licenses, access, and technical dependencies.
  • Ensure development and test environments remain appropriately separated from operational environments.
  • Lead release and Sprint planning across multiple Agile teams.
  • Recommend release and Sprint frequency, duration, sequencing, dependencies, and delivery milestones for Government approval.
  • Coordinate team structures, development environments, delivery methods, mission interaction, and supporting technical processes.
  • Facilitate or oversee Sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, Sprint reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure Sprint backlogs reflect approved priorities, estimated effort, available resources, technical dependencies, and delivery risks.
  • Provide or oversee weekly progress updates and software demonstrations for Government stakeholders.
  • Track planned, completed, added, deferred, blocked, and accepted work across participating teams.
  • Ensure lessons learned, development metrics, technical accomplishments, and delivery concerns are documented.
  • Coordinate the preparation and maintenance of Development Sprint Plans and Sprint Summary Reports.
  • Oversee configuration management for software, scripts, configuration files, interfaces, build assets, deployment assets, and related baseline components.
  • Ensure system changes are documented against current baselines and recorded in the Configuration Management Database as required.
  • Ensure configuration items, implementation status, issues, approvals, and baseline changes are traceable.
  • Coordinate configuration-control and change-control activities for development, test, and operational releases.
  • Ensure source code, configuration files, scripts, build instructions, installation procedures, dependencies, and version descriptions are complete and delivered as required.
  • Ensure version documentation identifies software modules, configuration components, scripts, release versions, dependencies, and known defects.
  • Ensure build, installation, deployment, rollback, and recovery procedures are documented and repeatable.
  • Establish and enforce release-readiness criteria.
  • Confirm that releases have completed required design, code, integration, functional, regression, interface, security, performance, load, accessibility, and operational testing.
  • Verify requirements traceability, test results, defect disposition, security findings, documentation, training, configuration control, deployment procedures, and rollback readiness.
  • Coordinate go/no-go recommendations with Government stakeholders and responsible technical teams.
  • Ensure unresolved defects, risks, exceptions, and limitations are documented and communicated before release approval.
  • Coordinate deployment to operational environments and oversee post-release verification and stabilization.
  • Ensure explicit feedback loops exist among development, test, operations, security, mission owners, and end users.
  • Regularly assess and improve feedback, integration, testing, deployment, and release-management practices.
  • Coordinate urgent software security fixes and ensure they are appropriately prioritized, tested, documented, and released.
  • Ensure security impacts are evaluated and documented throughout the software-development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel on secure design, vulnerability remediation, security testing, authorization evidence, and production approval.
  • Ensure software engineering complies with applicable Federal and DoD standards, including approved DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Promote automated builds, code control, regression testing, security scanning, integration testing, and deployment automation.
  • Monitor delivery performance, release predictability, defect trends, security issues, technical debt, rework, dependencies, and team capacity.
  • Identify systemic delivery problems and lead corrective and continual-improvement actions.
  • Mentor architects, technical leads, developers, testers, and Agile delivery personnel.
  • Facilitate resolution of complex technical disagreements and cross-team delivery barriers.
  • Support technical briefings, program reviews, release reviews, demonstrations, audits, and Government decision meetings.
  • Provide delivery status, schedule, accomplishments, risks, issues, dependencies, corrective actions, and release outlook for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of ten years of relevant experience in software engineering, systems engineering, software architecture, technical delivery, application development, or a related discipline.
  • Experience managing or coordinating multiple Agile software-development teams.
  • Experience leading software delivery for federal programs or customers.
  • Experience leading software architecture, system design, technical reviews, secure engineering, and release-readiness activities.
  • Experience directing software delivery across requirements, design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Experience applying Agile, DevSecOps, configuration-management, and secure software-development practices.
  • Experience managing cross-team dependencies, technical risks, delivery schedules, release criteria, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Experience coordinating software-development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, operations, and Government teams.
  • Experience evaluating test results, defects, security findings, documentation, deployment plans, and rollback readiness before release.
  • Experience developing or reviewing architecture documents, system-design documents, interface documents, requirements-traceability records, release documentation, or comparable technical artifacts.
  • Ability to translate complex technical information into clear recommendations, briefings, status reports, and delivery decisions.
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, communication, analytical, organizational, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Project Management Professional certification.
  • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster, Advanced Certified ScrumMaster, or Certified Scrum Professional certification.
  • SAFe Agilist, Release Train Engineer, or comparable scaled-Agile certification.
  • Certified Scrum Product Owner or comparable product-management certification.
  • DevSecOps, secure software-development, cloud, architecture, or systems-engineering certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation or higher certification.
  • Experience leading software delivery within Department of Defense environments.
  • Experience with Federal and DoD software, cybersecurity, accessibility, configuration-management, and documentation standards.
  • Experience managing several concurrent releases, products, or technical workstreams.
  • Experience with automated build, test, security-scanning, deployment, and release pipelines.
  • Experience supporting cloud-native, containerized, microservices, API-based, data-intensive, or hybrid enterprise solutions.
  • Experience supporting production deployment, operational transition, and post-release stabilization.
  • Experience conducting technical trade studies and developing concepts of operations or rough-order-of-magnitude estimates.

Skills and Competencies

  • Software architecture and technical leadership.
  • Multi-team Agile delivery management.
  • Secure software engineering and DevSecOps.
  • Release planning and readiness governance.
  • Requirements and systems engineering.
  • Configuration and baseline management.
  • Verification, validation, and quality oversight.
  • Risk, dependency, and technical-debt management.
  • Federal stakeholder coordination.
  • Architecture and design-review facilitation.
  • Technical documentation and executive-level communication.
  • Mentoring and cross-functional team leadership.
  • Strong judgment in balancing mission needs, security, quality, schedule, and technical sustainability.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

jobs.description:
ServiceNow Application Developer

Astreya | Full-Time | ServiceNow Platform Team — ITSM · HAM · SAM


About the Role

Astreya is building ServiceNow into the day-to-day operating platform for our service delivery teams (Fulfillers) across IT Service Management (ITSM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM), and Software Asset Management (SAM). Our ServiceNow Process Advisors define what belongs on the platform, how processes should work, and the governance guardrails the build must follow. We are hiring a ServiceNow Application Developer to turn those designs into working, supportable platform capability.

This is a hands-on build role. You will take approved process designs — intake structures, catalog items, fulfillment workflows, asset lifecycle processes, CMDB data standards — and implement them on the platform: configuring, scripting, testing, and releasing. You will work day-to-day with the Process Advisor, who acts as the process authority for the program, and you will be expected to build to the agreed design rather than around it — favoring out-of-the-box capability and configuration over customization, and raising a flag when a requested build conflicts with the platform’s guardrails or long-term maintainability.

What You Will Do

  • Build to design: Implement approved process designs across ITSM (Incident Management, Request Fulfillment, Service Catalog items, RITM/SCTASK structures, SLA definitions), HAM (asset lifecycle, stockroom and inventory processes), and SAM (software requests, entitlements, license allocation, reclamation workflows).
  • Platform development: Configure and develop on the platform using Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, script includes, notifications, ACLs, and Service Portal / Employee Center configuration — using JavaScript and Glide APIs where scripting is genuinely required.
  • CMDB and data model: Implement and maintain the agreed CMDB and asset data model: CI classes, Asset–CI relationships, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality jobs, in line with the data standards set by the Process Advisor.
  • Integrations: Build and maintain integrations with adjacent systems (e.g., procurement, discovery, HR, endpoint management) using IntegrationHub, REST APIs, and import sets / transform maps.
  • Quality and release: Write and maintain Automated Test Framework (ATF) coverage for what you build; follow update set / source control discipline, instance hygiene, and release practices across dev, test, and production.
  • Guardrail discipline: Prefer configuration over customization; document every deviation from out-of-the-box behavior and its rationale. Surface conflicts between requested builds and platform guardrails to the Process Advisor and platform owner before building.
  • Fulfiller experience: Support the teams who live in the platform: tune forms, views, and queues for Fulfiller productivity, fix defects quickly, and turn recurring pain points into small platform improvements.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation — configuration records, integration specs, runbooks — so what you build is supportable by others.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience, with at least one substantial implementation or major module rollout delivered end-to-end.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITSM applications (Incident, Request, Service Catalog, SLAs) and practical exposure to HAM and/or SAM modules, CMDB structures, and the Asset vs. CI distinction.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow Glide APIs (GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideSystem), Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and ACLs.
  • Experience building integrations via REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub, and import sets / transform maps.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • Disciplined delivery habits: update set / source control hygiene, testing before release, and documentation as part of done — not an afterthought.
  • Ability to work from written process designs and governance standards, ask sharp clarifying questions, and communicate clearly with non-technical process owners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in ITSM, HAM, or SAM; CAD (Certified Application Developer) is a plus.
  • Experience with Automated Test Framework (ATF), Performance Analytics, or Service Portal / Employee Center customization.
  • Exposure to Discovery, asset integrations (procurement, endpoint management), or software license management tooling.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification, or equivalent grounding in ITIL-aligned processes.
  • Experience in managed services or IT services environments where SLA performance directly drives client outcomes.

How This Role Fits

  • You will work alongside a senior ServiceNow Process Advisor (consulting) who owns process design and scoping decisions — what goes into ServiceNow and what stays out. You own the build.
  • You report into Astreya’s ServiceNow platform / program leadership and work daily with operations, service delivery, and asset management stakeholders.
  • Over time, you will become the go-to platform builder for the Fulfiller organization as ServiceNow becomes their primary day-to-day toolset.

Astreya is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Job Title: Chief Operating Officer Location: Remote (in-office preferred - Meridian, ID) Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Direct Reports: VP of Underwriting, Operations Manager Employment Type: Full-Time Scope: Owns production operations end-to-end (origination, underwriting, fulfillment) and provides advisory input into servicing strategy. Servicing and secondary/capital markets operations are owned by their respective functions

Who We Are Retail-focused independent mortgage bank (IMB) originating $2B+ in annual volume, with a growing servicing portfolio (~$400M UPB) and an all-agency (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA) approval footprint. The organization runs lean and flat by design — this hire replaces layers of middle management with one senior operator who can own credit risk, run people, and fix throughput directly.

Role Summary This is a true COO-level mandate, distinct in scope and authority from a VP Operations role. The scope — credit risk ownership, direct agency relationships, systems/process strategy including AI implementation, and direct management of underwriting and operations leadership — calls for full executive-level authority and accountability. The COO will work closely with the CEO, executive team, and department heads to enhance operational efficiency, improve service quality, and drive growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own credit risk policy and credit box strategy — author, defend, and evolve the credit box as an active policy owner.
  • Manage the VP of Underwriting and Operations Manager — set performance targets, build a culture of accountability, and coach and develop both leaders directly.
  • Own agency relationships and escalations — serve as the direct point of contact with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and VA on overlays, QC findings, and repurchase demands.
  • Own systems and process strategy for origination, including the AI implementation roadmap — set the strategy and priorities, drawing on vendors or a systems hire for technical execution.
  • Advise on servicing strategy from the production side — provide strategic input on how credit box and product-mix decisions affect MSR value and retention, keeping production operations as the core focus.
  • Retain hands-on fallback capability — step in personally to work a stuck file or a broken workflow when direct reports need support, reflecting a hands-on leadership style.

Required Qualifications - Priority Order

  • Deep credit risk expertise (highest priority)
  • Has personally authored and defended credit box and credit policy design as a true policy owner, taking ownership of authorship rather than enforcement alone.
  • Has personally negotiated with agencies on overlay treatment, QC escalations, or repurchase demands, leading these conversations directly rather than delegating them.
  • Understands how credit decisions flow through to servicing and MSR performance.
  • Strong people management
  • Has directly managed underwriting and operations leaders in a flat, accountability-heavy culture, maintaining a direct span of control rather than managing through layers of middle management.
  • Sets clear targets, holds people to them, and coaches and develops direct reports.
  • Steps in personally to work a file or a process when needed, balancing hands-on involvement with team autonomy so the team keeps moving rather than becoming dependent.
  • Deep agency knowledge
  • Fluent in Fannie Mae DU, Freddie Mac LPA overlays, FHA TOTAL Scorecard, and VA automated underwriting.
  • Understands how overlays get built into underwriting policy through direct, practical application, going beyond theoretical or classroom knowledge.
  • Retail fulfillment and throughput background
  • Has personally owned pull-through rate, cycle time, and underwriter capacity planning as direct, individual KPIs, with hands-on accountability rather than secondhand oversight.
  • Built this experience at a $1.5B–$5B retail-focused IMB, in an environment distinct from depository banking or correspondent-heavy lending models.
  • Compliance and audit experience
  • Experience serving as a key point of contact through Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac audits, from information requests through findings and remediation.
  • Experience with Ginnie Mae oversight and audits, including the reporting and compliance expectations tied to Ginnie Mae issuer status.
  • Extensive experience with compliance oversight more broadly, with a track record of building and maintaining a strong compliance posture across origination operations.

Preferred Qualifications (Additive Strengths)

  • AI/automation implementation experience in origination — a strong plus, and equally well covered through a systems hire or vendor partnership.
  • Direct servicing operations experience — a valuable complement to the advisory and strategic input this role provides on servicing, though the core requirements stand on their own.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and/or contract law — useful for navigating people-management decisions, vendor and agency agreements, and other contractual matters that intersect with this role.
  • Familiarity with ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) structures — helpful given the potential for equity or profit-interest arrangements tied to this role and the broader organization.
  • CFPB audit experience — a strong plus given the regulatory scrutiny facing IMBs, and complementary to the agency and compliance audit experience above.
  • Broad product knowledge acumen — depth across conventional, government, and non-QM product types strengthens credit box strategy and supports informed conversations on product mix.

PMR Core Values No matter your position or department, your primary responsibility at PMR is to embody our core values — Vision, Hustle, Grit, and Execute — in everything you do.

  • Vision – Innovate / Cultivate: Leads with foresight and creativity, fostering innovation in loan programs, production processes, and team development. Encourages collaboration and continuous improvement that shapes PMR's future.
  • Hustle – Speed / Excel: Embraces a sense of urgency and a results-driven mindset. Drives the team to move quickly, seize opportunities, and deliver outstanding service to clients and partners.
  • Grit – Strength / Courage: Perseveres through challenges with resilience and determination. Leads with courage during change and sets the tone for consistent, principled performance.
  • Execute – Implement / Achieve: Translates strategic goals into tangible outcomes. Holds the team accountable for precision, timeliness, and excellence in every stage of production.

Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Morava.
Project Morava aims to help build more natural and intelligent voice AI systems by collecting high-quality speech data from native speakers.
In this project, participants contribute by reading and recording short, scripted prompts in Punjabi. These recordings are used to train and evaluate speech recognition models, enabling voice assistants and AI systems to better understand and respond to real-world users.
Project Benefits
  • The entire task takes approximately 2 hours, including time to review the guidelines
  • Work on your own schedule
  • Participate from anywhere within India
  • Record scripted prompts on your smartphone using the Appen Mobile app
Task Summary
You will use the Appen Mobile app on your smartphone to record 150 short, scripted voice prompts in Language. Each prompt is a brief spoken command — natural, everyday language. Simply read each prompt clearly and naturally, and you're done.
Requirements
  • Must be a Native speaker of Punjabi
  • Must be currently residing in India
  • Must be 18 years old or above
  • Must have a smartphone compatible with the Appen Mobile app

The ideal candidate combines strong technical development skills with an analytical, consultative mindset—someone who can understand operational challenges, identify opportunities, develop and implement solutions, and work with stakeholders to ensure those solutions deliver value.


The work centers on Service Level Requirements (SLRs) that govern contractual performance across the program, with additional support to broader Navy performance initiatives such as World Class Alignment Metrics (WAM). Key priorities include identifying performance improvement opportunities, strengthening the effectiveness of Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and developing AI-enabled tools and workflows that help the team move from reactive analysis to proactive performance management.


This role sits at the intersection of applied analytics, AI solution development, and operational performance consulting. You will work closely with analysts, engineers, and performance leaders to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, while helping expand the team's ability to use AI, automation, and reusable code in everyday operations.


This position is remote.


Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

  • Develop and deliver practical solutions using Python, AI, data analytics, and automation to address real-world operational performance challenges.
  • Partner with performance analysts, engineers, and program stakeholders to understand business problems, define requirements, recommend approaches, and translate opportunities into actionable technical solutions.
  • Build, test, refine, and implement reusable code, analytical tools, and AI-enabled workflows that improve how the team identifies, investigates, and addresses performance issues.

  • Apply AI and machine learning where appropriate to accelerate analysis, identify patterns, support decision-making, and improve the prioritization and effectiveness of POAMs.
  • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions, then work with the team to turn successful approaches into repeatable, sustainable capabilities.
  • Improve existing analytical processes through automation, integration of data sources, and more efficient code-first workflows.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, practical actions, and measurable performance improvements.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, explaining not only what the data shows but what actions should be taken and why.
  • Serve as a hands-on resource for AI adoption and capability development, helping teammates identify useful applications and incorporate new tools and techniques into their work.
  • Support broader Navy performance initiatives by adapting and extending successful solutions across related operational challenges.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 4–8 years of prior relevant experience, or Master's degree with 2–6 years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
  • US citizenship
  • Must have an active DoD secret security clearance.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing data-driven, analytical, automation, or AI-enabled solutions to solve real-world business or operational problems.
  • Strong Python programming skills, including experience building reusable scripts, analytical workflows, tools, or applications.
  • Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand business needs, frame problems, define requirements, and deliver practical solutions.
  • Experience using data analysis, applied machine learning, or AI techniques to generate actionable insights and support operational decisions.
  • Ability to work with large, complex, or imperfect datasets and transform them into reliable, usable analytical outputs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to move independently from problem identification through solution development and implementation.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts, findings, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative, results-oriented mindset with a willingness to iterate, incorporate feedback, and adapt solutions to operational needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing AI-enabled applications, automation solutions, or decision-support tools using Python and modern development frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI APIs, or related tools to solve business problems or improve operational workflows.
  • Experience with SQL, data pipelines, APIs, or integrating data from multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with software development practices such as Git, version control, testing, documentation, and reusable code design.
  • Experience in a technical consulting, analytics consulting, solutions engineering, or business-facing development role.
  • Experience developing prototypes, demonstrating solutions to stakeholders, and iterating based on user feedback.
  • Familiarity with operational performance metrics, service-level agreements, continuous improvement, or contract-driven environments.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions that support prioritization, root cause analysis, forecasting, or operational decision-making.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government environments.
  • Ability to balance technical sophistication with practicality, maintainability, explainability, and user adoption.

What Success Looks Like

  • Working solutions are delivered, not just analyses or recommendations, and those solutions make a measurable difference in operational performance.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer – EDA Clusters
jobs.excerpt: Securing NVIDIA's EDA clusters is not a matter of deploying a standard security stack.
jobs.description:
Securing NVIDIA's EDA clusters is not a matter of deploying a standard security stack. The workloads are too large, too long-running, and too performance-sensitive for an off-the-shelf playbook to simply apply. That constraint is the job. You'll be an individual contributor on Infrastructure Security Engineering for EDA Clusters, the team that implements security controls across the compute, storage, and networking that NVIDIA's hardware engineers design silicon on - spanning on-prem data centers and multi-cloud. You will sit alongside the engineers who run these clusters 24x7, close enough to deploy a control, investigate a behavior, and change the running environment yourself.


This is hands-on build work, not control review. You'll decide where conventional tooling applies, where it actively cannot, and then engineer the alternative. If your depth is in large-scale compute, networking, or storage infrastructure at a hyperscaler, a security product company, or anywhere fleets and fabrics are the day job, and you've carried real accountability for the security properties of those systems, you're who we want to talk to. We don't expect fluency in every security product category. We expect you to own outcomes and pick up the remaining domain breadth fast. Security engineering here is engineering: code, instrumentation, and secure-by-default infrastructure - not tickets, exceptions, and spreadsheets.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build and operate security controls and telemetry for EDA compute, storage, and networking - design, ship to production, then own them.
  • Engineer around hard constraints. Protect multi-day, high-value compute jobs without degrading them. Where heavyweight in-node agents are not viable, build the workable answer instead.
  • Make the network and platform the control plane. Protection can't depend solely on what runs inside the node.
  • Instrument for detection. Collect and normalize security signals from the fleet into our SIEM, and build the detections and dashboards that turn it into something actionable. Log collection alone is not monitoring.
  • Investigate and respond. Chase down EDA-specific threats and exposure, and execute containment and remediation hands-on with infrastructure and service owners.
  • Automate enforcement and evidence. Infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code so secure configuration is the default state, with compliance evidence produced as an engineering output rather than a manual exercise.
  • Run the lifecycle of the security technologies you own: selection, rollout, operation, and eventual replacement.
  • Work across boundaries. Partner directly with data center operations, IT storage and networking, network engineering, CSP teams, and NVIDIA's central security organization on shared outcomes.
  • Think like an adversary. Threat modeling and mitigation planning across network, storage, and compute.

What We Need To See:

  • 8+ years of hands-on infrastructure or infrastructure-security engineering across on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Strong Linux depth - you are comfortable at the system level, not just the console level.
  • Real experience operating or securing compute fleets at scale: provisioning, lifecycle, and the operational realities of long-running jobs.
  • Working networking expertise applied to large compute environments.
  • Programming/scripting fluency (Python, Go, or shell) used for automation, detection, and tooling you've shipped and maintained.
  • Solid foundations in access control, authentication, segmentation, encryption, and vulnerability lifecycle.
  • A track record of landing changes with partners who don't report to you.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - credible with individual engineers and with leadership.
  • A Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Security or platform engineering inside EDA, HPC, or large research-cluster environments.
  • Breadth across security domains - IAM, EDR/XDR, CNAPP, CSPM, zero-trust architectures - or a demonstrated pattern of picking up new domains fast.
  • Built or operated infrastructure security capabilities at a hyperscaler or a security product company - you engineered detection and enforcement systems rather than deploying someone else's.
  • Experience with kernel- and fabric-level observability and enforcement - eBPF, in-line and out-of-band inspection, DPU/SmartNIC offload - as an alternative to heavyweight in-node agents.
  • Contributions to open-source security or infrastructure tooling.

NVIDIA is looking for a Senior Network and Fabric Operations Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial organizations around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power next-generation data centres. Join the team building and advising on the networks behind many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world!

This role will engage directly with customers, partners and cross-functional teams to assess, architect and operate the compute, storage and scale-up fabrics that underpin large GPU estates—serving as both a trusted advisor and a hands-on technical leader. You will own the fabric side of NVIDIA’s Cloud Partner (NCP) operating model across the full Day 1 to Day 2 lifecycle: from InfiniBand/UFM and Ethernet validation at handover, through NVLink partition operations, to a production-stable fabric running at maximum goodput. NCP estates are open-source-first and heterogeneous—Cumulus Linux, SONiC, Spectrum-X, DOCA/DPU services, upstream Kubernetes and Prometheus/Grafana—so this role is deliberately tool-agnostic: you will meet each partner on the fabric they actually run rather than on a single proprietary product.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own Day 2 fabric operations across NCP fleets: NVLink/NVSwitch partition management (NMX-C / NMX-M) on GB200/GB300 NVL72-class systems, maintenance-partition isolation, and safe partition-change workflows for multi-tenant estates.

  • Own the switch software and firmware lifecycle—Cumulus Linux, SONiC and switch-OS upgrades, CPLD and field-notice rollout campaigns—with staged, tested upgrade plans that keep partner fabrics off stale releases without disrupting production workloads.

  • Support Day 1 fabric validation and acceptance: InfiniBand and UFM bring-up, Spectrum-X/RoCE Ethernet configuration, cabling and link-health verification, routing and congestion-control validation, and multi-day, multi-rack burn-in against agreed MTBI and goodput targets.

  • Strong data center and backbone networking fundamentals across physical connectivity, routing, overlays, services, and customer-visible failures
  • Hands-on experience across an observability stack such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, including active or synthetic monitoring and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
  • Experience with large-scale graph, relational, time-series, streaming, API, or event-driven systems that reconcile multiple sources
  • Technical leadership across teams, with strong product and operational judgment and clear tradeoffs among performance, resiliency, usability, and cost

Working at Abbott

jobs.description:
Epoch AI is looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to keep our hiring accurate, organized, and responsive as we grow.

About the Role

    We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator to own the administrative and data backbone of hiring at Epoch. You will report to the Head of People and work alongside our recruiters, hiring managers, and our People Operations and Finance teams.

    Epoch has grown from roughly 20 people to 70 during 2026, with staff employed across North and South America and Europe. That pace produces a large volume of candidates, interviews, work tests, and records, and the quality of our hiring decisions depends on that volume being handled carefully. Much of your first year will go to making our applicant tracking system reliable, our reporting usable, and our candidate experience consistent.

    The role covers data hygiene and reporting in our applicant tracking system, candidate communications, administration of work tests and skills assessments, and administrative support to recruiters as needed. As you settle in, you will have the opportunity to take on application review and talent sourcing, which makes this a strong fit for someone who wants to move into a recruiter role over time.

    Recruiting volume ebbs and flows. When hiring slows, you will support the People Operations team as the organization's needs shift, which will give you exposure to the wider employee lifecycle.

Practicalities

    Location

    Global Remote

    Work Hours

    Flexible, with availability required from 8:30AM - 10:00 AM PST/ 5:30PM - 7:00PM CET

    Travel Requirement

    Employees are expected to attend our 3 in-person retreats each year

    Compensation

    Annual salary of $78k - $95k USD. Exact salary will reflect experience and location. Salaries are not restricted to USD; contracts and payments are usually in local currencies, converted at one-year average exchange rates

    Benefits

    • Comprehensive health insurance program, including supplemental benefits specific to a local country, as available and mandated by local law

    • Life insurance and retirement contributions plan, if applicable in your country

    • Unlimited PTO with a recommend minimum of 30 days off per year (including public local holidays and vacation time)

    • Unlimited personal and sick leave

    • Parental leave — up to 4 months of paid leave for permanent staff with at least 12 months of tenure, prorated for those with less tenure, to be taken within the first year after a child’s birth or adoption

    • A flexible and generous expense policy for you to spend on equipment and a large range of productivity tools or learning/development opportunities you might find valuable, subject to regulations and manager approval.

    • Other benefits as allowed at the discretion of Epoch AI’s leadership and local availability

    Reports to

    Head of People

    Start Date

    As soon as the successful candidate is available

    Application Deadline

    Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early

What You'll Own

    Applicant tracking system and reporting

    • Own the accuracy of our applicant tracking system: duplicate records, stalled pipelines, missing feedback, mislabelled stages, and candidates sitting in the wrong place

    • Set up each hiring round in the system, including stages, interview kits, feedback forms, and permissions

    • Maintain and improve templates

    • Post roles to our careers page and to external boards and communities

    • Maintain an up-to-date hiring tracker

    • Produce regular reporting on pipeline volume, time to hire, stage conversion, and source of applicants

    • Own ATS integrations with support from the IT team


      • Work tests and skills assessments

      • Own the administration of work tests and skills assessments end to end: issuing them, tracking what comes back, getting responses in front of reviewers, and ensuring candidates get paid

      • Assist with the drafting, formatting and filing of skills assessments

        • Administrative support to recruiters

        • Manage the careers inbox: answer basic candidate questions, route what needs a decision, and ensure timely responses to candidates

        • Assist recruiters with sending status updates, rejections, and next-step instructions to candidates as required

        • Schedule interviews across time zones, working around interviewer calendars and candidate constraints

        • Take on other administrative work that keeps active rounds moving

          • Growth into recruiting, and People Operations support

          • As you settle in, gain exposure to application review against agreed criteria and to sourcing candidates for open roles

          • As recruitment volume ebbs and flows, as capacity allows you will assist the People Operation team, offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle.

About You

    Must Haves

    • 1-3 years in a coordination, administrative, or operations role, ideally supporting hiring

    • Hands-on experience working in an applicant tracking system, CRM, or similar software

    • You find keeping data clean and current satisfying

    • Comfort with spreadsheets and basic reporting

    • Clear, warm written communication

    • Strong organization and attention to detail

    • Discretion with confidential candidate and employee information

    • Comfort with remote work and with asynchronous communication across time zones

      • Nice-to-Haves

      • Prior familiarity with and interest in Epoch's mission

      • Experience using Lever or a comparable applicant tracking system

      • Experience at a small organization that grew quickly

      • Exposure to sourcing, application review, or other recruiting work

      • Experience coordinating hiring across multiple countries

      • Comfort automating repetitive work, using Claude and other integrations

      • An interest in moving into a recruiter role over time

        • If you don't tick all these boxes but think you would be a great fit, please consider applying anyway!

Additional Information

    Please submit all of your application materials in English and note that we require professional level English proficiency.

    Please do not include a cover letter, photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you're applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.).

    Epoch is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. We're committed to finding the best people for our team, so please don't hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. Please if you have any questions about this role, accessibility requests, or if you want to request an extension to the application deadline. However, we will not review applications submitted to this email address; please submit your application through the link on this page.

About Epoch AI

    Epoch AI is a research institute that investigates trends in machine learning and the economic consequences of AI. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive, publicly accessible knowledge base on AI that informs policymakers, industry leaders, and society at large.

    We strive to achieve both rigor and accessibility to our work, as exemplified by some of our most successful projects, including our database of AI models and our AI trends dashboard. Our body of research includes our work on compute trends (IJCN 2022), data scarcity (ICML 2024), and algorithmic progress (NeurIPS 2024). You can read more about our work and mission on our website and in this Time profile.

jobs.description:
About Binagora

We are a fully remote community of software crafters with over a decade of experience partnering with international clients. We collaborate with bold organizations to deliver high-quality, custom solutions that achieve tangible results. Our expertise spans various sectors, including Media & Entertainment, Solar Energy, Healthcare, Marketing, Audit & Compliance, Diversity & Inclusion, among many others. From initial strategy to final delivery, we go above and beyond, infusing creativity and aligning with business objectives to develop innovative products that challenge conventions and propel businesses forward.

Our Client

Our client is an advanced influence measurement platform that sits on top of first-party customer data to quantify peer-to-peer influence and behavior drivers. By running sophisticated network-graph models and data pipelines inside client environments without using social media data, they unlock previously invisible revenue channels and influence metrics for high-growth brands and enterprises.

Requirements

ResponsibilitiesAs a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:

  • Deploy, configure, and execute data pipelines directly within client environments, performing precise field-level data mapping between customer schemas and internal platform data models.
  • Lead the technical translation and migration of existing backend data pipelines, workloads, and cloud infrastructure from Microsoft Azure over to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Design, build, and optimize Python-native data engineering pipelines, leveraging BigQuery as the primary high-performance datastore.
  • Establish and manage cloud infrastructure and orchestration workflows using tools such as Cloud Run, Apache Airflow, or similar native GCP services.
  • Configure Vertex AI for model registry and ML platforms, and utilize Spark/PySpark to optimize computationally intensive tasks such as network-graph calculations.
  • Leverage AI-assisted developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot) for efficient code generation, review, and overall engineering productivity.

Must-Haves

  • Core Data Engineering Skills: 4+ years of hands-on proficiency in Python and extensive experience using Google BigQuery as a core input/output storage engine.
  • Orchestration & Infrastructure: Experience setting up cloud infrastructure and orchestrating data workflows (Airflow, Cloud Run, or equivalent).
  • Client-Facing / Forward-Deployed Mindset: Experience adapting standard engineering solutions to diverse, client-specific schemas and environment constraints.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience porting data pipelines and infrastructure from Microsoft Azure to GCP.
  • Official Google Cloud certification (e.g., Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Data Engineer, or Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Experience with Apache Spark or PySpark for complex data processing (e.g., network graph calculations).
  • Hands-on experience with Vertex AI for AI platform setups and model management.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools like GitHub Copilot.

Benefits

  • Trust-based culture: We highly value ownership and we trust in our team's skills and seniority to achieve goals.
  • Remote work: Enjoy working remotely! We are spread-headed in different locations in LATAM and Europe.
  • Flexible time off policy.
  • Diverse & Impactful Projects: Engage with complex challenges for major players in Media & Entertainment, alongside innovative startups in Solar Energy, Compliance, and other dynamic sectors.
  • Learning and development: Get the opportunity to take English classes, trainings and certifications.
  • Referral Program: We value connection! Our referral program provides bonuses for successful referrals.
  • Strong culture and traditions: We foster a supportive and engaging work environment, highlighted by our annual “Binagora Week”, regular team gatherings and gifts for special occasions.

Direct Sales Program Manager
Department: Direct Sales
Reports To: Director of Direct Sales
Location: Remote
FLSA Status: Exempt
Compensation: TBD Base Salary + Performance-Based Commission/Incentive (Target OTE: TBD)
Position Summary
The Direct Sales Program Manager is responsible for the coordination, execution, and continuous improvement of programs and initiatives supporting the Direct Sales Channel. This role helps ensure Direct-to-Door (D2D), reseller, Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU), EMA/NEMA, and other direct sales initiatives are effectively implemented, measured, and supported across the organization.
The Program Manager serves as a key operational resource for the Direct Sales organization, working closely with the Director of Direct Sales and cross-functional teams to coordinate market initiatives, improve processes, track performance, manage program requirements, and resolve operational barriers impacting sales execution and the customer experience.
This role partners with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and billing to ensure Direct Sales programs are aligned, scalable, measurable, and positioned to support customer acquisition and revenue growth.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Direct Sales Program Management
  • Coordinate the planning, implementation, and ongoing management of Direct Sales programs and initiatives.
  • Support D2D, D2D resellers, MDU, EMA/NEMA, and other customer acquisition programs within the Direct Sales Channel.
  • Develop and maintain program documentation, processes, workflows, timelines, and performance tracking.
  • Coordinate program launches and market deployments with internal departments and external partners.
  • Monitor program execution and identify operational gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the Director of Direct Sales with strategic initiatives designed to expand and strengthen the Direct Sales Channel.
  • Maintain visibility into program priorities, deliverables, progress, and outstanding action items.
Reseller & Partner Program Support
  • Support the operational management of reseller and referral partner programs.
  • Coordinate reseller onboarding, market launches, training requirements, system access, and ongoing program support.
  • Facilitate regular partner business reviews and assist with performance reporting and follow-up action items.
  • Monitor partner sales activity, connects, cancellations, sales quality, ARPU, and other applicable program metrics.
  • Coordinate reseller needs and operational requirements with internal stakeholders.
  • Help identify program opportunities that support additional market penetration and customer acquisition.
Sales Operations & Performance Analytics
  • Develop and maintain reporting used to measure Direct Sales program performance.
  • Track sales activity, connects, cancellations, conversion, ARPU, productivity, and other key performance indicators.
  • Analyze program results and identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring additional attention.
  • Assist with sales forecasting, market planning, deployment planning, and performance reporting.
  • Prepare program updates, executive summaries, business reviews, and recommendations for Direct Sales leadership.
  • Maintain accurate program documentation and reporting to support business decisions.
MDU, EMA & NEMA Program Management
  • Coordinate Direct Sales activities associated with MDU, EMA, and NEMA programs and agreements.
  • Track properties, opportunities, program requirements, deployment status, sales activity, and results.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support successful program implementation and ongoing execution.
  • Identify operational barriers affecting customer acquisition within participating properties or programs.
  • Support initiatives designed to increase penetration and customer acquisition within existing programs and properties.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Serve as a liaison between Direct Sales and internal departments supporting sales execution.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and other stakeholders on program requirements and deliverables.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up on issues affecting Direct Sales programs, reseller partners, field representatives, or customers.
  • Coordinate market readiness activities and help ensure sales programs are aligned with operational capabilities.
  • Maintain clear accountability for program action items, dependencies, and deliverables.
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
  • Evaluate Direct Sales workflows and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, program guidelines, job aids, and other operational documentation.
  • Support improvements to order processes, reporting, reseller workflows, market launches, and customer experience.
  • Help establish standardized processes and controls across Direct Sales programs.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to implement process changes and monitor results.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and coordinate sustainable solutions rather than relying solely on individual issue resolution.
Customer & Partner Escalation Coordination
  • Coordinate complex customer, reseller, and program-related escalations requiring cross-functional involvement.
  • Ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged and action items are clearly documented and tracked through resolution.
  • Identify recurring escalation trends and recommend process improvements that address root causes.
  • Maintain communication with appropriate stakeholders throughout the resolution process.
Program Governance & Compliance
  • Support adherence to established Direct Sales policies, processes, contractual requirements, and sales quality standards.
  • Assist with monitoring program compliance and identifying areas requiring corrective action or process improvement.
  • Maintain program documentation and records necessary to support consistent execution.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to address compliance, sales quality, and process concerns.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in program management, Direct sales operations, channel management, business operations, telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple initiatives involving cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and reporting capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into structured plans, processes, and measurable deliverables.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience coordinating issue resolution across multiple departments.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, and business/sales reporting tools.
  • Ability to travel as required to support Direct Sales programs and market initiatives.
  • Bilingual is not required but preferred
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting reseller, channel, referral, or indirect sales programs.
  • Customer Service, Customer Experience, and Quality Control
  • Telecommunications, broadband, cable, or related industry experience.
  • Experience supporting Door-to-Door sales programs.
  • Experience with MDU, EMA, NEMA, or property-based sales programs.
  • Experience developing operational processes, program documentation, reporting, dashboards, or standard operating procedures.
  • Experience coordinating geographically dispersed sales programs or market launches.
Core Competencies
  • Program and project management
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Strategic execution
  • Process development and improvement
  • Data analysis and reporting
  • Partner relationship management
  • Organizational effectiveness
  • Problem solving
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail
  • Accountability and follow-through
  • Continuous improvement
Physical Requirements & Work Environment
  • Ability to travel to assigned markets as business needs require.
  • Ability to conduct field visits, market reviews, reseller meetings, and cross-functional meetings.
  • Ability to work effectively in remote, office, and field environments.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.
  • Valid Driver’s License.

jobs.description:
Lumenci is hiring a remote Customer Success Manager to deliver product demos and onboard new customers for iLumos, our AI-powered patent intelligence platform. In this fast-paced, customer-facing role, you will run live demos and discovery, handle objections, and help Sales close deals with law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors.

About Lumenci

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumos platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

Employment Type: Full-time, exempt
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: US
Reports To: iLumos GTM Leader
Travel: 10–15% (customer meetings, internal sessions, and industry events)

The Opportunity

iLumos is generating strong inbound interest from law firms, corporate IP teams, and patent investors, and we need someone who can turn that interest into customers. We are looking for an experienced demo professional who can join conversations quickly, show the product's value clearly, and help Sales close deals.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a professional with 3–5 years of experience who has delivered more than 100 product demos and brings energy, confidence, and presence to every conversation. You will own live demos, discovery, and new customer onboarding, then transition customers to our account team for long-term relationship management.

What You'll Do

Product demos and discovery

  • Deliver live, tailored iLumos demos to prospective customers, often on short notice as new leads come in

  • Run discovery to understand each prospect's workflows, priorities, and decision criteria

  • Show how iLumos solves real patent and IP challenges in terms customers care about

  • Adapt each demo to the audience, from patent attorneys and IP counsel to investors and executives

Objection handling and deal support

  • Answer product, workflow, and value questions confidently during live conversations

  • Handle objections and move conversations toward clear next steps

  • Partner with Sales to advance opportunities and help close deals

  • Support pilot programs by demoing and onboarding pilot users, while Sales owns the pilot

  • Share prospect feedback and common objections with the GTM Leader and Product

Customer onboarding

  • Lead onboarding for new customers so they start using iLumos quickly and confidently

  • Walk customers through setup, core workflows, and best practices

  • Transition customers smoothly to the account team once onboarding is complete, with a clear handoff of goals, stakeholders, and next steps

Demo materials

  • Build and refine demo scripts, talk tracks, and objection-handling guides

  • Help teammates deliver iLumos demos more consistently

jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist / ML Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a product-minded applied data scientist or engineer to turn raw operational data into products that measurably improve how our customers make decisions and run their businesses.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a product-minded applied data scientist or engineer to turn raw operational data into products that measurably improve how our customers make decisions and run their businesses. Which label you carry matters less to us than whether customers end up better off.

This is not a research-only role, nor a service-oriented internal analytics position—and it is not a role for a model builder alone. We want an owner: someone who frames the problem, learns the domain, builds the data when it doesn't exist, ships the model, and stays with it until customers are acting on it and can measure the reward. The road runs through data engineering; deployment and testing are part of delivery, not a handoff. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, and measurable inside a real product.

Whether you came to this work through statistics, software, analytics, or data engineering, you have a strong bias toward shipping.

What You'll Do

    From Raw Data to Better Decisions

    • Own the Outcome: Take an ambiguous customer problem, decide whether ML is even the right answer, build it, and stay with it until customers are acting on it.

    • Learn the Domain: Get fluent in the semantics of how our customers operate—what a route, a crew, or a service history actually means. A model that is accurate but wrong about the domain creates nothing.

    • Build the Data You Need: When the features don't exist, create them in Snowflake and dbt rather than waiting for someone else to.

      • Prove It and Make It Felt

      • Make the Value Legible: Decide how a prediction reaches the customer so they understand it, trust it, and act on it—then report realised impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up.

      • Measure Honestly: Define offline and online evaluation for model quality, drift, and reliability, and design the A/B tests or causal analyses that prove a feature improved customer outcomes.

        • Deliver

        • Ship and Operate: Deployment, testing, versioning, monitoring, and drift detection. Delivery is part of the job, not a handoff.

        • Embed with Product: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to put ML inside real product workflows—and say clearly when ML isn't the answer.

Who We Are

    • The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions, not by whether the model shipped.

    • Closer to the Data and the Customer: You'd rather spend a week understanding what the data means than a week tuning a model. You know the domain is the hard part.

    • A Multi-Disciplinary Operator: You'll chase down the data yourself when it isn't ready, and build the pipeline if that's what delivery requires. You prioritise usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency.

      • We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you have shipped a model you are proud of, we want to hear from you!

      HOW WE WORK

      We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next model faster to ship. The leverage is in the verification: the backtests, eval scaffolding, and data checks that make generated work safe to trust.

What You'll Bring

    • Experience: 5+ years in applied data science, ML engineering, or data engineering that included owning models in production—including at least one model you built and shipped into a real product. B2B SaaS experience is a strong plus.

    • Technical Core: Strong Python and applied ML libraries for tabular problems (scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, statsmodels or Prophet). Solid SQL expertise is required.

    • ML & Modeling Depth: Depth in supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation, or optimisation. You have modelled messy operational data, not benchmark datasets.

    • Data & Delivery: You build the data you need and ship what you build—dbt and Snowflake modelling, feature pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection. We're on AWS.

    • Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified the business impact of a model you shipped—adoption, outcome, ROI—and presented it to people who were never going to read your notebook.

    • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to product, engineering, and non-technical business stakeholders.

      • Bonus Points For:

      • Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real modelling or engineering work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the scaffolding that makes the next model faster to ship.

      • Decision Intelligence: Experience with decision intelligence, forecasting, customer behaviour modelling, workforce/route optimisation, or operational intelligence products.

      • Leadership: Prior experience as a senior or lead scientist or engineer responsible for guiding technical direction.

      • LLM / Agentic AI: LLM or agentic workflows shipped into a product.

        • LOCATION & RIGHT TO WORK

        • Location: Remote (UK-based) with flexible working options.

        • Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position.

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US

  • Laid back but focused: We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment and a passion for developing innovative, best-in-class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers.

  • Impact-driven: We care deeply and deliver services and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses.

  • Trust & Inclusion: We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust and mutual respect.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED

  • Competitive company pension scheme with employer match.

  • Generous holiday allowance / flexible time off plus UK bank holidays.

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, and parental leave policies.

  • Ongoing learning resources.

  • Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing free 24/7 mental health, legal, and financial guidance.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees in accordance with the Equality Act 2010.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies show that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. If you feel you could make a great impact in this role, we encourage you to apply anyway!

Your role. Your way.

hier machst du den unterschied.

1. AVGS-Coaching & berufliche Orientierung

Du begleitest Menschen in individuellen 1:1-Coachings im Rahmen unserer AVGS-Maßnahmen (§ 45 SGB III) und unterstützt sie dabei, neue berufliche Perspektiven zu entwickeln.

Du machst Deine Coachees fit für den Bewerbungsprozess und unterstützt sie auf ihrem Weg zurück in den Arbeitsmarkt.

das steckt in dir.

das erwartet dich bei uns.

  • Real impact. Du unterstützt Menschen dabei, neue berufliche Perspektiven zu entwickeln und konkrete Schritte in Richtung Arbeitsmarkt zu gehen.
  • Work your way. Du arbeitest 100 % remote oder - je nach Möglichkeit und Bedarf - vor Ort an einem unserer Standorte.

so lernen wir uns kennen.

It's a Match? Wenn wir uns gegenseitig überzeugt haben, steht Deinem Start bei uns nichts mehr im Weg!

Ready to join us? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden bei Dir. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

vielfalt is unsere stärke.

Cost Accounting

  • Maintain and enhance costing methodologies.

  • Analyze COGS variances and trends including purchase price, and production volume.
  • Prepare monthly cost accounting journal entries and reconciliations.
  • Review inventory transactions to ensure accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Perform margin and profitability analyses by product, customer, and business unit.
  • Assist with annual physical inventory processes.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate inventory valuation in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
  • Partner with Operations to improve inventory accuracy and cycle count programs.
  • Analyze inventory reserves, obsolescence, excess inventory, and slow-moving stock.
  • Reconcile inventory subledger to the general ledger.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
  • Prepare management reports explaining cost trends and manufacturing performance.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs related to inventory.
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and annual operating plans.

ERP Implementation & Process Improvement

  • Serve as Finance lead or key contributor during ERP implementations, upgrades, and optimization projects.
  • Design and validate cost accounting processes within ERP systems.
  • Test costing functionality, inventory transactions, production workflows, and financial reporting.
  • Develop internal controls around ERP cost accounting modules.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve reporting efficiency.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Core Competencies

  • Business partnership
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Project management
  • Problem solving

Preferred Experience

  • CPG operations
