About us

We’re Dayshape—an award-winning software scale-up with big ambitions and the momentum to match. Trusted by Big Four and many other top professional services firms globally, our AI-powered resource management platform is helping organizations to achieve extraordinary results. 

Our enterprise platform stands apart as the only solution that combines advanced AI, real-time project financials, and firm-wide insights to elevate resource management to a strategic function. By driving profitable growth, powering confident decisions, and ensuring satisfied clients and teams—we're helping our customers build strong organizations and careers for the long term.

Why our customers love Dayshape:

  • We help professional firms optimize margins and increase revenue, unlocking access to more profitable work. 
  • We provide complete operational visibility today and the tools to confidently predict tomorrow. 
  • We empower firms to be where top talent wants to work and where top clients want to buy from.

Recognized as Scotland’s fastest-growing tech company in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 for three consecutive years, we’ve consistently proven our ability to innovate and deliver real impact—and we’re always looking for like-minded people to join us.

At Dayshape, our purpose is to improve people's working lives, and our culture is an important driving force in helping us to do just that. We're a friendly, inclusive, and ambitious team—driven by our values and a shared commitment to success. If you’re ready to join a fast-growing, high-impact company that’s reimagining resource management, then let’s talk.

About the role

Our customers include some of the world's largest professional services firms, with thousands of users relying on Dayshape every day. As our North American customer base continues to grow, we're expanding our US Support team and looking for an Application Support Engineer to support our enterprise customers across the United States.

You'll work closely with customers and colleagues across Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Professional Services to resolve complex issues and help customers get the most value from Dayshape.

This role operates during US business hours. While you'll collaborate closely with our growing US team, there is limited overlap with our UK Engineering teams, so you'll need to be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of issues from investigation through to resolution.

Our customers provide first-line support internally, meaning the issues that reach us are often complex, business-critical, or technically challenging. That's where you'll make the difference.

Why this role is different

Support at Dayshape isn't a traditional help desk role. You'll be a product expert, technical investigator, customer advocate, and problem solver all in one. From supporting global enterprise customers and managing releases to influencing product decisions, adopting AI-driven ways of working, and improving how we operate, you'll have real ownership and visibility across the business.

If you want to move beyond ticket handling and become a trusted partner to customers and colleagues alike, this is the role for you

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and troubleshoot complex customer issues, analysing logs, data, and product behaviour to identify root causes.
  • Act as the technical owner of support cases, driving incidents through to resolution and coordinating with Engineering when code changes are required.
  • Create high-quality Jira tickets that provide engineers with the information they need to resolve issues quickly.
  • Resolve customer issues directly whenever a technical fix, configuration change, or workaround can be applied without development work.
  • Prioritise and manage support work across customer impact, business priorities, and operational risk.
  • Become a recognised product expert, supporting customers and colleagues with deep product and technical knowledge.
  • Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders through regular meetings and ongoing collaboration.
  • Sort major customer milestones, including go-lives, white glove activities, and occasional on-site visits.
  • Manage customer software releases and help ensure deployments are delivered smoothly and successfully.
  • Use trends from customer issues and bug reports to help improve product quality, testing, and operational processes.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, ensuring customer feedback helps shape future improvements.
  • Create and maintain knowledge articles, guides, videos, and other self-service content that enables customers to succeed.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve how we work through automation, AI, and process improvements.

About you

  • You've worked primarily in L3 Application Support, Technical Support, or Product Support role supporting external customers.
  • You are comfortable investigating complex issues independently and can confidently communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • You've worked in an enterprise software environment and understand the importance of building long-term customer relationships.
  • You enjoy taking ownership and seeing problems through to completion rather than simply passing them on.
  • You're a self-starter who thrives when trusted to work independently and make decisions.
  • You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding how systems work beneath the surface.
  • You have strong problem-solving skills and can take a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting.
  • You communicate effectively with everyone from end users to software engineers and senior stakeholders.
  • You're comfortable challenging assumptions, raising risks, and escalating concerns when necessary.
  • You have practical SQL experience and are comfortable writing and running queries.
  • You have experience with scripting or programming concepts, including JavaScript.
  • You have an interest in AI and emerging technologies and how they can improve customer outcomes, team efficiency, and product experiences.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform is advantageous.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise business applications (such as WorkDay, Star, SAP etc.).
  • Experience working with APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as .NET, JSON, JavaScript, or Vue.
  • Experience working with Azure Data Factory or similar integration technologies.
  • An understanding of how large professional services organisations operate.
  • Experience managing customer-facing software releases or deployment activities.
  • Experience working within a geographically distributed team across multiple time zones.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, troubleshooting, knowledge management, or customer support processes.

What you’ll get

  • Starting salary $75,000 to $95,000 (dependent on experience)
  • 31 days' vacation per year, including public holidays, and increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 38 days.
  • Paid four-week sabbatical in your fifth anniversary year on top of your holiday entitlement.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits
  • Disability and life insurance
  • 401k with employer matching
  • At least $1,400 per year to spend on professional and personal development.
  • Regular All Hands meeting for inspiration and over-communication
  • Monthly team events (sometimes in-person, sometimes virtual).
  • Volunteering time – up to 20 hours a year to participate in volunteer work.
  • Genuinely nice, smart people to work with, who are excited about growing our company

Working Details

This is a full-time role (37.5 hours per week), working 09AM – 5.30PM (CT) from Monday to Friday.

We are looking for someone ideally to join the team remotely in/around the NJ Tri State, Austin or San Antonio, Texas, in order to support customers across the United States, and to facilitate occasional in-person collaboration with others within the US team.

Join the team!

Equality of opportunity is more than just a responsibility: we believe it’s a huge advantage to welcome a variety of experiences and perspectives into the team. Diversity is a great asset and, as such, we strongly encourage applications from any background.

This is your opportunity to really influence how we get things done, and how our product helps our customers improve their working lives. We're doing well, but there's lots more to do in order to maintain the high bar and pace that we've set.

Everyone here is growing personally as the company grows, so if that sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’d love to see your application. The deadline for applications is 5PM CT, Friday 6th November.

*Please note the successful candidate for this role will be subject to background checks and will have an opportunity to declare anything to us beforehand*.

Office of the Director (OOD)

Job Location:

All AHCCCS Employees must reside within the state of Arizona.

Posting Details:

Salary: $108,000 - $119,000

Grade: 27

FLSA Status: Exempt

Job Summary:

The Agency Compliance Manager provides operational leadership for the agency’s enterprise compliance program, including governance, policy management, investigations, monitoring, corrective action, training, reporting, audit coordination, and technology-enabled compliance processes. This position supervises assigned staff and serves as a key advisor to the Chief Compliance Officer by identifying emerging compliance risks, recommending program enhancements, and advancing a culture of integrity, accountability, and ethical decision-making across the agency.

Major duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Enterprise compliance program leadership, work planning, and staff management. Maintain the Compliance Program Plan and annual compliance work plan; translate CCO and Compliance Committee direction into priorities, deliverables, assignments, and measurable outcomes; and maintain an enterprise-level view of significant compliance obligations, emerging compliance risks, program gaps, and priorities. Oversee workloads and quality; supervise, coach, and evaluate assigned staff; ensure appropriate delegation; identify resource and capacity needs; and elevate material risks, trade-offs, or barriers to the CCO.
• Policies, procedures, standards, and compliance controls. Direct the development, review cycle, maintenance, publication, and operationalization of the Code of Conduct, compliance policies, procedures, standard work, and related controls. Coordinate regulatory research and interpretation with OGC, program leadership, and subject-matter experts; oversee policy life cycle controls, documentation, approvals, acknowledgments, exceptions, and implementation follow-up; and verify that written requirements remain aligned with actual operational practices.
• Effective reporting channels, compliance concerns, investigations, escalation, and corrective action. Oversee accessible and confidential reporting channels and the end-to-end compliance concern life cycle, including intake, logging, triage, assignment, review or investigation, documentation, disposition recommendations, corrective or preventive actions, follow-up, and closure. Establish and administer consistent escalation, decision-routing, and status-reporting protocols; provide timely, appropriate updates to the CCO and other authorized leaders or governance bodies; maintain complete, defensible case records; coordinate appropriate referrals; and promptly elevate high-risk, sensitive, legally significant, executive-level, or reputational matters to the CCO.
• Risk-based compliance monitoring, enterprise compliance risk, and audit coordination. Partner with business owners to identify, assess, and prioritize enterprise compliance risks; support the development of appropriate mitigation strategies; and monitor mitigation progress and effectiveness. Coordinate periodic compliance risk assessment inputs; develop and oversee risk-based monitoring and review activities; evaluate controls and remediation effectiveness; identify trends and systemic weaknesses; and elevate material compliance risks, ineffective mitigation, or unresolved ownership to the CCO for appropriate escalation. Support external audits and regulatory reviews as assigned; coordinate Compliance Office responses and evidence; maintain visibility into findings and recommendations; and track corrective actions through validated closure. The position coordinates compliance monitoring and audit follow-up but does not replace independent assurance functions or operational ownership of remediation.
• Compliance training, education, communication, and culture. Direct the annual compliance training and education plan; identify training and awareness gaps based on compliance risks, concerns, audits, monitoring, corrective action, and regulatory changes; and ensure training is appropriately targeted to identified risks and audiences. Oversee general, targets, role-based, on-boarding, and remedial training; coordinate agency communications and awareness initiatives; evaluate training completion and effectiveness; and support Compliance Committee and divisional compliance liaison engagement.
• Metrics, reporting, program evaluation, and GRC enablement. Establish program measures and service expectations; monitor trends, aging, timeliness, closure, training, policy, monitoring, and corrective-action data; prepare reports for the CCO, Compliance Committee, and executive leadership; conduct or coordinate periodic program-effectiveness assessments; recommend improvement actions; and serve as Compliance Office business owner for relevant ServiceNow/GRC workflows, requirements, data quality, dashboards, access controls, and adoption.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:
• Effective compliance program principles, including HHS OIG guidance and the operation of the seven elements of an effective compliance program
• Compliance concern intake, triage, fact-finding, investigation, evidence management, root-cause analysis, referrals, corrective action, and closure validation
• Risk-based compliance assessment, monitoring, auditing, control evaluation, external-audit coordination, and findings-management practices
• Enterprise compliance governance, compliance committees, federated compliance models, escalation protocols, and defensible decision documentation
• Medicaid, healthcare, managed-care, fee-for-service, federal award, public-sector, privacy, confidentiality, ethics, conflicts-of-interest, and program-integrity compliance concepts
• Federal and Arizona regulatory structures and methods for researching, interpreting, documenting, and operationalizing regulatory requirements
• Policy, procedure, standard-work, control, exception, acknowledgment, and records-management lifecycles
• Adult-learning principles, role-based training, communication planning, and training-effectiveness evaluation
• Compliance metrics, trend analysis, program-effectiveness assessment, dashboards, data integrity, and continuous improvement
• GRC concepts and ServiceNow-enabled policy, compliance, issue, investigation, audit, corrective-action, and reporting workflows

Skilled in:
• Leading professional compliance, policy, investigation, monitoring, and audit personnel through clear assignments, quality expectations, coaching, and accountability
• Communicating complex regulatory, compliance, and risk issues to executive leadership, governing bodies, and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner
• Converting enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations into practical work plans, procedures, controls, training, monitoring, and measurable deliverables
• Managing sensitive concerns objectively, consistently, promptly, and with appropriate confidentiality
• Preparing concise executive briefings, findings, recommendations, dashboards, and decision memos
• Facilitating cross-divisional work and resolving operational barriers while preserving Compliance Office independence and escalation rights
• Using risk, trend, workload, and performance data to prioritize resources and improve program effectiveness

Ability to:
• Exercise sound judgment without exceeding delegated authority and recognize
matters requiring CCO, executive, cross-divisional, or regulator involvement
• Lead through influence in a federated compliance environment
• Build effective partnerships across diverse stakeholder groups
• Coach and develop compliance professionals
• Ensure investigations, monitoring, and corrective actions are adequately documented and capable of withstanding audit or regulatory scrutiny
• Influence leaders and risk/control owners who do not report directly to the position
• Balance prevention, education, monitoring, investigation, remediation, and enforcement considerations in a complex public Medicaid environment
• Manage competing priorities in a complex regulatory environment
• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement
• Maintain trust, neutrality, discretion, accessibility, and professional independence
• Support compliance oversight activities involving contractors, vendors, delegated entities, and other third parties as assigned

Qualifications:

Minimum:
• Bachelor’s degree in compliance, business administration, public administration, health administration, law, accounting, auditing, or a closely related field and five years of progressively responsible experience in compliance, regulatory oversight, audit, investigations, internal controls, risk management, or a related function, including two years of supervisory or program-lead experience. Relevant professional experience may substitute for the education requirement on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading or contributing to an enterprise compliance program in healthcare, Medicaid, government, or another highly regulated environment.
    • Experience supervising or leading compliance professionals and partnering with senior or executive leadership.
    • Experience with compliance monitoring, investigations, corrective action, policy governance, or regulatory/audit coordination.
    • Relevant professional certifications including Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), or a comparable credential.

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre d'un projet de moteur de matching, nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist / AI Engineer pour poursuivre le développement d'une solution dédiée au rapprochement entre profils de chercheurs d'emploi, offres d'emploi et offres de formation, ainsi que son intégration dans un environnement CRM Dynamics.

La mission porte sur la conception, le développement et l'évolution d'une solution data et IA basée sur Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search et Microsoft Fabric.

Concrètement, vous serez amené(e) à :

  • concevoir, développer et faire évoluer le moteur de matching et ses pipelines de données, avec ingestion des profils, des offres d'emploi et des offres de formation dans Microsoft Fabric ;
  • mettre en place l'indexation et la recherche sémantique dans Azure AI Search, ainsi que les logiques de matching flou, de scoring, de reranking et de hiérarchisation des propositions ;
  • déployer et activer les environnements techniques sous Azure, Fabric et Azure AI Foundry, avec l'utilisation de conteneurs Docker et d'Azure App Service ;
  • mettre en place les chaînes CI/CD, le monitoring, ainsi que les exigences liées à la sécurité, à l'identité, à la conformité et à la souveraineté ;
  • exposer le moteur sous forme d'API et de connecteurs exploitables par les applications métiers ;
  • veiller à la qualité des données et à la validation du moteur au moyen de jeux de tests, de protocoles de validation et de mesures de pertinence des résultats ;
  • préparer les mises en production et collaborer avec les équipes techniques et métier ;
  • assurer la documentation, le maintien en conditions opérationnelles et le transfert de connaissances vers les équipes internes.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience récente en tant que Data Scientist et/ou AI Engineer, avec une bonne maîtrise de la conception et du développement de solutions data et IA sur l'écosystème Microsoft.

  • connaissance de Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search et Microsoft Fabric ;
  • expérience avec Azure App Service, Docker et Python ;
  • maîtrise de l'indexation et de la recherche sémantique dans AI Search ;
  • bonne compréhension des mécanismes de matching flou, de scoring et de classement de résultats ;
  • capacité à intervenir sur des sujets de déploiement, de sécurité, de monitoring et d'industrialisation ;
  • français ou néerlandais, avec un bon niveau d'anglais.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

We're looking for a driven Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team to contribute to our mission of managing hundreds of thousands of business entities worldwide, empowering our users with a platform that inspires trust. In this role, you will contribute to designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that enhance our platform's functionality and performance. Reporting to the Director of Development, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality code, optimize application performance, and support the growth of our technology stack.

What you'll do

  • Architect & Deliver: Develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable software solutions that align with complex business needs.
  • Strategic System Design: Participate in technical discussions and contribute to high-level decisions on system architecture, focusing on configurability and long-term maintainability.
  • AI-Augmented Development: Leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery cycles while maintaining code integrity.
  • Collaborative Innovation: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate user needs into innovative features and improvements.
  • Quality & Security Governance: Optimize application performance, ensure security and reliability, and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high code quality.
  • Process Evolution: Identify and resolve technical challenges, propose solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.
  • Future-Proofing: Stay up to date with industry trends, specifically LLM integrations and automated testing advancements to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that can enhance our platform’s capabilities.
  • Technical Mentorship: Guide the team in best practices for modern engineering, from sophisticated TypeScript typing to efficient AI-prompting for complex refactors.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience building scalable, enterprise-grade applications.
  • Startup/Scale-Up Background: Experience navigating fast-paced software startup environments where shipping and iterating quickly is essential.
  • Production AI Experience: Proven track record of shipping and operating real-world AI features in a live product (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations, vector search, or AI agents) not just using AI coding tools.
  • Full-Stack Proficiency: Strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript environments, specifically the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js).
  • Modern Tooling & Testing: Fluent with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot), automated testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright), CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker).
Nice to Have Skills:
  • Databases & Vector Search: Solid relational/NoSQL foundation alongside experience with vector search (e.g., MongoDB Atlas Vector Search) or search indexing.
  • Security & Communication: Security-first mindset for handling sensitive corporate data and the ability to explain technical/AI trade-offs to non-technical partners.

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Our Culture

Our company thrives in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in driving success.

Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

You’ll be the person INNERGY clients call when they want their engineering libraries done right. You’ll work with clients using Microvellum Toolbox and INNERGY Engineering to configure, build, validate, and maintain the libraries that drive their design-to-manufacturing workflow. Some days that means coaching a client through best practices. Other days it means getting into their library yourself and fixing what’s broken.

What you’ll do

  • Work closely with clients. Hold regular check-ins to review progress and roadblocks in Toolbox and INNERGY Engineering. Ask the industry questions that help clients make their libraries more accurate and easier to use.
  • Build and validate libraries. Help clients create and validate product data, machining rules, and design standards. When it makes sense, work directly in client libraries so they’re accurate, complete, and ready for production.
  • Train and support. Give one-on-one guidance on using Toolbox and Engineering libraries well. Work with the Content Creation team to decide which training materials and documentation clients need most.
  • Meet clients where they are. Adjust your approach for clients at every technical skill level, and give extra support where it’s needed so they adopt Toolbox and Engineering workflows successfully.
  • Keep communication clear. Stay in steady contact with clients through onboarding and validation. Document progress, issues, and fixes so the wider support team always has the full picture.
  • Solve problems. Find and fix issues with library setup, configuration, and use. Work with clients on practical solutions that make their engineering workflows more accurate and efficient.
  • Make the product better. Pass client feedback and recurring issues to the development and content teams so library management, and the client experience, keep improving.

What you bring

  • Experience in a similar role, ideally in CAD/CAM, engineering software, or architectural millwork.
  • Hands-on time with Microvellum Toolbox, INNERGY Engineering, or another AutoCAD-based design-to-manufacturing tool. This is a big plus.
  • A solid grasp of engineering libraries: how to configure, validate, and maintain them.
  • The ability to explain technical ideas clearly to anyone, from power users to clients who are still getting comfortable with software.
  • Experience training and supporting clients both in person and remotely.
  • Strong organization and time management. You can run several client engagements at once without losing track of any of them.
  • Patience and empathy with clients, plus a habit of measuring your success by their results.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible work environment. We support reasonable workplace adjustments for individuals with disability in accordance with applicable Australian laws. If you require adjustments during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended screen time and regular communication through digital channels. Work may be performed in a remote or office-based environment, depending on role and location. INNERGY is committed to supporting employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe working environment across all regions.

Why INNERGY

We hire for how people show up, not just what’s on the resume. Here’s what that looks like day to day:

  • Voice of the Customer. It starts and ends with the woodworker. We build for the people running the saws.
  • Education. We listen, learn, and teach. Curiosity is part of the job description.
  • Agile as Hell. Fast improvement beats delayed perfection. Try it, learn, ship the better version.
  • Transparency. We share what we know, say the hard thing kindly, and earn trust the honest way.
  • Problem/Solution. We run toward problems, not around them.
  • Quality. We deliver as if we’re the ones on the receiving end.

The result is a remote team where ideas get heard, ownership is real, and good

jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

College Board – Technology – Core Assessment Platform, Onboard

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position.


Please include a portfolio of your work in your application that shows examples of your experience leading design research initiatives, we are unable to consider applications without a portfolio link.


About the Team

The Onboard team designs and builds the experiences that welcome new institutions, educators, and learners to College Board’s digital products and guide them to their first moment of value. Onboarding is where trust is earned: the first setup flow, the first sign-in, the first roster imported, the first assessment scheduled. Our mission is to make those first steps clear, confident, and inclusive—so that every user, regardless of their technical fluency, can get set up quickly and start doing meaningful work.We sit at the intersection of identity, provisioning, and activation, partnering across product domains to turn a complex, multi-tenant setup process into an experience that feels simple and human.


About the Opportunity

As a Senior Product Designer on the Onboard team at College Board, you are a highly skilled, thoughtful, and user-centered practitioner with a passion for designing products and experiences that meet real user needs. You will facilitate product discovery, shape design strategy, and guide onboarding and activation solutions from concept through delivery. As the team's first dedicated designer, you will help lay the foundation for experiences that reach every student and educator.

This role depends on close collaboration between product owners/product managers, aligning on priorities and turning roadmap goals into clear design direction so that onboarding and activation experiences deliver on shared outcomes.


You will work across one or more cross-functional teams and products, helping to connect the dots between research, design, engineering, and company mission. You are confident working independently on features—owning the flows that get institutions provisioned and users to first value—while also seeking feedback and alignment with teammates and design leadership. You are an advocate for users and inclusive design. As a creative problem solver, you identify patterns across large systems and balance the big picture with hands-on execution, bringing clarity to complex setup, permissions, and first-run challenges while staying focused on impact.


Your responsibilities will span early-stage discovery, end-to-end product design, usability testing, accessibility, and the creation of design artifacts that support high-quality implementation. You will also contribute to our design culture through mentorship, continuous learning, and collaborative design practices.

In this role, your responsibilities include:


Product Discovery and Design Strategy (30%)

  • Design Thinking. Apply design thinking within complex education ecosystems to deeply understand the needs of new users and administrators, reframe onboarding problems, and drive the creation of intuitive, scalable, and human-centered setup and activation experiences.
  • Research. Continuously conduct and synthesize generative, formative, and evaluative research on first-run and onboarding journeys, using methods such as user interviews, usability testing, and surveys.
  • Design with Users. Facilitate workshops and co-creation sessions with institutions, educators, and internal operations teams to align on onboarding goals and uncover opportunities.
  • Data into Insights. Turn activation funnels, drop-off points, and support-ticket and operational metrics into actionable insights that reduce time-to-value.
  • Prioritization. Influence prioritization and roadmapping efforts by connecting user needs with business goals and mission, focusing on the highest-friction moments in the onboarding path.
  • User Advocacy. Champion human-centered and inclusive design principles for users who may be encountering our products for the very first time.
  • Storytelling. Use strategic storytelling to communicate onboarding vision, value, and direction across stakeholders.

Design Execution and Delivery (40%)

  • Product Design. Partner with product and engineering teams on continuous discovery to translate concepts into detailed, production-ready, extensible designs — including user flows, sitemaps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI — for setup, provisioning, and activation experiences.
  • Design Systems. Apply and contribute to design systems, ensuring visual and functional consistency across onboarding touchpoints and the products users graduate into.
  • Plain Language. Write and test onboarding content, instructions, and error messaging using plain language for clarity and accessibility.
  • Testing. Conduct usability tests and A/B tests to validate onboarding design decisions and improve completion and activation rates.
  • Accessibility. Perform accessibility audits to ensure onboarding meets inclusive design standards, so no user is blocked at the front door.
  • Responsive Design. Design for responsive, mobile-first experiences and mobile apps.
  • Artificial Intelligence. Experiment with generative AI tools to support ideation, prototyping, and smart onboarding guidance.
  • Tools. Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Dovetail to design and document work.

Collaboration and Communication (20%)

  • Collaborate. Collaborate with the Design Council, product managers, engineers, researchers, leadership, identity and platform partners, and other stakeholders throughout the design and development process.
  • Ceremonies. Participate in standups, sprint planning, design reviews, design critiques, and QA cycles.
  • Specifications. Translate design decisions into clear specifications for implementation, including edge cases and error and empty states common to onboarding.
  • Presenting. Present ideas, research findings, and designs with confidence and clarity.
  • Design Operations. Contribute to company-wide design efforts, including shared tools, systems, and templates.

Growth and Culture (10%)

  • Teaching. Mentor junior designers or peers through pairing and feedback.
  • Continuous Learning. Continuously invest in personal development and share emerging tools, trends, and provocations.
  • Organizational Support. Support design education efforts such as lunch & learns, design critiques, and by contributing to internal documentation.
  • Hiring. Participate in hiring and new hire onboarding activities.

About You

You have:

  • A portfolio of your work included in your application.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in a related field (interaction design, HCI, industrial design, information science, social sciences, computer science, graphic design, etc.) and/or equivalent years of work experience.
  • 3–7 years of experience in product or service design
  • A product design mindset and experience designing for complex, content-rich websites and applications, including strong skills in creating and communicating design artifacts, such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Proficiency in design thinking and human-centered methodologies, with the ability to reframe challenges and translate insights into actionable design direction.
  • Experience designing onboarding, first-run, setup, or account/identity experiences—or a demonstrated ability to bring clarity to complex, multi-step flows—is a strong plus.
  • Strong skills in information design, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI design, with fluency in tools like Figma, Miro, and Dovetail.
  • Experience applying generative and evaluative research methods, along with facilitation skills to lead workshops and co-creation sessions.
  • A strong understanding of design systems, responsive design, and accessibility standards, including designing for web and native mobile platforms.
  • Comfortable discussing technical constraints and collaborating with engineers to ensure design feasibility (experience with front-end technologies is a plus).
  • A commitment to inclusive, ethical, and user-centered design, with the ability to write and test content using plain language principles.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a user advocacy mindset and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience influencing without formal authority, including using data and evidence to build alignment and helping partners work through disagreement
  • Curiosity and adaptability—you’re self-motivated, continuously learning, and excited by emerging tools and trends, including generative AI.
  • The ability to travel at a minimum of 3-5 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business (including but not limited to traveling to client/user sites to engage with stakeholders).
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise such as a design portfolio review or design challenge, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

About Our Benefits and Compensation

College Board offers a competitive benefits and compensation program that attracts top talent looking to make a difference in education. As a self-sustaining non-profit, we believe in compensating employees equitably in relation to each other, their qualifications, their impact, and the relevant market.


The hiring range for a new employee in this position is $98,000 to $134,000. College Board differentiates salaries by location so where you live will narrow the portion of this range in which you can expect a salary.


Your salary will be carefully determined based on your location, relevant experience, the external labor market, and the pay of College Board employees in similar roles. College Board strives to provide our best offer up front based on this criteria.


Your salary is only one part of all that College Board offers, including but not limited to:

  • A comprehensive package designed to support the well-being of employees and their families and promote education. Our robust benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, fertility benefits, pet insurance, tuition assistance, retirement benefits, and more.
  • Recognition of exceptional performance through annual bonuses, salary growth over time through market increases, and opportunities for merit raises and promotions based on increased scope of responsibility.
  • A job that matters, a team that cares, and a place to learn, innovate and thrive.

You can expect to have transparent conversations about benefits and compensation with our recruiters throughout your application process.

jobs.excerpt: MCM Technology is a leading platform provider of unified mission‑critical operations management for the public safety sector, with more than 250 systems deployed worldwide.
jobs.description:
MCM Technology is a leading platform provider of unified mission‑critical operations management for the public safety sector, with more than 250 systems deployed worldwide. Its platform is tailored to the specific needs of public safety and enables greater readiness, accountability and efficiency by offering simple configurability and flexible integration with existing industry systems.

At MCM, we’re building technology that helps public safety and government organizations operate more efficiently, make better decisions, and serve their communities with confidence.

Our platform brings critical data and workflows into one unified system—reducing complexity, improving visibility, and empowering the people who keep our communities safe.

We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems, working with innovative technology, and contributing to a mission that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

Join us in shaping the future of public safety technology.

Role overview

MCM Technology is hiring a Staff Accountant + O2C Conversion Specialist to own the accuracy of our quote to cash cycle, from won quote to collected cash. The goal is simple: every invoice goes out right the first time and gets paid without corrections or delays.

MCM builds an asset intelligence platform for public safety agencies, including law enforcement, fire/EMS, and 911 centers. Our revenue mix is SaaS subscriptions, maintenance, and professional services. Many customers are government agencies that pay against formal purchase orders, which makes quote, invoice, and PO alignment critical to getting paid.

This role sits on a small, hands on finance team. You will run daily invoicing and cash receipts, support the Sr. Accountant and Treasury Analyst, and play a central part in moving our order to cash process from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite. Once the conversion is complete, the role transitions to owning steady state O2C operations.

Key responsibilities

Quote to cash alignment

  • Review every won quote before invoicing to confirm it matches the customer's purchase order: account number, product line, product, quantity, price, term, and billing schedule.
  • Resolve mismatches between quote, PO, and contract with Sales, Customer Success, and the customer before the invoice is issued.
  • Maintain clean customer master data, including account numbers, bill to contacts, PO numbers, and invoicing portal requirements.
  • Track open POs, PO expirations, and remaining PO balances so renewals and milestone bills aren't delayed.
  • Identify root causes of invoice discrepancies, correct them, and recommend process or system fixes.

O2C conversion (QuickBooks Online to NetSuite)

  • Map customers, items, product lines, and billing schedules from QuickBooks Online into NetSuite.
  • Convert and validate open AR, active subscriptions, and recurring billing schedules, and reconcile converted balances to the source system.
  • Help design and improve NetSuite O2C workflows: sales orders, invoicing, revenue arrangements, and cash application.
  • Document the new O2C procedures and train internal users.

Daily invoicing and cash receipts

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices, including recurring SaaS and maintenance billings, milestone billings, and credit memos.
  • Submit invoices through customer portals and agency procurement systems as required.
  • Apply daily cash receipts (lockbox, ACH, wire, check, card) to the correct invoices and customers.
  • Investigate unapplied cash and short payments.
  • Run collections follow up on past due accounts and keep AR aging current.

Close and team support

  • Support the Sr. Accountant with month end close: AR reconciliation, deferred revenue roll forward, unbilled AR, and related journal entries.
  • Support the Treasury Analyst with daily cash positioning, bank reconciliations, and cash forecasting inputs.
  • Provide audit support for revenue and AR testing.
  • Prepare billing, bookings, and AR reporting for management.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of accounting experience, with hands on billing, AR, and cash application.
  • Experience with SaaS or subscription billing: recurring invoices, renewals, co terms, and credit memos.
  • Hands on experience with both an ERP and a CRM system.
  • Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and deferred revenue.
  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliations.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to speed up reconciliations, research, and documentation.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, and comfort pushing back when a quote, PO, or invoice doesn't match.
  • Clear written communication with customers, Sales, and internal teams.

Preferred

  • NetSuite experience, ideally in billing, SuiteBilling, or Advanced Revenue Management.
  • Hands on involvement in an ERP implementation or data migration, especially QuickBooks Online to NetSuite with Salesforce as the CRM.
  • Experience billing government or public sector customers: PO driven invoicing, procurement portals, and payment terms.
  • Experience with CPQ or CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Progress toward an MBA or CPA.

Other details

  • Reports to the Sr. Accountant / VP Financeand works closely with the VPs of Sales, Operations, and Transformation.
  • Remote position, with working hours aligned to Central time.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.


Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.


The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trustworthy automated-driving products.


As the central authority for automated-driving system safety, the department brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case, including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated-driving technologies. GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion, and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision.


The Role


The AV Safety Engineering Analytics team is seeking an experienced Safety Data Analysis Engineer to provide engineering support for AV Operational Safety and Issue Response. This is a safety engineering role focused on data-driven issue response and investigation. You will combine engineering judgment, safety analysis, and strong data skills to investigate potential issues, organize event-related data, and develop evidence that supports AV Safety Assurance and AV Operational Safety decisions.


The role is designed for an engineer who is highly proficient in navigating, integrating, designing, and analyzing large-scale data. You will support rapid, highly iterative investigations involving specific vehicles, locations, software releases, event sequences, operational conditions, and other issue-relevant dimensions.


The scale of AV operations, including potential issues, actual events, readiness drills, and ongoing software releases, creates a need for rapid, detailed, event-driven analyses. At the same time, you will help convert repeatable investigation patterns into reusable analytics and issue-detection methods.


What You'll Do


  • Respond collaboratively to AV Safety Strategy and Assurance and AV Operations requests for potential issue-specific analyses, event-related data organization, and root-cause investigations.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, and Safety teams to investigate potentialAV issues and conduct root-cause analyses.
  • Translate investigation needs into clear analysis requirements, data requirements, analytical designs, and execution plans in collaboration with requesting teams.
  • Establish and support rapid incident-response and targeted-analysis capabilities that leverage standing data pipelines as well as unique issue- and incident-relevant data sources.
  • Integrate vehicle telemetry, time-series signals, event and incident records, readiness-drill data, software-release information, location and operational context, and other relevant sources into analysis-ready datasets.
  • Distinguish data-quality, sensor, instrumentation, and pipeline issues from meaningful operational outliers using engineering judgment and data validation methods.
  • Deliver concise, technically rigorous analysis findings, readouts, and evidence that help partner teams assess potential operations safety issues and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Identify investigation workflows that can be generalized into reusable metrics, detection methods, pipelines, or analysis tooling without losing the flexibility required for issue investigation.
  • Apply engineering and physics-based methods, including signal decomposition, filtering, smoothing, sampling, and feature construction, to transform noisy signals into physically meaningful representations of vehicle behavior and system performance.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)


  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a related physical science.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience analyzing large-scale time-series, telemetry, vehicle, robotics, or other engineering data, including working with Robot Operating System (ROS) logs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Python and SQL.
  • Experience with time-series analysis, including signal decomposition, filtering, smoothing, sampling, feature construction, or related signal-processing methods.
  • Experience designing and executing ad hoc analyses while recognizing opportunities to develop scalable, repeatable analytical methods.
  • Experience gathering analytical requirements, defining data needs, selecting appropriate methods, and communicating findings to partner teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous, and highly iterative investigations.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to craft fact-based reports through individual and collaborative work across safety, operations, human factors, data engineering, and emerging-issues teams.

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)


  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, advanced driver-assistance systems, robotics, transportation safety, or a related domain.
  • Experience performing AV- or SDV-specific issue detection, anomaly detection, event investigation, or root-cause analysis.
  • Experience analyzing large-scale vehicle motion, driving context, automated-driving performance, or operational data.
  • Experience developing safety performance indicators, safety monitoring methods, or evidence used in safety assurance and operations decisions.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, distributed processing, or large-scale analytics workflows.
  • Experience with BigQuery or comparable cloud data platforms.
  • Familiarity with C++ or C++-based robotics and vehicle software environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, CI/CD, version control, or related software-development workflows.
  • Experience collaborating with human-factors, operations, systems, validation, verification, or safety-assurance teams.
  • Publications, conference participation, or other demonstrated engagement in vehicle safety, robotics safety, safety analytics, or related technical work.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de ShareGateShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.
jobs.description:
À propos de ShareGate

ShareGate est le leader en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, avec plus de 100 000 professionnels TI qui comptent sur sa simplicité imbattable.

Il offre l’approche la plus simple, fiable et abordable pour migrer les données d’entreprise sur Microsoft 365.

Que ce soit Google Workspace, les disques réseaux, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, ou d’un tenant à l’autre, ShareGate s’en occupe et offre la paix d’esprit. D’une transition vers le cloud à l’intégration d’une nouvelle entreprise, il garde les choses vraiment simples.

ShareGate est aussi l’outil de prédilection pour garder le contrôle des données une fois que la migration est complétée. Ses fonctionnalités de gouvernance permettent d'évaluer rapidement les environnements M365, détecter les problèmes et apporter les correctifs nécessaires, pour que tout reste ordonné, sécurisé et optimisé. Il aide à mettre en place la fondation pour déployer avec confiance l’assistant d'IA de Microsoft.

ShareGate est développé par Workleap Technologies, une entreprise de logiciels basée à Montréal.

Ton rôle

Les utilisateurs de ShareGate génèrent plusieurs signaux pertinents (utilisation du produit, interactions avec le soutien, dates de renouvellement), mais ces signaux ne sont pas encore reliés dans un moteur qui sécurise et fait croître les revenus qu’on a déjà. Comme Architecte GTM, Expansion et rétention, tu vas concevoir, bâtir et livrer des agents IA et des flux de travail agentiques qui transforment ces signaux en renouvellements sauvés et en pipeline de ventes croisées. C’est un rôle d’ingénierie intégré au GTM, pas un rôle d’opérations en arrière-plan : tu appliqueras à la clientèle qu’on a déjà l’approche axée sur les signaux et centrée sur les agents qu’on utilise pour l’acquisition de nouveaux clients.

Ton impact :

  • Sécuriser les renouvellements en bâtissant des agents IA qui surveillent en continu la santé des renouvellements et signalent tôt les comptes à risque aux gestionnaires de comptes, avec le contexte, les prochaines étapes recommandées et assez de temps pour agir.
  • Faire croître les revenus de notre clientèle existante en concevant et en exploitant une démarche de vente croisée agentique : évaluer l’adéquation avec notre deuxième ligne de produits, faire la recherche sur chaque compte, personnaliser les messages sortants, qualifier l’intérêt et acheminer les vraies intentions d’achat vers la bonne personne en ventes, avec tout le contexte nécessaire pour conclure.
  • Assumer l’ownership du flux de données entre nos systèmes d’utilisation du produit et notre CRM pour que l’évaluation du risque de renouvellement et le ciblage de la vente croisée soient précis et fiables, y compris la qualité des données, la réputation d’expéditeur et la justesse de l’attribution.
  • Remplacer les processus manuels par des agents IA et des modules de pipeline réutilisables (pas des automatisations ponctuelles) que la gestion de comptes et les ventes peuvent exécuter et gérer de façon autonome.
  • Optimiser les deux démarches en prenant en charge les rapports sur le pipeline généré, la conversion, les résultats de renouvellement et l’impact sur les revenus, et en menant des expériences contrôlées sans ajouter d’effectifs.
  • Favoriser l’adoption en transformant tout ce que tu bâtis en procédures normalisées, démos et playbooks, pour que l’équipe utilise ce que tu livres, et pas seulement l’apprécie.

Ton équipe

Tu te joins à un effort d’ingénierie GTM qui applique déjà une approche axée sur les signaux et centrée sur les agents à l’acquisition de nouvelle clientèle, et qui la tourne maintenant vers la clientèle qu’on a déjà. Training Manager Job Description

The Training Manager assists in the development, coordination, and delivery of new hire orientation for R/BTs, BCBAs, and Licensed Psychologists, ensuring a supportive and comprehensive onboarding experience across all staff levels. The Training Manager must effectively coordinate and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure new hires have any necessary training from other Frontera departments (e.g., people operations, product, engineering, clinical operations, payor operations, etc.).

This position fully owns FronteraCare's Behavior Technician (BT) and Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) training functions across all regions. This role directly supervises the Training Support Specialist and is expected to personally execute every part of that position when needed. This position is also responsible for providing direct training to BCBAs and Psychologists as a part of the new hire training sequence and ongoing professional development. The Training Manager builds and maintains the training curriculum, schedules and audits training quality across all locations, owns training data and reporting, and drives automation and process improvement across the training pipeline. This position reports to the Head of Clinical Training.

Key Responsibilities

Training Leadership & Team Oversight

  • Supervises the Training Support Specialist(s), providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and support. This role will personally step in and execute the Training Support Specialist role during gaps, surges, or as needed.
  • Leads Behavior Technician training directly including leading training, presenting in orientation, and running clinical competencies on new hires.
  • Serves as the escalation point whenever a new hire's progress or conduct raises concern.

Training Development, Curriculum & Quality

  • Develops and updates training content, orientation materials, and supporting job aids to keep them current and effective.
  • Audits existing trainings on a recurring basis to confirm they meet quality standards, reflect current practice, and produce the intended competencies.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate or streamline training workflows and partners with the Head of Clinical Training to implement improvements.
  • Schedule and deliver BCBA-level training and collaborate with the Head of Clinical Training on other BCBA training opportunities.
  • Lead psychologist onboarding training on FronteraCare processes and tools in collaboration with Frontera Diagnostics.

Training Data & Reporting

  • Owns new hire and ongoing training data – completion status, timelines, and competency tracking – and keeps it organized, accurate, and easy to review.
  • Regularly reviews training data to identify trends, bottlenecks, or regions falling behind, and takes action to correct course.
  • Reports on training progress and quality metrics to the Head of Clinical Training.

Multi-Location Quality & Travel

  • Ensures training quality is consistent across all FronteraCare locations.
  • Travels on an approximately 90-day cadence to directly implement and reinforce training on-site at clinics outside the home region.
  • Coordinates with RBT Leads and BCBA Regional Leads at each location to confirm training practices in the field match FronteraCare standards.

Qualifications

  • Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) certification required, with at least 3 years certified as a BCBA.
  • Prior experience successfully leading BT training and BCBA training.
  • Strong instructional design, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build and revise training content from the ground up.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships across roles and levels, and to communicate clearly with diverse audiences (new hires through senior clinical staff).
  • Track record of adapting quickly to shifting priorities and taking on new or undefined tasks as organizational needs change.
  • Comfortable working hands-on – this role executes training tasks directly, not just manages them.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple open projects and priorities at once while maintaining accuracy in materials, scheduling, and documentation.
  • Able to travel regionally on a recurring (approximately every 90 days) basis.
  • Proficiency with learning management systems and Google Workspace tools (Meet, Sheets, Calendar, etc.).
  • Leadership experience working across remote/hybrid with multi-location teams.
  • Located in AZ, CO, ID, FL, GA, NC, NM, NV, TX, or UT.

Salary Exempt

SUMMARY

This position is responsible for preparing, communicating, and tracking quoting activities internally and externally across supported ARCH Cutting Tools business units. The Multi-Site Quoter serves as a flexible cross-site resource and develops a working understanding of each location’s manufacturing capabilities, equipment, processes, costs, and quoting requirements.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Estimating Responsibilities

• Respond to RFQs in a timely manner.

  • Communicate with Sales, Engineering, and Supply Chain to gather information needed to quote jobs.
  • Prepare documents needed for Quote Review.
  • Retrieve outside sourcing quotes as needed for Quote Review.
  • Schedule Quote Review with senior management and follow up as needed.
  • Complete quote entry and communicate the final quote to the customer prior to the deadline.

• Maintain the quote database.

  • Track jobs won and lost and report results to Management on a regular basis.
  • Trend jobs won and lost to improve the accuracy of the quoting process.
  • Communicate new jobs and customers to the company to keep appropriate personnel informed.
  • Understand external market trends and use available data when quoting.
  • Understand internal financial resources and use available data when quoting.

Multi-Site Responsibilities

  • Travel to various business units as needed to receive hands-on training and develop a thorough understanding of each location’s manufacturing capabilities, equipment, processes, and quoting requirements.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Estimating, Engineering, Operations, and other key personnel across supported business units.
  • Maintain regular communication with each business unit following initial training to remain current on changes to equipment, capabilities, processes, pricing, lead times, and quoting practices.
  • Serve as a cross-site quoting resource, supporting business units during periods of increased RFQ volume, staffing shortages, vacations, or other workload demands.
  • Identify opportunities to share quoting knowledge, best practices, tooling strategies, manufacturing methods, and lessons learned between business units.
  • Identify quoting and process gaps between locations and communicate opportunities for improvement, alignment, or standardization.
  • Develop the ability to independently quote work for multiple business units while applying the appropriate manufacturing capabilities, processes, costs, and quoting standards specific to each location.

Ability to apply mathematical concepts, geometry, trigonometry, and practical calculations used in quoting.

Reasoning Ability

Through our stablecoin-powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help businesses scale. Our APIs enable businesses to integrate stablecoin-enabled finance into their own products and services—from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross-border payments.

Backed by leading investors including Acorn Pacific, Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin-enabled finance.

Why Reap?

Our platform empowers businesses with borderless card issuing, seamless payments, and rich expense management tooling. At the core of our offering is the Reap Card—a modern, stablecoin-enabled Visa commercial card solution that unlocks flexible spend controls, global acceptance, and real-time reconciliation for businesses of all sizes.

For developers and partners, Reap also offers a powerful Card Issuing API and white-labelled card program infrastructure—enabling businesses to launch their own branded corporate card experiences with full control over issuance, authorization, funding, and user management. Whether through our dashboard or API, Reap helps companies embed financial services into their workflows with scale, compliance, and flexibility.

The Card team is now scaling Reap's card infrastructure into new markets — bringing card issuing capability to new regulatory environments, BIN sponsors, and client segments.

What You’ll Do

As an Engineering Manager for Card Market Expansion, you will lead the engineering effort to launch and sustain Reap's card programs across new markets. You'll own the end-to-end engineering delivery for market entry: from local regulatory integration and processor configuration, to coordinating cross-team dependencies (Treasury, Onboarding, Compliance, Infrastructure, and Data Warehouse), to ensuring stable, supported operations after go-live.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on leadership role that sits at the intersection of product delivery, compliance requirements, and cross-functional engineering. You'll guide engineering strategy, participate in technical design, and be instrumental in shaping how Reap scales its card issuing infrastructure across multiple regulatory environments.

1. Market Localisation & Regulatory Integration

  • Own the engineering workstream for card program compliance across new markets — including local Visa/Mastercard network rules, BIN sponsor obligations, open banking requirements, and regional regulatory frameworks

  • Integrate with local vendors, issuer processors, and BIN sponsor systems to meet market-specific technical requirements

  • Partner with Product, Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into clearly scoped engineering deliverables

2. Cross-Team Launch Coordination

  • Drive sequenced delivery across all dependent teams: Card Platform, Treasury/Ledger, Onboarding/KYC-KYB, Regulatory Reporting, Chargeback/Disputes, Infrastructure, Data Warehouse, and Security Governance

  • Own the cross-team engineering plan for each market launch — surfacing blockers early, managing timelines, and keeping stakeholders aligned

  • Partner with Product and Country Leads to translate market requirements into scoped, deliverable milestones

3. BAU Ownership & Post-Launch Stability

  • Establish on-call runbooks, incident response playbooks, and SLAs for each live market

  • Own engineering stability post-launch: monitoring, alerting, and incident management across active regions

  • Drive continuous improvement based on production signals — auth failures, chargebacks, reconciliation issues, and SLA breaches

4. Core Card System Enhancements

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of the core card platform in parallel with market expansion work — identifying gaps, proposing improvements, and collaborating with other Card EMs on shared infrastructure

  • Ensure market-specific requirements are implemented in a way that strengthens the core system — favouring extensible, reusable solutions over one-off localisations

  • Balance market delivery velocity with long-term platform health and engineering quality

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years in a technical leadership or management role

  • Proven experience in building and operating systems in one or more of the following: payments, risk/fraud systems, card infrastructure, financial reconciliation, or API platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering initiatives and drive architectural decisions

  • Strong systems thinking; ability to design fault-tolerant, observable, and scalable services

  • Hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and peer review, and value working closely with others who do the same

  • Communicate clearly, challenge ideas respectfully, and help raise the quality of the whole team

  • Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, and AWS, but we value strong engineering fundamentals over any specific toolset

Nice to Have

  • Experience working on high-availability financial systems with real-time transaction processing

  • Experience with card networks (Visa, Mastercard) and card lifecycle management

  • Exposure to 3DS, tokenization, digital wallets, and PCI compliance

  • Experience leading teams in high-growth, fast-paced environments

  • Familiarity with observability tools (e.g., NewRelic, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) and CI/CD automation

  • Experience launching card programs in new geographies — including regulatory onboarding, issuer processor integration, and BIN sponsor coordination

  • Familiarity with financial regulations across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., PSD2, GDPR, open banking frameworks, US money transmission, FinCEN requirements, regional Visa/Mastercard rules)

  • Track record of driving cross-functional delivery across teams with shared dependencies (ledger, KYC, compliance, infrastructure)

  • AI/LLM-assisted development familiarity

Your Adventure Benefits

  • A high-impact role in a rapidly growing fintech startup

  • Flexible remote work environment with a global, collaborative team

  • Insurance coverage after probation

  • Reap Card stipend

  • Use of AI tools at work — and the space to learn, experiment, and grow with them

  • A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning

jobs.title: Performance Marketer (m/w/d) - Meta Ads × AI × Creative Strategy | E-Commerce, O
jobs.excerpt: Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien.
jobs.description:
Die meisten Performance Marketer können eines von dreien. Wir suchen jemanden, der alle drei verbindet.

Erstens: Performance. Du führst Meta-Ads-Accounts für hochpreisigen E-Commerce - Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, lange Kaufentscheidungen, komplexe Customer Journeys. Du steuerst nach Geschäftszahlen (CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER), nicht nach Plattform-ROAS. Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Wenn du verstehst, warum das richtig sein kann, bist du hier richtig.

Zweitens: AI - richtig eingesetzt. Wir sind eine AI-native Agentur. Das heißt bei uns: eigene MCP-Anbindung an die Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits und Anomalie-Erkennung, selbstgebaute Skills für Angle-Entwicklung und Skript-Bau. Diese Werkzeuge sollst du nicht bedienen wie ein Formular, sondern führen wie ein Instrument: AI übernimmt das Wie (Analysen strukturieren, Varianten bauen, Daten durchkämmen), die Hypothese - das Was - bleibt deine. Wer jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, produziert denselben Output, den jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell auch bekommt. Beides scheidet aus.

Drittens: Creative Strategy. Bei High-AOV entscheidet das Creative, nicht der Kampagnen-Setup-Trick. Du musst keine Creatives produzieren, aber du musst sie lesen können: Warum gewinnt dieser Winner? Welches Segment, welche Kaufhürde, welcher Beweis fehlt im Funnel? Du entwickelst mit dem Creative-Team Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → Angle), verstehst, warum ein kalter Markt andere Hooks braucht als ein heißer, und liest Creative-Performance jenseits von Hook Rate und Thumbstop.

Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio und dem Anspruch, in unserer Nische die Beste in Deutschland zu sein. Unsere Kunden kaufen Urteilsvermögen, kein Button-Pushing: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und nicht nur Anzeigen ins System tippen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst Accounts end-to-end: Audit → Hypothese → Test-Plan → Skalierung → Reporting.
  • Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers und inkrementellen KPIs; du verstehst warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht.
  • Du nutzt unseren AI-Stack als Standard-Werkzeug. Account-Audits, Breakdown-Analysen und Anomalie-Erkennung laufen AI-gestützt; du lieferst die Fragestellung, prüfst den Output und triffst die Entscheidung.
  • Du dekodierst Creative-Performance: Du erkennst, warum ein Winner gewinnt (Hook, Mechanismus, Einwandbehandlung, Proof), und übersetzt das in die nächste Test-Hypothese.
  • Du bringst eigene Angle- und Set-Piece-Hypothesen in die Creative-Planung ein: Welches Segment ist unterversorgt, welche Kaufhürde unbeantwortet, welches Stück Customer Journey fehlt.
  • Du sagst Kunden die harte Wahrheit, wenn der Bottleneck das Offer, die Landingpage oder das Produkt ist und nicht die Ads. Und du lieferst dazu immer einen Alternativweg.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Führen von Meta-Ads-Accounts mit relevantem Budget
  • Du arbeitest täglich und tief mit AI: eigene Prompts und Workflows, Erfahrung mit LLM-gestützter Analyse. Du kannst konkret zeigen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
  • Du kannst eine fremde Winning-Ad auseinandernehmen und erklären, warum sie funktioniert. Nicht "gutes Video", sondern Zielgruppe, Mechanismus, Beweisführung.
  • Du kennst die Grundlogik von Awareness- und Sophistication-Stufen (Schwartz) oder Vergleichbares aus der Praxis: verschiedene Bewusstseinsstufen brauchen verschiedene Botschaften.
  • Du denkst in Geschäftszahlen und verstehst ROAS ≠ Deckungsbeitrag
  • Du hast die Geduld für lange Journeys, die Disziplin, einem System zu folgen, und bist konfrontationsfähig gegenüber Kunden.

Benefits

  • Eine Rolle am Schnittpunkt von Performance, AI und Creative - mit Werkzeugen, die wir selbst bauen statt einkaufen.
  • Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
  • Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.
  • Kompetitiver Gehalt basierend auf deinem Erfahrungslevel
  • Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht.
  • Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work sind bei uns keine Fremdwörter.
  • Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten.
  • Nette, professionelle und sorgfältig ausgesuchte Kunden - die dein Leben definitiv NICHT zur Hölle machen. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden auf Augenhöhe.

So läuft die Bewerbung:

  1. Kurzbewerbung - Im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: Ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon.
  2. 2 x Gespräche - 1x mit Geschäftsführer & 1x mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung.
  3. Eine kompakte Probearbeit an einem realen Szenario. AI-Einsatz ist dabei ausdrücklich erlaubt und erwünscht - uns interessiert, wo du sie einsetzt und wo bewusst nicht.

Du erkennst dich wieder? Dann bewirb dich.
