jobs.title: Lead IT GRC Analyst (Policy Management)
jobs.excerpt: The Lead IT GRC Analyst will lead the operational execution, integration, and continuous improvement of the Cyber Governance & Controls function.
jobs.description:
The Lead IT GRC Analyst will lead the operational execution, integration, and continuous improvement of the Cyber Governance & Controls function. This role will support turning a broad portfolio of governance work including policies, standards, configuration baselines, Cybersecurity Risk Acceptance Memoranda, long-term governance models, control libraries, and governance advisory engagements into a coordinated, measurable enterprise service.

The successful candidate will serve as the operational leader connecting Governance strategy to day-to-day execution. The role will partner across Cybersecurity, Operations & Technology, Legal, Privacy, Audit, Procurement, and various business stakeholders to establish clear ownership, decision rights, evidence, review cadences, exception paths, and sustainable control outcomes.

This role enables delivery across eight connected service lines: policy and standards lifecycle management; security baselines and control governance; vendor security management; continuous third-party monitoring; GRC tooling and workflow automation; data protection governance; program governance advisory; and regulatory, audit, and standards interpretation. The position is differentiated from traditional project management by its accountability for the operating health, maturity, adoption, traceability, and effectiveness of Governance itself.

Responsibilities

Governance Operations

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Governance operating procedures, playbooks, lifecycle schedules, decision records, and recurring operating rhythms.
  • Coordinate policy forums, standards review, governance working sessions, steering decisions, escalations, action-item closure, and quarterly operating reviews.
  • Serve as coordinator for the Global Cybersecurity Governance Steering Committee, including agenda planning, materials, stakeholder alignment, decision tracking, action-item follow-through, and governance reporting.
  • Chair the Global Cybersecurity Governance Working Group, facilitating cross-functional discussion, driving alignment on governance priorities, escalating decisions as needed, and ensuring actions are assigned, documented, and completed.
  • Define and maintain roles, decision rights, RACIs, reviewers, approvers, accountable service owners, evidence expectations, and exception paths across Governance services.
  • Establish a consistent definition of done for governance outcomes spanning ownership, documented requirements, operational process, automation, monitoring, metrics, exceptions, and recurring review.
  • Separate administrative, technical, and operational governance so that requirements are not only approved, but implemented, monitored, evidenced, and sustained.

Policy, Standards, Baselines & Risk Acceptance Governance

  • Operate the end-to-end lifecycle for cyber policies, standards, configuration baselines, procedures, and supporting guidance, including intake, drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, communication, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Maintain the Cyber Policy Library, authoritative document hierarchy, review calendar, approval evidence, version history, control mappings, glossary, and publication quality controls.
  • Coordinate development and renewal of Cybersecurity Risk Acceptance Memoranda, including validated current-state data, residual-risk statements, accountable owners, corrective-action plans, milestones, approval records, audit dependencies, reporting, and retirement criteria.
  • Help transition broad, recurring risk acceptances toward targeted, risk-based exception and monitoring processes where sustainable ownership and evidence can be established.
  • Support requirement-centric governance by mapping policies, standards, baselines, and controls to authoritative frameworks and identifying opportunities to automate governance workflows, document reviews, approval processes, and evidence collection.

Service Management & Enablement

  • Maintain the Cyber Governance & Controls service catalog, definitions, owners, RACIs, inputs, outputs, dependencies, intake paths, service levels, and records of authority.
  • Coordinate operational visibility across policy and standards, control baselines, vendor security, continuous third-party monitoring, GRC tooling, data protection, governance advisory, and audit and standards interpretation.
  • Develop and administer common intake, triage, prioritization, status, decision, escalation, evidence, and closure practices while preserving accountability with service owners.

jobs.description:
Senior Pixel Artist (Stylized Games | 2D Art)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Pixel Artist with exceptional artistic taste and a passion for creating distinctive, expressive, and visually memorable pixel art for game development.

We believe great pixel art is more than working with a limited number of pixels. Every shape, color, and detail should serve a purpose, communicating personality, readability, and visual identity through carefully considered design.

In this role, you will create high-quality pixel art assets and help establish a cohesive visual language across game content, collaborating closely with Art Directors, Concept Artists, Animators, and Technical Artists.

This is a senior, hands-on role for an artist who combines strong traditional art fundamentals with exceptional pixel art craftsmanship and an instinct for creating visually appealing designs.

Key Responsibilities

Pixel Art Creation & Design

  • Create high-quality pixel art assets, including characters, creatures, props, environments, icons, and other game content.

  • Establish strong silhouettes, color palettes, proportions, and visual readability across assets.

  • Translate creative briefs and concept art into polished pixel-based designs.

  • Create distinctive characters and objects with strong visual appeal and recognizable personalities.

  • Balance artistic detail with stylistic consistency and clarity at different resolutions.

Visual Style & Quality

  • Help define and maintain pixel art standards, including pixel density, palette consistency, shading, and level of detail.

  • Explore creative visual solutions within the constraints of a pixel-based art style.

  • Ensure assets work cohesively alongside other stylized game content.

  • Create visual references, style explorations, and production-ready assets.

  • Identify and refine small details that significantly improve character appeal and artistic quality.

Production & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Concept Artists, Animators, and Technical Artists.

  • Prepare assets for efficient integration into game engines.

  • Participate in artistic reviews and provide constructive feedback when needed.

  • Maintain organized, reusable, and production-friendly asset structures.

  • Proactively contribute creative ideas that strengthen the overall visual identity of the project.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in pixel art, 2D game art, or related disciplines.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating high-quality pixel art and strong artistic fundamentals.

  • Excellent understanding of color theory, composition, silhouettes, shape language, and visual hierarchy.

  • Strong proficiency in pixel art tools such as Aseprite, Photoshop, or equivalent software.

  • Ability to create visually distinctive characters, props, and environments within a consistent pixel art style.

  • Strong attention to pixel placement, color relationships, shading, and detail.

  • Understanding of game art production pipelines and real-time asset requirements.

  • Ability to create production-ready assets and maintain consistency across large asset collections.

  • Strong artistic judgment, independent problem-solving, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with pixel art animation, spritesheets, and frame-by-frame workflows.

  • Familiarity with voxel art and stylized 3D aesthetics.

  • Experience with Unity3D or other real-time game engines.

  • Knowledge of tilesets, tilemaps, and modular pixel art environments.

  • Experience with character design, visual storytelling, and animation.

  • Experience establishing pixel art style guides and production pipelines.

  • Familiarity with mobile game art production and resolution constraints.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to create visually distinctive pixel art for game development projects.

  • High artistic ownership and influence over pixel art quality and visual consistency.

  • Collaboration with experienced artists and international creative teams.

  • Remote-friendly working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Create Art with Personality in Every Pixel?

Send us your portfolio and a short introduction. We would love to see pixel art that demonstrates exceptional artistic taste, visual clarity, creativity, and character.

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.excerpt: Who we are:At Wagepoint, we're good people.  It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Teamby collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kindby challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The Role:

We're looking for a talented Principal Software Development Engineer - Applied AI, who enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada.

You'll set the technical strategy for AI Products at Wagepoint, authoring the architecture decision records that define platform boundaries, persistence standards, and quality gates for every team building AI features, and setting the guardrails that let Engineering teams experiment with agentic AI. You will report directly to our VP, Engineering on a team of other Principal and Staff level engineers.

You'll keep Wagepoint's AI platform choices current against a fast-moving landscape, articulate tradeoffs in terms leadership can act on, and multiply the org through mentorship, pairing with and unblocking the engineers building on your standards.

Like every engineer at Wagepoint, you do not write software by hand. You're a major contributor to the software factory, the agentic pipeline of specs, agent implementation, agent review, and human approval that produces our software. You'll own specific agents within it and work with your teammates to constantly improve the factory itself.

Your primary mandate is to build customer-facing AI products. About 85% of your time will go toward designing, coding, shipping, and supporting AI experiences used directly by Wagepoint customers, along with the platform capabilities needed to power them. The remainder will support Wagepoint’s internal use of AI and our software factory.

This is a hands-on product engineering role with broad technical leadership scope. You will lead by building, stay close to customers and production, and make architecture decisions grounded in real product delivery. Your impact will be measured by the customer value you ship, the quality of the systems you build, and your ability to raise the capabilities of engineers across Wagepoint.

What You'll Be Expected To Own:

  • Build, ship, monitor, support, and continuously improve customer-facing AI products that solve meaningful payroll and workforce problems.

  • Turn ambiguous customer needs into intuitive AI experiences, combining strong product judgment with rapid prototyping, production code, and direct learning from usage.

  • Lead the architecture of distributed, customer-facing systems where AI intersects with the product stack, using Clean Architecture to establish clear boundaries.

  • Build the production services, shared libraries, critical integrations, and platform capabilities required to deliver reliable AI products at scale.

  • Make consequential decisions across models, orchestration, evals, observability, persistence, and vendors using product requirements, prototypes, benchmarks, and cost models.

  • Establish and implement quality gates for customer-facing AI, including evals in CI/CD, drift monitoring, release criteria, operational observability, and customer-impact measures.

  • Stay close to production by reviewing critical code and designs, diagnosing incidents, improving performance, and supporting the AI products customers depend on every day.

  • Build security, resource-isolation, and agentic-workflow guardrails appropriate for payroll, tax reporting, and other sensitive customer experiences.

What You Bring To The Table:

  • At least 18 months of recent, continuous experience personally building, shipping, and supporting active customer-facing AI products in production.

  • Strong product taste, with a record of turning emerging AI capabilities into useful, trustworthy experiences that customers understand and choose to use.

  • Significant software engineering experience with Staff-level scope or equivalent, plus a clear desire to remain deeply involved in coding and delivery.

  • Experience owning the full lifecycle of AI products, from customer problem and prototype through evaluation, launch, production operations, and iteration.

  • Strong distributed-systems and full-stack architecture experience across modern front ends and Python back ends; .NET/C# experience is helpful but not required.

  • Practical knowledge of Clean Architecture and the judgment to turn ambiguous problems into maintainable production systems.

  • Fluency in the modern AI platform landscape, including model selection, agent orchestration, MCP and inter-agent interoperability, eval-gated delivery, observability, and vector-enabled persistence.

  • Strong product, security, and business judgment, with the ability to make and communicate decisions using customer value, quality, cost, latency, control, risk, and optionality.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

Ingénieur ou ingénieure en chef, développement logiciel – IA appliquée

Qui sommes-nous :

Chez Wagepoint, nous sommes du bon monde. Et c'est facile à ressentir quand on est entouré de personnes qui réalisent le meilleur travail de leur carrière, à créer un logiciel de paie remarquable pour les petites entreprises de partout au Canada.

Notre équipe réunit des parcours, des perspectives, des expériences et des idées variés pour faire de la paie la partie la plus simple de la gestion d'une entreprise.

Le télétravail est notre norme, nous sommes en pleine croissance et nous cherchons des personnes passionnées qui ne se contentent pas de la première solution venue ni de la façon dont les choses ont toujours été faites. Nous tenons profondément à nos clients comme les uns aux autres, et nous savons qu'en matière de paie, l'exactitude compte.

Nos valeurs orientent notre façon de travailler et ce que nous attendons les uns des autres :

  • Cultiver l'impact en nous concentrant sur l'essentiel et en offrant des résultats concrets à nos clients.

  • Ne faire qu'une équipe en collaborant ouvertement, en communiquant clairement et en nous ralliant autour d'objectifs communs.

  • Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance en remettant en question les idées reçues, en apprenant rapidement et en agissant avec empathie.

Si vous voulez bâtir l'avenir de la paie dans un milieu où vos idées sont accueillies et où votre contribution compte, ne cherchez pas plus loin !

Le rôle :

Nous cherchons une personne de talent au poste d'ingénieur ou ingénieure en chef, développement logiciel – IA appliquée, qui aime s'attaquer à des problèmes difficiles et souhaite avoir un impact réel pour les petites entreprises partout au Canada. Vous définirez la stratégie technique des produits d'IA de Wagepoint : vous rédigerez les registres de décisions d'architecture qui établissent les frontières de la plateforme, les normes de persistance et les points de contrôle de la qualité pour chaque équipe qui conçoit des fonctionnalités d'IA, et vous mettrez en place les garde-fous qui permettent aux équipes d'ingénierie d'expérimenter avec l'IA agentique. Vous relèverez directement de notre vice-présidence, Ingénierie.

Vos décisions sont celles que les propositions des autres ingénieurs devront citer et respecter. Les feuilles de route d'autres équipes dépendent de la justesse de vos choix. Vous maintiendrez à jour les choix de plateforme d'IA de Wagepoint dans un contexte en évolution rapide, vous exposerez les compromis en des termes sur lesquels la direction peut agir, et vous démultiplierez l'organisation par le mentorat, en travaillant en binôme avec les ingénieurs qui s'appuient sur vos normes et en levant leurs obstacles.

Comme tout ingénieur ou ingénieure en chef chez Wagepoint, vous exercerez aussi un leadership architectural étendu au-delà de l'IA, notamment des systèmes distribués bien conçus et hautement performants, ainsi que des pratiques de développement augmentées par l'IA tout au long du cycle de vie du logiciel (SDLC).

Comme tout le personnel d'ingénierie chez Wagepoint, vous n'écrivez pas de logiciel à la main. Vous contribuez de façon majeure à l'usine logicielle, ce pipeline agentique de spécifications, d'implémentation par des agents, de révision par des agents et d'approbation humaine qui produit nos logiciels. Vous serez responsable de certains agents au sein de cette usine et vous travaillerez avec vos coéquipiers à l'améliorer sans cesse.

L'objectif de Wagepoint est d'atteindre le niveau 4 de notre échelle de développement agentique (les ingénieurs approuvent la spécification, les agents implémentent et révisent, les ingénieurs approuvent la PR), puis de progresser vers le niveau 5 au fil du temps, sans jamais compromettre la qualité dans notre environnement de paie et de déclaration fiscale hautement réglementé. C'est à vous qu'il revient de rendre cette transition possible.

85 % de votre attention va aux produits d'IA destinés aux clients et à la plateforme qui les soutient. Le reste sert à développer l'usage interne de l'IA chez Wagepoint et notre usine logicielle.

Ce poste se mesure à l'étendue de votre influence, et pas seulement à votre production personnelle.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Rédiger les registres de décisions qui définissent la façon dont l'IA est conçue dans toute l'organisation, et lever les ambiguïtés interéquipes au moyen de décisions écrites et référencées.

  • Définir et maintenir la frontière entre les services d'IA et la pile de produits, et être responsable de la trousse de services partagés.

  • Prendre des décisions de plateforme quantifiées (évaluations, observabilité, persistance) à partir de fournisseurs nommés et de modèles de coûts.

  • Définir la façon dont chaque équipe d'IA contrôle la qualité : normes d'évaluation dans les chaînes CI/CD, surveillance de la dérive et critères de mise en production.

  • Établir les garde-fous d'isolement des ressources et de flux de travail agentiques, et assumer la posture d'IA responsable et d'auditabilité à l'échelle de l'organisation.

  • Maintenir les choix de plateforme à jour selon l'évolution du domaine, et publier des notes de vérification datées ainsi que des critères de réévaluation.

  • Diriger la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, distribués et destinés aux clients, là où l'IA croise la pile de produits, et appliquer la conception pilotée par le domaine (DDD) pour définir les frontières de domaine.

  • Être une personne-ressource technique de référence pour les équipes, débloquer les initiatives à fort impact et façonner les normes d'ingénierie au moyen de RFC et de revues.

  • Tracer, pour toute l'organisation, le chemin depuis la situation actuelle jusqu'au niveau 4 de l'échelle de développement agentique, puis vers le niveau 5, tout en maintenant le niveau de qualité et de conformité qu'exigent la paie et la déclaration fiscale.

Ce que vous apportez :

  • Plus de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle en génie logiciel, avec un impact grandissant, dont plusieurs années à concevoir et à exploiter des systèmes LLM ou agentiques en production, à un niveau de responsabilité principal ou supérieur.

  • Un leadership technique éprouvé dans la conception de systèmes distribués et de microservices pour des domaines complexes, avec une connaissance pratique des principes de la conception pilotée par le domaine (DDD) et de la Clean Architecture appliqués à la création de systèmes performants et bien conçus (une expérience préalable de projets DDD n'est pas exigée).

  • Une polyvalence full stack, allant des cadriciels front-end modernes à un back-end Python, suffisante pour diriger l'architecture de l'ensemble de la pile de produits, et pas seulement des services d'IA. Une expérience de .NET ou C# est un atout, mais non une exigence.

  • Un bilan de rédaction de normes d'architecture adoptées au-delà de votre propre équipe, avec des registres de décisions que d'autres ingénieurs chevronnés révisent, citent et utilisent comme point de départ.

  • Des décisions « faire ou acheter » quantifiées et démontrées, comparant des fournisseurs nommés (p. ex. plateformes d'évaluation ou d'observabilité, magasins de vecteurs), avec des modèles de coûts et des solutions écartées explicitement.

  • Une connaissance approfondie du paysage actuel des plateformes d'IA : orchestration d'agents à état, interopérabilité MCP et interagents (A2A), chaînes CI/CD conditionnées par des évaluations, et persistance vectorielle (PostgreSQL/pgvector, indexation de type DiskANN, offres gérées).

  • Une vision réfléchie de ce que devrait être la stratégie de modèles de Wagepoint dans deux ans, y compris s'il convient d'adopter des petits modèles de langage affinés plutôt que des API de pointe, et à quels endroits, en tenant compte des compromis de coût, de latence et de contrôle.

  • De l'expérience dans la définition des frontières entre une pile d'IA et une pile de produits existante (p. ex. des services d'IA en Python aux côtés de .NET), y compris des bibliothèques de trousses de services partagés que d'autres équipes utilisent.

  • Un leadership en sécurité et en gouvernance : isolement des ressources, garde-fous des flux de travail agentiques et IA responsable dans un domaine réglementé où circule de l'argent.

  • Une communication de niveau exécutif, capable d'exposer les compromis de plateforme en des termes sur lesquels la direction peut agir — coût, risque et marge de manœuvre —, au-delà des seuls détails techniques.

  • Une grande autonomie d'action : créer des systèmes inédits et optimiser la performance des API là où aucun modèle établi n'existe, ouvrir la voie plutôt que d'attendre qu'on la trace, et savoir y entraîner les autres ingénieurs.

  • Un effet démultiplicateur démontré par le mentorat : travailler en binôme avec des ingénieurs chevronnés, lever leurs obstacles et les faire progresser.

  • Une contribution passionnée et déterminante à l'usine logicielle de Wagepoint : diriger et réviser le développement agentique tout en maintenant et en rehaussant notre haut niveau de qualité et de conformité.

Culture :Travaillez aux côtés d'une équipe qui aime vraiment résoudre des problèmes ensemble, qui célèbre ses réussites, qui se soutient dans les moments difficiles et qui trouve toujours le temps pour une mauvaise blague à l'occasion.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authorization Optimization
jobs.excerpt: At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers.
jobs.description:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our authorization optimization product area, where payments and fraud decisioning meet. You will own authorization rate improvement for legitimate transactions. Set the strategy, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and drive delivery across existing capability teams.

This is a hands-on, technical product role. You will translate strategy into precise requirements, define the data and API interfaces that connect us with merchants, payment service providers and issuers, and be the product voice in architecture discussions. You will work daily with engineering and data science, and alongside go-to-market teams who bring the product to merchants.

What you'll do

  • Own the authorization optimization roadmap end to end: set priorities, sequence delivery, make tradeoffs, and communicate the plan and its rationale to leadership, engineering and go-to-market teams.
  • Determine where Signifyd should build, orchestrate, partner or influence issuers directly, informed by issuer behavior, merchant needs and regional payment dynamics.
  • Write detailed technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage the backlog with engineering.
  • Define and evolve the APIs, data models and integration points through which authorization and decline data flows between merchants, PSPs, issuers and our platform.
  • Identify, evaluate and develop new partnerships (such as PSPs, gateways, acquirers, issuers and data or technology providers) that expand our coverage and deliver measurable value to merchants.
  • Build issuer/BIN intelligence covering authorization performance, decline patterns and treatment effectiveness. Maintain a quantified opportunity map to prioritize recoverable revenue.
  • Drive issuer-specific decisioning across step-ups, 3DS, decline recovery and intelligent retries; inform routing where merchants have multiple PSP or acquirer options.
  • Work with data science to define requirements for risk-aware decisioning, balancing approval gains against fraud and chargeback exposure.
  • Own measurable authorization uplift and recovered merchant revenue. Demonstrate treatment impact through merchant proofs of value and issuer/BIN-level reporting.
  • Partner with sales, solutions and customer success to bring merchant feedback into the roadmap and support adoption.
  • Stay current on card network rules, regulation and industry practice, and use that knowledge to sharpen requirements.

What you'll bring (required)

  • 5+ years in a product management role, including ownership of a roadmap and end-to-end delivery.
  • Hands-on payments product experience spanning issuer authorization behavior, with a deep understanding of decline recovery and retries, 3DS, PSD2/SCA frameworks (including the upcoming transition to PSD3/PSR), and demonstrated improvements in authorization performance.
  • Experience writing detailed technical specs and defining APIs or data interfaces in partnership with engineering (backend or high-volume transaction systems a plus).
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort working from transaction-level data and defining success metrics.
  • Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams and translating insights into product requirements.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience at a payment processor, PSP, acquirer, card network, issuer or fraud/risk vendor.
  • Exposure to fraud, risk or digital identity products, including the false-decline versus fraud-loss tradeoff.
  • Experience defining requirements for ML-driven decisioning.
  • Familiarity with 3DS/EMVCo, tokenization, ISO 8583 and PSD2/SCA.
  • B2B SaaS or enterprise e-commerce merchant experience.

Benefits in our US offices:

  • Discretionary Time Off Policy (Unlimited!)
  • 401K Match
  • Stock Options
  • Annual Performance Bonus or Commissions
  • Paid Parental Leave (12 weeks)
  • On-Demand Therapy for all employees & their dependents
  • Dedicated learning budget through Learnerbly
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Company Social Events
  • Signifyd Swag

Compensation:

In the United States, each work location is assigned a specific pay zone, which determines the salary range for a given position. The starting base salary for the selected candidate will be based on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and current market conditions.

Base Salary Ranges by Pay Zone:

  • Tier 1 (NYC/SF Bay Area/Seattle): $165,000 – $205,000 annually
  • Tier 2 (DC Metro/Austin/Chicago/Denver/Boston/Los Angeles/San Diego): $155,000 – $195,000 annually
  • Tier 3 (US - All Other): $145,000 – $185,000 annually

Equity: This role is eligible for a stock option grant of 7,000 stock options, based on the position level and internal compensation guidelines.

Bonus: This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 10% of base salary.

We want to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Overview• Location: Remote within the United States, with substantial overlap with East Coast working hours, or based in Zurich, Switzerland.
jobs.description:
Overview

  • Location: Remote within the United States, with substantial overlap with East Coast working hours, or based in Zurich, Switzerland. Regular collaboration with engineering teams and periodic hands-on laboratory work are essential to the role.
  • Travel: Approximately 5–10% (4–6 trips annually) for engineering collaboration, key customer milestones, and company retreats.
  • Type: Full-time
  • Department: Engineering
  • Level: IC4, Staff Embedded Engineer (individual contributor)

Who We Are:

Resonant Link Medical is pioneering the future of wireless power and data transfer for implantable medical devices to help people get well and stay well. We’re committed to revolutionizing patient care by delivering high-performance, reliable, and efficient wireless charging solutions that eliminate the burden of frequent battery-replacement surgeries, improve patient outcomes, and enable better care outside hospital settings. We’ve designed our first-of-its-kind wireless charging technology into more than 50 types of medical devices and support customers around the world from our offices in Burlington, Vermont; Cambridge, Massachusetts; and Zurich, Switzerland.

Resonant Link Medical is looking for an exceptional Staff Embedded Engineer to help define the next generation of wireless power systems for implantable medical devices. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of embedded software, advanced power electronics, and medical technology, developing firmware that enables smaller, smarter, and longer-lasting implanted devices.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will have substantial ownership of firmware architecture and development across multiple product platforms, working directly with experts in electromagnetics, controls, and electrical engineering to turn breakthrough technology into reliable, production-ready systems.

Working closely with our electrical, controls, systems, quality, and test engineers, you will lead the development of robust, production-ready firmware while establishing RLM's internal software development capabilities in accordance with IEC 62304. You will help build the engineering practices, processes, and technical foundation needed to support our growing portfolio of medical device technologies, including software-related safety requirements and risk controls supporting IEC 60601 compliance. You will bring sound engineering judgment to architecture, coding, verification, and documentation, while remaining actively involved in development and hardware–software debugging. With meaningful technical ownership and support from experts across disciplines, you will connect leading-edge R&D to reliable products that improve people’s lives.

At Resonant Link Medical, we’re committed to building a collaborative culture that spans disciplines and geographies. To help us deliver on our mission, we’re looking for detail-oriented problem solvers and empathetic team players who are accountable, self-directed, and comfortable working in a quickly growing and evolving business. If you thrive in a high-impact, hands-on environment and are excited to help advance promising medical technology, this is the role for you.

Your typical day will involve…

  • Owning embedded software development across RLM’s product platforms, taking work from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification, and release.
  • Shaping firmware architecture and technical direction across RLM's product platforms, establishing scalable, maintainable software designs that simplify integration, enable new capabilities, and support long-term product evolution.
  • Establishing and owning RLM's internal IEC 62304 software development practices, creating practical, scalable processes for requirements management, software architecture, risk controls, traceability, verification, and release documentation in partnership with systems and quality engineers.
  • Building internal software development expertise, strengthening RLM's engineering capabilities and reducing reliance on external development resources while maintaining a high standard of technical execution and regulatory rigor.
  • Owning software safety requirements and risk controls supporting IEC 60601 compliance, implementing protective measures and verifying that the system responds correctly to faults.
  • Developing and refining production firmware, building drivers, hardware interfaces, communications, and charging functions that deliver consistent, reliable system behavior.
  • Working alongside controls and electrical engineering experts to integrate new charging capabilities into robust, testable product firmware.
  • Getting hands-on with hardware and firmware integration and debugging, using schematics and laboratory tools to identify root causes and resolve issues affecting system performance.
  • Defining and implementing software verification strategies, developing automated tests that catch regressions and working with the testing team to verify requirements.
  • Creating clear, useful technical documentation, making design decisions easy to understand and requirements traceable through implementation and verification.
  • Bringing new features from concept to release, balancing technical tradeoffs and seeing your work operating on real hardware.
  • Providing hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration, elevating engineering practices while remaining actively involved in implementation and debugging.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience developing embedded software in accordance with IEC 62304, with a strong understanding of software lifecycle processes, requirements management, architecture, risk controls, traceability, verification, and release documentation. Capable of establishing, owning, and continuously improving a practical, scalable software development lifecycle appropriate for a growing medical technology company.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex embedded software development, with the ability to independently drive architecture, implementation, hardware integration, verification, and production release. Experience successfully delivering embedded firmware in commercial products and collaborating effectively across engineering disciplines.
  • Strong embedded C and firmware architecture skills, including experience with resource-constrained MCUs, RTOS-based and bare-metal systems, peripheral interfaces, and clear, maintainable, testable production code.
  • Strong practical electronics knowledge and hands-on hardware-software integration experience, including board bring-up, schematic interpretation, debugging complex interactions between firmware and electronics, and using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and firmware debuggers to resolve system-level issues.
  • Strong verification, documentation, and communication skills, with experience developing software tests, explaining technical decisions, and maintaining clear development records. Comfortable moving between coding, lab work, and lifecycle activities in a growing company, while helping establish effective engineering practices and standards.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with power electronics, closed-loop control, or wireless power-transfer systems.

Values and Culture Add:

  • High-Drive and Self-Motivated: You take ownership of your work, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and can manage tasks with minimal supervision while meeting objectives.
  • Strong Analytical Skills and Critical Thinking: You use a data-driven approach to problem solving and seek out information to make informed decisions.
  • Detail-Oriented and Organized: Your precision ensures consistent, high-quality work and organizational skills mean you efficiently manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Team-First Mentality: You collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, and support your teammates.
  • Growth Mindset: You welcome feedback and continuously seek to improve.

Benefits

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Paid holidays (including a week off at new year) and an unlimited vacation policy.
  • Generous medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • 401(k) retirement plan and company match.
  • Paid parental and family leave.
  • Professional development through opportunities like conferences, courses, mentorship, and other learning programs.
  • Company outings and team retreats.

Why Join Us

At Resonant Link Medical, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the technology behind the next generation of implantable medical devices.

Our wireless power platforms are enabling new possibilities across cardiac care, neuromodulation, brain-computer interfaces, and other emerging medical technologies. As a Staff Embedded Engineer, your work will directly influence how these systems are designed, developed, and brought to market.

You'll work alongside experts in electromagnetics, power electronics, and controls, solving complex engineering challenges at the intersection of hardware and software. You'll also have the opportunity to establish foundational software architecture and engineering practices that will support RLM's growth for years to come.

We offer the technical challenges of an advanced engineering organization, the ownership and influence of a growing company, and the opportunity to develop technology that can meaningfully improve patients' lives.

*Resonant Link Medical is an equal opportunity employer and includes “Together is Better” as a core value. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please do not hesitate to apply if you see yourself contributing even if you don’t check every box. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the future of wireless charging and patient care! To learn more about our values, mission, and team, visit

About The Role:

We are seeking a skilled Accounting Administrator with experience in the nonprofit sector and a solid background in accounts payable coordination. The ideal candidate will be responsible for, but not limited to, organizing and processing weekly pay runs, maintaining finance administrative communications, and preparing month-end reports and reconciliations. You will work closely with stakeholders to ensure accurate documentation and compliance with applicable policies. Strong time management and organization skills, along with a passion for nonprofit work, are essential; knowledge of GAAP is strongly preferred.

Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable (75% of time)

  • Manages finance@ email for general inquiries and bill delivery; acts as liaison between inbox and other Finance team members.
  • Assists with vendor onboarding and records creation/maintenance in NetSuite accounting software.
  • Updates and validates vendor banking information, ensuring changes are appropriately verified and documented in accordance with internal controls and fraud prevention procedures.
  • Receives and organizes bills, ensures proper supporting documentation and appropriate approval routing to Budget Holders; manages Budget Holder approvals against weekly payment timeline and follows up as needed.
  • Works closely with the Accountant(s) and other Accounting Administrators to coordinate the entering of weekly bills; plans for and communicates shifts to the timeline.
  • Aggregates and documents bills approved for payment, sets up bills to be paid in appropriate systems, coordinates closely with Signatories to ensure timely approval of payments, and handles all associated payment issues.
  • Enters Purchase Orders in NetSuite, as needed.
  • Monitors expenses to ensure they are allowable under the Federal Uniform Guidance and other funder policies.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of accounts payable and vendor file best practices and procedures, fraud detection and mitigation, and other up-to-date practices to ensure the safeguarding of VentureWell assets.
  • Assists in preparing annual Form 1099 reporting and other AP-related filings, as needed.

Month-End Close/Other (25% of time)

  • Prepares assigned monthly Bank Reconciliations.
  • Assists with monthly credit card reconciliations as assigned; processes in Concur ensuring timely submissions, appropriate approvals, accurate allocations, and imports into NetSuite.
  • Monitors outstanding checks in the system by conducting a monthly review and following up with vendors and Sr. Accountant/Controller, as needed.
  • Monitors outstanding purchase orders in NetSuite by conducting a monthly review, preparing a detailed report, and working closely with Accounting, Contracts, and others to resolve questions or issues.
  • Assists with entering cash receipts, bank transfers, and deposits during Accountant absences.
  • Assists with external audit preparation and ongoing internal audit and control procedures.
  • Provides other accounting and administrative support to the Finance & Administration team, as needed.
  • Maintains accurate electronic accounting files.

What You Bring:

  • Previous experience managing medium- to high-volume accounts payable operations strongly preferred; experience in a nonprofit or higher education environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with accounts payable fraud prevention, internal controls, and risk management procedures preferred.
  • Knowledge of accounting best practices, laws, standards, and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools required. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel (e.g. VLOOKUP function and/or pivot tables) preferred.
  • Digital fluency using cloud-based office tools such as G Suite, CRMs and/or ERPs (Salesforce, NetSuite, Sage Intacct), team collaboration tools, and other web-based applications (Concur, Stampli), with ease and ability to incorporate these tools into day-to-day work.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills with a wide range of constituents.
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills; ability to prioritize in a changing environment.

Across the Board, VentureWell Staff:

  • Are able to succeed and thrive in an environment with competing and changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Have track records of and ability to build solid collaborative working relationships, and are proven team players who enjoy a “customer service” orientation to collaboration
  • Are committed to embedding equity for all in our internal practices and culture and in our programs in order to live and achieve our mission
  • Bring openness and engagement to personal, professional, and organization-wide learning
  • Are curious and committed to issues of environmental sustainability
  • Are self-starters with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
  • Are active learners who independently learn new tools and work processes quickly
  • Have excellent written and oral communication skills

Our Benefits*:

  • An attractive and equitable compensation package, including:
    • a salary range of $50,000-$65,000 commensurate with experience and internal equity
    • 403 (b) with 200% match up to a maximum contribution from VentureWell of 10% when the employee puts in 5% (eligible after one year of service for the match)
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
    • $1,000 home office stipend upon hire
  • A true focus on work-life balance with work weeks that reflect that
    • It’s our aim for our employees in this position to not work more than a 40-hour workweek
    • 20 paid vacation days
    • 12 paid holidays
    • 12 paid wellness days

*Benefits are reviewed each fiscal year and may be subject to change.

What We Offer:

  • A culture where people work intentionally and collaboratively in pursuit of our mission
  • Values we believe in

About VentureWell:

VentureWell supports the cultivation of science and technology inventors and the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystems critical to their success. Since its founding in 1995, VentureWell has funded or trained over 21,400 early-stage science and technology inventors and innovators, resulting in the emergence of more than 7,400 ventures with groundbreaking technological advancements in fields like biomedicine and healthcare, sustainable energy and materials, and solutions for low-resource settings. The ventures it has supported have raised subsequent funds totaling more than $10.2 billion and are reaching millions of people globally.

Visit venturewell.org to learn more.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB

The Recruiter plays a vital role in developing and executing long-term recruiting strategies across Live Nation Venues. This role partners with business unit leaders, Human Resources, hiring managers, and other stakeholders across LNE to create and implement sustainable recruiting programs that address both immediate and long-term staffing needs.

This remote role leads full-time hiring for entry-level, mid-level, and senior-level positions across Live Nation Venues, including roles supporting shared services, clubs, theaters, amphitheaters, large indoor venues, and comedy clubs. The Recruiter sources, screens, interviews, recommends candidates, and manages the offer process.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, relationship-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with high-volume and event-based staffing needs.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Lead intake meetings with hiring managers to define role requirements, candidate profiles, interview processes, and hiring timelines.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 10–15 active requisitions at a time, prioritizing work effectively to meet business needs.
  • Develop sourcing strategies that maximize an inclusive and qualified candidate pool, including building relationships with community partners and attending recruiting events.
  • Leverage LinkedIn, Indeed, industry-specific job boards, referrals, and other channels to identify top venue and live entertainment talent.
  • Review resumes and applications to assess candidate qualifications, experience, and alignment with position requirements.
  • Conduct phone screens to evaluate candidates’ skills, experience, motivation, compensation expectations, and overall fit.
  • Create and present qualified candidate bundles to hiring managers, including clear recommendations and relevant screening insights.
  • Coordinate and schedule hiring manager and interview-panel meetings, ensuring a smooth and efficient candidate experience.
  • Partner with hiring managers to collect interview feedback, guide selection decisions, and provide recommendations throughout the hiring process.
  • Extend, negotiate, and close employment offers; prepare offer letters and ensure all pre-employment documentation is accurate and completed on time.
  • Maintain accurate, timely candidate and requisition data in Workday, while leveraging Gem AI and other recruiting technologies to improve sourcing efficiency, candidate outreach, talent-pipeline management, and overall recruiting operations.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Minimum 2 years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment required. Experience supporting venue operations, hospitality, live events, entertainment, or multi-unit businesses preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Psychology, or related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant recruiting experience will be considered.
  • Experience managing multiple requisitions simultaneously and executing all stages of the recruiting process, from intake and sourcing through interview coordination, offer creation, negotiation, and close.
  • Knowledge of sourcing strategies and recruitment channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, job boards, referrals, networking, and community-based outreach.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate-assessment skills and excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with the recruitment team on shared talent pipelines and projects.
  • Commitment to building inclusive candidate pipelines and delivering a positive, professional candidate and hiring-manager experience.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and recruiting technology required; experience with Workday and Gem AI is preferred.
  • Interest in music, live events, hospitality, technology or media preferred.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Live Nation may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review..

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

jobs.description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.


You bring more than your expertise to your role, and that matters here. Your story, perspectives, and lived experiences help shape belonging at BECU and deepen how we connect with and support our employees, our members, and our communities.


PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $189,000.00-$230,700.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $146,600.00 - $273,000.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – because people helping people starts with supporting you

  • 401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU

  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • PTO Program + Exchange Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

As a Principal Solutions Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of BECU’s lending and credit card technology ecosystem. You’ll bridge architecture and engineering, transforming complex business needs into scalable, secure, and innovative solutions that improve experiences for both members and internal partners. Your expertise will help drive modernization efforts, strengthen production stability, and accelerate the delivery of new financial products and digital capabilities. Through hands-on technical leadership, you’ll influence enterprise-wide design decisions, mentor engineering teams, and bring forward-thinking ideas that help BECU grow and differentiate itself in the market. You’ll have the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on critical platforms that support millions of member interactions and future business growth.

To join our dynamic team, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, AZ, TX, GA, SC, NC, CA or VA. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance from Tukwila, we are requesting that you come into our HQ on Tuesdays & Wednesdays. For those candidates that live outside the commute distance of TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead Solution Design: Design and deliver complex, enterprise-scale solutions that support lending and credit card platforms while aligning technical strategy with business objectives.
  • Architect for Scale: Translate business and stakeholder needs into detailed technical designs, ensuring solutions meet performance, security, reliability, and scalability requirements.
  • Drive Modernization Efforts: Identify opportunities to simplify complex systems, improve platform architecture, and introduce modern engineering practices that enhance speed and efficiency.
  • Shape Cloud-First Solutions: Lead the design of cloud-ready financial solutions, leveraging modern application architectures, integrations, and services to support future growth.
  • Partner Across Teams: Collaborate with architects, engineers, delivery teams, infrastructure partners, and business stakeholders to drive successful execution across interconnected systems.
  • Guide API and Integration Strategy: Design, develop, and troubleshoot APIs and enterprise integrations that power critical lending and credit card experiences.
  • Support Production Excellence: Analyze production challenges, identify root causes, and lead efforts to improve operational stability while balancing strategic project work.
  • Build Innovative Solutions: Create prototypes and proof-of-concepts that solve complex business challenges and help advance BECU’s technology capabilities.
  • Influence Technical Direction: Use your deep technical expertise and business acumen to recommend solutions that improve member experiences and business outcomes.
  • Mentor and Elevate Others: Provide technical leadership, code reviews, architectural guidance, and mentorship to engineers across the organization.
  • Champion Industry Best Practices: Stay current on emerging technologies, architecture trends, and engineering practices to help BECU continuously evolve and innovate.
  • Communicate with Impact: Present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment and confidence across the organization.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:

  • The opportunity to help shape the future of BECU’s lending and credit card platforms through high-visibility, strategic initiatives.
  • The ability to operate at the intersection of architecture and engineering while remaining hands-on with technology.
  • Exposure to large-scale cloud transformation efforts centered around Azure and modern distributed systems.
  • A platform to influence enterprise design decisions and drive meaningful modernization initiatives.
  • Opportunities to partner with cross-functional teams across technology, infrastructure, architecture, and business organizations.
  • The chance to mentor engineers and technical leaders while expanding your own leadership impact.
  • Meaningful work that directly improves member experiences through innovative financial products and digital capabilities.
  • The ability to balance strategic solution design with real-world operational challenges and production excellence.
  • A collaborative environment where your ideas, expertise, and vision can directly influence long-term technology strategy.
  • The opportunity to bring proven best practices and innovative approaches that help BECU scale for future growth.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a computer science or equivalent work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of information technology experience with demonstrated expertise in application design required.
  • Experience with Financial products, i.e., Credit Card, Mortgage, Loan, Deposits, etc., required.
  • Demonstrated experience in consumer financial products with expertise in UX, integration, and API layer required.
  • Experience with public cloud (Azure/AWS/Google Cloud) technologies including Iaas, Paas, Saas offerings required.
  • Experience leading and collaborating with multiple teams for enterprise-wide initiatives, including business unit teams, to deliver solutions through all aspects of the SDLC required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience with .NET, C#, node.js and modern JavaScript Frameworks in TypeScript or Javascript (React, Angular, etc.), or Python. System administration and automation with Powershell or bash preferred.
  • Strong understanding in SOLID design principles, Object-Oriented Programming and Design. Expertise with SOA patterns and distributed systems design preferred.
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems and tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Teamcity preferred.
  • Industry conference experience presenting in front of technically adept, and non-technical audiences preferred.

JOIN THE JOURNEY

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be a part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role, but fuel the growth and success of BECU?

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Product Manager who is passionate about understanding customer problems, validating opportunities, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. You'll own a product area focused on backoffice (cloud data processing) solutions, driving product strategy and execution, charting the roadmap, and managing the lifecycle of Verra Mobility’s market leading systems. As a member of the Product Management team, you will partner with leaders across the product, operations, engineering, IT, and sales teams to drive innovation and leverage the latest technologies to deliver best-in-class backoffice systems that achieve business objectives. The successful candidate will be passionate about technology with an ability to lead innovation and execution. In this business-critical role, you will merge customer needs with technology to cast a vision for Verra Mobility’s legacy and future backoffice solutions and drive the organization toward that goal. You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders to manage the backoffice systems across their lifecycle, gathering requirements, scoping initiatives, establishing product roadmaps, and working with development and support teams to ensure high product quality while minimizing cost.

You’ll join a product squad with a defined problem space, embedded alongside a technical lead and engineering team. But this isn’t a backlog-grooming role, as you’ll own discovery: getting in front of customers, validating the problems, stress-testing potential solutions, and driving a roadmap that delivers measurable outcomes. You’ll report directly to the Director of Product and operate as a key product leader as we build toward a modern Product Operating Model.

What You’ll Do

Own the problem, drive discovery

  • Lead continuous customer discovery, including interviews, ride-alongs, and data analysis, to validate problems and pressure-test solutions before committing to build.
  • Frame customer and business problems with clarity and evidence, ensuring the team works on what truly matters.
  • Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap grounded in measurable outcomes, rather than a feature wish list.
  • Balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility, using sound judgment and solid product sense.
  • Partner early with Legal, Compliance, and Operations functions to shape viable solutions.
  • Own the problem end-to-end, make tough prioritization calls, document your reasoning and outcomes.

Guide delivery and build trust with your squad

  • Partner closely with your technical lead and engineering team, creating context, removing ambiguity, and enabling the squad to move with speed and confidence.
  • Collaborate closely with your design lead to ensure solutions are not just technically sound but also user centered.
  • Write crisp, outcome-oriented briefs and acceptance criteria; avoid over-specifying implementation details, and focus on why the problem matters and what success looks like
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, documentation, and delivery workflows.
  • Share your approach to discovery and product thinking with peers, contributing to a growing product practice.

Connect product to impact

  • Develop a working understanding of how products drive revenue, retention, and operational efficiency for our customers.
  • Contribute to go-to-market strategy by informing pricing, positioning, and launch readiness in close collaboration with commercial teams.
  • Define and track success metrics that link customer outcomes to business performance.
  • Serve as the internal expert for your product area trusted by sales, operations, and leadership.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 3–7 years of product management experience, with a track record of owning outcomes.
  • Experience leading customer discovery and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional squad environment alongside engineering and design peers.
  • Experience in regulated or complex-domain industries, such as automotive, fleet, payments, fintech, or similar, with a demonstrated record of learning new domains.
  • Comfort working in and contributing to organizations evolving their product operating model.
  • Active use of AI tools to enhance productivity in day-to-day product work, such as discovery workflows, streamlining documentation, automating research, creating prototypes, and accelerating delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you write clearly, tailor your message to different audiences, and tell a coherent product story.
  • Strong critical thinking and a bias toward evidence over opinion.

Great to Have

  • Knowledge of the transportation/smart mobility sector and road safety is a plus
  • Familiarity with product tooling such as Aha!, Azure DevOps, JIRA, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience working with compliance, legal, or regulatory stakeholders in a multi-jurisdictional environment.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you’re not measured by how much you ship, you’re measured by the outcomes you drive with your team. In your first year, success looks like:

  • Deep fluency in the assigned problem space, backed by direct customer and stakeholder engagement.
  • A validated, outcome-oriented roadmap your squad believes in and can execute against.
  • Demonstrated velocity in shipping, learning, and adjusting with confidence.
  • Trusted relationships that enable influence without authority to drive alignment across engineering, design, commercial, and other operational functions.
  • Clear evidence of customer impact: reduced friction, improved adoption, or measurable efficiency gains.

Logistics

  • Location: Preference given to local candidates in our Mesa, AZ headquarters or New York City office. Will consider remote candidates who express willingness for occasional travel.
  • Travel: Light, primarily for team offsites and customer engagement.
  • Reports to: Director of Product.

Verra Mobility Values
An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It.We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What’s Right.We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.
