COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:


The Director, Publication Strategy and Execution, is a highly visible senior leader who will be responsible for leading the strategy and implementation of the Publications plan. This individual will be a critical member of the Medical Affairs Extended Leadership Team and will work closely with cross-functional leaders, especially in close collaboration with product and program leadership teams, clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, HEOR, medical affairs, and marketing.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Serve as the subject matter expert on publication-related matters, working closely with both internal and external disease area experts to ensure relevant data, analysis, interpretation, communication, and publication planning of data
  • Adhere to good publications practices and ensure compliance with BioCryst policies
  • Develop and revise internal guidance and policies as needed in support of publication activities
  • Deliver training to internal cross-functional teams and external partners, as appropriate

  • Lead development of medical and scientific publications including accountability for execution of deliverables across hereditary angioedema and pipeline portfolio:
  • Effectively coordinate, allocate resources for, and in cases, execute development of abstracts, posters, oral presentations, manuscripts, and/or presentations for scientific/medical meetings to support Publications Plans for all compound(s)
  • Coordinate resources for writing, editing, formatting and submitting articles to peer-reviewed scientific journals and scientific/medical conferences
  • Build and maintain excellent relationships with clinical experts, journal editors, and congress personnel

  • Manage annual budget, work, and allocation of resources, including ensuring contracts, SOWs, and invoices are submitted accurately and in a timely manner
  • Day-to-day vendor management to execute publications effectively and efficiently according to the Publications Policy and good publication practices (GPP).
  • Provide oversight of maintenance of documents in the publication planning platform software to ensure completeness, accuracy, and integrity, while keeping abreast of the latest GPP and ISMPP standards.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Advanced scientific degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD/DO)
  • Minimum 10 years of Medical Affairs experience in the pharmaceutical industry and/or relevant clinical or scientific experience, including leading scientific publications
  • Experience developing and executing integrated publication strategies across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases, aligned with medical strategy, evidence-generation priorities, scientific platforms, congress milestones, and lifecycle management objectives
  • Pipeline portfolio and rare disease experience required, with the ability to adapt publication strategies across early- and late-stage assets, evolving evidence plans, and changing program priorities
  • Expert knowledge of good publication practices and guidance, including GPP and ICMJE, and other standards related to scientific data communication
  • Demonstrated understanding of clinical trial design and execution, statistical methods, and clinical trial data reporting requirements
  • Ability to define and track publication performance metrics, assess scientific communication impact, and apply insights to optimize publication planning and execution
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to collaborate, influence, and execute within large matrixed, cross-functional teams
  • Experience managing and developing high-performing teams, including setting priorities, providing coaching and feedback, supporting professional growth, and fostering accountability in a matrixed environment
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver successful outcomes, including publication planning, medical and technical writing, editing, and review
  • Ability to think strategically, critically analyze complex data, and synthesize scientific information into clear communication strategies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of developing and delivering high-quality scientific content
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and document management systems (e.g., PubStrat, SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Smartsheet) required
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 25% of the time

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:


  • Certification as a Medical Publication Professional (CMPP) preferred
  • Hereditary angioedema/immunology/rare disease experience preferred
  • Experience with digital and innovative publication approaches, including enhanced publications, plain language summaries, digital congress assets, and technology-enabled publication workflow tools, preferred

jobs.description:

Spot AI turns cameras into coworkers.

Spot AI is relied on at over 10,000 locations by more than 1,000 customers across manufacturing, construction, logistics, and retail.

Backed by over $110 million from investors including Scale, Redpoint, Qualcomm Ventures, StepStone, and Bessemer, we are building the system that brings AI out of the digital world and into the real one.

We move fast, take ownership, and focus on outcomes. We are building a company for people who want to solve real problems and have a direct impact on how businesses operate.

Ready to learn more? Connect with us onLinkedIn|X|YouTube

Who we’re looking for.

We’re looking for enterprise sales team members to be at the forefront of this industry shift, selling a category-defining AI product that’s capturing the attention of some of the biggest names in the world.

You'll either own high-stakes, multi-threaded strategic deals. Every deal closes on partner paper as part of our channel-first motion, and you'll grind through complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from prospecting to negotiation to close.

You are responsible for creating your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner relationships, and field presence. Our inbound engine is designed to supplement your efforts, not replace them.

This isn’t a walk in the park - it’s a high-intensity, high-reward role. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive seamless adoption and long-term expansion.More tenured candidates will help shape the next generation of enterprise sellers at Spot AI by leveling up the team through mentorship and building repeatable, scalable sales motions that deliver big wins.

This isn’t for everyone- it’s for elite sellers ready to make an outsized impact. If you’re hungry to sell industry-changing AI, land enterprise logos, and make serious money while doing it, let’s talk.

Are you a like-minded builder?

If you wake up driven to build, see challenges as fuel, and refuse to settle for the status quo, you’ll fit right in.

At Spot AI, we’re not just building a company; we’re building a legacy that will outlast us. Every Spotan shares a relentless pursuit of excellence, and we’re looking for more teammates with the same high-performance DNA:

  • Relentless Drive: You have something to prove. Extreme ambition fuels you, and obstacles only make you push harder. Building isn’t just what you do; it’s who you are.

  • Builder’s Mentality: You don’t just want to scale what exists—you want to create what’s next. Maybe you’ve founded a company, been a first 20 employee, or led a venture for 2+ years—if so, we’re especially excited to meet you.

  • High Hustle, High Humility: You bring intellect, emotional intelligence, and an unyielding work ethic. You’re low ego, high impact, and always pushing to be among the best at what you do.

If this sounds like you, let’s build something legendary, together.

Our cultural pillars guide how we operate. We:

  • Spend Strategically.We maximize resources and minimize waste.

  • Push for Progress.We make decisions, move fast, and celebrate action.

  • Obsess Over Customers:We remove friction and add value to create delight.

  • Trust Our Team:Respect, trust and collaboration are non-negotiable.

  • Act Like Owners:We say what we’ll do, and we do what we say, taking pride and responsibility in our work.

  • Never Stop Having Fun:We’re creating something epic, and we’re having fun doing it.

How to stand out.

This is a high-impact opportunity to drive industry-changing AI solutions into the enterprise space. The right person for this role brings a powerful combination of skill, mindset, and leadership and can demonstrate that they are a/an:

  • Strategic Closer: Complex, multi-threaded deals are your craft. You understand enterprise deal cycles and know how todrive high-priority wins.

  • Self-Motivated & Accountable: You thrive with ownership and autonomy, delivering high-quality outcomes with minimal direction.

  • Leader & Team Player: You don’t just sell—you refine processes, share best practices, and elevate those around you.

  • Humble Expert: You bring deep expertise while staying open to new ideas, feedback, and innovation. You focus on getting it right, not just being right.

  • Impact-Driven: You operate with success in mind—not just for yourself, but for your team and the company.

  • Willing to Travel: You enjoy meeting customers face to face and are comfortable traveling up to 25% of the time.

  • Elite Sales Performer: You've been a top seller or President's Club performer with at least 3 years of enterprise sales success, ideally in high-growth SaaS or technology. Candidates with a track record of high performance working global or strategic enterprise deals ($500M revenue+) will be considered to work our highest scope, highest value deals, regardless of total years of experience.

What excites you.

  • Depending on team/experience, lead multi-threaded deal cycles:

    • Across 3-6+ month cycles for accounts ranging from $10-$500M in revenue, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups OR

    • Across 9-12+ month cycles for accounts ranging from $500M+ in revenue, building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Collaborating cross functionally as a subject matter expert to shape our enterprise sales strategy.

  • Setting company records for the largest deals closed while transforming how organizations use video data and intelligence.

  • Working with an ambitious, high-performing team that will push you as you push them.

  • A place that gives you the room to learn from failure while driving excellence.

  • A culture where hard work that drives great outcomes is expected, celebrated, and rewarded.

Compensation and Benefits.

Global or strategic enterprise deal experience may support eligibility for the top of this range, though placement depends on the full scope of the role and will be determined and communicated during the interview process.

    • 50/50 base/commission split. Commissions paid monthly on quarterly targets. Commissions are uncapped.

  • Meaningful early stage equity

  • Medical, dental and vision plan options with little-to-no cost for employees and dependents

  • Company paid short- and long-term disability plans

  • Company paid life insurance

What to expect.

We like to move fast, and we also want you to have every opportunity to interview us as much as we’re interviewing you. Our process is highly interactive, and we encourage you to ask anything! Each step builds on the last.

  • Final Conversations – If we’re here, things are getting serious! We’ll cover any open items and make sure you have all your questions answered. You’ll have another chat with the people team, plus have access to anyone else you want to meet, or talk to again.

If you’re ready to sell cutting-edge AI and be rewarded for it, let’s talk.

jobs.excerpt: Maximize your potential.  Minimize your footprint.
jobs.description:
Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.


Position Summary


The Program Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional integrator and accountability mechanism for customer commitments on assigned programs at Nortek Data Center Cooling. This role drives flawless execution across the full program lifecycle—from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.


Reporting to the Vice President of Program Management, the Program Manager coordinates Engineering, Test, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, Finance, and Service teams to meet schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments, while these functions continue to own execution within their respective areas. This is a hands-on execution role accountable for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance. Success requires strong critical-path management, cross-functional influence, and clear communication with both internal stakeholders and external customers. The Program Manager maintains direct customer contact on program execution and is accountable for the financial health of the program, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer contact and owns customer communication, negotiation, and pricing strategy.


Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Schedule Management

  • Own end-to-end execution of assigned customer programs from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.
  • Build, maintain, and drive the integrated program schedule with a relentless focus on critical-path items and dependencies across engineering, procurement, fabrication, assembly, test, shipping, installation, and commissioning.
  • Lead recurring program cadence meetings, ensuring clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through on action items.
  • Coordinate engineering release, drawing approval cycles, long-lead procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, customer acceptance, installation, and commissioning milestones per the standardized program workflow.
  • Escalate schedule risks and cross-functional roadblocks promptly, with proposed mitigation paths.

Customer Coordination & Communication

  • Maintain direct customer contact on program execution matters, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer point of contact and owns customer communication and negotiation.
  • Provide clear, proactive, and honest program status communications—schedule, milestones, risks, and change orders—to internal leadership and, in coordination with the Sales Account Executive, to the customer.
  • Build strong working relationships with customer counterparts; understand their pain points, priorities, and success metrics.
  • Represent the voice of the customer inside Nortek DCC and the voice of Nortek DCC to the customer with balance and integrity.

Program-Level P&L and Contract Management

  • Accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance against the approved deal model and budget. Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy.
  • Manage change orders end-to-end—identify scope changes, quantify impact, and drive internal approvals and execution—partnering with the Sales Account Executive, who leads customer negotiation.
  • Monitor contract obligations, deliverables, and customer commitments; ensure Nortek DCC meets its obligations.
  • Proactively identify risks to program profitability and partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Service to mitigate them.

Risk Management

  • Apply the standardized risk identification, escalation, and mitigation process to every assigned program.
  • Maintain a live program risk register with clear ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and status.
  • Drive critical risks to closure on time, targeting 90%+ on-time closure across the program portfolio.
  • Escalate top risks to the VP of Program Management with recommended actions; ensure high-risk issues have documented mitigation plans and appropriate visibility.

Installation, Commissioning & Service Coordination

  • Ensure Service has visibility to installation schedules and customer requirements.
  • Ensure field resources, parts, and support plans are aligned with program commitments.
  • Coordinate and escalate warranty issues, field modifications, or customer concerns.
  • Track financial and customer impacts associated with post-delivery issues.
  • Remain engaged whenever there are material issues impacting customer commitments, schedule, economics, or customer satisfaction; support formal handoff to Service when programs are running smoothly.
  • Service continues to own service execution (contracting, product offering, productivity, reliability, and overall quality), technician deployment and training, spare parts strategy, and long-term aftermarket support (e.g., Re-life).

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

  • Lead a cross-functional program team without direct reporting authority; drive alignment, accountability, and execution across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Test, Commercial, Finance, and Service.
  • Build consensus, resolve conflicts, and drive timely decisions to keep the program on track.
  • Communicate transparently and proactively so stakeholders are informed, aligned, and empowered to act.
  • Partner with Production Planning and Supply Chain to ensure material readiness and manufacturing capacity for assigned programs.

Continuous Improvement

  • Use and reinforce standardized program management processes and templates for execution, program-level P&L management, contract management, and risk management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve program execution practices, reduce rework, and minimize delays caused by engineering changes.
  • Contribute lessons learned back to the Program Management function to strengthen team-wide capability.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related discipline; equivalent experience considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive program or project management experience, ideally in an engineer-to-order or complex manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Working command of program management methodologies and tools (e.g., Monday.com, Microsoft Project, PLM systems).
  • Experience managing customer relationships and communicating program status directly with external stakeholders.
  • Strong critical-path thinking, risk management discipline, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent programs.

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification or equivalent.
  • Experience owning program-level P&L execution, change orders, and contract execution.
  • Direct experience with engineered-to-order capital equipment or B2B custom manufacturing, including installation and commissioning coordination.
  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers or other rapidly scaling B2B end markets.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Become a part of our caring community

Join a world-class marketing organization creating the best possible engagement experience for millions of members.

Humana is a $100+ billion, Fortune 50 healthcare leader dedicated to improving the health and well-being of some of the most vulnerable populations in the United States, including seniors, people with disabilities, and lower-income Americans. Humana is uniquely positioned to transform healthcare delivery by making high-quality care more affordable, accessible, and secure through integrated healthcare services, innovative technology, and data-driven solutions.

To help deliver on this mission, we are seeking a Lead Product Manager to support the continued development, adoption, and expansion of Humana's enterprise Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning platform. This role serves as a key member of the NBA Product team, helping define and evolve the platform capabilities that enable personalized, data-driven member experiences across channels and lines of business.

The Lead Product Manager will partner closely with business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, analytics, and user experience teams to translate strategic objectives and emerging business needs into scalable platform capabilities. This individual will balance short-term delivery needs with long-term platform evolution, ensuring the NBA platform continues to deliver business value while maintaining consistency, reusability, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideal for candidates who have partnered with business and engineering teams to define, deliver, or optimize customer decisioning and personalization capabilities, including solutions built on platforms such as Pega CDH, Adobe RTCDP, Salesforce Einstein, RTIM, or similar.

Role Responsibilities

  • Evaluate new business use cases and engagement opportunities against existing NBA capabilities to determine whether requirements can be met through current functionality or require new platform investments.
  • Identify capability gaps and emerging needs as NBA expands across channels, lines of business, products, and member interactions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives, customer needs, and operational challenges, translating those inputs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to product discovery efforts by identifying common patterns across use cases and recommending reusable solutions that improve platform scalability and reduce duplication.
  • Define and manage features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation priorities for enhancements to NBA platform capabilities, including decisioning logic, eligibility criteria, prioritization frameworks, business rules, constraints, and governance controls.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, analytics, and user experience teams to evaluate solution approaches, dependencies, technical tradeoffs, and implementation considerations for new platform capabilities.
  • Own and prioritize product backlogs for assigned NBA scrum teams, ensuring alignment with product strategy, roadmap priorities, business value, and technical needs.
  • Serve as Product Owner for assigned scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, acceptance of completed work, and ongoing clarification of requirements.
  • Evaluate competing business priorities, technical investments, platform improvements, and dependencies to make informed product decisions and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Partner with the Principal Product Manager, NBA to translate enterprise roadmap priorities and decisioning strategy into actionable delivery plans and platform investments.
  • Establish and monitor product success measures, using adoption, utilization, delivery, and stakeholder feedback metrics to inform prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional discussions and drive alignment among business, technology, operations, and product stakeholders to advance platform objectives and resolve competing priorities.
  • Partner with data science, analytics, and business teams to evolve decisioning strategies and ensure platform capabilities effectively support member engagement objectives.
  • Act as a champion for product management best practices, helping drive consistent execution, transparency, and continuous improvement across NBA product teams.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, decisioning platforms, personalization technologies, marketing technology, customer engagement platforms, or related disciplines.
  • Experience managing software products or platform capabilities through the full product development lifecycle.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into product strategies, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized development backlogs.
  • Experience partnering closely with software engineering, architecture, user experience, analytics, quality assurance, and business teams to deliver technology solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate competing priorities and make informed product tradeoff decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize across business needs, technical requirements, platform investments, and operational considerations.
  • Experience using data, customer insights, and stakeholder feedback to inform product decisions and roadmap recommendations.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment with evolving priorities and ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience working within Agile product organizations as both a Product Manager and Product Owner.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, and helping teams move efficiently from business need to delivered capability.

40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies or increasing efficiency in their laboratories, we are here to support them.

Our team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

How will you make an impact:

Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking an exceptional Director of Strategic Sales to lead our engagement with critical strategic customers in the semiconductor segment. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales, AMER/EMEA, this leader will be responsible for driving revenue, bookings, customer engagement, and long-term growth across a portfolio of strategic semiconductor accounts based in the United States with global sales impact.

The Director will lead a team of strategic account managers, serve as a senior face of Thermo Fisher Scientific to key customers, and build strong executive-level relationships that support growth, customer loyalty, and adoption of Thermo Fisher solutions.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business development, commercial leadership, technical understanding, and strong relationship management to help semiconductor customers solve complex technology and manufacturing challenges. This leader will coordinate cross-functional teams across Thermo Fisher Scientific to identify opportunities, build account strategies, develop pipeline, support commercial negotiations, and execute complex global deals.

What will you do:

  • Deliver annual bookings and revenue commitments for strategic semiconductor customers, with responsibility for $100M+ in annual business.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of strategic account managers supporting top semiconductor accounts.

  • Build and execute comprehensive global account strategies in partnership with account managers, business units, regional sales teams, service teams, and senior leadership.

  • Develop strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including executive, technical, procurement, operations, and manufacturing leaders.

  • Identify new growth opportunities by understanding customer roadmaps, technology inflections, manufacturing challenges, and emerging semiconductor applications.

  • Manage a robust pipeline of opportunities and drive customer adoption across products, services, and solutions relevant to semiconductor customers.

  • Lead strategic business reviews with customers and internal stakeholders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and resolve barriers.

  • Support complex commercial negotiations, contract discussions, pricing strategy, and long-term partnership agreements.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure alignment, accountability, and clear ownership for customer priorities.

  • Provide timely and accurate forecasting, reporting, and business updates to senior management and business units.

  • Drive disciplined use of CRM tools, including Salesforce, to manage pipeline, opportunities, customer engagement, and business performance.

  • Monitor, manage, and control team expenses in alignment with business priorities.

  • Foster a culture of teamwork, execution, accountability, and customer focus.

How will you get here:

Education

Bachelor’s degree required; technical degree and/or MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of successful sales, business development, or strategic account management experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading sales teams and managing large, complex strategic accounts.

  • Extensive background in the semiconductor industry, including strong understanding of semiconductor technology, market dynamics, customer needs, and industry trends.

  • Strong commercial skills, including strategic selling, negotiation, contract management, pricing, and complex deal execution.

  • Experience working in a multinational, matrixed organization.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical, business planning, forecasting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent executive presence, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM systems, especially Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Demonstrated ability to execute with urgency, discipline, and accountability.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% for customer engagement & internal business needs.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.description:
About the Internet Society Foundation

The Internet Society (ISOC) supports and promotes the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society. Our work aligns with our goals for the Internet to be open, globally connected, secure, and trustworthy. We seek collaboration with all who share these goals.

Together, we focus on building and supporting the communities that make the Internet work; advancing the development and application of Internet infrastructure, technologies, and open standards; and advocating for policy that is consistent with our view of the Internet.

The Internet Society Foundation (Foundation) is a non-profit organization that works in concert with the Internet Society. It exists to demonstrate and support the positive difference the Internet can make to people everywhere and promote the development of the Internet as a global technical infrastructure, a resource to enrich people’s lives, and a force for good in society.

The Foundation is committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion, where all individuals are valued for their distinct contributions. Our people are the most valuable strengths we have. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, inventiveness, innovation, self-expression, unique capabilities and talent that our staff invests in their work represents a significant part of not only our culture, but our reputation and the Foundation's achievements.

About the Position

The Content Communications Manager creates compelling, accurate content that connects the work of the Internet Society and Internet Society Foundation with the audiences we seek to engage. As part of the Content Communications team, you will turn complex programs, technical topics, and people’s experiences into accessible stories across blogs, video scripts, social media, and other formats.

Working within the Unified Communications Strategy, you will work closely with the empowerment team (fellowships, alumni, and learning) to clarify communication needs, recommend effective approaches, and connect their work to broader organizational priorities. The role combines hands-on content creation with planning, advice, and coordination, with approximately 60% of time focused on content production.

Location

Remote

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Content creation and editorial quality

  • Write and edit engaging blogs, impact stories, video scripts, social media copy, and other communications materials, adapting the message, tone, and structure to each audience and format.
  • Research topics, interview participants and experts, and verify facts, quotations, and claims of impact against source materials. Represent people and their experiences accurately and respectfully.
  • Deliver well-developed content ready for standard editorial review, applying brand, style, accessibility, and approval guidelines consistently.
  • Develop creative briefs and scripts, and guide video producers, photographers, and designers through clear direction and actionable feedback, coordinating with relevant communications colleagues.

Program partnership and communications planning

  • Build a strong understanding of Empowerment’s programs, audiences, milestones, and communications needs. Lead working meetings, ask clarifying questions, and translate requests into practical recommendations.
  • Advise colleagues on objectives, audiences, formats, and timing. Explain recommendations constructively, offer alternatives, and balance program needs with communications priorities and available capacity.
  • Apply the “All-of-ISOC” approach by connecting Empowerment stories with the organization’s broader work in connectivity, advocacy, safety, and community engagement.
  • Identify storytelling opportunities and contribute to integrated campaigns and program launches, agreeing priorities and the approach to major initiatives with the Director, Content.

Coordination and delivery

  • Plan assigned work from brief through delivery, mapping responsibilities, dependencies, deadlines, and review stages. Maintain the editorial calendar and the relevant project-tracking systems.
  • Coordinate directly with colleagues responsible for design, social media, email, web, media, and community engagement, involving them early and following through on agreed handoffs.
  • Make day-to-day content and delivery decisions within agreed priorities. Bring recommendations to regular check-ins and involve the Director when appropriate.
  • Stay informed about organizational developments through internal channels, program materials, and conversations with colleagues. Share relevant insights and connect opportunities across teams.
  • Work with colleagues responsible for measurement to assess content performance and use audience insights to improve messaging, formats, and future content. Explore relevant storytelling practices and recommend useful approaches.

Desired Qualifications

  • At least six years of relevant experience in communications, journalism, or content development, including substantial hands-on writing and experience advising internal stakeholders.
  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Exceptional and proven English writing and editing skills, demonstrated through a portfolio of clear, accurate, audience-focused content across multiple formats.
  • Strong editorial judgment, including interviewing, fact-checking, accurate quotation and attribution, and the ability to explain complex programs or technical topics in accessible language.
  • Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs and creating or guiding video scripts, with a track record of working effectively with creative suppliers such as video producers, photographers, and designers.
  • Ability to lead productive meetings, make evidence-informed recommendations, and discuss competing needs diplomatically while building constructive working relationships.
  • Strong planning and follow-through, with the judgment to manage assigned work, coordinate with specialists, and recognize when guidance or a broader decision is needed.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a demonstrated ability to learn about an organization’s work and apply feedback. Ability to collaborate across cultures, teams, and time zones.
  • Ability to communicate with accuracy, sensitivity, and inclusive language appropriate to a mission-driven organization, and a commitment to an Internet for everyone.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in a nonprofit or international organization, and using content performance insights to improve communications.
  • Communications experience related to Internet issues, technology, digital inclusion, or the technical community.

Key Attributes

  • Clear, structured thinker with an ability to translate complex topics into meaningful messaging.
  • Comfortable operating in a distributor organization with multiple stakeholders and experts
  • Collaborative and confident working across teams and disciplines
  • Strong alignment with the Internet Society’s mission and 2030 Strategy

What You'll Love About Us

  • Make an Impact. We have an exciting vision and mission to bring the internet to everyone!
  • Great Company Culture. We are a global team and live our values of collaboration, inclusion, respect, people and passion in all of our HR programs including our new recognition program!
  • Holiday/Vacation. Generous paid time off and paid public holidays.
  • Benefits. Based on local in-country guidelines.
  • Give back. Get paid to volunteer in your community!
  • Professional Development and Educational Benefits. Annual company contribution towards professional development or higher education.
  • Flexible Work Models. Flexible work-from-home.

Compensation and benefits for this position will be paid in local currency and based on the country and geographic location’s local salary and benefits market data for the position. Exact pay will be based on factors including but not limited to relevant qualifications, experience, geographic location, education, business and organizational needs.

The Foundation is an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to sex, race, age, disability, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, color or any other protected class. Compensation and benefit package for this position will be competitively commensurate with the successful applicant’s qualifications. Applications will be evaluated until the position has been filled. The list of applicants will not be posted publicly and will be reviewed in confidence by members of the evaluation committee.

Important Notice to Applicants:

The Internet Society Foundation will never request payment or fees from candidates at any stage of the hiring process. All official communications will originate directly from the Internet Society. Any use of third-party recruiters or partners will be clearly indicated in the job posting. If you receive unsolicited or suspicious outreach claiming to represent the Internet Society, please treat it with caution.

jobs.description:
TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

Join Our Team as aSenior Clinical Research Associate - home based in Germany (Hamburg area preferred).

About this role

As part of our CDS DIID (Dermatology, Immunology & Inflammatory Diseases)team you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Senior Clinical Research Associatewill function operationally as a member of a Project Team and is responsible for the initiation, on–site and/or remote monitoring, close outof study sites during study conduct, according to company policies, SOPs and GCP and ICH guidelines and other regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor on-site and remotely clinical trials in accordance with TFS and/or sponsor Standard Operating Procedures GCP and ICH guidelines and applicable regulatory regulations. Perform all required monitoring activities at the study sites to assess and ensure subjects safety, data integrity and quality.

  • Verify the protection of study participants by informed consent procedures and protocol requirements that follow appropriate regulations.

  • Review CRFs (electronic or paper) and subject source documentation for validity and accuracy

  • Verify proper management and accountability of Investigational Product

  • Timely reporting of actions taken during monitoring visits in Monitoring Visit Report including findings, corrective and preventive actions already taken and update applicable tracking systems, as required; escalate observed deficiencies and issues as appropriate.

  • Providing site with the listing of issues identified during monitoring visit and action items which will need to be addressed in a timely manner.

  • Timely delivering site documents to eTMF or paper TMF.

  • Verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and ICH guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

  • Update CTMS and all other required by projects systems with accurate site level information

  • Participate in audit and/or inspection, it’s preparation and follow-up activities, as needed.

  • Order, ship, and reconcile clinical investigative supplies for study sites, if applicable.

  • May assist the Clinical Research Manager or Project Manager in certain aspects of project activities which may include:

    • project tracking,

    • monitoring plans,

    • review of monitoring reports

    • CRA resources management within the project

  • May perform Assessment Site Visits (ASV) when requested.

  • May act as mentor of CRAs.

  • May develop and implement therapeutic area training for other CRAs and project team members.

  • May participate in capabilities presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or nursing; or equivalent

  • >3 years of experience as CRA including relevant on-site monitoring experience.

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

  • Understand basic medical terminology and science associated with the assigned drugs and therapeutic areas.

  • Possess the understanding of Good Clinical Practice regulations, ICH guidelines.

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team matrix organization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Fluent in English and German

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Technology savvy and good software and computer skills

  • Soft skills requirements: Self-awareness, resolute, flexibility, collaborative mindset, proactivity, analytic approach, and attention to detail, coach ability, motivated to take on new challenges, facilitation of discussion, diplomacy in difficult situations.

  • Ability to take the ownership of the assigned tasks.

  • Ability to manage complex or early phases studies.

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 60-80%, overnight and abroad, if applicable.

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries with flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability are our guiding light serving as the framework for decision-making at all levels of the organization. They assist us in attracting and retaining valuable talent who share our sentiments, resulting in high employee engagement and satisfaction. By aligning on these fundamental values, we cultivate a unified force, geared towards innovation and excellence. This collective effort propels us towards our shared goal and fosters a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.

Together we make a difference.

jobs.title: IT Support Manager - Microsoft Managed Services
jobs.excerpt: TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team.
jobs.description:
TEKenable is seeking a dynamic Support Manager to lead our managed services support team. The Support Manager is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of an ITIL-aligned Managed Services team, delivering high-quality support across Microsoft cloud-focused solutions including Azure, .NET-based applications, Business Central, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

The role requires proactive ownership of support operations, identifying and addressing service risks, customer concerns, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets and potential escalations before intervention is required. The Support Manager is responsible not only for monitoring and reporting service performance, but for analysing trends and underlying issues, identifying risks and improvement opportunities, recommending appropriate actions and driving those actions through to completion. The role will ensure service stability, effective incident and problem management, high customer satisfaction and continuous improvement across service operations.

The role holder can work remotely, but the position is open to applicants in either Ireland or the UK only.

TEKenable is a leader in digital transformation, specialising in Microsoft cloud solutions and recognised for excellence in AI and Data. With a global presence and a remote-first policy, we deliver innovative managed services to clients worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Service Coordination & Delivery

  • Act as the operational bridge between the Service Delivery Manager and functional delivery teams.
  • Ensure service levels, KPIs, and contractual obligations are consistently met.
  • Support the Service Delivery Manager in contractual compliance, reporting, and client satisfaction initiatives.
  • Serve as the point of coordination for internal teams, ensuring smooth communication between technical functions and service management.
  • Produce regular and ad hoc reports, dashboards, KPI metrics and presentations for internal stakeholders, ensuring data accuracy and clarity.
  • Analyse service performance data to identify trends, underlying causes, risks and areas requiring action, providing clear recommendations rather than reporting metrics in isolation.
  • Engage with client operational stakeholders on service delivery matters, while the Service Delivery Manager retains responsibility for overall client relationship, governance, and commercial performance.
  • Participate in client service reviews, governance meetings, and operational reporting sessions alongside the Service Delivery Manager.
  • Provide service performance insights, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships with client operational leads, ensuring alignment between business needs and service delivery.

Operational Ownership

  • Own day-to-day ticket operations including prioritisation, assignment, and SLA adherence
  • Own operational issues and escalations through to resolution, ensuring actions are clearly assigned, tracked and followed through to completion.
  • Proactively identify service risks, SLA risks, ageing or stalled tickets, customer concerns and potential escalations, taking appropriate action before management or customer intervention is required.
  • Manage backlog, ageing tickets, and escalation handling
  • Coordinate Major Incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely internal and customer communication, clear ownership of actions, and appropriate RCA and follow-up activities.
  • Ensure Problem Management activities reduce repeat incidents
  • Manage service delivery across multiple clients, balancing competing priorities and ensuring effective allocation of shared resources
  • Manage prioritisation between BAU support activities and minor enhancements (run vs change)
  • Establish and maintain regular ticket quality reviews, ensuring appropriate documentation, customer communication, troubleshooting, categorisation and adherence to agreed support processes.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor incident and request volumes, escalation trends, and service performance.
  • Provide input into dashboards, reports, and forecasting models to support proactive service management.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with the Service Delivery Manager and Director of Managed Services.
  • Ensure ITIL-aligned processes are embedded and followed across delivery teams.
  • Identify gaps in process adherence and recommend improvements.
  • Understand, comply with and actively promote adherence to ISO27001 and ISO9001 policies and procedures.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed services delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using Delivery Platforms (FreshService, Datadog)

Key Competencies

  • Proactive Ownership & Accountability – takes ownership of service operations, identifies risks and issues early, takes appropriate action and drives activities through to completion without requiring continual management intervention.
  • Leadership & People Development – able to motivate, coach, and manage diverse teams across geographies.
  • Process-driven mindset with attention to compliance and governance.
  • Collaborative leadership—able to influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical and Data-Driven Thinking – able to interpret service data, identify trends and underlying causes, assess risks and translate findings into meaningful insight and clear recommendations.
  • Resilience and adaptability in managing escalations and shifting priorities.
  • Continuous improvement orientation—always seeking efficiency and service quality gains.
  • Initiative & Tooling for Improvement – proactively identifies opportunities to enhance delivery and leverages automation, dashboards, and service management tooling (e.g., ITSM platforms, monitoring, reporting, and analytics) to drive measurable improvements in performance, transparency, and client value.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication – communicates clearly with customers, technical teams and management, and is comfortable challenging, escalating and influencing where appropriate.

Why apply

  • Remote-first flexibility anywhere from Ireland or the UK with global collaboration across Spain, Hungary, and UAE.
  • Industry-leading transformation challenges using Microsoft tech in AI, Dynamics, and Data solutions.
  • Professional recognition, including Deloitte Fast 50, Microsoft Business Applications Partner of the Year, and more.
  • Career growth through coaching, structured development, and international exposure.

Requirements

  • Strong grounding in ITIL v4 practices (Foundation certification required; Intermediate/Managing Professional desirable).
  • Proven experience in managed service delivery coordination within enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with incident, problem, change, and request management processes.
  • Experience working in multi-location delivery models, ideally with offshore/nearshore coordination.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
  • Analytical mindset with experience in KPI tracking, reporting, and service performance analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft technology stack (Business Central, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform)
  • Previous experience using ITSM Platform

TEKenable's culture is built upon the values of resilience, heartfelt service, always striving and insatiable curiosity. You can learn more about our values at www.tekenable.ie. Candidates applying for this role need to be able to demonstrate how they have applied these values in other roles and how they'll contribute to them, should they be successful.

At TEKenable we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion as we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, disability, sexual orientation, generation, ethnicity, religion, family or parental status, neurodiversity or belief.

Hiring Process

Once you are successfully selected for interview a dedicated talent acquisition manager will reach out and arrange a short pre-screening call. We want to learn more about you and the experience you can bring to the position. The interview process will have 2-3 stages and we will work around your availability. You will the opportunity to talk with our recruitment team at various points throughout the process. All interview stages will be conducted remotely via video calls and arranged at a time that fits with your schedule. We will close the position once the role is filled.

Benefits

Remote working & sustainability - Experience the flexibility to work from Ireland or the UK, avoiding the stress of being stuck in car jams, saving valuable commute time to an office, while actively contributing to a lower carbon footprint and the fight against climate change.

Equipment - We'll set you up with a laptop and any other equipment you might need to get the job done.

Flexible working hours - Once pre-approved by line management, employees can benefit from flexibility around core business hours Monday to Friday.

Health & life Insurance - We offer a comprehensive health & life insurance to ensure your well-being and peace of mind.

Pension Scheme - A supportive employee pension scheme is offered to help you build a secure and comfortable future

Training & Development Support - We invest in your professional growth through structured learning opportunities, certifications, and career development pathways tailored to your role and ambitions.

Sports & Social Events - Join a vibrant community through regular sports activities, team outings, and social events that bring colleagues together and foster meaningful connections beyond work.

Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - Access confidential support, counselling, and well-being resources through our Employee Assistance Programme ,because your mental and emotional health matter just as much as your professional success.

jobs.excerpt: About ArcanysArcanys launched in 2010 to help technology companies in Europe and Australia build better software with dedicated engineering teams in Cebu.
jobs.description:
About Arcanys

Arcanys launched in 2010 to help technology companies in Europe and Australia build better software with dedicated engineering teams in Cebu. Today we are 350+ engineers and product people, and Great Place to Work named us the #1 medium-sized tech workplace in Southeast Asia in 2026.

Arcanys Ventures, our venture arm, has backed 35 early-stage startups since 2020 with a mix of capital and Arcanys engineering teams.

Why work with us?

There is a unique spirit at Arcanys: great people, a real passion for technology, and a strong focus on everyone's career and personal development. As a company rooted in people, we offer work that matters and a culture everyone can contribute to.

Join us as a Senior Revenue Operations Specialist

You will build and own the revenue engine behind two businesses: Arcanys sales and Arcanys Ventures dealflow. That means one front door for every startup, partner and client enquiry, HubSpot as the single source of truth, AI automations that screen and route leads, and the numbers our leadership uses to decide.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You design the systems, set the standards for how our data and pipelines are run, and run them yourself day to day, with AI tools doing the first pass.

In this role you'll get to:

  • Design and run the front door: one deals inbox and intake (forms, booking links, AI intro tools), with every enquiry routed to the right owner within one business day.

  • Own HubSpot end to end across two pipelines (Arcanys Sales and Arcanys Ventures): architecture, properties, workflows, data quality and dashboards.

  • Take ownership of our AI and automation stack (Claude, HubSpot, Make, Jotform, Apollo): document it, improve its accuracy and keep its cost in check.

  • Build the reporting: a monthly dealflow and sales scorecard and quarterly growth KPIs for the management team, with your own read on what the numbers say.

  • Run outbound and marketing tools: sequences, deliverability, newsletters and follow-up on every qualified lead.

  • Partner with our team in Europe, the UK and Australia on process and data, and make sure the systems work for them day to day.

  • You may also perform RevOps functions for some of our customers in Europe and Australia.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 6+ years in revenue operations, sales operations or CRM, including systems you built and ran yourself, end to end.

  • A HubSpot instance you designed or owned end to end.

  • Reports that leadership relied on to make decisions, and the judgment to spot a data problem before it becomes a reporting problem.

  • Hands-on experience building automations with AI tools (Claude or similar, Make or Zapier), well beyond chat.

  • A strong grasp of B2B funnels and pipeline metrics; at ease with spreadsheets and data.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to work directly with founders, partners and senior leaders.

  • Philippine business hours, with a morning overlap to Europe.

It's great if you have

  • A background in startups, venture capital or B2B services

  • HubSpot certification, and basic SQL

  • Experience with Apollo or another outbound tool, form integrations (Jotform or similar) and Notion

The Perks

We make sure our people are well taken care of. Here are some of the benefits you will enjoy:

  • Top compensation based on expertise: we look for top talent and pay accordingly.

  • Standard 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, with a flexible schedule (within reason).

  • Flat management and an open-door policy: no micromanagement, and your voice is heard.

  • HMO from day one, for you and up to 3 immediate dependents.

  • Incentive-based wellness program, free consultations with our nutritionist-dietitians, and free access to the Arcanys gym.

  • Free access to Mental Health Therapists (online)

jobs.description:
Local SEO Sales Representative

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, results-driven Local SEO Sales Representative to help small and medium-sized businesses improve their online visibility through local SEO services.

In this role, you’ll own the sales process from prospecting and lead qualification to discovery calls, proposals, follow-ups, and closing deals. You’ll need strong communication skills, a consultative sales approach, and a working understanding of local SEO to explain how these services help businesses attract more local customers.

This is a remote role for someone who takes ownership of their pipeline, works independently, and consistently strives to meet sales targets.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting

  • Identify small and medium-sized businesses that could benefit from local SEO services.
  • Build a consistent sales pipeline through cold calls, emails, and social outreach.
  • Prioritize prospects based on their potential needs and likelihood of conversion.

Consultative Selling & Lead Qualification

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand prospects’ online visibility challenges and business goals.
  • Explain local SEO services and how they can help businesses reach more local customers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads based on fit, potential value, and conversion likelihood.

Proposals, Objection Handling & Closing

  • Prepare and present service proposals tailored to prospect needs.
  • Address objections confidently and communicate the value of local SEO solutions.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects and guide them toward a purchasing decision.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, including prospect details, communication history, and next steps.
  • Track pipeline progress and ensure opportunities receive timely follow-up.
  • Keep sales activity organized so potential deals do not fall through the cracks.

Sales Targets & Performance

  • Work toward defined monthly revenue targets and sales quotas.
  • Monitor performance against targets and identify areas that need improvement.
  • Proactively communicate challenges, seek support when needed, and adjust outreach strategies to improve results.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in B2B or B2C sales, preferably selling digital marketing services or recurring-revenue solutions.
  • Working knowledge of local SEO concepts, including Google Business Profile, local citations, map pack rankings, and review management.
  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in clear, persuasive language.
  • Experience using a CRM to manage sales pipelines, track prospect interactions, and document follow-up activities.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and manage daily priorities.
  • Strong prospecting, objection-handling, follow-up, and closing skills.
  • A results-driven mindset with the ability to monitor and take ownership of sales performance.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of your sales numbers and know where you stand against your targets.
  • You act early when performance falls behind instead of waiting until the end of the month.
  • You communicate proactively, flag challenges early, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • You are curious about small business owners and take time to understand their challenges rather than relying on scripted pitches.
  • You handle rejection professionally, learn from lost deals, and move quickly to the next opportunity.
  • You are comfortable managing your own schedule, pipeline, and follow-up process without close supervision.

What Success Looks Like

  • A consistent pipeline of qualified prospects is maintained through proactive outreach.
  • Discovery conversations identify genuine business needs and opportunities.
  • Proposals, follow-ups, and objections are handled effectively to move deals toward closing.
  • CRM records remain accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Monthly sales and revenue targets are consistently pursued and achieved.
  • Sales activity and messaging improve over time based on results and feedback.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing your pipeline and prioritizing prospects most likely to move forward. Much of your day will involve outbound prospecting, including cold calls, emails, and follow-ups with business owners. You’ll lead discovery calls, explain local SEO solutions, address objections, and guide prospects through the sales process.

Between conversations, you’ll update your CRM, review pipeline performance, refine your outreach approach, and coordinate with the team when additional support is needed to close a deal. Most communication is asynchronous, with check-ins as needed to align on priorities and pipeline health.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

AI Optimization Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Optimization Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Optimization Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. The ideal candidate has demonstrated impact on production AI workloads, with strong instrumentation and measurement discipline that enables rigorous, data-driven optimization decisions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in performance engineering, ML systems, or HPC.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques.
  • Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications.
  • Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies.
  • Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale.
  • Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects.
  • Familiarity with custom kernel authoring in Triton or CUTLASS.
  • Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.
  • Publications or talks on AI systems performance.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Make a difference.

Are you looking for something new in your career? Enjoy a challenge? Love to innovate and learn? This is an exciting opportunity to join a technology startup in a high growth phase. Our Enterprise Solutions Engineering team are our in-house, customer-facing product experts. The Enterprise SE team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands-on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We also partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Enterprise SE team is also one of the primary routes of communication from our customers through into the Product Management and Engineering teams.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Join as an early member of a high growth team working together to solve technical and customer problems the right way
  • Partner with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision, and strategy to customers
  • Own the technical engagement with customers and help to close high-velocity opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill, and credibility
  • Deliver product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
  • Proactively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide a feedback loop on our products and the competitive landscape
  • Drive product conversations based on need and problems learned during customer interactions
  • Work with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles, and create other public and internal enablement material

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years of technical pre-sales experience, ideally with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space while we will be adding more junior folks later on, right now we just need team members that can hit the ground running.

  • You will love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
  • You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically. Great candidates may be a recent grad of a coding bootcamp or have previous post-sales or engineering experience–we are excited to see what unique experiences and skill sets you bring to the table!
  • You are self-motivated, initiative, creative, and maybe you’ve already done a brave thing or two in your life!

In the United States the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $204,000 - $254,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito. Você será responsável por:

Execução e evolução (base atual do produto)

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter os serviços core do Conexa AI (ms-agency, ms-ai-gatekeeper e adjacências), com foco em assertividade, escalabilidade, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar funcionalidades de IA generativa e agêntica em produção: agentes, pipelines RAG, orquestração de workflows, integração com LLMs e ferramentas externas via MCPs.
