  • Trabalhar com filas de mensagens e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (RabbitMQ, BullMQ) para processamento assíncrono e orquestração de fluxos conversacionais e agênticos.
  • Modelar, otimizar e manter bancos de dados relacionais, não-relacionais e vector databases — incluindo estratégias de embeddings, cache e consistência eventual.
  • Contribuir pontualmente com o front-end do produto (React/TypeScript) quando o fluxo de entrega demandar.
  • Investigar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em ambientes de produção multi-tenant, incluindo comportamentos não-determinísticos típicos de sistemas baseados em LLM.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes automatizados, avaliações de qualidade de agentes (evals) e boas práticas de engenharia de software.

Inovação e expansão de escopo

  • Identificar e propor novas aplicações de IA generativa/agêntica no ecossistema Conexa, além do Conexa AI, a partir de dores reais de produto ou operação.
  • Prototipar rapidamente (spikes, POCs) hipóteses de features de IA antes de comprometer com implementação completa, validando viabilidade técnica e valor de negócio.
  • Ter voz ativa na definição de onde e como IA deve ser aplicada no roadmap do time, não apenas executar especificações vindas de Produto.
  • Trazer conhecimento de estado da arte em IA (novos modelos, técnicas de agentes, avaliação, tooling) para o time e avaliar adoção pragmática.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (Produto, Design, QA, Dados, IA) para entregas integradas, alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio e trazendo perspectiva técnica para a priorização de novas ideias.
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis e contribuir ativamente para a evolução técnica e estratégica do time.

Esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com e NestJS, com domínio de TypeScript estrito e arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com Python (FastAPI ou equivalente) aplicada ao desenvolvimento de serviços e APIs — especialmente no contexto de IA generativa.
  • Experiência prática construindo agentes de IA, pipelines RAG e integrações com LLMs em produção — independentemente de framework específico (LangChain, LlamaIndex, orquestração própria ou similar). O que importa é o domínio dos fundamentos, não a ferramenta.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de orquestração de workflows e automação (n8n ou equivalentes) — disposição para aprender a ferramenta usada no time, mesmo sem experiência prévia específica nela.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), incluindo modelagem, queries complexas e tuning de performance.
  • Prática com bancos não-relacionais (MongoDB, Redis) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (RabbitMQ, BullMQ).
  • Familiaridade com vector databases e princípios de embeddings/busca semântica — independente de qual (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, etc.).
  • Experiência com design e versionamento de APIs RESTful e WebSockets.
  • Capacidade de ler e evoluir código front-end em React/TypeScript quando necessário para desbloquear a entrega — sem exigência de especialização na camada.
  • Uso habitual e avançado de ferramentas de IA agêntica no desenvolvimento (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot ou similares), com capacidade de revisar criticamente as sugestões geradas e customizar o ambiente (incluindo MCPs) para maximizar a produtividade do time.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e squads multidisciplinares.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com forte ownership — confortável propondo, prototipando e defendendo iniciativas próprias, não apenas executando demandas definidas por terceiros.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto em ambientes de alta ambiguidade, típicos de produtos de IA.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Vivência prévia puxando iniciativas de IA do zero (0 to 1) — não só evoluindo produtos de IA já estabelecidos.
  • Prática com observabilidade aplicada a sistemas de IA: logs estruturados, métricas, distributed tracing e monitoramento de qualidade de agentes/prompts.
  • Experiência com AWS e arquitetura em nuvem.
  • Vivência prévia em produtos de saúde digital, healthtech ou domínios regulados equivalentes.
  • Interesse ativo e atualizado em pesquisa e novidades de IA generativa/agêntica (novos modelos, técnicas, papers, ferramentas).

Resource Coordinator

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.

Overview

The Resource Operations team is responsible for the management and effective scheduling of our resources for all client engagements.

As a Resource Coordinator, you’ll play a key role in supporting the management of our resource pool. You’ll act as a primary point of contact, keeping consistent communication with resources to provide an accurate, current view of availability and skills, along with driving timely updates, reporting and administration activities. Working across Salesforce, Suite Projects Pro and our internal tracking tools, you’ll help maintain a single, trusted view of capacity, project status and timelines so stakeholders can rely on accurate resourcing data.

This is a fully remote role, so you’ll be expected to work autonomously by prioritizing your workload, driving follow-ups, and keeping systems up to date while collaborating with the team via Slack, email and Zoom.

Expected results

  • Support the Resource Manager by promptly updating relevant systems with confirmed changes to resource availability and project status, timelines and commitments, and communicating the staffing implications with relevant context to internal stakeholders
  • Proactively and systematically engage with practitioners to confirm availability, project status and commitments, and follow up on missing or outdated information
  • Maintain accurate practitioner data around skills, expertise and project assignments in all internal systems.
  • Coordinate practitioner onboarding activities, including drafting contractor agreements, submitting systems onboarding requests and scheduling orientation activities
  • Support the Resource Manager by identifying potential practitioners whose expertise and experience match project requirements and presenting suitable options for the Resource Manager to make staffing decisions
  • Report on daily global resourcing availability

Required qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to deliver concise summaries and relay specific details efficiently to senior stakeholders
  • Highly organized with strong prioritization skills; able to manage multiple concurrent requests and shifting timelines in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment
  • Demonstrated ability to pull together information from multiple sources, reconcile discrepancies, and have a holistic view of team, project and operational needs
  • Strong attention to detail and a “data hygiene” mindset; able to maintain accuracy across multiple systems and spot inconsistencies before they become issues
  • Confident problem-solver who can surface conflicts early and propose practical options and trade-offs
  • Takes initiative and has a willing, collaborative attitude
  • Proficient in Microsoft - particularly Excel and Outlook

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development or modernization programs.
  • Experience developing mission-critical, regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability systems.

Job Overview

The GxP Compliance Manager is responsible for overseeing cleanroom cleaning operations, contamination control programs, and regulatory compliance within GxP cleanrooms, laboratories, and other controlled environments. This role ensures that all cleaning and disinfection activities are performed in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), validated cleaning methods, and applicable regulatory and safety requirements.


In addition to technical and compliance oversight, the GMP Compliance Manager is accountable for overall account performance, including, labor productivity, staffing, client satisfaction, contract compliance, and continuous operational improvement. The successful candidate will develop strong client partnerships, lead and develop site teams, maintain inspection-ready documentation, and ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality, compliant services within regulated life sciences environments.

GMP Compliance & Contamination Control

  • Develop, implement, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and cleaning documentation to ensure consistent execution and regulatory compliance.

Are you passionate about being part of a team at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales that delivers extraordinary care to help individuals and businesses prepare for and protect their future? If so, then Nationwide Financial could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across projects, releases, and business processes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, project managers, developers, and QA teams to define UAT scope, objectives, timelines, and entry/exit criteria.
  • Translate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into comprehensive UAT scenarios, test cases, and data requirements.
  • Identify and coordinate appropriate business testers, clarify roles and responsibilities, and provide UAT guidance, training, and support.
  • Develop and maintain UAT plans, schedules, test scripts, traceability matrices, status reports, and other required documentation.
  • Coordinate test environments, system access, integrations, test data, and other readiness dependencies before testing begins.
  • Facilitate UAT execution, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure testing remains aligned with business priorities and release milestones.
  • Review, validate, and triage defects; ensure issues are documented with sufficient detail, prioritized appropriately, assigned to owners, and retested through resolution.
  • Track test results, requirements coverage, defect trends, risks, and outstanding issues; communicate status and recommendations to project and business leadership.
  • Evaluate UAT outcomes and provide a clear go/no-go recommendation for production release based on agreed acceptance criteria and residual risk.
  • Ensure business and compliance requirements are adequately tested and that required approvals, signoffs, and audit evidence are completed.
  • Drive continuous improvement of UAT processes, templates, tools, metrics, and testing practices.
  • Mentor UAT testers and promote consistent, risk-based, and customer-focused quality practices across delivery teams.
  • Support post-release validation, production readiness activities, and lessons-learned reviews as needed.


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

Job Description Summary

We are a versatile group of individuals, working together to meet the needs of our customers. We value knowledge, strong business savvy and contributing to a stellar team dynamic. If you thrive in a busy, engaging work environment, we want to know more about you!

As a Consultant, you'll act independently or as a member of a team responsible for establishing a common understanding of the business environment in which a project must be defined, designed, created, deployed, used and supported. You will participate in major process modeling, analysis and design efforts providing business performance management, organizational design and business risk management capabilities to formulate pragmatic, forward facing and impactful business transformation plans.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partners with senior leaders to transform their businesses through the strategic application of people, processes and technology. Participates in the planning process by identifying complexities, dependencies and duplications.

  • Demonstrates expertise in leading business process analysis/design, organizational analysis, needs assessments and cost/benefit analysis to align solutions with business strategies and direction. Consults with functional groups within Nationwide Technology and internal business clients to develop short- and long-term business transformation plans.

  • Serves as process management contributor and consultant between business customers and systems area for development and implementation of business processes and procedures. Responsible for communicating to customers, management and external sources.

  • As a team member, participates in analysis and design of organizational structures, roles, responsibilities, governance, staffing and sourcing to support business goals, strategies and process architecture. Provides significant contribution in executing business unit level change.

May monitors project schedules and costs. May develops project plans, work breakdown structures and desired outcomes for overall solution delivery.

Performs other responsibilities as assigned.

Sound knowledge of a variety of tools, concepts and techniques. Understanding of new technologies and developments in the technology industry. Detailed knowledge of the system development life cycle. Knowledge of project management concepts and techniques are required. Thorough knowledge of facilitation, performance management, organizational design and managing organization change. jobs.title: Communications and Advocacy Specialist - MEER
jobs.excerpt: With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life.
jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Employee Contract Type:

Local - Fixed Term Employee (Fixed Term)

Job Description:

JOB PURPOSE: The Communications and Advocacy Specialist supports the development and implementation of communications, advocacy, and engagement strategies that enhance organizational visibility, reputation, and influence of the organization across the Middle East and Eastern Europe Region (MEER). The role co-leads risk communications, media engagement, and reputation management efforts, while supporting external relations, advocacy initiatives, and meaningful child participation. It develops and delivers compelling communication products and social media content, coordinates media outreach activities, and provides technical support and guidance to field offices on communications, risk communications, and advocacy. The position also strengthens internal communications and cross-functional coordination to ensure consistent messaging across the organization and contributes to emergency communications and advocacy responses as required.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

A. RISK COMMUNICATIONS, AND REPUTATION

  • Co-lead on risk communications, media and reputation with Advocacy, Communications & External Engagement Senior Advisor and in close coordination with FO, RO and GC risk leads.
  • Ensure all communications, media and reputation risk issues are addressed in a timely and effective way.
  • Ensure FOs address communications, media and reputation risks and draft reactive statements in timely way.
  • Onboard new comms risk focal points and ensure they complete online training.
  • Organise regular refresher trainings with all comms risk focal points in the region.
  • Update senior advisor and SDO on a regular basis regarding any major communications risks.
  • Liaise closely with FO, RO and GC risk leads to mitigate any negative outcomes.
  • Update and assign media, risk and reputation cases accordingly in ethics point.

B. EXTERNAL ENGAGEMENT, ADVOCACY & CHILD PARTICIPATION

  • Support with advocacy initiatives, including external engagement events, reports and policy briefs, talking points and key messages.
  • Support with child participation initiatives in close coordination with field offices’ child participation focal points and children’s councils.
  • Support with the establishment of sustainable child and youth participation mechanisms at field and regional level.
  • Support with the conceptualisation and implementation of external engagement events at regional level.

C. COMMUNICATIONS & SOCIAL MEDIA

  • Support with communications and social media content production and design.
  • Support with updating RO website pages in WVI.
  • Support with reviewing and publishing FO content in WVI.
  • Supporting with uploading regional content in storyhub and answering any content requests.
  • Support with social media posting and monitoring.
  • Support with communications dashboard and hootsuite roll out at regional level and in close collaboration with GC and RO.
  • Lead on Cision media monitoring tool roll out at regional level.
  • Produce quarterly media monitoring reports through Cision.
  • Support with media engagement, particularly through Cision’s media pitching tools.
  • Lead on liaising with external designers for the design of external products such as reports and capacity statements.
  • Ensure all regional products are up to standard, branded correctly and in line with safeguarding policies.
  • Support the team with exploring how the usage of AI tools could facilitate and enhance communications and social media content development

D. TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR FIELD OFFICES

  • Provide technical communications and social media support to field offices when needs arise.
  • Provide technical advocacy and child participation support to field offices when needs arise.
  • Provide technical support to field offices in risk communications, media and reputation.
  • Support field offices with Cision onboarding and use.
  • Support RO and FOs with emergency advocacy and communications during emergencies.
  • Support with the development of regional internal and external pools of comms and advocacy experts who can be deployed in during P&C gaps and emergencies.

E. INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS & COORDINATION

  • Attend regional and global advocacy and communications coordination calls and provide regular updates.
  • Support with the dissemination of MEERO’s communications and advocacy products through key TEAMS channels.
  • Support with internal communications (ie Ignite newsletter, WV Central etc.)

F. GENERAL

  • Participate in devotions and other activities that enrich and develop mutual growth in Christ.
  • Ensure World Vision’s Christian identity is well represented through our external and internal communications and advocacy.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND EXPERIENCE

Required Education, training, license, registration, and/or Certification

  • University degree in Communications, Journalism, International Relations, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • Relevant professional training in communications, advocacy, media relations, digital communications, or humanitarian programming is desirable.

Required Professional Experience

  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant professional experience in communications, advocacy, media relations, public affairs, or external engagement within the humanitarian, development, or non-profit sector.
  • Experience developing and implementing communications and advocacy initiatives at national, regional, or international level.
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders, including media representatives, civil society organizations, government actors, donors, and community representatives.
  • Experience providing communications and/or advocacy support to field teams and/or local partners.
  • Experience working in complex humanitarian and emergency contexts is desirable.

Required Language(s)

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Knowledge of any other language relevant to the Middle East and Eastern Europe Region (MEER) is an asset.

Position’s physical requirements

Must be in good physical health


Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications

  • Strong communications content development skills, including photography, videography, graphic design, storytelling, and multimedia content production.
  • Experience in social media management, monitoring, audience engagement, and digital communications.
  • Excellent report writing, editing, proofreading, and report design skills.
  • Experience drafting advocacy messages, key messages, talking points, policy briefs, and other advocacy materials.
  • Good knowledge and practical experience in child and youth participation approaches and initiatives.

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organization with a mission centered on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

jobs.title: Licensed Therapist (West Virginia Licensure)
jobs.excerpt: Help Shape the Future of Behavioral Addiction TreatmentAs online gambling and gaming continue to expand, so does the need for specialized behavioral health care.
jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Behavioral Addiction Treatment

As online gambling and gaming continue to expand, so does the need for specialized behavioral health care. At Kindbridge Behavioral Health, a Joint Commission-accredited telehealth organization, we help individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related challenges while providing therapists the opportunity to build expertise in this growing field.

We're seeking part-time Therapists licensed to practice in West Virginia (residency in WV not required) who are interested in expanding their clinical skill set, working with a unique client population, and making a meaningful impact through flexible, remote work.

Why Choose Kindbridge:

Develop a Specialized Clinical Skill Set — Gain hands-on experience treating gambling, gaming, and other behavioral addictions while building expertise in one of behavioral health's fastest-growing specialties

Receive Clinical Training & Mentorship — We provide ongoing education, clinical consultation, and support pursuing the International Certified Gambling Counselor (ICGC-I) credential through mentorship from a nationally recognized, Ph.D.-trained, ICGC-II-certified gambling addiction clinician

Join an Accredited Behavioral Health Organization — Work with a Joint Commission-accredited organization committed to the highest standards of quality, safety and patient care

Focus on Clinical Work — We handle credentialing, billing, insurance claims, collections, and other administrative tasks so you can focus on providing care

Build a Flexible Remote Practice — Set your own schedule and maintain a caseload that aligns with your availability and professional goals

Work Alongside Experts in the Field — Join a collaborative team of clinicians who are passionate about advancing care for individuals and families seeking support for compulsive or overuse behaviors, or emotional dysregulation struggles through compassionate, evidence-based treatment

What We Provide:

  • ICGC-I certification support
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Clinical consultation and peer support
  • Insurance credentialing support
  • Assistance with and funding for additional state licensure
  • Administrative and billing support
  • Flexible scheduling and remote work
  • W-2 employment
  • 401(k) with employer match

Who We're Looking For:

  • Active clinical licensure in the state of West Virginia: LPC, LPCC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent license
  • Interest in gambling disorder, gaming disorder, and other behavioral challenges
  • Desire to pursue ICGC-I certification with company support
  • Commitment to evidence-based, client-centered care
  • Interest in collaborating with a team that’s driving innovation in teletherapy
  • Spanish fluency is a plus

Join Our Mission:

At Kindbridge, you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise into a highly specialized area of behavioral health while helping individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related behavioral challenges.

If you're looking for meaningful clinical work, ongoing mentorship, and the opportunity to become a leader in an emerging field, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you?
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Overview: Lead and deliver complex security engagements centered on Azure Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM), and Microsoft Purview / AI Governance. Serve as a principal-level architect, thought leader, and trusted advisor who shapes secure cloud, data, and AI governance strategies for enterprise clients while remaining deeply engaged in delivery. This role is primarily delivery focused, with approximately 25-30% dedicated to sales support, solution development, and strategic client pursuits.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Principal Technical Leadership: Provide senior technical leadership across multiple strategic client engagements. Lead executive and architectural design sessions, define target-state security architectures, and guide delivery teams through implementation with a strong focus on quality, scalability, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Trusted Advisor & Thought Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, including security, infrastructure, data, and executive leaders. Shape security roadmaps, advise on operating models and governance, and bring forward innovative perspectives on Azure security, identity modernization, data protection, and AI governance.
  • Delivery Oversight & Execution: Remain hands-on in delivery while overseeing complex programs from strategy through implementation. Partner with delivery leadership to align milestones, manage technical risk, remove blockers, and ensure successful outcomes across architecture, implementation, and adoption phases.
  • Azure Security & IAM Architecture: Design and lead implementation of enterprise security architectures across Azure and hybrid environments, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), role-based access control, Zero Trust controls, workload protection, and security monitoring patterns aligned to least privilege and strong governance.
  • Purview & AI Governance Leadership: Lead engagements focused on Microsoft Purview, information protection, data security posture management, data loss prevention, compliance, and governance for Copilot, AI applications, and AI agents. Help clients establish secure and compliant approaches for data access, policy enforcement, monitoring, lifecycle management, and responsible AI enablement.
  • Sales Support & Solution Development: Contribute approximately 25-30% of role capacity to sales enablement and solution development activities. Partner with account teams and solution leaders to shape opportunities, lead discovery conversations, develop solution approaches, support estimates and statements of work, contribute to proposals, and articulate differentiated value in client pursuits.
  • Practice Development & Mentorship: Help scale the security practice through reusable assets, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards. Mentor architects and engineers, coach teams on emerging Microsoft security capabilities, and strengthen organizational readiness across Azure security, identity, data governance, and AI security disciplines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 12+ years in security, infrastructure, or cloud consulting, including 7+ years focused on Azure security, IAM, and enterprise governance. Proven experience leading complex client engagements, influencing senior stakeholders, and owning architectural outcomes across multiple initiatives.
  • Azure Security & Identity Expertise: Deep hands-on and architectural expertise across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, PIM, access reviews, lifecycle governance, Azure Policy, Defender, Sentinel, RBAC, and Zero Trust design. Strong understanding of hybrid identity, privileged access, and security controls for cloud-first enterprises.
  • Purview & Governance Expertise: Strong experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities including data classification, sensitivity labeling, DLP, compliance controls, audit, eDiscovery, data lifecycle management, and AI/data security governance. Ability to design governance models that support secure adoption of Copilot, AI applications, and agent-based solutions.
  • Solutioning & Client Advisory: Demonstrated ability to support pre-sales and solution development, including leading workshops, defining scope, developing roadmaps, building solution narratives, estimating delivery approaches, and supporting proposals and executive presentations.
  • Delivery Leadership: Strong consulting and delivery leadership skills, including risk management, technical oversight, stakeholder communication, and the ability to balance strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on execution.
  • Communication & Presence: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences. Recognized as a credible thought leader with strong facilitation, mentorship, and client relationship skills.
  • Certifications: Strongly preferred certifications include SC-100 (Cybersecurity Architect Expert), AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), and relevant Microsoft Purview, compliance, or security certifications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Additional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or GIAC are highly desirable.
  • Architecture & Platform Breadth: Broad understanding of Azure platform architecture, security operations, infrastructure-as-code, and integration across identity, networking, data, and cloud governance domains.
  • Executive Advisory Experience: Experience advising senior client leaders on security strategy, governance operating models, regulatory readiness, Zero Trust transformation, and responsible AI adoption.

Location: Remote (USA) – with potential occasional travel to client sites.

Join 3Cloud’s Azure and Security team to help clients modernize security architecture, strengthen identity and governance, and enable AI responsibly. This role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact delivery, shape strategic client outcomes, and influence the evolution of our security solutions and go-to-market offerings.

jobs.title: Optimization Engineer (North America)
jobs.excerpt: About BraincubeBraincube is a global real-time process optimization company helping manufacturers improve operational performance through AI, advanced data capabilities, and deep industrial expertise.
jobs.description:
About Braincube

Braincube is a global real-time process optimization company helping manufacturers improve operational performance through AI, advanced data capabilities, and deep industrial expertise. Our platform enables manufacturers to increase yield, improve quality, optimize energy usage, and enhance throughput, at scale and in real-time across complex, multi-site operations.

The Role

The Optimization Engineer plays a key role in helping customers achieve measurable business results throughout their journey with Braincube, from onboarding and deployment through adoption, value realization, and expansion. In this role, you’ll work directly with customer teams to understand their operational challenges, translate business objectives into actionable improvement opportunities, and help drive sustainable gains in areas such as uptime, throughput, quality, and efficiency.

You’ll serve as a critical link between technical execution and business value, partnering closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and cross-functional technical teams to ensure successful customer outcomes. You’ll also have the opportunity to work across multiple sites and levels of an organization, advising customers on digital maturity, Manufacturing Excellence, Six Sigma, and broader continuous improvement initiatives.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in Oil & Gas or Petrochemical operations, with downstream experience considered a plus. This is a highly collaborative, customer-facing role for someone who enjoys solving complex operational problems, working with data and technology, and helping manufacturers and industrial organizations turn improvement opportunities into measurable results.

What you'll do

  • Partner with customer leadership and plant teams to define objectives, build trusted relationships, and drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Lead customer engagements from the plant floor through the executive level, translating business challenges into structured, actionable improvement plans.

  • Diagnose complex operational challenges using root-cause analysis, Manufacturing Excellence, Six Sigma, DMAIC, and other continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Provide analytical and technical expertise to identify opportunities, reduce variability, and improve performance across metrics such as uptime, throughput, quality, and ROI.

  • Lead solution deployment and execution, ensuring alignment between customer stakeholders and internal technical, engineering, data science, and product teams.

  • Assess customer digital maturity and identify opportunities for digital transformation and continuous improvement across sites and at the corporate level.

  • Drive adoption and value realization by helping customers effectively implement, use, and scale solutions within their operations.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion based on demonstrated customer value and collaborate with Account Executives on technical discussions, demos, value assessments, and opportunity development.

  • Deliver training, coaching, and best-practice guidance to build customer proficiency and enable sustainable improvements.

  • Develop documentation and resources that capture best practices and support scalable customer enablement.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong ability to identify needs and drive toward outcomes despite ambiguity and challenges

  • Expertise in Continuous Improvement methodologies (DMAIC, gap planning, process variability reduction)

  • Expertise in Statistical Process Control (control charts, centerlines, process stability)

  • Advanced data analysis capabilities (trial comparisons, root cause analysis, failure analysis)

  • Working knowledge of Data Science concepts and applications

  • Demonstrated experience in Change Management and Project Management

  • Servant leadership mindset with a focus on empowering customers

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex or unclear objectives into actionable solutions

  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills

  • Highly proactive and self-directed, with the ability to balance autonomy and structure

  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills in a dynamic environment

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace or similar tools

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or other related fields (preferred)

  • 7 years of experience in manufacturing or industrial operations.

  • Experience working in or supporting Oil & Gas or Petrochemical operations required.

  • Downstream Oil & Gas experience preferred.

Compensation (North America)

Pay: PHP 50k to 60k per month

Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.

Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.

This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.

For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.

A few examples of your responsibilities

Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.

Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.

Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.

Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.

Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.

Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.

Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.

Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.

What we look for

Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.

Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.

Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.

Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.

Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.

Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.

Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.

What we offer

Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.

Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.

Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.

Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you decide how to use it.

Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.

A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.

The selection process

We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.

Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link:

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.

We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.

Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.

If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Turn founder ideas into short-form content that earns qualified attention

We are hiring a hands-on short-form strategist to own the idea-to-performance loop for Eric Siu's content across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Include “Short-form strategy is cool” in the subject line. Otherwise, your application will be disqualified.

You will turn X posts, podcasts, long-form videos, and current ideas into platform-native concepts. You will own the hook, angle, format, script or shot plan, visual treatment, editor brief, test plan, CTA, and performance review. This is a strategy and operating role, not an editing-only or advisory role.

Your work should create qualified attention, conversations, email growth, and leads. Views without business relevance are not enough.

About Single Grain

Single Grain is a revenue marketing agency. We build pipeline-focused systems that compound, not campaigns that expire. We have helped more than 500 companies, from venture-backed startups to the Fortune 500, drive measurable growth.

Eric Siu hosts the Leveling Up podcast and co-hosts Marketing School with Neil Patel. The content reaches marketers, founders, and operators across YouTube, podcasts, email, and social platforms.

We operate as an AI-native team. Every role uses AI to improve speed, quality, judgment, and leverage. AI output still requires strong human taste and quality control.

Your mission

Build a repeatable short-form content system that turns Eric's current ideas and long-form source material into native concepts that improve qualified engagement and lead actions.

Primary KPI: improve qualified short-form actions from the first-30-day baseline while maintaining a reliable weekly testing cadence. Qualified actions include relevant profile visits, email sign-ups, comment-keyword actions, booked calls, or attributed leads.

What you will own

  • Audit current short-form performance, source content, audience, offers, and workflow.

  • Build and maintain a current format and hook library for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

  • Produce a rolling weekly slate of concepts, hooks, scripts or shot plans, visual treatments, editor briefs, and CTAs.

  • Turn long-form material into original short-form ideas, not only basic cutdowns.

  • Direct editors through delivery and give clear, timely feedback.

  • Run structured tests across hooks, topics, formats, visual treatments, and CTAs.

  • Review hold rate, completion, saves, shares, profile actions, and qualified lead actions each week.

  • Keep a four-week concept backlog and document what to scale, stop, or change.

  • Build AI-assisted research, scripting, briefing, and analysis workflows with clear human QA.

What success looks like

In 30 days, you have audited the system, set the baseline, built the first format library, and established a reliable editor handoff.

By 60 days, you run a steady weekly test cadence and can show which hooks, formats, topics, and CTAs work for this audience.

By 90 days, the system runs from idea selection through performance review with minimal handholding, and qualified actions have improved from the baseline.

Evidence we need to see

  • Recent strategy work for B2B, AI, SaaS, business, entrepreneur, marketing, finance, podcast, or expert-led creators.

  • Hands-on ownership from concept and hook through editor direction, publishing recommendation, and analytics review.

  • Current knowledge of platform-native formats and why they work.

  • Two recent examples with your exact contribution and the decisions you made.

  • One quantified result tied to qualified engagement, email growth, booked calls, pipeline, sales, revenue, or another business outcome.

  • A concrete AI-assisted workflow: trigger, inputs, tools, steps, output, QA, time saved, and the judgment that stays human.

  • Clear evidence that you can coordinate a small production team without waiting for a perfect brief.

This role is not

  • An editing-only seat.

  • A social scheduler or community-manager role.

  • A role that optimizes for views while ignoring audience quality and business outcomes.

  • A role for stale format knowledge or generic templates.

  • A role that waits for Eric to supply finished scripts and detailed instructions.

How the process works

  1. Application and evidence review.

  2. A focused screen against the role outcomes.

  3. A paid exercise using one real source asset: three distinct concepts, hooks, visual treatments, script or shot-plan notes, a lead-focused CTA, and an editor handoff.

  4. A live review of your choices, tradeoffs, and iteration.

  5. References and final decision.

The paid exercise is timeboxed and will not be used as unpaid production work.

Work model and compensation

This is a fully remote, part-time contractor role. Applicants must state their weekly capacity, available working hours, start date, and compensation expectations.

About Us

Job purpose

The Medical Billing Coordinator ensures timely and accurate reimbursement by managing outstanding claims and collaborating with insurance carriers, providers, and billing teams. This role requires strong problem-solving skills to resolve complex billing issues and maintain compliance with industry standards. This person will be key to early detection of problems ensuring claims are processed accurately and promptly. The position plays a key role in maintaining client satisfaction, providing critical support to ensure the financial health of our clients and growth for our company. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and insurance representatives.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Claims Management:
    • Conducts timely and accurate follow-up on professional services claims to ensure all requested information has been submitted and claims are being processed utilizing payor portals, secure chat, secure messaging, and telephone calls.
    • Identifies missing payments from the health plan and initiates tracking procedures.
    • Reviews incoming correspondence from health plans and takes appropriate action or escalates to designated team members as needed.
    • Identifies pending claims and determines next steps required to obtain reimbursement for claim.
    • Uses existing queries to review limited new denials for processing errors, appropriately assigns a status based on review, corrects any internal errors and resubmits claims as necessary.
    • Follows up with insurance carriers, providers, or other stakeholders to gather additional information or documentation required for claims resolution.
    • Monitors incoming messages from providers and responds to the provider or escalates the request to the appropriate team member.
    • Identifies claims with more complex issues and escalate them to the appropriate team member for resolution as needed.
    • Research health plan reimbursement policies and procedures, clinical guidelines, coding, and CCI edits to ensure claims are billed appropriately.
    • All other duties as assigned.
  • Communication:
    • Communicate effectively with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and their billing staff to resolve claims issues and answer inquiries.
    • Document all interactions and updates in the claims management system.
  • Documentation and Reporting:
    • Maintain accurate records of claim status, actions taken, and resolutions utilizing established policies and procedures.

  • Compliance:
    • Ensure all claims follow-up activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements.

    • Must meet quantitative production standard of working 100 – 150 claims per week.
    • Attend departmental and company meetings as required.
  • Problem Resolution:
    • Identify and report trends which could have an overall negative impact on claim payments such as processing errors, denials, or billing issues.
    • Investigate and resolve discrepancies or issues related to claims processing and payment.
    • Work with other team members and departments ensure proper claim submission.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Identify and recommend process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the claims follow-up process.
    • Participate in training and development opportunities to stay current with best practices and industry trends.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience as a medical biller or similar role.
  • Excellent technical skills including the ability to work in multiple systems simultaneously and learn new systems quickly.
    • EZ-Cap experience preferred.
    • Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Clearinghouse (Office Ally) experience preferred.
    • Microsoft Suite – Outlook, Teams, Office365, OneNote, OneDrive, SharePoint
    • Sequel Server Management Studio
    • Confluence
    • Azure
  • Thorough knowledge of healthcare benefits, network participation, coordination of benefits, referral and authorization requirements, and insurance follow up.
  • Working knowledge of CPT Codes, ICD-10 Codes, Modifiers, MUE, LCD, NCD, and CCI edits.
  • Must have strong time management skills, be able to multi-task, resolve problems utilizing critical thinking, be detail oriented and highly organized.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strict confidentiality.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

EEOC Statement

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

The position is: Remote

Travel Requirements: Less than 25%

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Backend Integration Engineer is the connective tissue of the AI Transformation team. This engineer builds and maintains the API infrastructure and system integrations that allow AI agents to interact with the organization’s core enterprise platforms — including ServiceNow, Okta, ERP systems, and other business-critical tools. This role ensures that when an AI agent needs to take action in the real world, the pathways are secure, reliable, well-documented, and reusable.

This is a role for a solid backend developer who is excited to apply strong fundamentals in an AI-first context. Experience with enterprise platform APIs is a strong differentiator. Direct MCP server development experience is rare and not required — a willingness to become an internal expert is expected.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Design, build, and maintain RESTful and event-driven APIs that expose enterprise system capabilities to AI agents and agentic workflows in a secure and controlled manner.
  • Develop and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementations that provide AI agents with structured, secure, and auditable access to enterprise tools, data sources, and services.
  • Build and manage integrations with key enterprise platforms including ServiceNow (workflow triggers, CMDB queries, ticket management), Okta (identity and access queries, group management), and ERP/financial systems.
  • Implement security controls for all integration endpoints: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authentication, API gateway policies, rate limiting, input sanitization, payload validation, and comprehensive audit logging.
  • Collaborate with Agentic AI Engineers to define MCP tool specifications and ensure agents can reliably invoke enterprise actions with appropriate authorization checks and operational guardrails.
  • Maintain comprehensive API documentation and an integration catalog so the team can build on existing ‘paved paths’ rather than re-implementing integrations from scratch.
  • Monitor integration health, SLA adherence, and error rates; implement alerting and graceful degradation patterns so agent failures are isolated and recoverable.
  • Work with the AI governance team to ensure integration designs comply with data classification policies, access control requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Evaluate and onboard new enterprise system integrations as the team’s scope of automation expands to additional business units and platforms.
  • Contribute to the team’s security review process for agent tool definitions, ensuring tool permissions follow the principle of least privilege.

QUALIFICATION, EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field preferred. Equivalent practical experience will be considered.

EXPERIENCE:

2–4 years of backend software development or systems integration experience. Experience with enterprise platform APIs (ServiceNow, Okta, Microsoft 365, or ERP systems) is a strong plus. Candidates with strong API and backend fundamentals who demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven automation will be considered.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Proficiency in at least one backend language — Python strongly preferred; Node.js or Java acceptable.
  • Strong understanding of REST API design principles, authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, API keys, JWT), and API gateway configuration.
  • Experience consuming and integrating with enterprise platform APIs (ServiceNow, Okta, Microsoft Graph, SAP, or similar).
  • Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or ability and enthusiasm to rapidly learn and implement MCP server patterns — a key skill for this team.
  • Security-first development mindset: input validation and sanitization, secure credential handling and rotation, least-privilege API scoping, audit logging, and OWASP API Security Top 10 awareness.
  • Familiarity with Azure API Management, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, or similar Azure integration and serverless platform services.
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture, webhook patterns, and asynchronous integration approaches.
  • Experience with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to write clear, accurate API documentation and integration specifications that other engineers can build on.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI agents and automation — understanding of how MCP tools are invoked by LLMs is a significant plus.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSURE:

Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) preferred. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or Okta certifications are a strong plus. OWASP API Security awareness desirable.

This leader will own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio—including new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, recurring-revenue growth, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy. The Vice President will lead a team of Global Strategic Account Managers who serve as the single commercial owners of their assigned accounts, managing the full relationship from strategy and executive alignment through opportunity development and commercial execution.


The mandate is to transform how Esko engages its most important customers and prospects: moving from transactional, product-led selling to consultative, value-based partnerships. This includes establishing rigorous account and pursuit planning, building executive-level relationships, uncovering enterprise-wide opportunities, and developing strategic commercial models such as multiyear agreements and Enterprise License Agreements.


The Vice President will bring together Sales, Customer Success, Presales, Product, Services, Marketing, partners, and Esko’s executive leadership around one coordinated strategy for each account. Success will be measured by sustainable portfolio growth, strong retention and expansion, new strategic customer acquisition, improved commercial discipline, deeper executive relationships, and customers who view Esko as a trusted strategic partner.


What You'll Do


In this role, you will:


  • Build and lead Esko’s global Strategic Account Sales organization, establishing the operating model, performance expectations, and execution standards for the Tier 1 portfolio.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Global Strategic Account Managers, with each SAM serving as the single commercial owner of assigned strategic customers and prospects.
  • Own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio, including bookings, recurring-revenue growth, new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy.
  • Establish clear criteria and governance for identifying and managing strategic customers and high-potential prospects in partnership with Esko’s leadership team.
  • Develop and execute multiyear strategic account plans for existing customers and comprehensive pursuit plans for Tier 1 prospects.
  • Expand Esko’s presence within strategic customers by identifying new buying centers, business units, geographies, use cases, and enterprise-wide opportunities across Esko’s portfolio.
  • Shift customer engagement from transactional product selling to consultative, value-based selling through executive discovery, trusted-advisor workshops, business-value assessments, and outcome-based proposals.
  • Develop and execute strategic commercial models, including Enterprise License Agreements, multiyear agreements, and portfolio-based solutions that increase customer value and strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Build strong, multilevel relationships across customer organizations, including executive sponsors, business leaders, operational stakeholders, procurement, and technology teams.
  • Establish executive sponsorship, account governance, strategic customer workshops, and regular business reviews for Esko’s most important relationships.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and deal strategist for significant opportunities, ensuring disciplined qualification, competitive positioning, negotiation, pricing, discount governance, and deal closure.
  • Orchestrate Presales, Customer Success, Product, Services, Marketing, product specialists, partners, and Esko executives around a single account strategy with clear roles and rules of engagement.
  • Partner with Customer Success to protect retention, drive adoption and customer value, identify expansion opportunities, and address account risk proactively.
  • Implement consistent operating discipline across account planning, pipeline management, opportunity progression, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and business reviews.
  • Represent the voice of strategic customers internally, using market and customer insight to inform product, packaging, services, and go-to-market priorities while balancing individual requests with Esko’s broader strategic direction.
  • Build the capabilities, methodologies, playbooks, and coaching practices required to scale a world-class strategic-account organization globally.

What We're Looking For


Minimum Qualifications


These are the must-have requirements for the role:


  • Experience leading a global enterprise sales teams in a recurring revenue B2B software environment
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing sales teams that have delivered measurable ARR growth through acquisition, expansion, and customer retention
  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute multi-year account strategies across complex, multinational customer
  • Experience leading teams through complex sales cycles, including contract negotiation and deal closure at the executive level
  • Experience with CRM tools and commercial reporting, with demonstrated ability to drive accurate team forecasting and pipeline management
  • Collaborative leadership skills with demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Finance, and Customer Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications


These are nice-to-have skills that will set candidates apart:


  • Experience selling or managing accounts within the packaging, print technology, pre-media, or digital workflow software industries
  • Background in building or transforming a Strategic Account Management function within a global software organization
  • Experience with MEDDPPIC
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, and an AI automated GTM tech stack
  • Experience with value selling
  • Additional language proficiency relevant to global Tier 1 account engagement

About Esko

It's all possible with a role at ​Esko ​. Esko, a ​Veralto ​ company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.​​


About Veralto

At Veralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it's a proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself. Whether we're ensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 13 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.​​
