Code and Theory is looking for a Multi-Solution Architect to lead commerce architecture within our Adobe practice, anchoring the Adobe Commerce pillar alongside our AEM, Workfront, and AEP/data practices. This is a hands-on architect role.

You’ll play a vital role in the architecture, design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Adobe Commerce solutions and the Adobe Experience Cloud platforms around them, including Experience Platform, Real-Time CDP, Experience Manager, Edge Delivery Services, Target, and Workfront. Working closely with Engineering, Strategy, and Sales teams and directly with clients, you’ll provide best-fit architecture for commerce programs, help define scope and sizing, anchor proof-of-concept builds, and design integrations with ERP, OMS, PIM, and other third-party services. You’ll also take part in sales pursuits, contribute to thought leadership and mentorship, and collaborate with top talent around the world to deliver high-quality solutions across a wide range of industries.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect end-to-end Adobe Commerce (Magento Open Source and Commerce/Cloud) solutions for enterprise B2B and B2C clients, from catalog and pricing to checkout, order management, and fulfillment
  • Design headless and composable commerce architectures using PWA Studio, Adobe Commerce Storefront, GraphQL, and API-first integration patterns
  • Lead architecture reviews and ensure scalable, secure, enterprise-grade implementations aligned with modern patterns (API-first, composable, cloud-native)
  • Design integrations between Adobe Commerce and the broader Adobe ecosystem: AEM for content and merchandising experiences, AEP/Real-Time CDP for unified customer profiles and personalization, Adobe Target for experimentation, and Workfront for content and campaign operations
  • Architect B2B commerce capabilities (company accounts, quoting, negotiated pricing, requisition lists, and complex catalog/pricing rules) alongside B2C storefront experiences
  • Own technical solutioning for enterprise RFPs and strategic deals, partnering with sales and client partners on scoping, estimation, and solution design
  • Translate business requirements into scalable commerce architectures, including migration strategy for clients moving from legacy or competitor platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce/Hybris, Shopify Plus, custom-built) onto Adobe Commerce
  • Design and guide extension development, third-party integrations (ERP, OMS, PIM, payment gateways, tax, shipping/logistics), and custom module architecture
  • Guide performance and scalability engineering: catalog indexing, caching strategy, checkout performance, and peak-load readiness (e.g., seasonal traffic spikes)
  • Use AI tools like Claude, Cursor, and V0/Vercel to build AI-enabled workflows, agents, skills, and automation that improve delivery speed, code quality, and operational efficiency
  • Mentor and upskill engineers and application architects on Adobe Commerce best practices, extension standards, and modern architecture patterns
  • Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and delivery playbooks that raise the commerce practice’s technical standards and speed up future engagements

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology experience, including 5+ years architecting Adobe Commerce (Magento) solutions at scale
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Adobe Commerce/Magento 2 architecture
  • Experience with headless/composable commerce including PWA Studio, Adobe Commerce Storefront, GraphQL APIs, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js)
  • Hands-on experience integrating Adobe Commerce with AEM, AEP/Real-Time CDP, Adobe Target, and/or Adobe Campaign in real client engagements, not just adjacent platform awareness
  • Strong experience with third-party and backend system integrations like ERP (SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics), OMS, PIM, payment gateways, tax engines, and logistics/shipping providers
  • Experience with extension development and customization in PHP, and familiarity with Adobe Commerce Cloud infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices
  • Proven experience leading technical solutioning for RFPs, client pursuits, and architecture reviews with executive stakeholders
  • Experience migrating clients from legacy or competitor commerce platforms onto Adobe Commerce
  • Strong understanding of performance engineering for high-traffic commerce, like caching (Varnish, Redis), catalog indexing, and checkout optimization
  • Experience working with content, web, and data management systems in a broader enterprise architecture context
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted software development, using tools like Claude, Cursor, or equivalent to accelerate architecture design, debugging, code review, and documentation
  • Strong communication and client-facing skills, and comfort operating at both the architecture-review level and the boardroom level
  • Collaborative mindset and the ability to work across creative, data, content, and engineering teams on integrated solutions

NICE TO HAVE

  • Adobe Commerce / Magento certifications (Certified Professional Developer, Certified Solution Specialist, Certified Front-End Developer)
  • Multi-solution architecture experience across other Adobe products (AEM, AEP, Workfront) in addition to Commerce
  • Experience with Adobe’s agentic/AI commerce tooling (GenStudio, Firefly Services) and how they integrate with commerce and content supply chain workflows
  • Experience with marketplace, subscription, or complex pricing/promotion models
  • Familiarity with modern engineering productivity and delivery platforms such as Jira, Linear, or similar
  • Experience driving platform modernization or large-scale commerce replatforming initiatives
  • Prior experience in an agency or consulting environment serving global enterprise clients

ABOUT US

Born in 2001, Code and Theory is a digital-first creative agency that sits at the center of creativity and technology. We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. We have teams distributed across North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. The Code and Theory global network of agencies is growing and includes Kettle, Instrument, Left Field Labs, Create Group, Current, and TrueLogic.

Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $150,000 – $215,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. jobs.description:
Director of Strategic Philanthropy | Equitable Growth

Location: Remote

Reports to: President / CEO

Salary: $155,000 - $170,000

ABOUT EQUITABLE GROWTH

The Washington Center for Equitable Growth (Equitable Growth) is a nonprofit, nonpartisan economic policy organization that connects economic evidence and policy to promote shared prosperity and growth in the United States. We do this by seeding policy-relevant research agendas and funding research, elevating scholars and their work within the policy world, and translating evidence for policymakers. Our vision is a dynamic U.S. economy in which prosperity is broadly shared, economic policy is driven by evidence, and workers and families are thriving.

SUMMARY

The Director of Strategic Philanthropy will lead our newly restructured development operations, to reposition and lead the institutional fundraising strategy, major donor engagement, and external philanthropic initiatives, with a primary focus on cultivating high-value foundation partnerships and strategic funding opportunities. The Director will design a new strategy for the organization’s philanthropy work, and will report to the President/CEO and serve as a key advisor to the President/CEO and senior leadership on organizational positioning, philanthropic trends, revenue forecasting, and strategic choices to ensure long-term financial sustainability. This role places particular emphasis on foundation relations, and the ideal candidate will bring established philanthropic relationships and up-to-date knowledge of broader giving trends and evolving priorities at individual foundations.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Fundraising Strategy & Implementation

  • Develops and executes a multi-year institutional fundraising strategy centered on expanding foundation support, securing major gifts, identifying priority funders, and leveraging philanthropic trends, with a focus on foundation support.
  • Quickly adapts fundraising strategies to shifts in philanthropic trends, donor priorities, and organizational needs.
  • Oversees the development, submission, and tracking of high-quality grant proposals, concept notes, reports, and funding applications aligned with programmatic goals.

Donor Relations & Stewardship

  • Builds, deepens, and leverages Board and senior-level relationships with philanthropic partners, institutional funders, and prospective major donors.
  • Opens doors to key decision-makers across partner organizations, high-net-worth individuals, and family/corporate foundations.
  • Establishes systematic stewardship practices and regular donor reporting to ensure meaningful engagement and strong donor retention.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Leads, coaches, and manages development activities and collaborates staff and external consultants to achieve annual revenue goals and long-term institutional development goals.
  • Initially operates without direct staff management, with the potential to build a team as goals expand.
  • Establishes workflows and operational infrastructure to support effective execution.

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Advises the President, Board of Directors, and executive leadership on fundraising progress, revenue risk, philanthropic trends, and strategic positioning.
  • Serves as a collaborative and supportive member of the Senior Leadership Team alongside Equitable Growth’s other department leaders.
  • Collaborates closely across organizational divisions (programmatic, finance, and operations) to align strategic priorities, budgets, and deliverables with donor expectations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in fundraising and development within nonprofit or mission-driven environments, with primary experience in foundations.
  • Deep knowledge of philanthropic trends and evolving foundation priorities, along with established relationships with foundation program officers.
  • Track record of securing major gifts, foundation grants, and seven-figure institutional funding portfolios.
  • Expertise developing, executing, and scaling multi-year revenue generation strategies and capital campaigns, as well as developing relationship building strategies tailored to individual donor needs.
  • Strategic judgment to recognize when organizational strategies need to shift and advise senior leadership on appropriate responses informed by research and experience.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, executive communication, and written presentation skills with high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience managing development staff, collaborating with board members, and serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership.
  • Experience establishing workflows and operational processes to support effective fundraising and development operations.
  • Experience fundraising for policy non-profits and/or think tanks.
  • Alignment with the organization’s mission and commitment to fostering shared prosperity in the United States.
  • Familiarity with donor databases and CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) and prospect research tools.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Managerin our Billing Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

Billing is how Wellhub turns the value we deliver to corporate clients into revenue: how clients are billed, taxed, invoiced, and how their payments are applied, collected, and reconciled across the ecosystem.

You will own the product vision and roadmap for B2B Billing, including taxation, invoicing, accounting, cash application, collections, and reconciliation, for the Enterprise and Membership fee models. You will work closely with Engineering, Finance, Legal, Design, and the product teams that depend on Billing. Your job is to make billing accurate, simple, and consistent across Wellhub, and to give other teams a platform they can build on with confidence.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Every B2B customer is affected by what the Billing teams build. As Wellhub grows, so does the reach of your work.
  • Your solutions shape critical touchpoints corporate clients have with Wellhub: invoices and tax documents, billing and legal entity details, payment status, and account statements.
  • You will make it easier for corporate clients to understand, pay, and reconcile what they owe, and for internal teams to adopt shared billing capabilities instead of building their own.
  • Your decisions directly affect financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, and trust in the platform.
  • You will partner with technical leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver end to end, and you will help raise the product bar across the organization.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

What You Will Do

  • Set and communicate the product vision and strategy for B2B Billing, and explain it clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Build and manage a high-quality roadmap that balances client experience, compliance, and platform scalability.
  • Define product requirements in close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Finance, and Legal, proposing new solutions and continuously improving existing ones.
  • Make trade-offs between automation and control using data, not intuition.
  • Partner with product teams across Wellhub to understand their billing needs, and prioritize platform capabilities that serve them.
  • Work closely with data, experimentation, design, and engineering to deliver scalable, well-crafted products.
  • Define OKRs, goals, and metrics, and track their progress.
  • Manage the backlog and lead meetings with stakeholders, engineers, and designers.
  • Develop hypotheses and run experiments to validate them, improving the client experience across billing journeys.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You use AI tools to produce high-quality work faster and make better decisions.
  • You have experience leading impactful product development, with a proven track record. Experience on platform or foundational products is a plus.
  • You communicate effectively in English, in writing and in meetings, with colleagues and stakeholders across countries and cultures.
  • You are adaptable and comfortable working with people across different timezones.
  • You are data-driven: you use metrics and insights to iterate and deliver outcomes, and you are comfortable with numbers.
  • You can work through technical complexity. You are comfortable discussing architecture and financial or compliance trade-offs with engineers, and you can explain them to non-technical stakeholders.
  • You break down complex problems into smaller independent sub-problems, navigate ambiguity, and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments.
  • You influence without authority. You build trust with engineers and cross-functional partners, and you align teams that have competing priorities.
  • You are well organized, handle multiple parallel initiatives, and keep stakeholders informed in a timely way.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing, payments, or financial systems
  • Experience with B2B SaaS products
  • Experience with multi-country products, including tax and regulatory requirements
  • Engineering or software development background

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading impactful product development projects are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer, Strategic - Seattle, WA
jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available location: Seattle, WA

What you will do as a Customer Engineer

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
  • Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.
  • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
  • Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).
  • Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
  • Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
  • Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.
  • Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:
    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
    • Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
    • Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.
    • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.
    • Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.
    • Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

  • Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.
  • Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.
  • Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Education
Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Travel
This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

Compensation
This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

For Washington: Estimated annual salary of $204,000.00 - $321,000.00

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Fall back to school tutoring is underway and students are seeking tutoring support!

Are you available to tutor from within the USA Monday to Thursday at least one hour a day between 5 pm to 7 pm ET?

  • Please only apply if you’re ready to dive into the application steps and keep the momentum going with BookNook.
  • A one-way recording five minute early elementary math demonstration will be requested using provided BookNook elementary math content.
  • Interested? Please review the full details below and apply with a personal email (rather than a work or school email) to help ensure replies arrive at your inbox successfully.

BookNook tutors support school districts across the United States meeting with students in consistent, recurring weekly sessions. Tutors enjoy a supportive community, the BookNook virtual classroom, and fully provided lesson content—no lesson content prep and planning! This is an exciting opportunity to make a direct, positive impact on students by walking alongside students on their learning journey.

To align with anticipated tutoring days and times, we invite you to apply if your availability often includes at least one hour Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday within the time range of 5:00 PM and 7:00 PM ET (with the potential to claim sessions to tutor outside of this time frame as well). Tutoring opportunities and hours often vary from week to week.

Position Specifics

  • Subject: Math and Reading with provided lesson content and practice extension materials.
  • Students: Across the USA, grades K to 8 (choose your grade levels to tutor)
  • Type: 1099-eligible independent contractor
  • Schedule: Generally follows the school year, September to May, most often 30 minute sessions
  • Pay Rate: $20 per hour ($10 per 30-minute session) with opportunities for incentive payments
  • Total Flexibility: Enjoy ultimate control over your schedule without weekly hours claimed requirements
  • Schedule Consistency: To provide students stable support, tutors attend at least 80% of sessions claimed.
  • Maximize Your Bookings: Our peak student demand falls between 5:00 PM and 7:00 PM ET. While tutors are free to set their own hours, availability during this high-volume window is a way to build your tutoring schedule.
  • Life Happens—We’ve Got You Covered: We fully respect that you have personal plans and obligations outside of work. Unable to attend a claimed session? Simply drop it on your calendar, and a peer from our collaborative tutor community can claim the session to support your students.

Requirements

  • Experience: Classroom teacher, EL/ESL/ELL, tutoring, coaching, or similar student support, online instruction experience with a college degree preferred.
  • Tutoring Focus: Deliver pre-designed, best-practice math lessons to provide targeted support for students often seeking to improve skills and topics at or below grade level.
  • Rapport: Ability to build meaningful professional connections with students and create an encouraging and motivating learning environment with supportive student corrections.
  • Technology: A computer (laptop or desktop), webcam, clean and distraction-free environment, reliable, high-speed internet connection speed of at least 20 mbps
  • Reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Washington, or Washington DC.
  • Location: All sessions must be claimed and conducted from within the 50 United States or Washington, DC.

Ready to apply?

  • Apply: Submit an application online
  • Demonstrate: Applicants may be invited to submit a 5 minute one-way recorded demonstration of their tutoring style using the provided BookNook sample lesson content.
  • Onboard: Tutors that receive and accept an offer begin onboarding steps such as setting up a payment account, sharing a clear result on an in-person fingerprint-based FBI background check (reimbursed up to a maximum of $99), and completion of a paid, self-paced BookNook tutor certification.

Equality in Hiring

BookNook does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

Benefits

Why do the best tutors choose BookNook?

  • Earnings: Get paid for your completed, attended sessions - separate from student attendance, with additional incentive payments seasonally offered for specific sessions.
  • Zero Lesson Prep: Jump straight into teaching! All curriculum materials, lesson structures, and virtual tools are pre-designed and provided for you.

jobs.title: Editor, Subscriber Content
jobs.excerpt: Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years.
jobs.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

JOB SUMMARY

The Editor, Subscriber Content is responsible for writing and helping to package fast, distinctive subscriber-first commentary that supports Newsweek's subscription proposition. Working within the subscriber content operation and under the direction of the Senior Editor, Subscriber Content, this role will focus on producing timely, high-value analysis and commentary on the major political, global, cultural and breaking-news stories that matter most to subscribers.

This is an execution-focused editorial role for a journalist with strong news judgment, sharp writing and the ability to turn fast-moving developments into clear, valuable commentary for a paying audience. The Editor will be expected to respond quickly to briefs, identify strong subscriber angles within the news agenda, and deliver engaging, clean, accurate copy under pressure, often to tight deadlines and during live news cycles.

The role is centered on subscription commentary rather than general news reporting. That means helping readers understand why a story matters, what has changed, what the stakes are, and how to interpret developments in a crowded news environment. The Editor should be able to move beyond summary by producing copy with a clear thesis, strong framing, a persuasive but fair point of view, and an approach that reflects Newsweek's standards and tone.

This role works under close editorial direction from senior staff. It is not a management or strategy role; instead, it is focused on strong day-to-day execution across writing, revision, packaging and support for the subscriber workflow.

Alongside writing, the Editor will contribute to packaging, newsletter preparation and occasional support for other audience-facing formats where required. They will be expected to take direction well, revise accurately and work efficiently with colleagues to help ensure subscriber content is timely, well presented and ready for publication.

They will be responsible for ensuring high-quality coverage that is accurate, fair and conforms to accepted standards of journalism. They will perform any other reasonable duties as necessary to meet the needs of the business.

This is a full-time role, working Monday to Friday, with occasional weekend work. Working hours are normally 8am to 5pm UK time. You will be able to work from home, from anywhere in the UK or from our office space at Canary Wharf, London

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Write rapid, high-quality subscriber commentary on breaking, developing and agenda-setting news stories, with a particular focus on producing copy that adds interpretation, analysis and value rather than simply recapping events.
  • Identify subscriber-worthy angles on major stories across the United States and internationally, and develop them into sharp commentary pieces with a clear thesis, strong framing and an authoritative voice appropriate to Newsweek's standards.
  • Turn around clean copy quickly under deadline pressure, including first drafts, rewrites and updates, while maintaining accuracy, clarity, balance and strong structure throughout.
  • Take briefs and editorial direction from senior editors, and respond constructively to line edits and feedback, including revising intros, nutgraphs, headlines, structure, framing and emphasis where required.
  • Produce commentary that explains why a story matters to subscribers by setting out the context, stakes, implications and next developments readers should watch.
  • Help package stories in CMS, including writing or refining headlines, decks, standfirsts, captions, links, keywords and other metadata so that subscriber content is complete and ready to publish quickly.
  • Work with editors to ensure stories are visually and editorially complete at publication, including identifying suitable art, embeds, related links or other presentation elements where appropriate.
  • Assist with the subscriber newsletter workflow, including suggesting stories, drafting summaries, writing display copy and helping prepare material under the direction of senior editors.
  • Provide occasional support for other formats where requested, such as short videos, talking points or basic editorial input for audience-facing promotion of subscriber journalism.
  • Keep abreast of the live news agenda and flag timelysubscriber commentary opportunities or follow-up ideas to senior editors.
  • Apply sound media-law and standards judgment in day-to-day editorial decisions, including awareness of defamation, privacy, reporting restrictions, copyright and fair use, and escalate concerns quickly when needed.
  • Use AI tools responsibly and in line with editorial best practice, including careful verification of outputs, appropriate disclosure or attribution where relevant, and strong human oversight of all published work.
  • Collaborate with editorial, newsletters, video and audience colleagues where needed to execute assignments and support an organized subscriber workflow.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties as necessary to meet the needs of the business.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

  • Demonstrable knowledge of the news agenda in the United States and internationally, with the judgment to recognize which developments are most likely to matter to a subscription audience.
  • Strong experience writing quickly and accurately in a digital news environment, including under breaking-news pressure and to multiple deadlines in a shift.
  • Demonstrable ability to write commentary, analysis or interpretive journalism that goes beyond summary and gives readers a clear, valuable take on events.
  • Good sourcing instincts and a strong commitment to accuracy, fairness and transparency, including understanding when additional context, balance or stakeholder comment is needed.
  • Comfort with CMS publishing workflows and the editorial details that support publication quality, such as metadata, links, visuals, tags, captions and story presentation.
  • Demonstrable interest in or experience with subscriber products, newsletters, audience-facing packaging or other forms of journalism designed to deepen engagement and retention.
  • Experience of video, audio, social or other multi-format journalism would be useful but is not essential.
  • Working knowledge of media law and editorial risk, with the confidence to flag concerns appropriately and seek guidance when required.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the professionalism to work calmly, accurately and constructively under pressure.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. We’re looking for a Delivery Manager to run delivery across Acquisitions, reporting to the Principal Delivery Manager.

The impact you’ll make:

Right now, someone is applying for a Mission Lane credit card because they have somewhere they’re headed. Another cardholder is looking at their account and choosing their next step. Both moments depend on work that shipped on time and with the right guardrails, because teams across Credit, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Data moved in step. As Delivery Manager, you help those teams move together, so customers see improvements sooner.

You’ll make delivery faster and more predictable at the same time, which takes surfacing risks and trade-offs across those teams early enough to act on them.

Acquisitions is your long-term focus. You may also help other high-priority initiatives that need extra delivery support. You’ll know it’s working when you’ve found and closed a delivery gap others hadn’t noticed, and the problems you own get resolved before they need escalation.

As Delivery Manager you will:

  • Contribute to the delivery approach and be the go-to for delivery questions within your teams.
  • Run delivery discovery on new work, mapping dependencies, risks, and open questions before committing to a plan, then keep that plan current as delivery signals change
  • Run specific workstreams end to end, defining clear criteria for ‘done’ and delivering against them with a clear view of risk.
  • Coordinate across cross-functional teams and any third parties, spotting connections between teams and building strong working relationships with each

  • Coach teams on delivery practices, onboard new contributors to delivery tooling and norms, and help improve delivery standards and metrics

You’ll thrive in this role if:

  • You get energized by improving how delivery works, even when current results are good.
  • You see the connections between teams and act on them without waiting to be asked.
  • You enjoy being the person teammates turn to for answers, and coaching them along the way.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience delivering cross-functional initiatives end-to-end

Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a remote product studio that builds MVPs and custom software for startups and companies past the idea stage. Clients pay for each build, and a small team works in two-week sprints with AI coding tools used every day. Clients are startup founders and their teams, so developers explain tradeoffs to them directly.

They've been at it since 2020 and were profitable in 2025, with a 30% net margin. After building their own AI systems, they tripled monthly revenue with the same team size. Clients rate them 4.9 out of 5 in verified reviews, and the startups they build for have raised more than $25M in venture funding.

Your Role

You'll be the only mobile developer on a new offline-first iOS and Android app, starting from the first project setup. The developer accounts, build pipeline and release tracks don't exist yet, so that's where you begin, and you stay on the same app through its public launch on the App Store and Google Play.

Sprints run two weeks with four to five features each, and coding agents write most of the first draft. You review every diff, add the tests the agents missed, and make the calls on sync, storage and releases. If you'd rather have a QA team or a release manager handle testing and store submissions, this probably isn't the right seat.

You report to the studio's leadership and work day to day with the lead developer and a backend developer, who's your counterpart on the sync and upload APIs. You'll also write risk notes and tradeoffs directly to the client team, with your recommendation attached. Success means sprints that close with their acceptance criteria verified, a write queue that neither loses nor doubles a submission on real devices, and an app live on both stores where sync failures show up in monitoring before anyone reports them.

You'll:

  • Set up Apple and Google developer accounts, signing, CI builds and testing tracks

  • Build the local storage, write queue and retry logic that keep the app working offline

  • Agree the sync and upload APIs with the backend developer, and decide how conflicting edits resolve

  • Build phone-number sign-in with SMS codes, and push notifications that fall back to SMS

  • Build camera capture and e-signature flows that save each signed record as a new version

  • Measure and improve startup time, memory and app size on low-end Android phones

  • Handle store submissions, privacy disclosures and review rejections, and add crash and sync monitoring

You Bring:

  • 4+ years building mobile applications, including React Native applications released on both the App Store and Google Play

  • Offline-first work you built yourself: local storage, queued writes, retries and conflict handling

  • Performance tuning on low-end Android, with startup time or memory measured before and after a change

  • Daily use of Cursor, Claude Code or a similar AI coding tool on production mobile work, with TypeScript, automated tests and CI around it

  • Clear written and spoken English for PR descriptions, risk notes and tradeoff explanations to a client team

  • Experience working from written acceptance criteria, and the judgment to push back on a merge that misses them

Bonus Points:

  • An in-app e-signature or document flow that stored versioned records

  • An application built for field, frontline or hourly workers

  • A localized application, or Spanish for testing the interface

  • Backend work such as writing an endpoint or a database migration

  • Crash reporting or sync monitoring you set up and then used to fix a problem seen in the field

What's Offered:

  • Fully remote contractor role from LATAM, full time at about 40 hours a week

  • Core hours in US time zones, overlapping with the lead developer and the backend developer

  • One app to own, from the first project files through public release on both stores

  • Sync, storage and release decisions that are yours to make, with a backend developer as your counterpart

  • A team where AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow, with typed code, automated tests and CI in place

Interview Process:

1️⃣ Intro Call: 30 minutes with atomic✳HR on your background and goals
2️⃣ Leadership Screening: A short call, possibly with an async part first
3️⃣ Product and Developer Conversation: How you take features to merge and agree sync APIs
4️⃣ Take-Home Test: One feature like the real scope, built and checked

jobs.title: Creative & Brand Strategist (On-Call)
jobs.excerpt: Organizations have never had more ways to reach people.
jobs.description:
Organizations have never had more ways to reach people. More channels. More content. More data. More expertise. Yet influence remains scarce.

People decide what to trust. What to believe. What to adopt. What to join. What to ignore. The gap between what organizations intend and what people do is where growth is won or lost.

That's where strategy matters. We're looking for a Creative & Brand Strategist to help organizations navigate that gap. This is a senior leadership role for a strategist who can transform complexity into clarity, insight into direction, and direction into ideas that create measurable impact.

You'll work across brand, marketing, customer experience, communications, digital transformation, and organizational challenges - helping clients identify opportunities, define strategic choices, and create meaningful connections with the people they serve.

The Opportunity

As a Creative & Brand Strategist, you will lead strategic development across integrated engagements that span brand, campaign, digital experience, customer engagement, and organizational transformation.

You will partner with researchers, behavioral scientists, consultants, creatives, technologists, and client leaders to uncover what drives decisions and define what should happen next.

You'll be responsible for shaping the strategic foundation behind the work: identifying opportunities, framing challenges, developing positioning, creating narratives, and inspiring ideas that move people to action.

This role requires equal comfort in the boardroom, workshop, research review, and creative briefing. You will influence executive stakeholders, guide multidisciplinary teams, and ensure strategy serves as a catalyst for both creativity and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead strategic direction across brands, campaigns, experiences, and integrated initiatives.
  • Translate research, data, and audience understanding into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, narrative platforms, and campaign strategies.
  • Partner with research, analytics and account teams to unlock audience drivers, develop personas and segmentation strategies that drive program development and delivery.
  • Contribute to developing key performance indicators and program evaluation approaches.
  • Create clear, inspiring briefs that drive exceptional creative and experience design work.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops, executive alignment sessions, and strategic planning engagements.
  • Identify emerging cultural, behavioral, and market shifts that create new opportunities for clients.
  • Partner closely with research, customer experience, creative, digital, consulting, and account teams to solve complex business challenges.
  • Check for strategy and brand consistency in creative concepting and delivery.

What We're Looking For

You are a strategist first. You know how to uncover meaningful insights, define compelling positions, build persuasive narratives, and create strategic direction that inspires action. You understand that brands are not simply communications systems - they are systems of meaning.

You see audiences as people, not segments. You know how to connect human motivations with organizational goals. You can move comfortably between long-term brand building and immediate business priorities. Between analytical rigor and creative imagination. Between evidence, intuition, and judgment. Most importantly, you know that strategy is not about having all the answers. It's about asking the questions that reveal opportunities others miss.

You Bring:

Professional Skills

  • Significant experience in brand strategy, communications planning, creative strategy, customer strategy, consumer behavioral psychology, consulting, or a related discipline.
  • A strong track record of leading strategic work across complex, multidisciplinary engagements and with cross-functional marketing teams.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging architectures, audience personas, narrative frameworks, campaign strategies, and creative briefs.
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level engagement.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation abilities.
  • Proven ability to align diverse stakeholders around strategic direction and organizational priorities
  • Curiosity about culture, behavior, technology, and the forces shaping how people make decisions
  • Experience using AI as a tool to make our research and deliverables smarter and more efficient.
  • Primary and secondary research experience and demonstrated ability to use the data to unlock insights that drive program design.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, market research, journalism, sociology or related fields. (applicants can substitute one year of related experience for one year of education)
  • 10+ years of experience developing and leading brand, communications, customer experience, or business strategies within agencies, consultancies, or client organizations.
  • Must be able to pass a background check and secure public trust clearance.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by the number of strategies created. It's measured by the decisions those strategies enable.

You will:

  • Help clients see opportunities they couldn't previously see.
  • Bring clarity to ambiguity and alignment to complexity.
  • Influence critical business, brand, and experience decisions.
  • Elevate the quality of creative thinking across teams.
  • Strengthen client relationships through trusted strategic leadership.
  • Create work that earns attention, builds trust, drives participation, and delivers meaningful outcomes.
  • Build a stronger culture of strategic thinking across teams, improving how opportunities are identified, framed, and brought to market.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.excerpt: Team Leadership & Functional Ownership• Manage, develop, and provide technical oversight to the provider compensation team responsible for more than 200 providers across multiple legal entities and compensation structures.
jobs.description:
Team Leadership & Functional Ownership

• Manage, develop, and provide technical oversight to the provider compensation team responsible for more than 200 providers across multiple legal entities and compensation structures.

• Own the monthly provider compensation close process, including work allocation, review standards, deadlines, issue escalation, and final approval of calculations and accounting entries.

• Establish procedures, review controls, documentation standards, and cross-training to ensure continuity, accuracy, and scalability.

• Serve as the senior escalation point for complex provider compensation questions and disputes.

Provider Compensation Governance & Master Matrix

• Own and maintain the master provider compensation matrix as the authoritative source for all arrangements, including legal entity, effective dates, methodology, rates/percentages, thresholds, guarantees, draws, profit/loss sharing, expense allocations, supervisory fees, incentives, true-up provisions, payment timing, and other contractual terms.

• Ensure new agreements, amendments, renewals, terminations, and provider changes are reflected timely and accurately in the matrix and supporting calculation models.

• Maintain supporting documentation and version control so each calculation can be traced directly to the applicable contractual provision.

• Perform periodic audits of the master matrix against executed agreements, payroll records, accounting schedules, and provider rosters.

Contract Review & Translation to Calculation

• Proactively participate in provider contracting and amendments before execution to ensure compensation terms can be operationalized and calculated accurately.

• Review proposed contractual language and translate economic terms into clear mathematical formulas, calculation examples, data requirements, accounting treatment, and payment schedules.

• Identify ambiguous, conflicting, incomplete, or administratively burdensome provisions and work with Legal, Operations, and leadership to resolve them before execution.

• Assess downstream impacts on payroll, general ledger accounting, intercompany allocations, provider reporting, and system requirements.

• Document approved calculation methodologies and ensure the final model is consistent with the executed agreement.

• Review model and calculations with the provider prior to first pay check to ensure mutual understanding and alignment on timing of deliverables, method of receiving the information, and payment.

Complex Provider Compensation Accounting

• Oversee and review monthly calculations across models including percentage of collections, productivity-based compensation, profit and loss sharing, allocated profit pools, growth incentives, guarantees, draws, supervisory fees, and other custom arrangements.

• Oversee complex profit and loss calculations requiring revenue attribution, direct expenses, shared overhead allocations, provider-specific adjustments, and contractual exclusions or add-backs.

• Ensure accruals, true-ups, liabilities, and related journal entries are recorded accurately and timely in accordance with U.S. GAAP and company policy.

• Own accounting for arrangements spanning multiple entities, including identification, calculation, reconciliation, and documentation of intercompany charges, receivables/payables, and allocations.

• Reconcile compensation calculations and payments to collections, payroll, accounts payable, provider statements, and the general ledger.

Financial Analysis, Reporting & Provider Support

• Review monthly compensation reporting packages, provider statements, variance analyses, and management reporting for accuracy and completeness.

• Analyze productivity, collections, profitability, compensation trends, and material variances; investigate and resolve anomalies.

• Develop dashboards, schedules, and KPIs providing visibility into compensation expense, accrual accuracy, true-ups, and outstanding issues.

• Explain complex calculations, variances, and adjustments clearly to providers, practice administrators, operational leaders, and executives.

Controls, Audit & Process Improvement

• Design and maintain a strong control environment including preparer/reviewer controls, contract-to-calculation validation, change controls, reconciliations, and documented approvals.

• Support internal and external audits with complete, organized, and auditable compensation documentation.

• Identify opportunities to standardize and automate calculations, reporting, provider onboarding, and change-management workflows while preserving individual contract requirements.

• Lead compensation workstreams for acquisitions, provider onboarding, system implementations, and transitions to new compensation models.

• Partner with Finance and executive leadership to identify recurring contractual complexity and recommend more scalable structures and processes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; CPA or advanced degree preferred.

• 7+ years of progressive accounting, financial analysis, or provider compensation experience, including team leadership or ownership of a complex functional process.

• Healthcare accounting experience strongly preferred; physician practice management or multi-site provider compensation experience required.

• Demonstrated experience interpreting complex contracts and converting contractual terms into mathematical calculations, accounting treatments, and repeatable operational processes.

• Experience with complex physician compensation models, including percentage of collections, profit/loss sharing, productivity incentives, guarantees/draws, and custom calculations.

• Experience with multi-entity accounting and intercompany transactions, allocations, reconciliations, and eliminations.

• Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, reconciliations, and internal controls.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with ERP, payroll, reporting, and data systems. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, organizational, documentation, leadership, and communication skills.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field required
  • CPA or advanced degree preferred

Job Type:

  • Full-time

jobs.excerpt: ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team.
jobs.description:
ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team.

Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6.7 billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280+ full-time staff.

The Company has developed an industry-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023.

While the Company delivers immense business value, the social impact of ClassWallet is a fabric that runs through its mission and corporate culture. As a result of ClassWallet’s innovation, public programs run with exponentially more efficiency and the impact and breadth of the programs for the individuals they serve is dramatically higher. This mission complements the company's mission-based culture with focus on gratitude and work-life balance.

About the Role

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own how ClassWallet wins in its core markets: Education Savings Account (ESA) and school choice programs, and K-12 schools and districts. You will also own how we position the ClassWallet platform as a whole as it evolves. You will report to the Senior Director, Marketing.

You will also maintain the company-level message framework that holds together every market we serve, and our messaging for new markets will build on your work. ClassWallet is moving to a product-led operating model, with product marketing at the center of that shift. You will partner with Product Management from business case to launch, and make sure Sales and our proposal team can explain clearly why we win.

This is a hands-on role. You will write the messaging, build the enablement packet, and talk directly to the agency leaders, families and educators who use ClassWallet. Pricing is set by the CPO with analysis from Product Strategy & Insights, and product requirements by Product Management; you provide market input to both.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the company-level message framework that every market's messaging must fit, with approval from the Senior Director, Marketing.
  • Own positioning and messaging for ESA and school choice programs, K-12 schools and districts, and the ClassWallet platform as a whole, for both the agencies and districts that buy ClassWallet and the families and educators who use it.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement: pitch deck, battlecards, talk tracks, demo narratives and objection handling.
  • Own competitive intelligence and positioning for the core markets, using win/loss analysis from Product Strategy & Insights.
  • Plan and deliver launch marketing for Tier 1–3 launches under our tiered launch model, and review the Tier 4 launches that product managers run from templates.
  • Bring buyer and market insight into product discovery, and join discovery where go-to-market risk is high.
  • Supply the messaging used in proposals, customer service communications, on the website and in campaigns.
  • Train the trainers: equip sales leadership to drive adoption of the enablement you build.

Requirements

  • Experience marketing to government, education or other public-sector buyers.
  • A track record of positioning and messaging that measurably improved win rates or sales effectiveness.
  • Experience running launches end to end with product and sales teams.
  • Hands-on competitive intelligence experience; win/loss experience a plus.
  • An excellent writer who can turn complex policy and financial detail into clear language.
  • Comfortable interviewing buyers and users, from state program directors to parents.
  • Excellent presentation skills and ability to command a room.
  • 6+ years of B2B product marketing experience, ideally at a SaaS company.

Preferred:

  • Experience with ESA, school choice, K-12 district or other education funding programs.
  • Experience in fintech or payments.
  • Experience at a company moving from a sales-led to a product-led operating model.
  • Degree in a technical field such as engineering.

Benefits

ClassWallet is a positive, family-oriented team environment. Our focus is on encouragement, positive reinforcement, and gratitude. We work hard and are highly motivated to win but with a healthy perspective on life.

We offer an excellent salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

ClassWallet.com is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineer Manager role, aligning how we lead teams to best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

As our Solutions Consultant Manager, you are the technical leader for your District Solutions Consulting team. You will work closely with the District Sales Manager and, along with your team, build relationships with your customers with the goal of helping them detect and prevent advanced cyberattacks and breaches. Our customers need guidance on what applications to deploy from our platform. Your guidance, expertise, and mentorship of your team will keep them ahead of the latest cyberthreats and stay on the leading edge of prevention.

As the technical leader for your assigned territory, you will guide and develop your team to define innovative technical solutions that secure customers' key business imperatives and maximize the value of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You will champion our industry leadership in on-premises, cloud, and security operations services, establishing Palo Alto Networks as the preferred cybersecurity partner for your customers. You will also nurture talent within your team and provide valuable feedback to the product management team on new feature requests and product improvements based on insights gained from your customer interaction. Your team will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Recruit and hire new Solutions Consultants into the territory, hiring the best talent in the industry

  • Act as an escalation point to collaborate with pre-sales and post-sales teams for any issues that arise

  • Build and maintain relationships with key customers to solidify reference accounts and to assist the account teams with defining plans to drive more business

  • Present to customers as our expert in your area at all levels in the customer hierarchy from technician to CIO

  • Discuss competitor products in the marketplace and positions ours as the best alternative

  • Working with Product Management, Technical Marketing, and R&D to build requirements and product features for our large customers and provide feedback from customers

  • 50-75% travel within the region

  • Work with your sales counterpart (DSM) to develop a technical strategy that accelerates growth. Identify key verticals, markets, use cases, and solutions to focus on, and devise a comprehensive strategy and engagement model tailored to your region or district.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience as a pre-sales System Engineer Manager

  • Experience as a Senior System Engineer/Specialist

  • Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of our roadmap and technology development efforts, knowledge of competitor offerings and products

  • Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to Palo Alto Networks customer base

  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
