Job Title: Local Trial Manager, Sponsor Dedicated → Responsable local(e) des essais

Job Location: Kirkland, Quebec, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The Local Trial Manager (LTM) provides local management of clinical trials within assigned countries, ensuring studies are conducted in accordance with protocol requirements, applicable regulations, ICH-GCP guidelines, and internal procedures. The LTM is responsible for overseeing operational study delivery from startup through closeout while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure quality, timelines, and patient recruitment objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead country-level execution of assigned clinical trials, ensuring milestones, quality metrics, and timelines are met.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for country-specific study operations.
  • Support site identification, feasibility assessments, site selection, and activation activities.
  • Collaborate with investigators, site staff, and cross-functional teams to drive study performance and enrollment.
  • Monitor study progress and proactively identify and mitigate operational risks.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GCP guidelines, study protocols, and SOPs.
  • Oversee site readiness, site performance, and issue resolution throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Partner with study teams to develop and execute recruitment and retention strategies.
  • Facilitate study team meetings and communicate study updates, risks, and mitigation plans.
  • Support management of vendors, study supplies, budgets, and invoicing activities as applicable.
  • Coordinate local regulatory submissions and approvals in partnership with study startup teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of study documentation, CTMS, and eTMF records.
  • Support audit and inspection readiness activities and help address findings through corrective actions.
  • Ensure appropriate reporting and documentation of safety-related information and protocol deviations.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and best practice sharing across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related field preferred.
  • Clinical research experience with demonstrated experience managing clinical trial activities.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical trial regulations, and study conduct requirements.
  • Experience working with investigators, clinical sites, and cross-functional study teams.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience with CTMS, eTMF, and other clinical trial management systems preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to travel as required.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience overseeing studies from startup through closeout.
  • Experience supporting global or multicountry clinical trials.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to proactively identify and address study risks.

VIDIZMO is an AI software company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia. We build Nexus, AI Intelligence Hub, AI Live Insight and Redactor, a product family that lets an organization search, analyze, redact and act on its unstructured data, where video, audio, images, documents and text are treated as equal first-class sources rather than one format with the rest bolted on. More than 100 customers run VIDIZMO in production across public safety and justice, government, healthcare, financial services, education, legal, manufacturing and energy, and much of that installed base runs on premises, in air-gapped environments, or in FedRAMP High environments through our hosting partners, on a CJIS Security Policy-aligned architecture.

We are an independent software vendor. We build and support the software, and the channel sells it, with qualified partners also installing, delivering and supporting deployments for their own clients. That model shapes almost every role here: the people we hire spend their time making partners and customers successful rather than pushing paper through a direct sales funnel.

Role Overview

This role is for someone who understands Large Language Models (LLMs) not just as tools, but as both business enablers and things you build with - equally able to write the code that automates a workflow and to use that automation to market, position, and sell complex SaaS products. Whether your primary background is software engineering or marketing/growth, a real hands-on experience on both sides will be a plus.

You will be responsible for turning AI into a distribution, demand generation, and sales enablement engine for VIDIZMO's products - not only by prompting AI chat tools, but by engineering the automations, integrations, and workflows that let content, personalization, and sales enablement run at scale with minimal manual work. That means deeply learning VIDIZMO products, the competitive landscape, customer pain points, and market positioning, then building and operating the AI-driven systems that market and sell VIDIZMO at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scripts and integrations (Python/JavaScript) that connect the marketing and sales stack - CRM, CMS, analytics, email, and AI tools - via their APIs and webhooks
  • Use Claude Code to build custom AI agents and multi-step workflows.
  • Stand up and maintain workflow-orchestration pipelines (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom code) that trigger content updates, personalization, or outreach based on product, CRM, or website events.
  • Keep automations under version control, document them, and monitor them for failures so they run reliably without manual babysitting
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs for new automation needs and prototype quickly using AI-assisted coding

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or maintaining internal tools, browser extensions, or lightweight web apps

  • Exposure to CI/CD basics, cron jobs/schedulers, or serverless functions (for scheduled or event-driven marketing automations)
  • Proficient with SEO and organic growth strategies
  • Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, RAG-based knowledge systems, and competitive intelligence tooling

Success Metrics

  • Number and reliability of automations/workflows shipped and kept running (uptime, error rate)
  • Time saved or manual effort removed from recurring marketing/sales tasks through automation
  • Speed and quality of product messaging.
  • Discoverability of VIDIZMO innovations.
  • Sales enablement effectiveness and real impact on demand and revenue.

Required Qualifications (Must-Have)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of total professional experience combining software development and marketing/growth in B2B SaaS - at least 1.5 years hands-on coding (writing, testing, and shipping code, not just using no-code tools) and at least 2 years in a product/growth marketing or GTM role.
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python or JavaScript/Node preferred), and comfort reading/adapting code written by an AI agent
  • Practical experience calling and integrating REST APIs, and familiarity with git/version control
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, and with AI chat tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) for content and research
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, generative AI concepts, and prompt engineering, including RAG at a conceptual level
  • Proven ability to learn complex products quickly and translate technical features into business value
  • Demonstrated business aptitude: understanding buyer intent, revenue-focused thinking, and the ability to support sales, not just marketing
  • Comfortable operating in a hands-on, high-ownership role

Why Join US?

  • Own the narrative and growth of mission-critical products

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

  • Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.
  • Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.
  • Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.
  • Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About This Role

As the Director of California Operations for Waymark, you will be a key leader in our operations, directly overseeing our local managers and the patient-facing care teams within your assigned state with responsibility for delivering on operational, clinical, and financial goals. You are an experienced leader who excels at developing and mentoring managers and their teams to deliver excellent patient care and service. You are passionate about empowering teams to use a metrics-driven approach and continuous process improvement to meet the highest standards of care access, coordination, and quality for patients with Medicaid benefits. You will report to and collaborate with the Regional VP to represent regional needs and deliver on operational goals. You will also support your local managers as they engage with local providers and community-based organizations to build strong relationships that support the health and social needs of our patients.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of local managers to ensure alignment with state-level operational, clinical, and financial goals.
  • Assist local managers with hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members to support regional growth and retention goals.
  • Own state performance of goals by tracking and reporting on operational performance within your market and translating high-level strategic objectives into actionable plans for local care teams.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to local managers, fostering their professional development and ensuring a high-performing, collaborative team culture.
  • Oversee the day-to-day performance of care teams within your designated region, ensuring they meet the highest standards of patient access, care coordination, and quality.
  • Collaborate with national care support teams (Clinical, Quality, Analytics, etc.) to relay regional needs and challenges and implement new workflows and initiatives.
  • Support regional VP, Partnerships and Implementation teams to successfully launch new contracts in the state in conjunction with partner expectations and timelines.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for local providers and community-based organizations, helping to develop, maintain and strengthen partnerships that support Waymark patients.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare or health services operations, with a focus on patient-facing care teams, outpatient services, and/or whole-person care focus.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, including supervising managers or team leads.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage operational performance, gather and analyze data, and drive continuous improvement within a defined geographic area.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with budget oversight or financial management.
  • A track record of effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, including providers and community partners.
  • Ability to travel frequently within the state to support local teams and engage with community stakeholders.
  • Must reside in California, preferably Sonoma/Orange or San Bernardino County.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A history of relationships or experience with community-based healthcare initiatives in the region and medicaid.
  • Strong understanding of barriers to healthcare access and quality among diverse, underserved populations.
  • Experience working in startup environments and enjoys rapid pace of work.
  • MHA or MBA

The expected hiring range for this role is $146,000 – $187,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.
This is a remote role within California, however, candidates living in certain high-cost of living cities such as San Francisco may be eligible for an additional market premium.

  • Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.

At Fidus, you’ll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Work directly with potential and existing clients to understand their needs, then develop their requirements;
  • Architect a solution that meets the Client’s needs;
  • Develop a plan, identify risks and mitigation strategies, and estimate the work required, to deliver a client solution;
  • Write the technical content for proposals;
  • Understand and present Fidus’ resource skill capabilities and work approach;

  • Ideally at least seven (7) years of design background in an AI/ML engineering role, with significant time spent deploying models into production rather than training them alone;
  • System Level design experience and interest, including identifying architectural approaches and tradeoffs;
  • An expert level of knowledge of the modern machine learning toolchain, including PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, and the quantization, pruning, and compilation steps that turn a trained model into a deployable one;
  • Experience deploying inference on embedded and accelerated targets such as FPGA and adaptive SoC, GPU, or dedicated AI accelerators, and reasoning about the latency, throughput, power, and memory bandwidth tradeoffs between them;
  • Experience designing with CUDA and/or ROCm;
  • Familiarity with the hardware and infrastructure that AI workloads depend on — high-speed interconnect, memory hierarchy, and thermal and power budgets — at the edge, in the data center, or both;
  • Ability to assess the feasibility of a client’s AI objective against the data actually available, and to scope the data pipeline, training, and validation effort realistically;
  • Some knowledge of FPGA’s, hardware, and embedded software;
  • Exposure to MLOps practice, including model versioning, monitoring, and retraining in production, is an asset;
  • Ability to undertake designs with ITAR restrictions or Classified information in the United States, or with Controlled Goods Program (CGP) restrictions or Classified information in Canada;
  • Concise communication and writing skills;
  • Excellent listening, understanding, and extrapolation skills;
  • Professional and personable;
  • Enjoys travel, which is anticipated to be up to 6 weeks per year, typically within North America;
  • Proven experience with giving presentations to small-to-medium sized groups.

Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel will be required typically within North America for up to 6 weeks per year.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce. Through our 7,500 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.

At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Our Values and Leadership Behaviors

About the Role

ecoATM pays people cash for their used phones, tablets and other devices at more than 7,500 self-serve kiosks in Walmart, Kroger, Dollar General and other retailers. We collect millions of devices a year, giving them a second life, and have paid customers more than $2 billion since our founding in 2009. Most customers check their price online first, lock in an offer, then head to a kiosk. Search is where much of that intent shows up, which makes it our largest and most efficient paid channel.

As the owner of paid search execution, you will be responsible for a large and growing budget across Google, Microsoft, OpenAI's ChatGPT ads and app campaigns. You'll join the Consumer Growth team, a core focus for the company, as our increasing investment in marketing has accelerated our growth with consumers. Search is changing fast, and we want to stay ahead of it. AI Max and AI Overviews are changing how paid search and SEO have traditionally worked. ChatGPT ads are already one of our growth channels, and we’re building a paid presence across AI assistants and LLMs. You’ll lead that work and help keep ecoATM at the forefront of AI search.

This is a hands-on role reporting to our Director of Paid Media. You’ll build and run campaigns yourself and own the results. We optimize for incrementality, using every metric we have, from both the ad platforms and our own data. You’ll help shape how we define success and where we invest our spend.

What You’ll Do

  • Run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads day to day across Search, Performance Max and AI Max, including structure, bidding, budgets, keywords, ad copy, assets and audiences.
  • Build our paid presence on AI platforms. Scale ChatGPT ads, test new AI and LLM placements as they open up, and show what they add beyond Google.
  • Shape search strategy for the near and long term as AI changes the channel. Track competitive and industry trends and flag what they mean for us.
  • Test your way to growth with an always-on A/B testing roadmap that improves performance and earns more investment.
  • Grow app advertising. Find out what it would take to invest more in app campaigns and to make them succeed.
  • Measure what’s incremental. Optimize daily toward online offer locks, and work with the Director of Paid Media on geo holdout tests that show what search adds in kiosk visits and margin.
  • Own pacing, forecasting and reporting, including weekly performance updates, budget tracking and clear write-ups of what you tested and learned.
  • Work across teams with our Web and Conversion Manager on landing page tests, with Creative on ad copy and assets, and with SEO so paid and organic work together on the results page without overlapping.

Core Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid search experience, including at least 2 years owning a large account.
  • Deep, current expertise in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including bidding and keyword strategy, campaign types, and newer offerings like AI Max.
  • A track record of growing paid search investment through experimentation and hypothesis testing.
  • A clear understanding of incrementality versus attributed performance, and experience using that difference to make investment decisions.
  • Experience with offline or store conversions, including offline conversion import, enhanced conversions, GA4, and conversion tracking you can audit yourself.
  • Strong spreadsheet analysis skills, plus comfort pulling your own data from a reporting tool or data warehouse.
  • A point of view on where search is heading as people turn to AI assistants, and how a brand should buy media there.
  • Clear writing. You can explain a result and a recommendation to people who don’t work in search.
  • Ownership. You take pride in the channel’s performance and drive it forward without waiting to be asked.

Nice to Haves:

  • Hands-on time with ChatGPT ads or other AI ad placements.
  • Experience at a business where the sale happens offline: retail, recommerce, auto, insurance or similar.
  • Local search across thousands of locations, including location assets and store-visit measurement.
  • Hands-on time with geo testing tools such as Haus, or with media mix models.

  • SQL, and reporting tools such as Funnel.io or Looker.

jobs.description:
CVEDIA · Remote, anywhere (with overlap with European afternoons) · Full-time

(This job requires Advanced English (C1) proficiency - with the ability to communicate fluently and handle complex, fast-paced technical and professional tasks.)

About CVEDIA

CVEDIA builds AI video analytics for physical security, smart cities and defense. We train our own models, and we make them run about ten times more efficiently than our competitors, which makes every appliance far more cost-effective. Our models already run in real products on server and edge hardware around the world, and we ship them on our own appliances, from edge hubs to rack servers.

About the role

We need someone to own that hardware line globally: the suppliers who build it, the partners who distribute it, and the story that sells it. Our appliances have to win on their own merits, so you will decide what we build, who builds it, where it sells and at what price.

You will report to our CTO and to our Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with our engineers on what goes into each appliance. There is a lot to handle at the same time, and you will own all of it and set the priorities.

In your first months you will get to know our appliances, our suppliers and our software, and then turn them into a line we can sell worldwide. That means choosing the suppliers who can build at global scale, setting up how new hardware is tested and qualified before it ships, and picking the first distribution partners in each region.

If you have taken hardware from spec to shelf and know how to work with manufacturers and distributors, keep reading.

What you will do

  • Own our relationships with system builders, ODMs and component vendors, including pricing, lead times, quality and continuity of supply.
  • Decide which appliances belong in the lineup, when a new one comes in, and when an old one is retired.
  • Build distribution across North America, Europe, LATAM and the Middle East, choosing the partners and the terms in each region.
  • Lead hardware product marketing, from positioning and datasheets to launches and the tools our channel partners use to sell.
  • Keep pricing, margins and inventory healthy, so that every appliance we sell earns its place in the lineup.
  • Work with our engineers on CPU, GPU and storage choices, so that each appliance runs our models well at the right cost.

You may be a good fit if

  • You have five or more years of experience in hardware product management.
  • You have managed contract manufacturers or system builders directly, from the first specification through production.
  • You have launched hardware products that sold at a healthy margin, and you can tell us the numbers.

It would be great if you

  • Have worked in physical security, IT infrastructure or edge computing.
  • Have built or run distribution in more than one region.
  • Can discuss CPU, GPU and storage tradeoffs with engineers in enough depth to question their choices.
  • Have worked in a company that changed direction when its market did, and helped it adjust.

You do not need to tick every box. If you have taken hardware to market and want to own a whole line, we would like to hear from you.

Why CVEDIA

  • You own it. There are no layers of approval and no committee between you and the supplier. You see the problem, you make the call, and we back you.
  • A product role. You decide how our appliances win, from what goes in the lineup to how it is priced and sold, rather than only buying what others specify.
  • A running start. You inherit a real lineup with real demand, not a blank page.
  • Direct influence. We are a small team, so you will work directly with all of us and see the effect of your decisions quickly.

Where and how you work

  • We are fully remote and have no offices. We meet in person once a year at a company meetup, usually in Europe.
  • You need to overlap with European afternoons for our team meetings.
  • Partners in four regions sometimes need an early morning or a late evening call, so you need some flexibility in your hours.
  • Pay depends on your experience.

How to apply

Please submit your resume/CV in English. Tell us about one hardware product you took to market: what you decided, what went wrong, and how it sold.

The interview process is a few calls with our managers.

CVEDIA welcomes applicants from every background and country. We judge your work, not your title or your path to it.

jobs.description:
About Intento

Founded in 2016, Intento has grown alongside the AI and language technology industry itself — from early machine translation, through the rise of LLMs, to the AI agents we build today. Throughout that shift, the problem we're solving hasn't changed: helping global enterprises communicate authentically in the native language of every customer and employee. What's changed is our ability to solve it well. Today, Intento is AI Agents for Enterprise Translation: we automate translation for global enterprises across every touchpoint — websites, apps, help centers, support, and internal tools — in 650+ languages, with AI agents that meet the requirements of each company: terminology, tone, and compliance. Not just fluency.

We've built this fully remotely, with a diverse team spread across the world, held together by a culture of teamwork, ownership, and trust. And because the technology we work with keeps moving, so do we — we don't hold onto an approach just because it used to work. When something changes in the landscape, or in what our customers need, we adjust fast and keep building.

Why Intento?

At Intento, we're solving a problem that looks simple from the outside and isn't: getting AI to translate not just fluently, but to the requirements of each company — terminology, tone of voice, compliance — and to verify and repair the output automatically when it falls short. It's a harder, more interesting engineering and product problem than most AI applications get to work on, and it's why 60+ global enterprises, including Indeed, Hexagon, Strava, and Agilent, trust Intento with it.

We're a multicultural team working remotely from different parts of the world, with a culture built around flexibility, transparency, and ownership. We offer competitive compensation and an environment where people are trusted to do their best work.

  • Join a fast-paced environment where you can directly shape the course of the company.

  • Get real transparency into business strategy and decisions — you'll understand the big picture and your impact on it.

  • Enjoy a balance of autonomy and responsibility: make decisions and own outcomes.

  • Work on a genuinely hard problem — translation that meets enterprise requirements automatically, beyond fluency — alongside people who've thought deeply about it.

  • Get hands-on experience deploying AI agents into production for global enterprises.

  • Work alongside a talented team — Software engineers, Language engineers, operations, and beyond — who care about doing the job well and supporting each other.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Technical Support Expert to join our 2nd-line support team. This is the team the rest of Support, our Technical Account Managers and Customer Success Managers turn to when an issue needs an investigation.

You’ll take escalations from our 1st-line team and reproduce and root-cause problems across our API, our platform, and the integrations our enterprise customers rely on. Then you’ll either resolve the problem yourself or hand it to Development with everything they need to act on it.

Most of your communication will be with internal teams: 1st-line support, TAMs, CSMs, Product and R&D but occasionally the role may require you to also join technical calls with customers and own the troubleshooting part of the conversation.

We’re looking for someone who has already done this work at a B2B SaaS company, supporting that company’s external, paying customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigate, reproduce and resolve issues escalated from 1st-line support, using our platform, test environments and API tooling.

  • Trouble-shoot non-trivial integration issues across TMS systems, such as Trados, memoQ, XTM and Phrase and third-party MT/LLM providers. This includes going directly to those vendors’ teams when the root cause is on their side.

  • Escalate to R&D after you’ve done your own investigation, with clear reproduction steps, logs, scope and impact. Keep driving the issue until it’s resolved.

  • Keep 1st-line and customer-facing teams updated with full context.

  • Join technical calls with customers when needed and own the troubleshooting.

  • During incidents, notify stakeholders and help keep customers informed

  • Document new scenarios, workarounds and fixes in our internal and external Knowledge Base.

  • Spot inefficient workflows and gaps in alerting or tooling, and fix them, including scripts and automations that can be reused by the rest of the team

  • From time to time, cover the front-line queue.

  • Be available on-call for high-severity issues outside standard hours

If this sounds like a good fit for you, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
About You

You are an experienced offensive security professional with strong manual penetration testing expertise and a disciplined approach to testing production environments. You validate vulnerabilities through controlled exploitation attempts and produce clear, reproducible evidence.

You are comfortable testing web applications, REST/SOAP APIs, and applications protected by enterprise SSO. You understand how to assess authorization across roles and accounts, identify exploitable weaknesses, and explain their impact.

Note: This role operates under a contractor model for an initial period of 2 months, with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of hands on penetration testing experience, including 3+ years testing web applications and APIs in production environments.
  • Manual web application penetration testing following OWASP WSTG and the OWASP Top 10.
  • API security testing following the OWASP API Security Top 10, including BOLA/IDOR and broken function level authorization.
  • SOAP and WSDL web service testing using Burp Suite, SoapUI or an equivalent tool.
  • Burp Suite Professional as your primary tool, including extensions and custom payloads.
  • Experience testing applications protected by SSO with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML on Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Multi role and multi account authorization testing methodology.
  • External reconnaissance and attack surface enumeration using Amass, subfinder, httpx, Nmap or equivalent tooling.
  • Proven ability to test safely in production, applying rate control, test records and defined stop conditions.
  • CVSS v3.1 scoring and regulator ready reporting supported by reproducible evidence.
  • Strict adherence to rules of engagement, stopping and escalating within one hour when a stop condition is met.
  • Documentation discipline that records every attempt, successful or not, so results stand up to regulatory review.
  • Commitment to collecting only the minimum evidence required and masking nonpublic information in all deliverables.
  • Strong spoken and written English (B2+) to document findings and weekly status reports and to join live working sessions with a U.S. based security team.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience testing Java EE and JSF enterprise applications, such as loan servicing or core lending platforms.
  • Experience testing ASP.NET web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with Azure API Management, Application Gateway or Front Door WAF.
  • Experience testing payment, e signature and webhook or callback integrations.
  • Python or Bash scripting to automate test cases.
  • Prior participation in regulatory penetration tests under NYDFS Part 500, PCI DSS 11.4 or FFIEC.
  • Offensive security certification such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, GPEN, GXPN or BSCP.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Perform outside unauthenticated testing of in scope web applications, REST and SOAP APIs, an API gateway and internet exposed hosts.
  • Perform inside testing from client provided accounts, covering cross role and cross account authorization, privilege escalation and access beyond the assigned role.
  • Discover API specifications such as OpenAPI, WSDL and Postman collections for REST and SOAP services before testing when required.
  • Base every finding on an exploitation attempt and record its result, listing scan only items separately as untested.
  • Test all authorized in scope assets, or document the reason for exclusion when client side dependencies are not met.
  • Execute all testing without causing service disruption or data loss, escalating stop conditions within one hour.
  • Score findings using CVSS v3.1 and document reproducible evidence suitable for regulatory review.
  • Contribute to the draft report, the final report and the signed attestation letter covering the outside, inside application and inside identity perspectives.
  • Support the revalidation report delivered within 60 days of the final report.
  • Report weekly status in English and participate in working sessions with the client security team.
  • 5+ years of hands on penetration testing, including 3+ years on web applications and APIs in production.
  • Manual testing aligned to OWASP WSTG, OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10.
  • Burp Suite Professional expertise, including SOAP and WSDL service testing.
  • Authorization testing across multiple roles and accounts in SSO protected applications (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Everyone is welcome here. Each of us is unique, and that’s what makes us amazing. We believe in inclusiveness and celebrating each person’s individuality, because there’s power in bringing people with different points of view and life experiences together. That’s why we provide equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

So, bring yourself and your best ideas; when we feel safe and comfortable being ourselves, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

IN A NUTSHELL…

Parallel is one of the multi-state cannabis companies, owning and operating in three markets; Florida (Surterra Wellness), Massachusetts (NETA), and Texas (Goodblend). If you enjoy companies that are growing, moving fast, and constantly challenging themselves to achieve more, then Parallel is for you. We work hard, lean on each other, and are passionate about a pretty ambitious vision … pioneering a new paradigm of what well-being can be for all people, everywhere. For more information, visit .

**Varies by position. **

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

** Varies by position. **

Our Mission – how we will do this – is to build a leading, global well-being company through the best talent, our values, trusted and recognized brands, science and technology-based innovation, and a relentless focus on execution and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Engineering has changed.  We're changing with it.
jobs.description:
Engineering has changed. We're changing with it. At clearer.io, we build the software that helps eCommerce merchants win on search, discovery, and customer engagement. Building that well, in this market, means the engineering behind it can't stand still either. AI has moved past being a coding aid, it's reshaping how software actually gets built, from spec to delivery, and we're moving with it rather than waiting for the dust to settle: agentic workflows, new tooling, new ideas about what a software factory even looks like. We build on and around Shopify, a platform that changes just as fast, so staying current isn't a nice to have here, it's the job.

That's why we're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring the next level of engineer, people who see this pace of change as the interesting part of the work, not something to survive until things settle down.

Your Impact:

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build and run production AI/ML systems, from classic ML models to LLM and agent-based applications, that improve the user experience and business results. You will lead technical work on large AI systems, set a high bar for AI-native engineering practice, mentor engineers and work with stakeholders to define and deliver AI initiatives.

what you'll do

    • Develop and maintain scalable ML pipelines on Databricks and AWS covering data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation and serving, with monitoring, drift detection and automated retraining.

    • Build systems that combine models, tools and data into cohesive, agentic workflows capable of executing multi-step tasks. This includes designing system behaviors such as planning, tool use, structured outputs and failure handling.

    • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in model training and inference through profiling, optimization, and architectural improvements, optimizing for latency and cost (e.g., TensorRT, quantization, batching).

    • Set up evaluation frameworks for LLM and ML systems, including offline evals, online A/B tests and quality guardrails, and ensure model fairness, bias mitigation and responsible AI practices.

    • Find and redesign engineering and business workflows using AI tools, and measure the impact.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate product requirements into production-ready systems, and continuously improve system performance through iteration and evaluation.

    • Mentor engineers on ML practice and AI-assisted development.

what you'll bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on machine learning systems, model development, or ML infrastructure.

  • Proven track record of deploying AI/ML solutions at scale in production.

  • Experience in one or more specialized ML domains: search, recommendation systems, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision or generative AI.

  • Experience leading and owning end-to-end delivery of AI/ML projects, including technical design, cross-functional collaboration, and operational readiness.

  • Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing and refactoring.

  • Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL and data exploration, and speeding up engineering workflows.

  • Has integrated AI tools to improve engineering efficiency and code quality, or to redesign workflows, with measurable impact such as time saved, defect reduction or throughput gains.

  • Keeps building AI skills, for example prompt and context engineering or agent orchestration, and stays current with new AI technologies.

  • Excellent communication and mentorship skills.

  • Good English communication skills (written and verbal)

    • Tech Stack:

    • Languages: Python (primary)

    • Data & ML platform: Databricks (Spark, MLflow, Unity Catalog), AWS (SageMaker, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS)

    • Vector search / RAG: Qdrant

    • Inference optimisation: TensorRT

    • Frameworks: PyTorch, Hugging Face; LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) and agent frameworks

    • Nice to have: LLM observability and eval tooling (e.g. Datadog LLM Observability), Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD for ML

life at clearer.io

    eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.

    We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide.

    We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners.

    We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric.

    What guides us day to day:

  • Customers at the heart: we obsess over their needs so we can grow together

  • Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinking

  • Endless innovation: we refine, improve, and take meaningful action

  • Always open: we build trust through transparency and global collaboration

clear benefits

    Everyone, everywhere

  • Your birthday off - a full paid day, just for you, every year

  • Give Back Day - a paid day each year to volunteer for a cause you care about

  • Bonusly peer recognition - real-time shout-outs tied to our values, with points that convert to real rewards

  • Clearer Together - employees who exemplifies our values wins a fully-funded 5-night trip to one of our global offices (Sydney, Berlin, Leicester, Irvine or Ho Chi Minh City)

  • Stopover - travelling near one of our offices? Once a year we'll fund a day with the local team

    • VN

  • 100% Remote Culture: Work from anywhere in Vietnam that brings you happiness.

  • Performance-based Year-End Bonus: Recognizing and rewarding your individual contributions.

  • Wellness Allowance: Support for classes promoting physical and mental health.

  • Time Off: 20 days/year, in addition to Vietnam holidays.

  • MacBook Provided.

  • Collaborative Events: Offline meet-ups, monthly gatherings and year-end party.

  • Continuous Learning: Technical and general workshops, online resources.

  • Health and Wellness Benefits: Generali Health Care, annual check-up.

  • International Exposure: Enhance expertise and English communication skills.

    • a fair shot for everyone

    We're committed to a fair and inclusive hiring experience. Hiring decisions at clearer.io are based on skills, experience and role requirements - nothing else. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just tell us; it won't affect your application.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Post Order Experience
jobs.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

The Post Order Experience team owns what happens after a customer places an order, the moments that determine whether CookUnity feels dependable, flexible, and easy to fit into everyday life.

We build the experiences that help customers stay in control when plans change, whether they need to manage or reschedule an order, skip a delivery, pause their subscription, or cancel when CookUnity no longer meets their needs. We also look for thoughtful ways to understand and address why someone may want to leave, while always making the experience clear, respectful, and easy to navigate.

This is a broad, high-impact space where simple customer experiences often sit on top of significant operational complexity. We partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Experience, and Operations to turn that complexity into journeys that feel intuitive and trustworthy. Our work directly shapes customer satisfaction and retention and, most importantly, whether customers feel confident and cared for long after checkout.

The role:

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in our Post-Orders Experience Squad, directly reporting to the Engineer Manager.

Collaborating closely with a Product Manager and a designer, you'll be contributing to the shape of the product strategy, define OKRs, and chart the roadmap. Your responsibilities will extend to maintaining regular communication with senior management and providing updates on status, risk assessment, and the broader product strategy.

This position offers an opportunity to drive meaningful impact within our team and organization, contributing your expertise to guide our product's growth and success. This role involves working on the Server-Driven UI (SDUI) service within our Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture, as well as developing and maintaining backend services and databases.

Responsibilities:

  • Owning the design and implementation of features within our technical stack that engage customers and have a meaningful impact on people’s lives.
  • Iterating on new and existing features to improve user experience and performance.
  • Actively contribute to the adoption of strong software architecture, development of best practices, and new technologies.
  • Improving the maturity of our technical stack with engineering best practices.
  • Being part of the code review process and helping to mentor other engineers.
  • Contribute technically to projects by being a hands-on coder, removing roadblocks, and repairing technical issues.
  • Partner with members of Product, Growth, Marketing, Customer Experience and other teams to continually refine and improve our product in an agile process.
  • Helping to have higher levels of uptime & supporting the on-call rotation that will help the business run 24/7.

Qualifications:

  • You have at least +5yrs of experience as a Software Engineer, and you can engage with projects in ReactJS, Kotlin/Java, GraphQL, MySQL.
  • You have experience designing and building cloud architecture, backends, middle ends, web apps, basically the whole combo!
  • Experience implementing and maintaining unit tests and e2e tests.
  • Strong knowledge of service-oriented architectures.
  • You understand how to interact with and build backend REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with continuous integration.
  • Advanced level of English
  • Ability to leverage generative AI to increase output quality and speed.

Preferred requirements:

  • Experience with DevOps tools and cloud platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS
  • Experience with React Native.
  • Experience in the food technology sector is a plus.

Benefits:

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want.

⛱ Enjoy 15 business days of vacation each year from the start date.

🎄16 fully paid Argentinean holidays.

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider.

🗓️ 5-year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (w/m/d) – React, Node.js, TypeScript + AI
jobs.excerpt: AI macht uns schneller.  Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.
jobs.description:
AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.
Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade.
Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich.

Gestalte die User Experience. Gestalte die Technologie. Entwickle, was als Nächstes kommt.

Software verändert sich. AI-Agenten verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen mit digitalen Produkten interagieren. Wir entwickeln die Lösungen für die nächste Generation dieser Interaktionen.

Werde Teil unseres UI Engineering Teams und entwickle leistungsfähige, produktionsreife Anwendungen an der Schnittstelle von Softwareentwicklung, UX, Product und AI. Du gestaltest nicht nur, wie unsere Produkte aussehen und funktionieren, sondern auch, wie Menschen künftig mit ihnen interagieren.

Be an engineer. Think like a Product Builder.

Deine Mission

  • Entwickle produktionsreife Anwendungen. Arbeite mit React, Next.js, TypeScript und Node.js – vom User Interface über APIs bis hin zu Backend-Services.

  • Triff fundierte technische Entscheidungen. Gestalte skalierbare Architekturen, bewege dich sicher über den gesamten Stack und erkenne, wann eine einfache Lösung die beste ist.

  • Gestalte neue Wege der Interaktion. Entwickle intuitive Interfaces und innovative Anwendungskonzepte – von modernen User Interfaces bis hin zu AI-gestützten Interaktionen und agentenbasierten Workflows.

  • Finde heraus, was die User wirklich brauchen. Hinterfrage Annahmen, erkenne die eigentlichen Herausforderungen und entwickle Lösungen, die einen echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Übernimm Verantwortung für Produkt und Code. Arbeite eng mit Product, UX/UI und Engineering zusammen und nutze AI gezielt, um Ideen zu entwickeln, Code zu schreiben und Probleme zu lösen. Hinterfrage Ergebnisse kritisch und stehe für die Qualität deiner Lösungen ein.

Code ist nur der Anfang. Hinterfrage, gestalte und entwickle Lösungen, die einen echten Mehrwert schaffen.

Deine Skills

  • Bring fundierte Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-JavaScript-Entwicklung mit. Entwickle anspruchsvolle Webanwendungen mit React, Next.js, TypeScript und Node.js eigenständig und bringe sie erfolgreich in den Produktivbetrieb.

  • Setze React, Next.js, TypeScript und Node.js sicher ein. Verstehe, wie moderne Webanwendungen aufgebaut sind und wie ihre einzelnen Komponenten zusammenspielen.

  • Entwickle und integriere APIs. Arbeite sicher mit REST-APIs und SQL-Datenbanken und triff fundierte Entscheidungen zu Datenstrukturen und Datenbankdesign. Erfahrung mit GraphQL ist ein Plus.

  • Setze auf sauberen, zuverlässigen Code. Berücksichtige Architektur, Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Wartbarkeit. Erkenne Sonderfälle und nimm Tests ernst. Praktische Erfahrung mit Jest, Vitest oder dem Testing in Node.js ist Voraussetzung.

  • Nutze AI selbstverständlich in deiner täglichen Arbeit und übernimm Verantwortung – über den Code hinaus. Entwickle Ideen, schreibe Code und löse Probleme mit AI. Hinterfrage die Ergebnisse kritisch, triff fundierte technische Entscheidungen und finde eigenständig die passende Lösung. Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Interfaces, AI-Agenten oder dialogbasierten Anwendungen ist ein Plus.

Das ist ein Plus: Erfahrung mit AWS, Jenkins, Grafana, Graylog, Confluence, Jira oder Shell-Scripting.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle.

  • Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran.

  • Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen.

  • Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen.

Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr.

Dein Lebenslauf ist nur der Anfang.

Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Lebenslauf: ein Portfolio, ein Side Project oder ein Demo-Repo – etwas, das zeigt, wie du technische Probleme angehst und Lösungen umsetzt.

🤖 AI Disclaimer: AI durfte mitdenken, aber nicht das letzte Wort haben. Das behalten wir uns vor.

jobs.description:
What you'll do...

Position: Senior Software Engineer

Job Location: 221 River Street, Hoboken, NJ 07030

Duties: Owns the last mile part of the DMAS (Digital Marketing Asset Services) platform for SEM (Search Engine Marketing) ensuring smooth operation and data feed push from DMAS to GMC (Google Merchant Center) and BMC (Bing Merchant Center). Adds instrumentation mechanism to the DMAS engine and implement the capability to log events based on a filter to detect event loss between DMAS and GMC, without the need for enabling logs. Contributes significantly to the new account structure and offer level bidding and do the migration of offers from the old structure to the new structure in GMC and managing labels as offers move from cold to warm and vice versa. Publishes feeds for Walmart B2B SEM and regional inventory, expanding the platform's capabilities and reach. Assists in migrating items from old structure to new structure for strategic SEM campaigns and automate the process through building pipelines. Develops rules and quality metrics for publishing offers in GMC based on offer quality to ensure the success and effectiveness of the platform. Manage end to end optimization of data pipelines for SEM program at scale.

Minimum education and experience required: Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 1 year of experience in software engineering or related area; OR Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years of experience in software engineering or related area.

Skills required: Experience working closely with product, design, and UX teams to create intuitive experiences and Agile methodology. Experience developing software systems and solve complex problems by leveraging state-of-the-art technology. Experience participating in large-scale, complex, cross-functional projects by reviewing project requirements and translating them into technical solutions. Experience building high quality code by conducting unit testing and enhancing design to prevent re-occurrences of defects. Experience troubleshooting business and production issues by gathering and evaluating information. Experience building scalable and flexible applications based on Microservices Architecture. Experience with Spark and Hive and experience with Airflow for ETL and Java. Experience with REST API, Elasticsearch, and Python. Experience in computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and design patterns. Employer will accept any amount of experience with the required skills.

Salary Range: $137,717/year to $216,000/year. Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance incentives. 

Benefits: At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based incentive awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty and voting. jobs.description:
This position is remote within the EMEA region, with the flexibility to work from our Munich or Budapest office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About You:

  • You are customer focussed and and excited to partner with customers to identify and deliver measurable impact
  • You communicate clearly and effectively across levels, with people from the shop floor to engineering managers to c-level executives
  • You like to solve problems, working closely with colleagues from other departments
  • You have worked for or supported a Life Sciences company and understand their regulatory requirements
  • You have experience in life science development, operations and/or manufacturing environments
  • You Google your way out of most problems, and understand that every customer sees the world a bit differently

What skills do I need?

  • BA/BS (MBA/Masters preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Product Management, Management Consulting or other client-facing roles in the Life Sciences industry
  • Experience with change management in a GxP manufacturing and operations
  • Experience creating and leading stakeholder & executive presentations, working with enterprise corporations and multicultural business environments
  • Experience coordinating and leading actions among cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services)
  • Bias for action and client impact
  • Passion for continuous improvement and digital transformation
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, technology-driven business environment
  • Ability to travel (estimated up to 15%)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts by monitoring their adoption, utilization and overall health of their deployment
  • Serve as internal customer champion
  • Guide customers to use Tulip as a tool to improve their operations through digitization, including recommending new use cases, tracking and communicating ROI
  • Act as a trusted partner to customers to ensure and manage contract renewals and support commercial expansion
  • Coordinate across internal teams, from Customer Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Sales
  • Build and improve internal processes and content, as mechanisms to scale up and mature the Customer Success function

Key Collaborators:

  • Customers
  • Professional Services
  • Customer Support
  • Sales
  • Product Management
  • Tulip’s partners, who may also be supporting an account

Working At Tulip

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being.

Benefits of working with us include:

  • Direct impact on product and culture
  • Company equity
  • Competitive benefits package including commuter benefits, learning and development stipend, team events, catered lunches 3 days a week

jobs.excerpt: Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown.
jobs.description:
Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN) is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non-human pilot to deliver full-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation.

About You:

    You are an experienced systems engineer with a strong background in system architecture, interface definition, requirements management, and system validation for civil-certified or DOD safety-critical avionics systems. You excel at capturing and communicating architectures, and at translating customer needs into top-level system requirements that decompose cleanly into subsystems. You have a passion for new product development and a proven record of delivering high-quality systems engineering work products in a fast-moving R&D flight test environment while keeping safety at the forefront. You work effectively across engineering domains and communicate clearly with hardware, software, safety, and flight test teams, as well as customers, suppliers, and partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute assigned segments of the Merlin Pilot System architecture and interface definition, including functional/logical architecture, functional behaviors, and physical architecture.
  • Capture and maintain system architectures in models (MBSE), keeping them current as the design evolves.
  • Translate customer needs into top-level system descriptions and requirements that decompose to the Mission Autonomy and Flight Autonomy teams. Develop CONOPs, Use Cases, and other tools to capture customer needs.
  • Define and assess the interfaces between mission autonomy and flight autonomy, ensuring correctness and feasibility, and document Merlin Pilot’s architecture interfaces to support interoperability and integration across multiple aircraft types.
  • Develop system-level requirements for features, functions, interfaces, performance, and operational needs, and support allocation of requirements to sub-systems and items.
  • Specify physical interfaces and data protocols, and produce detailed interface definitions and supporting documentation.
  • Support Merlin Pilot software releases, providing systems engineering support from requirements definition through validation.
  • Perform change impact assessments in response to change requests, problem reports, and new requirements from Air Vehicle Integration.
  • Execute trade studies and present results and recommendations to appropriate Engineering Review Boards.
  • Collaborate with System Safety and Product Cybersecurity to capture system-level safety and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Participate in reviews of artifacts with customers, suppliers, and regulatory authorities as required.

Qualifications:

  • BS in Systems/Aerospace/Electrical Engineering or a related subject, MS preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience conducting systems engineering in FAA/EASA/DOD certification programs (7+ years with MS degree, 5+ years with PhD).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver complex systems engineering work products with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on experience in integrated avionics equipment using ARP4754A/B and RTCA DO-178B/C for flight-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop system-level requirements, architectures, and interfaces, and decompose down to lower levels.
  • History in requirements validation and verification.
  • Demonstrated experience capturing system architectures using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools (e.g., Cameo).
  • Demonstrated familiarity with general aviation aircraft and integration.

Nice to Have:

  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects or work packages from a technical perspective.
  • Specific experience in the area of Automatic Flight Controls, Flight Management, or Display Systems.
  • Specific experience in developing software requirements and performing software verification.

Logistics:

  • We welcome remote applicants for this role, with a preference for candidates based in or willing to relocate to Boston, MA for a hybrid work schedule at our HQ.

We also offer a top-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, flexible paid time off, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. The Opportunity:

SPHERE is seeking a Technical Delivery Manager to lead implementations and upgrades of SPHEREboard, our identity intelligence platform. You will lead a delivery pod made up of the technical engineers who implement and upgrade SPHEREboard for our clients, along with dedicated Support and engineering resources.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work directly in client environments alongside pod team members, partner subcontractors, and client-assigned resources, and serve as the client’s primary point of contact from kickoff through go-live.
A core part of the mission is to scale our delivery model as our client base grows, making every implementation and upgrade faster and more consistent.
No prior SPHEREboard experience is expected. You will bring deep identity and infrastructure knowledge, and within your first 90 days become hands-on proficient in SPHEREboard and how it behaves across client environments.

Essential Functions:

Technical Delivery
  • Plan and run implementations, version upgrades, and environment migrations (Dev to Prod, on-prem to SaaS).
  • Guide clients through infrastructure readiness (systems permissions, network access, database sizing, etc.) so deployments start smoothly.
  • Work hands-on in client engagements: configure, tune, and troubleshoot SPHEREboard integrations and scans alongside pod team members.

Team & Delivery Model

  • Manage subcontracted and partner delivery resources, including hours and budget against SOWs, technical quality review, and change control.

  • Build trusted client relationships during engagements, communicating clearly with technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify risks early, articulate their business impact, and recommend options to clients and leadership.

  • Proven player-coach who has led engineers and/or PMs while staying hands-on in client environments.
  • Working fluency across the identity estate: Active Directory, LDAP, and Entra; Windows and UNIX/Linux; databases; file systems; AWS and Azure; CyberArk; SailPoint; and ServiceNow CMDB. Hands-on depth in at least two, ideally Active Directory plus PAM or IGA.

  • Comfortable navigating PowerShell scripts and SQL queries: able to understand what a script is meant to do, follow along as it is built, and validate that it worked as intended.

jobs.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYDirectly handle a diverse claims caseload of multiple coverage types, including casualty and D&O, with a large percentage of losses of moderate to high complexity and financial severity.
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Directly handle a diverse claims caseload of multiple coverage types, including casualty and D&O, with a large percentage of losses of moderate to high complexity and financial severity. Claims assigned occasionally involve substantive coverage issues or litigation. Employee should possess demonstrated expertise in handling significant bodily injury claims which involve both comparative negligence theories and defenses. Employee should be highly skilled in all coverages written with an emphasis on the more difficult losses and exposures and be capable of seeing more difficult adjustments through final resolution using a wide variety of settlement techniques. Conclude claims promptly and equitably within the provisions of the policy contract and in accordance with known damages and legal requirements. All files handled must comply with claim handling guidelines and all other job expectations, regulations and requirements.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct and coordinate loss investigations on all assigned claims.
  • Negotiate the settlement of claims within authorized amounts or specific file authority.
  • Maintain accountability for all assigned claims until disposition is reached.
  • Recommend further action on claims exceeding authority limits.
  • Document all activity on assigned claims and assist in the control of independent vendors.
  • Review new losses and files on diary to ensure reserve adequacy while keeping management informed of adverse developments.
  • Monitor loss adjustment expenses and take steps to effectively manage costs of third party service providers.
  • Utilize vendors judiciously to ensure maximum value from services.
  • Review coverage questions and suggest interpretations to Claim Staff Supervisor for approval.
  • Refer appropriate coverage matters to the Claim Supervisor and/or Claim Manager.
  • Ensure appropriate file handling, documentation, special reporting and expense control of all files handled.
  • Provide accurate, courteous and timely information to all eligible external and internal customers concerning claim status and other claim inquiries.
  • Presents reports and leads discussion on files requiring roundtable reviews with peers and management
  • Provide service calls to policyholders and agencies as needed.
  • Serve as a technical resource within the Department through mentoring and knowledge sharing.
  • Draft coverage correspondence, including reservation of rights and coverage disclaimers along with composing detailed correspondence to insureds, claimants, attorneys, etc.
  • Attend trials, depositions, EUO’s and mediations where deemed beneficial or required by jurisdiction.
  • Suggest improvements to processes within the department to increase the level and quality of service provided to internal and external customers, e.g. workflow changes, systems implementation, etc.
  • Effectively follow direction on complicated or high-exposure matters and recommend appropriate reserves on claim files within specific authority and on files requiring mandatory reporting to management.
  • Deliver technical training for adjusting staff and clerical personnel as needed.
  • This position handles an assigned claim pending.
  • Performs other duties or special projects as required or as assigned.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED

The Claim Supervisor provides minimal direct supervision.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED

This job primarily has no supervisory duties; however moderate supervision of independent adjusters, vendors and claim support staff may occur.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance or a related field, or its equivalent.
  • Five or more years of relevant technical claim handling experience with demonstrated achievement and progressive responsibilities; or a combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and skills are acquired.
  • Appropriate state Adjuster’s License(s) where required by law.
  • Advanced knowledge of the technical aspects of casualty claims (general liability, subrogation and litigation).
  • Demonstrated commitment to professional development through the attainment of recognized industry designations such as AIC, AEI, SCLA, CPCU programs, etc.
  • Fully developed skills in specialized technical disciplines; including extensive knowledge of relevant contract and tort law.
  • Sound understanding of the insurance industry and company operations.
  • Strong analytical and negotiating skills.
  • Very good oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment in dealing with professional issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with a wide range of outside firms and organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with company management, peers and claim support staff.
  • Proficiency with PC applications including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel & Outlook); Experience with imaging programs preferred.
  • Ability to perform job responsibilities under stressful situations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Employees in this job classification may be based in either a typical office environment or from a remote location or residence as determined by management.
  • For non-field positions, predominately sedentary office position with high frequency of keyboarding/computer work required.
  • Occasional overnight travel.
  • Potentially subject to inclement weather and stressful situations with respect to claim disputes.

The salary range reflected is a good faith estimate of base pay for the position. In addition to base salary, this role is incentive compensation and benefits eligible, and individual salary will ultimately be determined based on individual experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location.

What we’re looking for…

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

40
