jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Mission Liaison / Analyst Lead to lead mission-owner engagement, requirements decomposition, backlog readiness, and cross-team traceability for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Mission Liaison / Analyst Lead to lead mission-owner engagement, requirements decomposition, backlog readiness, and cross-team traceability for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior role serves as a primary connection between Government mission owners, users, business analysts, software delivery teams, trainers, and technical stakeholders.

The Mission Liaison / Analyst Lead translates mission needs into actionable requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, training objectives, and release communications. The position also owns the User Training Plan and user collaboration and feedback process, ensuring that mission-owner input remains traceable through design, development, testing, training, acceptance, and release.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Mission Liaison / Analyst Lead will:

  • Lead engagement with Government mission owners, users, product stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and manage functional and mission requirements.
  • Decompose mission needs into clear, measurable, testable, and traceable requirements.
  • Develop and refine user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, workflows, and related functional documentation.
  • Assess backlog readiness and work with delivery teams to prepare requirements for sprint planning and implementation.
  • Maintain end-to-end traceability among mission needs, requirements, user stories, design decisions, acceptance criteria, test results, training materials, and released capabilities.
  • Coordinate mission-owner input for Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), requirements packages, interface considerations, and solution-development activities.
  • Own and maintain the User Training Plan in coordination with Government representatives, technical subject matter experts, trainers, and release teams.
  • Coordinate the development and review of user guides, job aids, release notes, training materials, and other user-facing documentation.
  • Establish and manage structured user collaboration, feedback, and validation processes throughout the software-development lifecycle.
  • Facilitate requirements workshops, backlog-refinement sessions, user reviews, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
  • Coordinate user acceptance criteria and support user acceptance, operational validation, and release-readiness activities.
  • Translate user feedback and operational lessons learned into prioritized requirements, backlog updates, and improvement recommendations.
  • Coordinate release communications with Government mission owners, users, training personnel, and technical teams.
  • Identify requirements gaps, conflicting stakeholder needs, dependencies, and traceability risks and drive them to resolution.
  • Support Agile planning, sprint reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release-planning activities.
  • Ensure mission requirements and user needs remain aligned with system architecture, integration requirements, scalability objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Prepare briefings, status updates, decision materials, meeting minutes, and other program documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement of requirements-management, stakeholder-engagement, training, and user-feedback practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing requirements analysis and decomposing complex mission or business needs into actionable requirements.
  • Experience developing and managing user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability.
  • Experience coordinating requirements and deliverables across mission stakeholders, users, analysts, developers, testers, trainers, and other technical teams.
  • A current business analysis or Agile certification.
  • Ability to lead stakeholder-engagement sessions, requirements workshops, backlog-refinement discussions, and user-feedback activities.
  • Ability to produce clear functional requirements, workflows, training inputs, user documentation, release communications, and decision-support materials.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical information for mission and operational audiences.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, and cross-team actions.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development, modernization, or systems-engineering programs.
  • Experience supporting Government mission owners or serving as a liaison between operational users and technical delivery teams.
  • Experience developing or coordinating CONOPS inputs, user training plans, user guides, release notes, and other operational documentation.
  • Experience working in Agile, DevSecOps, or hybrid federal software-delivery environments.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing, demonstrations, release readiness, and operational validation.
  • Familiarity with requirements-management and Agile collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with requirements traceability matrices, process modeling, workflow analysis, and backlog-management practices.
  • Knowledge of secure software-development and systems-engineering practices applicable to federal or DoD environments.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe certification, or equivalent credentials.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

About the Company

Our client is an established U.S.-based law firm that has represented injured workers and injury victims for decades, with a focus on workers' compensation and personal injury matters.

The firm is looking to add a highly experienced paralegal or attorney to work as the right hand of its litigating attorneys.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly experienced paralegal or attorney to serve as the right hand to the litigating attorney on Minnesota workers' compensation cases (work comp and related tort claims, meaning injury claims brought against insurance companies on behalf of injured workers).

This is not an entry-level or general admin role. The ideal candidate already understands how workers' compensation litigation works and can get a case fully prepared for the attorney to argue, including making appearances on the attorney's behalf short of trial itself.

This is intended to be a long-term engagement. Because of the learning curve involved in understanding Minnesota workers' compensation law and the firm's internal processes, the firm is not looking to repeat this training with frequent turnover. There is also potential for this role to expand into related personal injury matters outside of workers' compensation.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Long-term engagement with a law firm that values stability and continuity.
  • Work in close coordination with experienced litigating attorneys.
  • Act essentially as an attorney would on a case, short of appearing at trial.
  • Potential to expand into related personal injury matters.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare case files for the litigating attorney from start to finish, including legal research specific to Minnesota workers' compensation and injury law.
  • Review medical records and cross-reference them against the client's account of the injury to build a complete, accurate picture of the case.
  • Ensure every case meets the proper medical-legal standards required to win in front of a judge or in settlement.
  • Make appearances on behalf of the attorney as needed throughout the case lifecycle.
  • Work under the direct supervision of, and in close coordination with, Attorney Mark Rodgers and Attorney Jim Perkett.
  • Act essentially as an attorney would on a case, short of appearing at trial.

Qualifications

Required

  • Significant, hands-on experience with Minnesota workers' compensation cases or closely related injury and insurance litigation work. Candidates fresh out of school are not a fit for this role.
  • Comfortable independently managing a full caseload: legal research, medical record review, case preparation, and appearances.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Based in Mexico, Central America, or South America, with availability aligned to U.S. Central or Eastern business hours.

How Success Is Measured

  • Case files fully prepared for the attorney to argue.
  • Accurate, complete case pictures built from medical records and client accounts.
  • Reliable appearances and follow-through on the attorney's behalf.
  • Long-term commitment and low turnover.

Why Join Us

You'll join a collaborative, fully remote team that values ownership, professionalism, clear communication, and long-term commitment, working side by side with experienced attorneys.

Compensation: $10–$20 USD per hour, depending on qualifications and experience; final terms to be confirmed.

Contract Type: Independent Contractor, with contracting and payments managed through Deel.

Important Notes

  • This is a legal support role, not a position to practice U.S. law independently. All work is performed under the supervision of the firm's licensed attorneys.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a written English and legal-support skills assessment.
  • Please submit your CV in English, detailing your legal education, bar admission or professional credentials (if applicable), English proficiency, and relevant workers' compensation, injury, or insurance litigation experience.

This is a fully remote position.

Travel: As Required
Functional Reporting: SDI Consultant Sr. Program Manager
Salary Rate: $120,000

Position Description

The Senior Project Manager, Security Design & Integration (SDI), is a Securitas-employed professional embedded within a client’s Global Security organization. This position manages complex physical security projects across a geographically distributed portfolio of hyperscale and enterprise data centers.

Reporting functionally to the SDI Consultant Sr. Program Manager, the position oversees assigned projects from planning and design coordination through implementation, commissioning, and closeout. The role collaborates with security leadership, engineering, construction, IT, site operations, systems integrators, and technology vendors.

The Senior Project Manager is accountable for delivering projects within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements while maintaining compliance with established SDI governance standards.

Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead physical security deployments, expansions, upgrades, and modernization projects across assigned data center locations.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and critical paths.
  • Coordinate execution with engineering, construction, IT, facilities, security operations, and site stakeholders.
  • Monitor project performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements; implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Manage project changes through established approval processes, evaluating impacts to cost, schedule, and deliverables.
  • Facilitate project meetings, milestone reviews, and cross-functional coordination activities.
  • Manage concurrent projects while maintaining alignment with program priorities and operational requirements.

Technical Oversight & Systems Integration

  • Provide project-level technical coordination for access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and supporting security infrastructure.
  • Coordinate deployments involving LenelS2 OnGuard, Milestone XProtect, and comparable enterprise security platforms.
  • Review system designs, technical drawings, equipment specifications, and installation documentation for alignment with approved requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists, systems engineers, and integrators to address infrastructure readiness, networking dependencies, and integration requirements.
  • Coordinate system upgrades, migrations, and installations to minimize disruption to active data center operations.
  • Oversee functional testing, commissioning activities, technical acceptance, and resolution of installation deficiencies.
  • Verify delivery of required technical documentation, including as-built drawings, equipment inventories, test results, and configuration records.
  • Technical design approval and system configuration authority remain with designated engineering and technical personnel.

Vendor, Stakeholder & Financial Management

  • Manage systems integrators, contractors, and vendors against approved scopes of work, contractual commitments, schedules, and quality expectations.
  • Coordinate vendor resources, site access, equipment deliveries, and installation activities.
  • Review vendor proposals, estimates, change orders, and invoices for alignment with approved project requirements.
  • Maintain project budgets, expenditure forecasts, purchase order tracking, and cost variance reporting.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Procurement on purchasing, invoice reconciliation, and related financial reporting requirements.
  • Identify vendor performance issues, funding concerns, and potential cost overruns, escalating matters requiring management intervention.
  • Maintain effective relationships with client leadership, technical teams, and operational stakeholders.
  • Financial approval authority remains with designated client and organizational representatives.

Governance, Risk Management & Reporting

  • Execute projects in accordance with SDI operating procedures, project governance standards, and client security requirements.
  • Maintain accurate project records, including schedules, RAID logs, decision registers, change documentation, and status reports.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, financial, schedule, vendor, and operational risks.
  • Prepare project performance reports covering milestones, budget status, delivery risks, and corrective actions.
  • Escalate significant project deviations and unresolved issues to the SDI Consultant Program Manager.
  • Support compliance with site security policies, operational change control, and applicable construction requirements.
  • Participate in governance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Operational Readiness & Closeout

  • Coordinate operational readiness reviews and verify completion of commissioning and acceptance requirements.
  • Track outstanding deficiencies and punch-list items through resolution.
  • Facilitate project handover to security operations, technical support, and maintenance teams.
  • Confirm completion of warranties, support documentation, training requirements, and final deliverables.
  • Obtain required stakeholder acceptance and project closeout approvals.
  • Document lessons learned and confirm completion of project closure requirements.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Information Systems, Security Management, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
  • Minimum eight (8) years of project management experience, including complex, multi-site projects.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering physical security, electronic security systems, critical infrastructure, data center, construction, or systems integration projects.
  • Experience managing budgets, schedules, vendors, contractual deliverables, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent projects across geographically distributed locations.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Working knowledge of enterprise access control, video management, intrusion detection, and related security technologies.
  • Understanding of structured cabling, IP networking, server infrastructure, and system integration dependencies.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, security designs, construction documents, and equipment specifications.
  • Familiarity with security system commissioning, acceptance testing, and operational turnover.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management platforms such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong communication, organizational, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent credential.
  • Ten (10) or more years of experience managing complex technical infrastructure or security systems projects.
  • Experience supporting hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center environments.
  • Familiarity with LenelS2 OnGuard, Milestone XProtect, Genetec, Software House C•CURE, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise security upgrades, system migrations, and multi-site technology deployments.
  • Knowledge of data center construction, operational change control, and critical infrastructure requirements.
  • Familiarity with ASIS International guidance, ISO 27001, NIST, or comparable security frameworks.
  • ASIS CPP, PSP, or relevant technical certifications.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated against established project objectives, including schedule and budget adherence, technical quality, risk mitigation, vendor accountability, operational readiness, governance compliance, and stakeholder communication.

Reporting & Organizational Alignment

The Senior Project Manager is employed by Securitas Security Services USA and reports functionally to the SDI Consultant Sr. Program Manager within the client’s Global Security organization.

The position is accountable for executing assigned projects. Overall portfolio strategy, program governance, resource prioritization, and executive-level program accountability remain with the SDI Consultant Program Manager.

The Senior Project Manager may coordinate project coordinators, technical specialists, and vendors but does not exercise direct personnel management authority unless formally assigned.

About Securitas

Securitas is a global security solutions provider dedicated to helping make the world a safer place. The company combines people, technology, and expertise to protect clients, their operations, and their assets.

Securitas operates according to three core values: Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values guide its commitment to ethical conduct, proactive risk awareness, service excellence, and professional accountability.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic Automation
jobs.excerpt: About Cerby At Cerby, security is everyone's business.
jobs.description:
About Cerby

At Cerby, security is everyone's business.

Cerby extends your security perimeter to include your disconnected applications, providing identity automation and eliminating manual processes. It's one of the biggest blind spots in enterprise security, and we're the team closing it. If you want to work alongside the team solving one of the hardest, most overlooked problems in security, you're in the right place.

Founded in 2020, Cerby is backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises across the globe.

OVERVIEW & IMPACT

Every application Cerby protects needs Cerby to know how it works — its API, or the clicks behind its login, password rotation, MFA setup, or access change — and that knowledge breaks whenever a vendor redesigns its site or changes its API. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to own the AI agents that onboard new applications and repair automations when they drift. You will start with two agent systems we have already built and benchmarked:

API catalog generation: reads a vendor’s public API docs in a headless browser and produces a validated OpenAPI spec, with per-job cost ceilings and an accuracy benchmark.

Browser workflow generation: performs a task in a SaaS app’s web UI and writes a replayable automation workflow, handling MFA, one-time codes, and CAPTCHAs along the way.

Your job is to take them to production, make them self-healing, and set the direction for agentic automation at Cerby. These agents handle real customer credentials and browse untrusted sites, so security is part of the job, not an afterthought.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership and Production

  • Own agentic onboarding and self-healing end to end: architecture, roadmap, and on-call once live.
  • Take the existing systems to production on durable workflows (Temporal), with the observability to run them.

Self-Healing Automation

  • Detect drift — a changed login page, a moved button, a renamed API field — from failed runs, before customers notice.
  • Build agents that diagnose the break, repair the workflow or spec, and re-validate the fix against real runs before it goes back into service.
  • Decide what heals automatically and what needs human review.

Evaluation and Cost

  • Own the benchmarks for generated specs, workflows, and repairs, and make “good enough to ship” a measured threshold.
  • Own cost and latency per output, choosing between frontier and open-weight models on measured accuracy versus cost.

Security

  • Own the threat model: prompt injection from page content, credential isolation, token handling, sandboxed browsing, and egress.
  • Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, queues, and stored run state.

Collaboration

  • Partner with the integrations, automation-runtime, and platform teams; write the design docs they build on, and mentor contributors.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIRED SKILLS

Experience

  • You have shipped an LLM agent with tool use that ran unattended for real users, and owned a backend system in production.

Technical Skills

  • Strong in Python or TypeScript, and productive in both.
  • LLM agents and tool use: agent loops, structured outputs, retries, and the failure modes they create.
  • Eval discipline: you have built benchmarks or eval harnesses and used them to make decisions.
  • Depth in browser automation (Playwright or similar) orbackend and API-integration systems, and comfort in the other.
  • Distributed systems: queues, idempotency, and durable workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar).
  • Security judgment for systems that handle secrets, including agent-specific threats such as prompt injection.

Desirable

  • Temporal in production; Pydantic AI or a comparable agent framework.
  • Open-weight model serving (Fireworks, Together, Bedrock) and LLM cost modeling.
  • Computer-use agents or browser extensions (Chrome MV3); OpenAPI tooling.
  • Identity, IAM, or credential-management experience; AWS and Terraform.

Soft Skills

  • Clear technical writing and trade-offs other teams can depend on.
  • You take an early system to production without waiting to be told how, and care that it keeps working after launch.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • 6 months: both systems run in production for real workloads, with improving error rates and cost per output, and drift is detected automatically.
  • 12 months: onboarding a new application is predominantly automated, and most drift-driven breakages heal without a human.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer (Senior) - IFS Logistics
jobs.excerpt: About IFS LogisticsIFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend, and automate execution.
jobs.description:
About IFS Logistics

IFS Logistics helps enterprise shippers connect transport data, manage carrier spend, and automate execution. The product began as 7bridges and is now part of IFS, with a small, focused team working closely with the commercial organisation.

We build SaaS products that customers can run themselves. The platform handles busy, data-heavy logistics operations, so reliability and clear operational visibility matter every day.

The role

You will join Diego Silva, our Lead DevOps Engineer, as the second DevOps specialist responsible for the platform. You will take ownership of substantial workstreams while partnering closely with application and data engineers.

There is useful work to do from day one. We want every merge request reviewed, production deployments controlled, and releases running to a predictable cadence. Those practices are not yet consistent across the team. Our monitoring also needs to cover more of the application and data estate, and our pipelines need stronger detection, recovery and ownership when something fails.

You will help turn those goals into working systems: better signals, safer delivery paths, faster recovery and infrastructure the team understands. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving a live platform rather than waiting for a perfect starting point.

What you'll work on

  • Build useful observability. Improve metrics, logs, traces and alerts across the Django API, data pipelines and warehouse so the team spots problems early and can diagnose them quickly.
  • Improve CI/CD. Make GitLab pipelines fast, dependable and difficult to bypass, with review and deployment controls built into the workflow.
  • Reduce operational risk. Remove direct-to-production paths, improve release controls and help the team establish a reliable weekly release rhythm.
  • Manage cloud cost. Make GCP spend visible by workload and product area, then reduce waste without compromising service quality.
  • Develop infrastructure as code. Improve our Terraform and Kubernetes setup so environments are reproducible, secure and clearly documented.
  • Strengthen data-pipeline reliability. Add failure detection, freshness checks, replay paths and clear ownership across Datastream, Pub/Sub, dbt and BigQuery.
  • Respond and learn. Help shape incident management and on-call practices, then turn recurring failures into automated checks and safeguards.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience running production services on GCP.
  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform, including operating and improving infrastructure rather than only deploying to it.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab or a similar platform.
  • Evidence that you have instrumented a real system and improved its metrics, logging, tracing or alerting.
  • Examples of treating cloud cost as an engineering concern: attributing spend, finding waste and making informed trade-offs.
  • Experience operating data pipelines, such as streaming ingestion, warehouse loads, dbt transformations or similar workflows.
  • The confidence to challenge an unsafe change and explain what needs to happen before it can ship.
  • Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude, including how you provide context and verify infrastructure changes before accepting them.
  • The ability to assess an imperfect system, decide what matters most and carry the improvement through to production.

Nice to have

  • Enough Python experience to investigate or fix issues in a Django application.
  • Security or compliance work in an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience designing incident-management or on-call processes.
  • BigQuery cost and performance tuning.

Tech stack

GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitLab CI/CD. Python and Django REST, TypeScript, Node and React. BigQuery, dbt, Cube Cloud and Superset. Pub/Sub and Datastream. The team uses Cursor and Claude for development, Notion for specifications and Jira for delivery.

What success looks like in the first six months

  • Our monitoring identifies production problems before customers report them.
  • Pipeline failures are detected quickly, assigned clearly and recoverable without improvised fixes.
  • Merge-request review and controlled production deployment are enforced through the delivery pipeline.
  • Weekly releases run predictably without creating unnecessary overhead for engineers.
  • GCP spend is attributable to workloads and product areas, with clear action taken on the main cost drivers.
  • Application and data teams have a responsive platform partner who improves their ability to ship safely.

Why we're hiring now

The team is growing and the platform needs to support a faster pace of delivery. That requires better visibility, stronger data pipelines and release controls that work without relying on individual memory or manual intervention.

Diego currently carries too much of that responsibility alone. This role adds the capacity to improve the platform while still supporting the product in production, and gives the team another engineer who can take a problem, form a plan and see it through.

This successful candidate will need to be based in the UK or the Netherlands. We're a remote team with clusters of people in London and Amsterdam.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

jobs.description:
Shape the future of our strongest sales region.

Natuvion is #TheDataMovingCompany. We help companies around the globe transform their data and business processes securely and efficiently to modern technologies and platforms. As part of the NTT DATA Business Solutions Group, we combine deep technology expertise with an international footprint and a clear growth trajectory.

The DACH region is the foundation of our business and a key driver of growth. To further strengthen our market position and leverage regional synergies more effectively, we are looking for an experienced sales leader and executive to join us as Regional Head of Sales DACH (f/m/d).

Your tasks

Strategic and Commercial Responsibility

  • Own the achievement of sales and revenue targets and drive sustainable growth across the DACH region, reporting directly to the Group CEOs.

  • Translate the global sales strategy into a regional go-to-market and sales strategy.

  • Identify new market potential, growth opportunities, and business opportunities.

Manage regional sales performance through KPIs, forecasts, and pipeline development

Regional Responsibility and Global Collaboration

  • Drive and coordinate strategic sales and business development initiatives across national borders.

  • Work closely with the Managing Directors of the country organizations.

  • Align the requirements of regional markets with the strategic objectives of the Natuvion Group and a unified market strategy.

Market Positioning and Synergies

  • Further develop Natuvion’s joint market presence and strengthen its market positioning.

  • Identify and realize cross-country synergies in customer engagement, partnerships, and sales models.

  • Expand cross-border customer relationships and joint sales initiatives, with a focus on advancing regional go-to-market approaches.

Global Alignment and Operational Execution

  • Collaborate closely with the Global Chief Sales & Partner Officer (CSPO), global sales functions, and delivery teams to implement the global sales strategy across the DACH region.

  • Represent the needs and market perspective of the DACH region in global strategic decision-making.

  • Foster strategic customer and partner relationships and personally support key proposal and sales processes.

Requirements

Your Profile:

  • Several years of leadership and sales experience in a technology, IT consulting, or professional services environment.

  • Proven success in developing and managing regional sales organizations and business units.

  • Expertise in business development, strategic market expansion, and managing complex B2B customer relationships.

  • Deep understanding of the DACH market, combined with experience working in international and matrix organizations.

  • An entrepreneurial, analytical, and execution-oriented leader with a strong presence and credibility at management and C-level.

  • Fluent business-level German and English language skills.

If you feel that you do not meet every requirement: at Natuvion, there are no limits to your development. Grow your career with us - we will support you every step of the way. Simply show us who you are.

What you can expect:

Empowerment and Ownership: Take on a key leadership role in our largest and most established sales region and actively shape its future development and success.

International Environment: Work within a growing, internationally positioned group of companies with a global footprint.

Entrepreneurial Culture: We value short decision-making processes, personal accountability, and a strong commitment to turning ideas into action.

Collaboration at Eye Level: Partner closely with experienced leaders across Sales, Delivery, and global functions in a highly collaborative environment.

Future-Focused Business: Operate in a dynamic market at the forefront of digital transformation, data migration, and the modernization of complex IT landscapes.

Ready to Take Our DACH Region to the Next Level? Are you driven not only by achieving sales targets, but also by connecting markets, strengthening collaboration, and shaping sustainable growth?

If so, we look forward to getting to know you.

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a data moving company

Our team doesn't move desks, filing cabinets, or office furniture. Instead, Natuvion relocates business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. Typical Natuvion "moving services" include data migration, data transformation, data integration, data privacy, data security, and data quality.

With more than 500 consultants and developers across Germany, Austria, Slovakia, the USA, and Australia, we combine deep expertise in SAP® projects with extensive cross-industry process knowledge. Through experience, commitment, and proprietary software solutions, we support our customers with consulting services, project delivery, and innovative technology. This enables organizations to continuously leverage their data and processes on the most modern and advanced platforms available.

Interested? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

jobs.description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for aSenior IT Engineerto help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

What you'll do

Own and improve our IT operations

  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
  • Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
  • Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
  • Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
  • Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
  • Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.

Think like a product owner

  • Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
  • Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
  • Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
  • Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.

What you'll bring

  • Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
  • ITIL certification and practical experienceapplying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations.
  • Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian.
  • Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools.
  • Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity.
  • Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution.
  • A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems.
  • Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms.
  • Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance.
  • Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Staff Product Security Engineer

Who we are

We’re doxy.me (doc-see-me), the world's most loved telemedicine solution, and we're on a mission to connect the world to the future of healthcare.

We believe that cost and complexity should never be a barrier to telemedicine. That’s why we created a simple, free, and secure telemedicine platform. Since 2013, we’ve grown to more than 1 million healthcare providers from 180+ countries who have clocked over 8 billion minutes of telemedicine sessions to date.

Our goal is to deliver the future of healthcare to every patient and healthcare professional on earth. Help us get there by joining our team of innovators, dreamers, and doers.

We’re a remote-first company with regional hubs for in-person collaboration (Charleston, SC, Salt Lake City, UT,London, UK, & Kyiv, UA).

Who you are

We’re seeking a Staff Product Security Engineer who thrives on making an impact by being part of a team that ensures that Doxy.me is safe, secure, and compliant over time with industry standards for security, secure SDLC, and secure operating principles. As an early member of Doxy.me’s Application Security team you will build the technical foundation of the security and privacy of our products long into the future.

What you’ll do

  • Provide security leadership and guidance within our product engineering teams through developer-led threat modeling and education on security and privacy best practices that prevent the authoring of vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate security requirements and standards throughout the product life cycle by working closely with product engineering to manage the vulnerabilities, cryptography, security monitoring, and risk management controls within our application-based products.
  • Participate in the development of Doxy.me’s DevSecOps security strategy and posture by designing, advocating and helping build secure-by-default CI/CD pipelines and processes
  • Develop engineering reference implementations on topics of security patterns and security guardrails and how to implement these into software frameworks and the technology stack. Support and implement security technology and security control design proof of concepts and implementations
  • Be a pioneering member of the Doxy.me Information Security Team; liaise with Product and Engineering teams to ensure all product business cases include functional security specs to ensure compliance with information security standards
  • Track trends against various metrics that capture the risks, threats, and vulnerabilities within the product environment then prioritise and implement remediation activities for application flaws.

Your skills and experience

  • A Bachelor's degree in computer science, programming, or related field and or equivalent job experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience working with remote, globally distributed teams
  • Experience working in organisations that develop software and/or operate managed infrastructure and technology services for their own customers
  • AWS platforms or services (also consider equivalent experience in Azure or GCP)
  • Kubernetes and container infrastructure
  • Secure development and application of IAC solutions (Terraform, Helm)
  • Experience with DevOps tools and processes, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD)
  • Experience with security testing tools, such as static Code analysis and dynamic Application security testing (DAST)
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, application security vulnerabilities and web security testing methodologies
  • Understanding of secure coding practices for compliance requirements within SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, HITRUST, etc.
  • Able to effectively give, receive, and respond to feedback
  • Ability to educate company employees about security measures.
  • Strong communication skills in English & Ukrainian are highly desirable for this position.

Interview process

  • 1st stage - Chat with our internal recruiter
  • 2nd stage - Hiring Manager interview
  • 3rd stage - Team Based interview
  • 4th stage - Technical interview/test
  • 5th stage - Meet with our VP of Engineering

Additional information

  • Doxy.me tech stack
    • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Playwright, WebRTC, Next.js,
    • Backend: Nodejs, TypeScript, Jest, NestJS,
    • Cloud: AWS
    • 3rd party: Vonage, Segment, Twilio, Stripe
  • Our team: technologists, academics, researchers, and innovators from all over the world. English is the language used in all internal communication.
  • To ensure HIPAA compliance we perform background checks after extending a job offer
Salary: PLN 350,000–400,000

jobs.description:
Role Summary

As a Sr. Fleet Sales Specialist at Rivian, you will play a pivotal role in driving enterprise fleet sales by developing relationships, identifying opportunities, and managing key enterprise accounts. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Enterprise Sales, you will focus on managing day-to-day interactions with prospective and current enterprise customers, aligning their needs with Rivian’s fleet solutions. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution to generate revenue, build partnerships, and ensure successful fleet deployments. As the go-to person for enterprise customers, you will work closely with internal teams to provide a seamless sales experience while supporting Rivian’s mission of sustainable mobility.

Responsibilities

Management & Customer Relationships:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with enterprise customers to understand their fleet needs and align them with Rivian’s electric vehicle solutions.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key enterprise clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and addressing any issues or concerns in a timely manner.
  • Support senior leadership in managing high-value accounts and complex sales cycles from lead generation through to contract execution and fleet deployment.

Sales Growth & Pipeline Development:

  • Identify and develop new enterprise sales opportunities by researching market trends, building relationships, and leveraging existing networks.
  • Lead the sales process for medium to large enterprise accounts, working with customers to define fleet requirements, present tailored solutions, and close deals.
  • Maintain a healthy sales pipeline, track progress in CRM tools, and regularly report on sales activities, forecasts, and results to the Senior Manager.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Operations, and Customer Success to ensure customer needs are met and that fleet solutions are successfully implemented.
  • Work closely with the Technical Sales Manager and Customer Success teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to deployment, ensuring Rivian’s vehicles are integrated effectively into customers’ operations.
  • Provide feedback to internal teams regarding customer preferences, product performance, and market trends to help shape future fleet offerings.

Market & Competitive Analysis:

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to position Rivian’s enterprise fleet solutions effectively within the market.
  • Share insights with senior leadership and contribute to the development of sales strategies and product roadmaps based on market intelligence.

Contract Negotiation & Closing Deals:

  • Assist the Senior Manager in negotiating contracts, pricing structures, and terms of service with enterprise clients, ensuring Rivian’s solutions meet customer expectations and are commercially viable.
  • Work with legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure all contracts comply with Rivian’s policies and processes.

Sales Strategy Execution:

  • Contribute to the execution of the enterprise sales strategy, supporting overall team objectives for revenue generation, market share growth, and customer satisfaction.
  • Monitor customer KPIs, report on key account performance, and contribute to strategies that drive account growth and retention.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in B2B sales or account management, ideally within the automotive, fleet, or electric vehicle (EV) sectors
  • Proven track record of managing large, complex sales cycles with enterprise clients, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals.
  • Experience in fleet management, transportation, or sustainability-driven industries is preferred.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with the ability to work closely with senior leadership and enterprise-level clients.
  • A consultative approach to sales, with the ability to identify customer pain points and present tailored solutions that align with Rivian’s offerings.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Familiarity with electric vehicle technology, fleet management solutions, or transportation software is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and sales pipeline management software.
  • Background in EV fleet sales or a related sustainability field.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a focus on enterprise sales and long-term account growth.
  • Knowledge of enterprise fleet management systems, telematics, and vehicle lifecycle management.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $94,000 to $134,000 [$116,000 to $134,000 for New York based applicants, $107,000 to $123,000 for Irvine, California based applicants, $102,000 to $118,000 for Colorado based applicants, $98,000 to $113,000 for Georgia based applicants, and $94,000 to $108,000 for Tennessee based applicants]. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com. You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 11/15/26.

Performance will be assessed through outcomes such as quality, reliability, cycle time, risk control and knowledge transfer - not simply the volume of AI-generated output or frequency of tool use.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Implement and maintain security controls across Azure subscriptions, identities, networks, Kubernetes, containers, servers, data services, endpoints and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Review cloud and platform designs, configuration and change proposals, identifying practical improvements before risk reaches production.
    • Automate secure configuration, vulnerability detection, policy checks, evidence collection and repeatable remediation where appropriate.
    • Support secrets, key, certificate, privileged-access and service-account lifecycle management.
    Detection, Response and Vulnerability Management
    • Monitor security signals and investigate suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, misconfiguration and control failures.
    • Prioritise remediation using exploitability, exposure, business impact and compensating controls rather than severity labels alone.
    • Support security incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis and completion of corrective actions.
    • Maintain clear security findings, owners, due dates, exceptions and risk acceptance records.
    AI and Application Security
    • Threat model AI-enabled services and operational agents, including data leakage, prompt injection, over-permission, unsafe actions, supplier risk and inadequate human oversight.
    • Use approved AI tools to support security analysis, query development, evidence review and incident investigation while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.
    • Work with R&D and Data teams to embed secure-by-design controls into the AI-DLC, data flows, APIs and deployment patterns.
    • Define and test guardrails for AI access to production systems, credentials, logs and customer information.
    Compliance and Security Culture
    • Provide technical evidence and remediation support for ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR and customer assurance activity.
    • Create practical standards, runbooks and guidance and coach engineers on secure cloud and AI-enabled working.
    • Report material risks and trends clearly to the Cloud Operations Manager, Compliance Manager and relevant owners.

EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Essential

  • Hands-on experience securing Azure or another major cloud platform in a production environment.
    • Practical knowledge of identity and access management, networking, Kubernetes or containers, operating systems, vulnerability management, logging and incident response.
    • Ability to investigate and prioritise technical security findings and implement or coordinate effective remediation.
    • Experience with scripting, policy-as-code, infrastructure automation or security automation.
    • Understanding of secure development and deployment practices, including secrets and pipeline security.
    • Clear documentation and communication of technical risk to different audiences.
    Desirable
    • Azure security, Kubernetes security or recognised cyber-security certification.
    • Experience of ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus or regulated SaaS environments.
    • Experience threat modelling AI-enabled systems, APIs or agentic automation.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

• Curious and adaptable, with a practical commitment to continuous learning and responsible AI adoption.
• Systematic, evidence-led problem solving and attention to detail.

Senior UX Designer

Location: Remote

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wiki projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. Technology and innovation are critical in our quest to support every human in freely sharing knowledge.

The Product Design team is looking for a Senior UX Designer with a solid understanding of user experience and product development processes to work within a new multi-disciplinary product team that will be focused on improving trust and safety. You will be influential in creating and developing the user experience, feeding directly into the product strategy for your product team.

For this role, you will primarily be working with the Reader Growth team, software focused on ways of learning and engagement for new and casual readers of Wikipedia.

Must be available for design, product and engineering team meetings and synchronous collaboration from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

You will be responsible for…

  • Reducing complexity to create simple, delightful experiences for our users.
  • Creating prototypes and running experiments to iteratively test your hypotheses.
  • Using and evolving our design system and guidelines, to create new features from ideas on paper to implementation.
  • Applying accessibility standards and guidelines to your designs.
  • Collaborating with product managers and engineers to create product plans and maintain product design processes.
  • Distilling complex concepts into easy to understand talking points to engage with our readers and communities throughout the design process.

Skills and experience….

The right person is better than the right set of experiences. These are the traits we’ve identified that make great additions to our team so far.

  • Can communicate their design goals and processes clearly and concisely to other team members and stakeholders.
  • Provides constructive feedback to other designers and welcomes feedback from others.
  • Experienced in conducting research, as well as collaborating with UX researchers, to build a deeper understanding of audience behaviours.
  • Is able to generate ideas for the future as well as think tactically about how to deliver work in the present.
  • Is self-motivated and seeks to evolve their skills and share what they’ve learnt with others.
  • 5+ years of experience contributing on design teams.
  • Bachelor's degree and/or Masters degree, or equivalent in related work experience

Additionally, we’d love it if you have...

  • Background in content consumption, publishing, education, or news
  • Experience acting as a researcher, both in-person and with remote participants

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This SME-level position will maintain and optimize SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), implement approved API integrations and incremental loading approaches, and build raw, standardized, and curated data layers. The engineer will establish reliable processes for reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, lineage, and failed-record handling.

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will collaborate with database administrators, architects, governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to deliver accurate, traceable, and maintainable data pipelines supporting mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise data integration and ETL pipelines.
  • Maintain and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, dependencies, and execution processes.
  • Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.
  • Use Python or another approved automation language to support ingestion, orchestration, validation, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Implement approved API integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate-limit handling, retries, and error processing.
  • Design incremental loading strategies and implement change-data capture where appropriate and approved.
  • Build and maintain raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.
  • Establish source-to-target mappings, common identifier mappings, and consistent handling of reference data.
  • Implement reconciliation checks to verify record counts, totals, completeness, and transformation accuracy.
  • Develop restartable processing, controlled retries, checkpoints, and recovery procedures.
  • Implement failed-record handling, quarantine processes, error logging, and controlled reprocessing.
  • Assess and manage schema changes and their effects on pipelines, datasets, analytical models, and reports.
  • Maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, interface specifications, and pipeline dependencies.
  • Monitor pipeline execution, throughput, freshness, resource utilization, and operational failures.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving source systems, APIs, SSIS packages, SQL logic, data quality, and downstream integrations.
  • Optimize pipeline performance while maintaining data integrity, traceability, and approved security controls.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on definitions, ownership, authoritative sources, metadata, and approved data uses.
  • Work with independent testing personnel to support reconciliation, regression testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
  • Coordinate pipeline changes with database, application, AI/ML, warehouse, and BI teams.
  • Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Review technical designs and code, guide engineering practices, and provide knowledge transfer to other engineers.
  • Communicate pipeline health, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations to technical leads and Government stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience maintaining and optimizing SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Experience with Python and data engineering automation.
  • Experience implementing and supporting API integrations.
  • Experience developing incremental data loads.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.
  • Ability to build raw, standardized, and curated data layers.
  • Ability to manage reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, and failed-record handling.
  • Ability to implement change-data capture where appropriate.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Relevant data engineering or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense data environments.
  • Experience modernizing legacy SSIS integrations or transitioning pipelines to approved cloud platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses, analytical datasets, BI platforms, or AI-ready data.
  • Familiarity with data catalogs, metadata management, data governance, and automated lineage tools.
  • Experience developing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation frameworks, and pipeline regression tests.
  • Experience integrating data engineering workflows with CI/CD, version control, and automated deployment.
  • Experience implementing secure service accounts, secrets management, encryption, and pipeline audit logging.
  • Strong technical mentoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer to build, deploy, monitor, maintain, and govern production machine learning capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This position will maintain training, validation, and testing datasets; develop automated model deployment pipelines; monitor deployed models; detect data and model drift; and control updates to production models, datasets, configurations, and supporting services. The engineer will implement repeatable, traceable, and secure processes for promoting machine learning capabilities from development through testing and into production.

The Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will work with data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, testers, operations teams, and Government mission owners. The successful candidate must be able to combine machine learning engineering with deployment automation, monitoring, version control, rollback planning, and model and data governance.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will:

  • Maintain training, validation, and testing datasets used for machine learning development and evaluation.
  • Develop repeatable processes for dataset ingestion, preparation, transformation, validation, versioning, and controlled promotion.
  • Ensure datasets are maintained in or can be transformed into analysis-ready and model-ready formats.
  • Evaluate datasets for quality, completeness, consistency, integrity, provenance, and fitness for their intended purpose.
  • Maintain traceability among source data, transformed datasets, features, model versions, evaluation results, and production deployments.
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines for data preparation, model training, model evaluation, packaging, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.
  • Deploy machine learning models into approved cloud, application, analytical, and operational environments.
  • Automate model build, test, validation, promotion, deployment, and recovery processes.
  • Configure and maintain model registries and controlled repositories for models, datasets, code, configurations, dependencies, and evaluation results.
  • Implement automated unit, integration, regression, data-quality, pipeline, and deployment testing.
  • Establish model-evaluation procedures, performance measures, validation thresholds, and release-readiness criteria.
  • Monitor production models for accuracy, performance, availability, latency, errors, data drift, concept drift, and unexpected behavior.
  • Configure alerts, dashboards, thresholds, and escalation procedures for model degradation, drift, data-quality issues, and pipeline failures.
  • Investigate production model, dataset, pipeline, and deployment anomalies.
  • Coordinate corrective actions with data, application, infrastructure, security, testing, and mission teams.
  • Control updates to production models, datasets, pipelines, features, dependencies, and configurations through documented change and approval procedures.
  • Maintain version control for model code, training logic, deployment scripts, datasets, features, configurations, and infrastructure definitions.
  • Develop and test rollback procedures for model, dataset, pipeline, and configuration updates.
  • Support secure data pipelines used for model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational analysis.
  • Maintain documentation covering model purpose, datasets, evaluation methods, performance, limitations, dependencies, deployments, changes, incidents, and known risks.
  • Support the auditing and validation of model outputs to identify inaccurate, unsupported, or unexpected results.
  • Help implement human-review and escalation checkpoints for model outputs that may affect mission or operational decisions.
  • Integrate MLOps workflows with continuous integration, continuous delivery, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, and incident-management capabilities.
  • Support data and model governance requirements, including access controls, versioning, approval gates, traceability, change control, and audit logging.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to address vulnerabilities, identity and access controls, secrets management, software dependencies, encryption, logging, and authorization requirements.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams on data ingestion, transformation, metadata, warehouse integration, data quality, and governed access.
  • Assist with architecture reviews, code reviews, release-readiness reviews, troubleshooting, operational handoff, and knowledge transfer.
  • Prepare model lifecycle documentation, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, monitoring plans, test results, technical diagrams, and operating guides.
  • Communicate model status, performance, drift, risks, incidents, and corrective actions to technical teams, Government stakeholders, and program leadership.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience maintaining machine learning training, validation, and testing datasets.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated machine learning deployment pipelines.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models into production environments.
  • Experience monitoring production models and supporting services.
  • Experience detecting and responding to model or data drift.
  • Experience using version control for model code, datasets, configurations, pipelines, or deployment artifacts.
  • Experience developing and executing rollback procedures for models, datasets, pipelines, or production configurations.
  • Experience controlling model and dataset updates through documented change, testing, and approval procedures.
  • Experience implementing automated testing for machine learning models, data pipelines, APIs, or deployment workflows.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning services or production cloud environments.
  • Understanding of model evaluation, validation metrics, production monitoring, model governance, and data governance.
  • Ability to maintain traceability across datasets, transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployments, and production outcomes.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve model, dataset, pipeline, and deployment issues.
  • Understanding of secure data pipelines, access controls, audit logging, encryption, secrets management, and dependency security.
  • Ability to document and communicate model performance, drift, limitations, risks, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate or a comparable machine learning platform certification.
  • Additional AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, data engineering, or cloud architecture certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience operating machine learning capabilities in secure, regulated, or mission-critical environments.
  • Experience with MLflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Kubeflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with model registries, feature stores, metadata repositories, experiment tracking, or data-lineage tools.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing observability, automated alerting, incident response, and production reliability controls.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, model explainability, output validation, bias evaluation, and human oversight.
  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Level 4 or comparable Government cloud and data-protection requirements.
  • Experience supporting analytical models, generative AI, retrieval workflows, or agentic AI capabilities.
