jobs.description:
About The Role

EverPro is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the next chapter of ZyraTalk, our AI-powered voice and receptionist product line. ZyraTalk was recently acquired by EverCommerce and is now becoming a core part of EverPro’s AI and customer engagement strategy across our portfolio of home services software products.

This role will own the product direction for ZyraTalk while also driving the broader EverPro Voice product line: deepening integrations into EverPro Product Suite; expanding the value of AI voice across customer communication workflows; and helping shape how voice agents become an embedded, revenue-driving capability across the EverPro suite.

The ideal candidate is a senior product leader who is comfortable operating at the intersection of AI, voice, SaaS workflow automation, customer experience, and platform integration. They should be able to translate market opportunity and customer pain into clear product strategy, partner closely with engineering and go-to-market teams, and bring structure to a product area entering its next phase of scale.

What You’ll Own

  • Lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ZyraTalk as part of the EverPro product portfolio.
  • Define and drive the EverPro Voice product line, including how AI voice capabilities integrate into and enhance EverPro’s vertical SaaS products.
  • Identify and prioritize integration opportunities across EverPro products, with a focus on customer communication, scheduling, lead capture, missed-call handling, support workflows, and revenue conversion.
  • Partner with engineering, design, AI/platform teams, customer success, sales, and business unit leaders to deliver high-impact voice and AI-powered workflows.
  • Build a deep understanding of home services SMB customers and how voice automation can reduce administrative burden, improve responsiveness, and drive business outcomes.
  • Translate customer needs, product usage, and business priorities into clear requirements, product briefs, launch plans, and success metrics.
  • Own product discovery, customer feedback loops, competitive analysis, and market insights for AI voice and receptionist capabilities.
  • Drive adoption and commercialization of voice offerings across EverPro, including packaging, positioning, enablement, and expansion opportunities.
  • Establish product KPIs and operating rhythms to measure usage, quality, retention, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.
  • Help lead the transition from founder-led product intuition to a scalable product management discipline for the ZyraTalk product area.

What You’ll Do

  • Create a compelling product vision for AI voice within EverPro and turn that vision into an actionable roadmap.
  • Work closely with engineering to continue developing ZyraTalk’s core capabilities, including call handling, conversational flows, integrations, routing, summaries, handoffs, analytics, and customer-specific configuration.
  • Partner with EverPro product teams to determine where voice should be embedded directly into existing workflows and where it should operate as a standalone or cross-product offering.
  • Prioritize product investments across core ZyraTalk enhancements, platform integrations, customer-specific needs, and scalable shared capabilities.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams to define target customers, packaging, pricing inputs, sales enablement, launch sequencing, and expansion motions.
  • Partner with AI and platform leaders to ensure voice capabilities align with EverPro’s broader agentic platform strategy, including shared tooling, data access, observability, security, and reusable agent patterns.
  • Develop a strong point of view on the AI voice market, including competitive offerings, customer expectations, technical constraints, and emerging opportunities.
  • Bring clarity and momentum to a product area with high strategic importance and significant cross-portfolio potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience owning complex SaaS products or platform capabilities.
  • Experience with AI, voice, conversational products, communications platforms, workflow automation, or customer engagement tools strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead product strategy and execution in a cross-functional environment.
  • Strong customer discovery skills and ability to translate qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.
  • Experience working with engineering teams on technically complex products, integrations, APIs, data workflows, or platform capabilities.
  • Ability to balance near-term customer and business needs with longer-term platform and product strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort defining success metrics, evaluating adoption, and making prioritization decisions based on data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align executives, product teams, engineering, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, especially in a newly acquired or rapidly evolving product area.
  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how product decisions influence packaging, adoption, retention, and revenue growth.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with voice AI, contact center technology, virtual receptionist products, call tracking, telephony, or conversational AI.
  • Experience integrating acquired products into a broader product portfolio.
  • Experience serving SMB customers, especially in home services, field services, construction, pest control, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, or similar verticals.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, speech-to-text / text-to-speech systems, call analytics, or automation platforms.
  • Experience building products across multiple brands, business units, or vertical SaaS products.

Success In This Role Looks Like

  • ZyraTalk has a clear product strategy, roadmap, and operating rhythm.
  • EverPro has a defined Voice product line with clear integration paths across priority products.
  • Voice capabilities are embedded into meaningful customer workflows, not treated as a standalone add-on alone.
  • Product teams across EverPro understand how and where to leverage ZyraTalk capabilities.
  • Customers see measurable value through improved responsiveness, reduced missed opportunities, saved administrative time, and stronger customer communication.
  • The business has a clear view of adoption, quality, revenue impact, and expansion potential.
  • ZyraTalk successfully transitions from founder-led momentum into a scalable, integrated EverPro product capability.

Why This Role Matters

AI voice is becoming one of the most important front doors for small businesses. For EverPro customers, every missed call can mean missed revenue, slower service, or a weaker customer experience. ZyraTalk gives EverPro the opportunity to bring intelligent voice automation directly into the workflows our customers already use every day.

This role will help turn that opportunity into a scaled product line: continuing to advance ZyraTalk while building the voice layer of the EverPro suite.

Become a part of our caring community

Become a Part of Our Caring Community

Humana is seeking a Lead Applied Scientist to design, develop, and scale intelligent decision systems powering our Next Best Action (NBA) platform.

Our platform combines machine learning, reinforcement learning, and decision intelligence to deliver personalized recommendations that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for millions of members.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can translate complex business problems into scalable, production-ready decision systems. The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with an understanding of decision science and software engineering.

This role goes beyond building predictive models. You will have end-to-end ownership of models and decision policies, from initial prototyping and experimentation through offline evaluation, simulation, testing, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. You will help define how intelligent systems make decisions, evaluate their behavior under real-world constraints and uncertainty, and continuously improve their performance based on production outcomes.

Key Responsibilities


Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning


Design, develop, and improve machine learning and reinforcement learning models for personalized recommendations, sequential decision making, and policy learning.


Decision Intelligence and Simulation


Apply decision science, operations research, and simulation techniques to formulate complex decision problems, evaluate alternatives, and improve outcomes under business and operational constraints.


Scalable ML Engineering


Develop and improve production ML pipelines using Python, PyTorch, Databricks, PySpark, Ray RLlib, and MLflow, supporting large-scale data processing, model training, and inference.


Model Evaluation and Experimentation


Design experiments, simulations, offline evaluations, and performance metrics to assess model effectiveness, policy behavior, decision quality, and business impact before and after deployment.


Production Deployment and Monitoring


Own models and decision policies throughout their lifecycle, from prototyping and testing through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner with software engineering and platform teams to ensure production systems are scalable, reliable, and observable.


Constraint-Aware Decision Making


Incorporate clinical eligibility, member preferences, business rules, operational capacity, and other constraints into intelligent decision systems.


Technical Leadership


Provide technical direction on model architecture, algorithm selection, evaluation methods, engineering best practices, and system design while collaborating with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

The Senior Manufacturing Engineer role is a senior-level, hands-on manufacturing engineering position responsible for defining how custom parts are built and priced—reviewing manufacturability, generating competitive quotes, and providing design feedback that brings products to market faster. The role serves as a technical authority who helps raise the bar for costing and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) quality across regions.
MISUMI Americas serves three sets of customers—builders who order parts through us, manufacturing partners who make and assemble those parts, and our world-class sales professionals who rely on fast, accurate quoting and DFM support to win and serve accounts. This role sits at the interface of all three. As a senior member of the team, this person also coaches and mentors other engineers and partners closely with the Global Capability Center (GCC) Costing and DFM team, with room to grow their scope and influence over time.

Manufacturing Engineering & Quoting
● Release package review — Analyze models, drawings, parts lists, and other data to determine scope of work, manufacturing feasibility, requirements, and minimum lead time.
● Quoting — Combine engineering analysis with platform recommendations to generate quotes for builders or collaborate with external suppliers to determine the parameters needed to quote.
● Cost calculator generation — Use fabrication expertise and an understanding of process cost drivers to build cost calculators that bring quoting in-house for new service offerings.
● DFx feedback — Provide design-for-manufacturability and design-for-assembly feedback to builders, recommending changes that improve manufacturability, reduce part cost, or ease assembly.
● Automation feedback — Feed insights back to the quoting software team to improve the accuracy of automated quoting across manufacturing services.
● Drawing generation — Produce high-quality 2D drawings per ANSI/ASME Y14.5 standards.
Mentorship & Cross-Functional Collaboration
● Coaching & mentorship — Coach and mentor engineers on the US and GCC Costing and DFM teams, sharing fabrication and costing expertise to help them grow.
● Best practices & peer review — Help establish and document costing and DFM best practices, review work, and provide feedback that improves technical accuracy and consistency across regions.
● Cross-functional leadership — Lead through influence across engineering, sourcing, sales, quality, and software, aligning stakeholders on costing and DFM decisions without relying on direct authority.
● Dotted-line coordination — Guide and coordinate the technical work of engineers who do not report to this role (including GCC and cross-regional partners) and keep shared initiatives on track.
All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

● 4-year Mechanical Engineering degree or equivalent technical training.
● 5–10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, costing/DFM, or related custom mechanical hardware work.
● Hands-on experience across multiple custom mechanical manufacturing processes (sheet metal, urethane casting, injection molding, etc.); CNC machining and 3D printing experience is a must.
● Strong understanding of GD&T and conventional (coordinate) tolerancing, and deep knowledge of the manufacturability and limitations of common metals and plastics.
● Experience mentoring or coaching other engineers and acting as a technical resource; collaborating with offshore/GCC teams is a plus.
● Proven ability to lead through influence and coordinate cross-functional or dotted-line teams without direct reporting authority.
● Thrives with a high degree of autonomy—owns their workload end to end, exercises sound technical judgment independently, and drives decisions to closure in a remote environment with minimal oversight.

● Experience in AS9100, ISO 13485, or other highly regulated industries is highly recommended.

This position will work primarily remotely, computer-based work involving prolonged periods at a workstation reviewing CAD models and 2D drawings. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

As onX continues to grow, we're evolving how we plan, make decisions, allocate resources, and work together across the business. Making these changes successful requires more than designing better processes and operating models. It requires turning those ideas into practical, sustainable ways of working that teams can adopt.

onX is seeking a Transformation Manager to support the delivery and adoption of operating model initiatives across the organization. This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on translating transformation priorities into actionable plans, coordinating implementation, and helping teams successfully adopt new ways of working.

You'll own multiple cross-functional initiatives and workstreams from planning through implementation and transition to ongoing business ownership. You'll manage timelines and dependencies, coordinate cross-functional partners, identify and address delivery challenges, and execute organizational change management activities that help improvements take hold.

This role reports to the Director of Enterprise Digital Transformation.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Transformation is a growing function within onX's People & Culture organization, focused on making it easier for teams to work effectively as onX grows. We work across the company to improve how teams operate, make decisions, and get work done—so onX can move faster, focus on what matters most, and make better use of its people, resources, and technology.

Our work sits at the intersection of business operations, technology, and organizational change. We partner with leaders across onX to rethink how work gets done, remove barriers that slow teams down, and introduce better ways of working that can grow with the business. That includes helping onX rethink how work gets done with AI, partnering with our AI and engineering teams so new tools change how teams actually work, not just what they use.

As an early member of this function, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact across onX while helping establish how we deliver change. You'll turn ambitious ideas into improvements that people experience in their everyday work—and help build the practices that make those improvements last.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

1. Deliver Operating Model Initiatives and Workstreams

  • Own the planning and hands-on execution of assigned transformation initiatives and workstreams, from scoping and implementation through transition to ongoing business ownership.
  • Translate operating model priorities into actionable plans, managing workstreams, milestones, resources, risks, and dependencies to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Coordinate critical planning and decisioning milestones across teams, proactively resolving obstacles and surfacing decisions that could impact progress.
  • Track progress and outcomes, adjusting execution plans as needed and ensuring stakeholders have the information they need to support timely decisions.

2. Drive Organizational Change & Operational Readiness

  • Develop and execute change management plans that prepare teams to adopt new processes, technologies, and ways of working, including AI-enabled workflows.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to understand how changes will affect their teams and identify the communication, training, and support needed for successful adoption.
  • Assess operational readiness, identify adoption barriers, and work with business owners and project partners to develop and implement practical solutions.
  • Define and track relevant adoption measures, using feedback and results to recommend adjustments and support the successful transition of changes into ongoing operations.

3. Coordinate Stakeholders & Support Effective Decisions

  • Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners, coordinating activities, clarifying responsibilities, and keeping stakeholders informed and engaged throughout implementation.
  • Make sound decisions within assigned workstreams, balancing timelines, quality, stakeholder needs, and business impact while recognizing when broader direction or escalation is needed.
  • Make informed decisions on delivery approaches, sequencing, and risk mitigation within agreed priorities. Evaluate trade-offs using business impact, available data, and downstream implications, escalating decisions that require changes to strategic direction or executive alignment.
  • Communicate progress, decisions, and outcomes clearly, adapting your approach to different audiences and helping teams stay aligned on next steps.

4. Improve and Apply AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools to improve day-to-day analysis, planning, problem-solving, and communication, applying sound judgment and validating outputs.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, or improve workflows, working with business and technical partners to evaluate and implement practical solutions.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of tools, templates, and change management practices that improve delivery efficiency and stakeholder experience.
  • Capture lessons learned and share practical improvements that help the Transformation team work more effectively over time.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 5+ years of experience in organizational change management, business transformation, or operating model delivery, including enterprise-wide or functional transformations.
  • Proven ability to independently manage initiatives or workstreams from planning through implementation, including coordinating stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Strong organizational change management skills, with experience developing and executing change plans, preparing teams for new ways of working, and supporting successful adoption.
  • Experience defining and tracking project outcomes or adoption measures, using data and stakeholder feedback to evaluate progress and recommend improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with the ability to navigate changing requirements, identify practical solutions, and make sound decisions within established priorities.
  • Effective stakeholder communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work across functions, navigate differing perspectives, and present clear recommendations that support decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve day-to-day work, analysis, or problem-solving, with sound judgment about their application.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX's Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel up to quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide or cross-functional transformation initiatives involving multiple business teams.
  • Experience implementing changes to business planning, resource allocation, or decision-making processes.
  • Experience developing or improving change management tools, templates, or practices that support consistent delivery.
  • Experience supporting organizational adoption of AI or automation, including tracking usage, adoption, or business impact.
  • Experience delivering change initiatives in SaaS, high-growth technology, or similarly complex business environments.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $110,000 and $130,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help shape the architecture behind Keeper’s next generation of security products and platforms

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

As a Senior Software Architect, Security Platforms, you will provide architectural leadership across multiple Keeper engineering teams and product areas. You will work across frontend, backend, client, browser and security platforms to establish scalable technical patterns, resolve complex cross-product architectural challenges and guide teams through major design decisions.

This is not a purely advisory role. You will remain hands-on with architecture, prototyping, code reviews and technical problem solving while partnering with Engineering, Product and Security leadership to ensure Keeper’s systems remain secure, performant and maintainable as the platform grows. The ideal candidate has broad full-stack architecture experience, deep software engineering fundamentals and the ability to move comfortably across product domains, technologies and operating environments.

  • Define and drive architecture across multiple Keeper product areas, including PAM, Browser Extension and other core security platforms

Requirements

  • Experience designing highly available, scalable and secure SaaS architectures

  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native application design

  • Experience designing and integrating APIs, shared services and cross-product platform capabilities
  • Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational database architecture, data modeling and performance considerations
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern deployment environments such as AWS, containers and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of application performance, profiling, debugging and reliability engineering

jobs.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Chez Workleap, nos équipes d'ingénierie livrent déjà plus de deux fois plus vite grâce à l'IA. Maintenant, on étend ça à tout ce qui entoure le code : briefs, specs, design, lancement et mesure. L'idée est simple : les agents font le travail, et les humains prennent les décisions. On repense la façon dont on construit les produits et on explore les possibilités techniques : ce n'est que le début. Comme Développeur.euse IA senior.e, tu te joins à nous pour façonner et bâtir cette solution, et t'assurer qu'elle repose sur des fondations techniques solides.

Ton impact :

  • Livrer les premiers agents en production avec nos Gestionnaire produit, en commençant par la création de briefs et la transition du Gestionnaire produit vers le design, puis en les étendant au reste du cycle de vie du produit.
  • Façonner l'architecture et les standards communs (orchestration, skills, mémoire, evals, garde-fous) pour que nos deux lignes de produits reposent sur la même fondation.
  • Prendre en charge la qualité en production de ces agents : observabilité, tests, sécurité et coûts intégrés dès le départ, avec une approbation humaine à chaque étape clé.
  • Co-concevoir avec les Gestionnaires produits : comprendre comment ils travaillent, réutiliser ce qu'ils ont déjà automatisé et livrer de petites itérations qu'ils testent et adoptent.
  • Mesurer ce qui fonctionne : temps sauvé, délai entre le signal client et la décision livrée, coût par agent et par fonctionnalité, puis couper ce qui n'ajoute pas de valeur.
  • Faire grandir les autres : partager tes pratiques de développement d'agents pour que l'équipe puisse bâtir, opérer et améliorer des agents en toute autonomie.

Ton équipe

Au cours des 6 à 12 prochains mois, tu vas plancher sur des questions comme : comment un agent transforme-t-il une idée en un brief qu'un.e Product Manager approuve sans le réécrire ? Comment des agents spécialisés se transmettent-ils le contexte sans le perdre ni faire exploser les coûts ? Comment décide-t-on qu'un agent est assez fiable pour alléger une étape de validation ? La vision est claire et une preuve de concept dans Slack est en cours : tu arrives assez tôt pour façonner l'architecture et transformer ce début en standard de production.

Tu te joins à l'équipe Operations Produit, une petite équipe qui sert les Gestionnaires produit des deux lignes de produits et qui s'occupe déjà du tracking, de la qualité des données produit et de l'analytique. Tu vas travailler au quotidien avec cette équipe, avec notre équipe AI-Software Development Life Cycle, qui automatise déjà la livraison logicielle, et avec nos Product Managers des deux lignes de produits. Tu vas aussi collaborer avec le.la Développeur.euse IA senior.e de notre équipe Data pour partager patterns et outillage. On utilise l'IA tous les jours, on décide vite et on livre par itérations.

Notre écosystème technologique comprend Claude (Claude Code, skills, Managed Agents, Design), MCP, Slack, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Mixpanel, Snowflake, Azure, etc.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français;
  • Solide expérience en ingénierie de production sur l'ensemble du cycle de développement d'agents ;
  • Expérience concrète de conception et de mise en production de systèmes multi-agents (orchestration, outils, contexte et mémoire), intégrés à des outils comme Slack, Atlassian et MCP ;
  • Expérience en instrumentation et en évaluation de systèmes : evaluation, observabilité, tests de régression et suivi des coûts ;
  • Bon jugement architectural en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de coûts, y compris pour choisir le bon modèle pour la bonne tâche, et la confiance pour forger et défendre une opinion technique ;
  • Expérience de création de composants ou d'outils que d'autres personnes adoptent ;
  • Vrai sens du produit : tu comprends comment travaille un.e Gestionnaire produit et tu construis avec les utilisateur.rice.s, pas dans ton coin ;
  • Le goût de bâtir en équipe et d'aider les gens à changer leur façon de travailler en partageant tes pratiques ;
  • Un mindset de bâtisseur.euse : tu assumes ce que tu livres, l'ambiguïté d'un projet à ses débuts ne te dérange pas, et tu utilises des outils de développement assistés par l'IA au quotidien, avec un esprit critique ;
  • Atout : expérience en gestion de produit, ou sur un produit B2B SaaS, RH ou TI.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 140 000$ - 170 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

Working largely independently, the engineer translates business questions into clear analyses defines and builds maintainable workflows for client stakeholders. Company Overview:

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency specializing in mission-driven organizations across higher education and nonprofit sectors. Since launching in 2020, the agency has built a strong reputation for combining strategic thinking, creative execution, and data-driven marketing to help universities and organizations achieve measurable growth.

Your Role:

The Senior Data Engineer sits at the center of the agency's Data and Analytics function, connecting every paid media platform and CRM the agency touches into a single, reliable source of truth. You'll own the full path data takes: from a client's ad accounts and CRM, through Adverity, into a BigQuery warehouse, through modular dbt/Dataform transformations, and out to the Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports the team and its partners rely on daily. Reporting to the Data and Analytics Manager, you're joining at a pivotal moment — the agency is scaling its roster of education and nonprofit partners, and this role is instrumental in evolving the automated reporting suite that makes that growth possible without sacrificing data quality or client trust.

You'll:

  • Own data ingestion & pipeline architecture — connect and maintain API pipelines from paid media platforms (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic) into Adverity, build custom Python connectors for anything not natively supported, and architect scalable pipelines from source system through to dashboard

  • Own CRM integration — build and maintain reliable CRM data connections (Slate, Salesforce, HubSpot) so lead and enrollment data flows cleanly into the warehouse

  • Own the data warehouse — route, optimize, and store raw and processed data in Google BigQuery; design efficient schemas for complex, multi-source marketing data (granularity, normalization, slowly changing dimensions); manage partitioning, clustering, and storage strategy to control query cost and performance

  • Own transformation & mapping — build SQL schemas that map, blend, and organize multi-channel data accurately for each client, in modular, version-controlled, documented dbt or Dataform pipelines, with standardized naming conventions and metric definitions across platforms and clients

  • Own CI/CD & data segregation — maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, automated testing) for robust, version-controlled releases, and enforce strict data segregation across multi-client environments

  • Enable the reporting layer — create clean, performant data views built specifically for fast Looker Studio dashboards and automated Google Sheets reports, and partner with the Data and Analytics Manager and client teams to translate reporting requirements into warehouse models

  • Drive data quality — monitor pipeline health, resolve API breaks, minimize latency, implement validation frameworks and automated testing, troubleshoot discrepancies to root cause across source/warehouse/BI layers, and proactively flag data quality risks to leadership

You Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, ideally in a marketing or agency environment

  • Strong experience configuring datastreams, transformations, and destinations in Adverity or a comparable ETL platform (Fivetran, Supermetrics, Funnel)

  • Intermediate to advanced SQL, with proven BigQuery experience in transformation, partitioning, and modeling

  • Expertise in dbt or Dataform, managing modular, version-controlled, documented SQL transformation pipelines

  • Python proficiency for custom API connections and pipeline automation

  • Experience with CRM data flows and integrations (Slate, Salesforce, and/or HubSpot)

  • A deep understanding of marketing metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC) and paid platform schemas, with a proven track record of structuring data to optimize Looker Studio performance

  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows, and proven ability to manage multi-client data environments with strict data segregation

  • An analytical, solution-driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn complex data workflows into clear narratives for non-technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued

Bonus Points:

  • Experience integrating AI-driven insights or machine learning models into marketing data pipelines to sharpen predictive analytics and data utility

  • Familiarity using AI or LLM tools to optimize performance forecasting, automated audience segmentation, or marketing workflows

  • Experience connecting, managing, and maintaining APIs for generative AI platforms within a marketing data architecture

  • Experience using AI/ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor pipelines and proactively flag data quality issues

What’s Offered:

  • Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async-friendly team

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and location

  • A pivotal, high-visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the agency's reporting infrastructure

  • The chance to build the data backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world

  • A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A-players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal

  • Direct impact: the pipelines and models you build directly shape how partners see (and trust) their own performance data

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Application Review (resume + a few questions)

  • 2️⃣ Screening Call with Atomic HR

  • 3️⃣ Hiring Team Interview (walkthrough of a pipeline or data model you've built)

  • 4️⃣ Technical Assessment (a real-world data engineering case study)

  • 5️⃣ Final Interview with company leadership

Executive Assistant & Operations Partner

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $7/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.

You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.

We are looking for someone who does not simply identify problems. You should be able to determine why they are happening, create a practical solution, implement it, and measure whether the solution worked.

What You Will Do

1. Executive Support & Project Management

  • Work closely with leadership to organize priorities, coordinate projects, manage follow-ups, and ensure important tasks and deadlines are completed.

  • Turn leadership discussions, ideas, and decisions into clear action plans, while coordinating with stakeholders and tracking progress.

  • Prepare meeting summaries, presentations, reports, and other business materials to support leadership and decision-making.

2. Business Operations & Process Improvement

  • Coordinate daily operational activities involving physician practices, patients, healthcare providers, and internal teams, ensuring smooth communication and timely resolution of concerns.

  • Support practice onboarding, patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, and other healthcare administrative workflows.

  • Identify operational inefficiencies, resolve recurring issues, and create or improve SOPs, checklists, templates, and standardized processes.

3. Reporting, Technology & AI Automation

  • Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and performance reports to monitor operational activities, business priorities, and key performance indicators.

  • Analyze operational data, identify trends or potential issues, and provide leadership with actionable insights and recommendations.

  • Leverage AI tools, automation, and digital platforms to streamline repetitive tasks, improve reporting, and increase overall business efficiency.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, program management and client success

  • Experience owning processes and outcomes rather than only completing assigned administrative tasks.

  • Strong understanding of patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, healthcare administrative workflows, and service operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems, investigate root causes, and independently implement solutions.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with physicians, practice staff, healthcare professionals, patients, and senior leadership.

  • Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, trackers, or operational systems.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with patient information, documentation, billing information, and operational data.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, changing, or early-stage environment.

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, systems, workflows, and processes independently.

  • Practical experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve business processes.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting US medical practices or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience in telehealth, nutrition, wellness, chronic care, preventive health, exercise programs, or virtual healthcare services.

  • Familiarity with healthcare insurance, eligibility, reimbursement, billing, claims, or revenue-cycle workflows.

  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems, scheduling platforms, CRM tools, telehealth systems, or patient communication platforms.

  • Experience coordinating or managing remote healthcare teams.

  • Experience with physician practice onboarding, account management, or client success.

  • Experience building processes or operations within an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

  • Previous ownership of operational KPIs, service-level metrics, or business performance reporting.

What Success Looks Like

During your first few weeks, success will mean developing a strong understanding of Pillar's end-to-end operating model and creating clear visibility into how physician practices, patients, providers, documentation, billing, and internal workflows connect.

You will identify the biggest operational bottlenecks, improve patient and practice workflows, strengthen accountability, establish meaningful operational reporting, and reduce recurring operational issues.

Over time, you will help build an operating system capable of supporting substantially more physician practices, patients, and providers without operational complexity increasing at the same rate as the business.

The ultimate goal is simple:

Create an operation where physician practices receive a reliable experience, patients move through the program smoothly, providers have the support they need, leadership has visibility into performance, and fewer problems require manual intervention as Pillar grows.

Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.
  • Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.
  • Identify ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and coordinate resolution with engineering stakeholders.

SCADE & Software Development Support

  • Utilize SCADE within model-based software development and verification environments.
  • Support verification of SCADE generated or model-based avionics software.
  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.
  • Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.
  • Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.
  • Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.
  • Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.
  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.
  • Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.
  • Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.
  • Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience.
  • Minimum five years of Java development experience.
  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
  • Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.
  • Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.
  • Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.
  • Experience with test automation.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.
  • Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools.
  • Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.
  • Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.
  • Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is remote and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Travel of up to 10% may be required to support program activities, technical reviews, integration, testing, or customer needs.

The position requires close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, certification, and program engineering teams.

Compensation

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer: $100,000 to $150,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors.

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Sr. Director, Industry and Payor Strategy to join our team!

Accountability includes limited distribution drug (LDD) access, manufacturer and enhanced service agreements, payor network participation and reimbursement strategy, procurement and GPO contracting, and health system partnerships.

Establish negotiation objectives and financial guardrails, obtain required approvals, and oversee implementation, contractual compliance, and realization of agreed-upon economics.

Evaluate contract profitability, concentration risk, and strategic fit, and recommend corrective actions or alternative arrangements.

The best business decisions don't happen by accident. They happen when leaders have the right information, the right context, and the confidence to act.

As a Senior Business Insights Analyst, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Summit, transforming complex operational, financial, and customer data into meaningful business insights. You'll partner with executives and cross-functional teams to develop performance frameworks, evaluate strategic opportunities, build business cases, and provide the analysis that helps shape the company's future.

  • Develop business cases, scenario models, forecasting tools, and value-realization analyses that support investment decisions and organizational priorities.

  • Coordinate with data engineering and database teams to investigate data discrepancies and source changes.
  • Follow approved version control, review, deployment, and change-management procedures.

Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 9 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

Position Summary

The Director of Real Estate owns every step from market selection to signed lease, and the lease portfolio thereafter. We open roughly 20 clinics a year today and intend to reach 30. Site selection, LOI and lease negotiation currently run out of the VP of Business Development's desk, and that is the constraint on getting there.

This is a builder's role in a lean organization. You will be the first dedicated real estate hire, you will work directly with the CEO, the VP of Business Development and the Board, and you will set how this function operates rather than inherit a playbook. You will partner closely with the Director of Clinic Development & Facilities, who takes each site from lease signature through construction and opening.

This role has no initial direct reports. You will work through an external broker network and alongside internal project management, legal and finance.

Key Opportunities

  • Own a function outright and define how it runs
  • Report up to the VP of Business Development
  • Set the pace of a national expansion moving from 20 to 30 clinics a year
  • Build the site criteria and the market model the company will use for years
  • Lean organization with opportunity to take on significant responsibility quickly

Responsibilities

New markets and densification

  • Analyze and rank new metro opportunities using demographics, payer landscape, competitive density and labor supply; recommend where we go next and defend it to leadership and the Board
  • Assess densification in markets we already serve — where a second or third clinic adds revenue/ebitda rather than splitting the ones we have
  • Build and maintain the scoring model and site criteria behind those recommendations

Site selection and transactions

  • Source and virtually tour sites, manage the broker network, and maintain a pipeline deep enough to sustain 30 openings a year
  • Negotiate letters of intent
  • Negotiate leases and the documents that go with them: commencement terms, tenant improvement reimbursement, move-in allowance, options and renewal rights
  • Hand each signed site to Clinic Development with the delivery condition, TI allowance and landlord obligations documented

Portfolio and asset management

  • Own the lease portfolio: the critical-date calendar, option notice deadlines, renewals, estoppels and CAM reconciliation
  • Analyze the current clinic footprint — square footage against clinic productivity — and recommend where to expand, contract, sublease or relocate
  • Lead exits: lease termination, assignment and subleasing when a site closes or moves

Partnership

  • Work with Recruiting so market selection matches physician supply; a site we cannot staff is a site we should not sign
  • Work with Revenue Cycle on payer access in a prospective market before we commit to it
  • Report pipeline, cycle times and lease economics to leadership and the Board

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5 to 7+ years in commercial real estate, with direct ownership of site selection and lease negotiation for a multi-site operator
  • A track record of closing sites at volume, you have personally run a pipeline of 15+ locations a year, not supported one
  • Fluent in lease economics: TI allowances, base rent and escalations, CAM, options, delivery condition, landlord work letters
  • Strong analytical skills; you build the market model yourself rather than commission it
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to put a site recommendation in front of a CEO and a Board and defend it
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools. You use large language models and AI-assisted tooling as part of your day-to-day workflow, and you can show us how. We will ask you to walk us through real examples: how you prompt, where you have automated or accelerated your own work, and how you check and validate AI output before relying on it.
  • Comfortable operating without a team, you work through brokers, counsel and internal partners
  • Willing to travel to tour markets and sites
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Nice to Have

None of the following are required. Tell us which ones you have, or which you would be most excited to learn.

  • Healthcare real estate, or another regulated multi-site operator (dental, veterinary, urgent care, dialysis, physical therapy)
  • Experience standing up a real estate function rather than joining an established one
  • Tenant representation background, or time on the brokerage side
  • GIS, site-scoring or trade-area tools — Buxton, Placer.ai, Esri, CoStar
  • Experience with a national tenant-rep relationship at scale

Compensation & Benefits

  • $130k to $190k (based on experience) plus 15% yearly performance bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Flexible paid time off
  • 401K

Compensation for this role varies based on years of experience, skill set, and alignment with position requirements.

Hiring Process

The hiring process consists of three rounds:

  1. Phone screening interview
  2. Formal hour-long interview
  3. Case study: assess a prospective market and a specific site, and present the recommendation

You are welcome to use AI tools during the case study. We will ask you to show your work and explain your reasoning, including where you used AI and how you verified the results.

Lumenci is hiring a remote Director of Marketing to lead US marketing for a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform. In this hands-on, senior individual contributor role, you will own IP industry events, demand generation, ABM, content, and brand for our patent litigation, monetization, and iLumOS AI businesses, working closely with Sales and collaborating with teams globally.

About Lumenci

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumOS platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

Employment Type: Full-time, exempt
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: US
Reports To: Senior VP of Sales
Travel: 15–25% (trade shows, industry events, client dinners)

The Opportunity

Lumenci is reshaping how it goes to market. As we grow our client base and expand iLumOS, we need marketing to shape the market story our commercial teams bring to clients. Our work has earned deep trust with the clients who know us. Your job is to make sure the rest of the market knows us too.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with a clear path to building a team. With a US focus, you will own Lumenci's US marketing presence: our trade show calendar, client events, collateral, campaigns, and brand. You will support the rollout of our US team and work closely with Sales and sales enablement, while collaborating with Lumenci colleagues globally.

What You'll Do

Events and client experiences

  • Lead Lumenci's US trade show and conference program, including key IP events such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES. Own each event from planning through follow-up, covering booth presence, staffing, materials, and lead capture

  • Plan and run client dinners and hosted events in key markets

  • Own promotional items, giveaways, branded merchandise, and client dinners within Lumenci's gift, entertainment, and expense policies, including vendor management, ordering, and inventory

Content and collateral

  • Audit current collateral and set priorities for what to revise or create first

  • Create overview, introductory, and solution-specific collateral for both Lumenci services and iLumOS

  • Build tailored presentation slides for sales conversations, conferences, and client meetings

  • Manage the webinar, white paper, and use case program, working with internal subject-matter experts to turn complex IP work into clear client stories

  • Work with Legal and delivery leaders to make sure case studies, use cases, and outcome claims protect client confidentiality and are approved before publication

Demand generation and sales enablement

  • Partner with sales enablement to keep sales materials and messaging current and consistent

  • Create content for the SDR team and build targeted outreach campaigns aimed at priority accounts and buyer segments

  • Design and run account-based marketing (ABM) programs for high-value target accounts, coordinating events, content, and digital outreach with Sales

  • Build a demand generation engine that produces measurable pipeline, using HubSpot for campaigns, lead scoring, tracking, and attribution to prove ROI for every program

  • Guide website content, SEO, and visibility in AI-driven search so buyers can find Lumenci and iLumOS

  • Develop thought leadership programs that position Lumenci and iLumOS as authorities in patent monetization and IP strategy

  • Manage the marketing budget, agencies, and external partners to get the most from every dollar

Brand

  • Own the Lumenci brand across every touchpoint, including PowerPoint templates, email signatures, digital assets, and event presence

  • Make sure brand standards are applied consistently across our US and global teams

  • Partner with HR on employer branding, including branded templates for offer and onboarding communications and new-hire welcome kits

What You Bring

Required

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in the intellectual property industry, such as IP information and analytics, IP software, IP or legal services, litigation support, or licensing

  • Deep knowledge of the IP market, its buyers, and how they evaluate services and technology, including law firms, corporate IP teams, patent owners, and litigation funders

  • Proven success running trade show and event programs from start to finish

  • A track record of demand generation tied to measurable results, such as qualified leads, marketing-sourced pipeline, and closed revenue

  • Experience owning a marketing budget and managing agencies or external partners

  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn technical and legal subject matter into clear, persuasive content

  • A strong sense of urgency and a habit of planning ahead, keeping several priorities moving without last-minute scrambles

  • Comfort working as a hands-on individual contributor who personally delivers the work while also setting strategy

  • Ability to build alignment and work well with sales and with global, cross-functional teams across time zones

  • Ability to travel 15–25% for trade shows, industry events, and client dinners. Event work may involve standing for extended periods and setting up booth materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

Preferred

  • Director-level marketing experience in an IP-focused company

  • Experience marketing both professional services and a software or AI platform, across multiple business lines

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience, including campaigns, lead scoring, lead flow, and ROI reporting

  • Experience building account-based marketing programs

  • Familiarity with SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) for AI-driven search

  • Existing relationships across the IP event and association circuit, such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams or managing marketing staff

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Review all existing collateral and agree with leadership on what to revise first. Take ownership of promotional items and giveaways. Get up to speed quickly on events already scheduled for conference season.

First 60 days: Deliver refreshed priority collateral and presentation templates. Run upcoming trade shows and client dinners. Start building SDR content and targeted outreach campaigns with sales enablement.

First 90 days: Set clear brand standards that every team is using. Put a regular webinar and white paper calendar in place. Put pipeline and ROI reporting in place for marketing programs. Present a US marketing plan that supports Lumenci's broader go-to-market strategy and iLumOS growth.

Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci

Be Part of a Global Team: Joining Lumenci means joining a diverse and globally distributed team. You'll collaborate with talented individuals from different backgrounds and cultures, bringing unique perspectives to every project.

Growth and Development Opportunities: At Lumenci, we believe in recognizing and rewarding merit. We offer opportunities for merit-based promotions, allowing you to advance your career based on your performance, contributions, and dedication. We are committed to supporting your professional growth and development, providing the resources and mentorship needed to excel in your role and take on new challenges.

Benefits & Total Rewards

  • Comprehensive Health & Well-being: We offer robust medical, dental, and vision insurance options that include significant company contributions toward employee premiums to support the health of our "Luminaries" and their families.

  • Retirement Strategy: Lumenci provides a 401(k) program with a competitive employer-matching contribution, enabling employees to build long-term financial security.

  • Culture of Autonomy & Growth: Employees benefit from a flexible, remote-first work environment that favors autonomy and provides structured support for ongoing professional development and career advancement.

Compensation and Pay Transparency

Actual base salary within this range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant experience, depth of IP industry expertise, skills, and internal equity.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual performance bonus and Lumenci's benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off.

Vi strävar efter att de flesta i teamet ska ha över fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta med produkter med inbyggd mjukvara.

Vi har många exempel på lyckade projekt vi jobbat med, i olika branscher:

  • Medicintekniska produkter –applikationer för mätning, behandling och uppföljning i hemmiljö av patienter med kronisk smärta, Parkinson, diabetes, hjärtproblem m.m. System för patientdatainsamling i kliniska studier.
  • Telecom – Mobiltelefonisystem 2G, 3G, 4G och 5G, fiber-transceivers,
  • Internet-of-things: M2M plattformar och applikationer för el, olja, gas, vatten, avfall, skogsmaskiner m.m.
  • Industri- system för tvätt- och sophantering, och inspektion av avloppsnät

Vi söker dig som känner igen dig i följande:

Du vill arbeta med att utveckla system med hög kvalitet och säkerhet och hitta nya användningsområden där IT och teknik underlättar och effektiviserar. Du är lösningsfokuserad, delar med dig av dina idéer och är självgående. Uthållighet och ordningssinne är önskvärda egenskaper.

Några av dina tidigare erfarenheter:

Om oss

På Nordforce jobbar vi ofta i mindre team. Kommunikation, tillit och lojalitet är A och O för att nå ett bra arbetsklimat i gruppen. Lika viktigt är att kunna arbeta självständigt, speciellt i dessa tider när vi sitter på distans.

Vår kultur präglas av och består av tre ord: nyfikenhet, omtanke och professionalism. Vi hjälper varandra att lyckas och vi har höga ambitioner, både som individer och företag - och vi vill utveckla produkter i världsklass!
