  • Work with the Finance & Operations team on funding agreements, pledge tracking, income forecasting and reporting to funders
  1. Innovation & Value Proposition

Make sure Impact Europe offers clear, distinctive value to members, funders and partners, and keeps renewing it:

  • Own Impact Europe’s value proposition for each member and funder segment, so it is clear why organisations join, stay, fund and partner with us
  • Turn member and market insight (needs, feedback, data, retention trends) into a clear view of where our offer is strong and where it has gaps
  • Design, pilot and launch new products, services and membership models with programme colleagues, such as segment-specific or tiered memberships, peer-learning formats, data and benchmarking services and digital community tools
  • Develop new, mission-aligned income streams beyond membership fees and grants, such as sponsorship, paid programmes, events and earned-income services
  • Review the portfolio of offers regularly: scale what works, adapt what could work better and retire what no longer adds value
  • Track trends in impact investing, philanthropy and sustainable finance so Impact Europe’s offer stays ahead of what the market needs
  • Build a culture of experimentation in the team: test ideas quickly, measure the results and share what we learn
  1. Team Leadership

Lead the Growth team to deliver its goals:

  • Lead, coach and develop the Growth team, with clear goals, trust, empowerment and accountability
  • Improve processes and workflows so the team works efficiently and in step with other departments
  • Attract, retain and develop key talent
  1. Organisational Leadership

Contribute to Impact Europe’s direction as a member of the leadership team:

  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and contribute to organisational strategy as a member of the leadership team
  • Work across teams in a matrix environment to align objectives, priorities and resources
  • Manage the budget for the department and report on results to the CEO and Board

Key Performance Indicators

  • Fundraising income secured and renewed, against annual targets
  • New funding partnerships
  • Membership growth, retention and satisfaction
  • Diversity and representativeness of the network
  • Uptake of and income from new products, services and partnership models
  • How members and funders rate the value Impact Europe offers them (e.g. satisfaction or Net Promoter Score)
  • Impact Europe's presence and credibility in key impact and philanthropy circles
  • Team engagement, retention and development

Skills & Qualities

Essential experience

  • Proven track record in fundraising, with a history of securing significant multi-year grants and partnerships from foundations, corporates or other institutional funders
  • Senior leadership experience, including leading and developing a team and managing a budget
  • Experience growing a membership network, community or client base, with a focus on engagement and retention
  • Experience working with boards, CEOs and senior funders, including briefing them for funder approaches
  • Ability to build a compelling case for support and communicate impact clearly
  • Experience working collaboratively in a matrix environment; fluent professional English
  • An established network among European foundations, philanthropists or impact investors

Desirable experience

  • Experience working in or with a philanthropic foundation, ideally on the grant-making or partnerships side
  • Knowledge of impact investing, venture philanthropy or sustainable finance
  • Experience building a fundraising function or programme from scratch
  • Experience developing and launching new products, services or membership offers, ideally in a network, association or mission-driven organisation
  • Fluency in other European languages, in addition to English

Personal qualities

  • Modern leadership based on trust, empowerment and accountability; inclusive and able to co-create solutions
  • Strategic thinker who is also pragmatic and results-driven, able to switch between the two daily
  • Excellent relationship builder, networker and communicator
  • Analytical mindset, able to spot growth opportunities and barriers
  • Curious and entrepreneurial: comfortable testing new ideas and learning from what does not work
  • Strong ability to prioritise; agile and goal-oriented
  • Team player, and passionate about accelerating positive change and ecosystem building

Reporting & Stakeholders

Regional Digital Program Manager – Operational Excellence Engineering, EMEA & APAC

Purpose of the role

Join our regional Operational Excellence Engineering Digital team and play a key role in accelerating digital transformation across our manufacturing network in EMEA & APAC.

Our team owns and develops the shared regional platform connecting machine data, orchestration, analytics and business systems, providing manufacturing sites with the standards and capabilities they need to turn digital solutions into tangible operational improvements.

As Regional Digital Program Manager, you will be the driving force behind the execution of this regional digital program. You will coordinate rollout waves, site engagements, external partners and demand intake, ensuring that priorities translate into action and that regional solutions are successfully adopted across our manufacturing sites.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys connecting technology, manufacturing operations and people, bringing structure to complex programs and making things happen across multiple countries and stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive regional rollout coordination across manufacturing sites, managing schedules, dependencies, site readiness and open actions.
  • Manage the demand intake process, gathering and structuring requests from sites and business teams and preparing them for prioritisation by the Regional Program Lead.
  • Coordinate external contractor delivery from scope definition and planning through progress tracking and final handover to internal owners.
  • Support the implementation of regional digital standards across all sites, including KPI definitions, templates and applications, while monitoring progress and closing adoption gaps.

  • Organise capability-building and key-user training, working with internal and external trainers and monitoring adoption across sites.

You don’t need to be the deepest technical expert in one specific technology. What matters is your ability to understand the technical landscape, connect the right people and turn priorities into execution.

You are someone who brings clarity to complexity, keeps multiple workstreams moving and enjoys seeing digital solutions successfully adopted in real manufacturing environments.

Department: Business Intelligence & Strategy

Location: United States, Remote with Travel to Clients, Conferences, and Events

Senior Vice President, Growth & Commercialization

  • About Underscore

    Underscore is a specialized commercialization partner helping biopharma organizations apply strategic media and professional services to activate healthcare professionals and patients for new treatments, including rare disease and oncology launches and brand growth efforts.

    Our next chapter is powered by deep strategic expertise, data and technology-enabled solutions, productized intellectual property, a repeatable innovation engine, strong commercialization, and a clear market position.

    To help build this next chapter, we are seeking a Senior Vice President, Growth & Commercialization.

    Position Overview

    The SVP, Growth & Commercialization is accountable for Underscore’s market-facing growth engine. This leader owns agency positioning, marketing, business development, pipeline generation, new client acquisition, and the commercialization of new products, services, and capabilities.

    The role does not own Innovation governance or Product development. Instead, the SVP works as the commercial counterpart to the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology: Growth brings market trends, prospect feedback, competitive intelligence, and client demand signals into the innovation funnel; Product brings selected products and capabilities into commercialization for packaging, positioning, enablement, launch, adoption, and revenue realization.

    The role also partners closely with Client Services, which retains and grows existing accounts, Strategic Solutions, which delivers client solutions and consulting, and with Strategic Operations, which operationalizes new offerings so the organization can deliver them consistently and at scale.

    Position Purpose

    The primary mission of this role is to answer five critical questions:

    Where should Underscore compete and grow?

    How should Underscore continue to position and differentiate itself as market changes occur?

    How do we continue to generate qualified demand and win new clients (strategic approach, staffing, messaging, materials) ?

    How do new products and capabilities in development become market-ready offerings?

    How do we drive adoption, utilization, revenue, and commercial learning after launch of new products and services?

    Own the Growth Strategy and Commercial Engine

    Build and lead the integrated system for market visibility, demand generation, pipeline development, new business, and new client acquisition.

    Responsibilities

    • Develop enterprise growth strategy, annual priorities, and measurable growth plans with support from leaders, consultants and staff
    • Own agency marketing, ongoing brand positioning, thought leadership, and market visibility
    • Lead business development and sales strategy, pipeline governance, and new-client pursuits
    • Translate market trends, competitive activity, prospect feedback, and unmet needs into actionable opportunity signals for product and solution expansion
    • Partner with Client Services on clear boundaries between new-logo growth and organic growth within current accounts as well as integration and onboarding into the agency for new-logo wins
    • Build strategic partnerships and ecosystem relationships that strengthen market reach and commercial opportunity

    Success Measures

    • Forecast accuracy and pipeline discipline
    • Market awareness and thought-leadership reach
    • Qualified pipeline growth and quality
    • New client acquisition and win rate
    • Revenue from new clients
    • Strategic-partnership contribution

    Own Commercialization of New Offerings

    Turn products, services, and capabilities into clear, differentiated, sellable offerings that can be launched, adopted, and scaled.

    Responsibilities

    • Partner with the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology early in the product lifecycle to define commercial requirements and market viability
    • Own offer design, packaging, value proposition, positioning, and commercialization plans
    • Partner with Client Finance and Finance on pricing strategy, business cases, financial assumptions, and margin expectations
    • Develop go-to-market plans, sales enablement, launch materials, proof points, and buyer narratives
    • Coordinate market readiness with Product, Strategy, Media, Client Services, and external partners
    • Own launch, adoption, utilization, commercial performance, and post-launch learning
    • Feed market response and adoption data back to Product and Innovation to improve the roadmap and portfolio

    Success Measures

    • Time from product readiness to market launch
    • Adoption and utilization
    • Revenue and margin from new offerings
    • Sales enablement readiness
    • Commercial conversion and attach rates
    • Post-launch learning incorporated into product decisions and ongoing improvements

    Create the Market-to-Innovation Feedback Loop

    Ensure Innovation and Product development decisions are grounded in external demand rather than internal ideas alone.

    Responsibilities

    • Monitor healthcare, biopharma, agency, media, data, technology, and buyer trends
    • Bring market, prospect, partner, and client signals into the innovation funnel
    • Partner with the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology on opportunity assessment, business cases, and prioritization
    • Validate value propositions, buyer audiences, willingness to adopt, and competitive differentiation before significant build investment
    • Identify white-space opportunities that can become new services, products, or partnerships

    Success Measures

    • Quality and usefulness of market inputs to the innovation portfolio
    • Percentage of prioritized ideas validated with market evidence
    • Commercial potential of innovation pipeline
    • Reduced investment in low-demand ideas
    • Speed of learning from market validation

    Lead Positioning and Market Activation

    Create a distinct and consistent market presence across marketing, sales, partnerships, thought leadership, and new offerings.

    Responsibilities

    • Own the agency positioning framework and activation plan
    • Ensure coordinated narratives and team training across company marketing, new business, offerings, and external thought leadership
    • Guide competitive differentiation and category positioning in alignment with growth goals
    • Partner with Strategy and Media leaders to ensure market claims reflect real delivery capabilities
    • Establish positioning governance and reusable messaging tools

    Success Measures

    • Market differentiation
    • Brand awareness and visibility
    • Message consistency
    • Thought-leadership engagement
    • Win-rate and pitch-quality improvement

    Build Strategic Partnerships

    Develop relationships that expand reach, enable capabilities, or create commercial opportunities.

    Responsibilities

    • Identify and prioritize data, technology, industry, channel, research, and ecosystem partnerships
    • Define the commercial rationale, value exchange, and success measures for partnerships
    • Coordinate partnerships with Product, Media, Strategy, Finance, Client Services, and Strategic Operations
    • Develop co-marketing, co-selling, referral, and capability-enablement opportunities
    • Review partnership performance and discontinue relationships that do not create value

    Success Measures

    • Partnership-sourced opportunities and revenue
    • New capabilities or reach enabled
    • Market visibility created
    • Partnership performance against business case
    • Strategic value realized

    Key Cross-Functional Partnerships

    SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology: Receives market trends, buyer needs, prospect feedback, and commercial requirements; provides product roadmaps, release readiness, technical proof points, and new capabilities for commercialization.

    Strategic Operations: Operationalizes offerings through workflows, Wrike, roles, handoffs, SOPs, QA, training, launch governance, and adoption support.

    Client Services: Shares client needs, account risk, and expansion opportunities; Client Services owns organic growth and closing within current clients.

    Strategy: Brings client and market insight, solution strategy, research, KBQs, message strategy, and strategic proof points.

    Media: Contributes media-market trends, partner intelligence, differentiated media capabilities, and go-to-market innovation.

    Client Finance / Finance: Supports pricing, business cases, revenue planning, margins, investment decisions, and financial performance.

    Analytics: Provides commercial reporting, adoption analytics, performance evidence, and measurement support.

    Ideal Candidate

    Required Experience

    • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in growth, marketing, business development, commercialization, or related commercial functions
    • Demonstrated ownership of marketing and new-business outcomes
    • Experience commercializing new products, services, capabilities, or technology-enabled solutions
    • Direct experience in media, healthcare marketing, life sciences, biopharma, medical device, or a closely related environment
    • Experience building pipeline governance, commercial priorities, and measurable growth plans
    • Cross-functional leadership across product, strategy, operations, finance, delivery, and client teams
    • Agency leadership and/or consulting experience
    • Healthcare or biopharma product launch experience
    • Commercialization of data, analytics, AI, or technology-enabled offerings
    • Strategic partnerships and ecosystem development
    • Experience in a high-growth or transformation environment

    Leadership Traits

    • Strategic and commercially minded
    • Market-oriented and customer curious
    • Entrepreneurial and resourceful
    • Highly collaborative and low-ego
    • Operationally disciplined
    • Direct, persuasive executive communicator
    • Comfortable building systems from ambiguity
    • Accountable for measurable results

  • Experience & Education

    Critical Experiences

    • Built or scaled an integrated growth engine
    • Owned marketing and business-development outcomes
    • Commercialized new offerings with measurable adoption and revenue
    • Created market-feedback loops that improved product or portfolio decisions
    • Led cross-functional launches and commercial change
    • Built strategic partnerships with measurable value
    • Healthcare, life sciences, biopharma, medical device, or healthcare agency background
    • Media-heavy agency or consulting experience
    • Experience with data, analytics, AI, or productized IP
    • Product launch and commercialization experience

    Education

    • Bachelor’s degree required
    • Advanced education in business, marketing, strategy, healthcare, or a related field preferred

    Knowledge

    Knowledge Of

    • Growth strategy and operating systems
    • Commercialization frameworks
    • Positioning and differentiation
    • Marketing and business development
    • Pipeline and sales governance
    • Strategic partnerships
    • Healthcare commercialization landscape
    • Agency economics and profitability

    Skilled At

    • Turning market signals into growth priorities
    • Packaging and positioning complex offerings
    • Building commercial business cases
    • Leading pitches and executive buyer conversations
    • Creating sales enablement and launch plans
    • Building cross-functional alignment
    • Measuring adoption and revenue performance

    Deep Understanding Of

    • Healthcare and media buying environments
    • Client decision-making and agency procurement
    • Commercial lifecycle from concept through adoption
    • How product, strategy, media, delivery, and finance combine to create client value
    • Growth metrics and performance management

    Competencies

    Strategic Vision

    • Connects market shifts and business priorities to a focused growth agenda
    • Balances immediate revenue needs with long-term market position

    Growth Leadership

    • Creates disciplined marketing, pipeline, sales, and partnership systems
    • Builds accountability for demand and new-client outcomes

    Commercialization Leadership

    • Turns capabilities into clear offers with pricing, enablement, launch, and adoption plans
    • Balances buyer value, delivery feasibility, and economics

    Commercial Acumen

    • Understands agency economics, buyer decisions, revenue levers, and margin implications
    • Uses evidence to prioritize opportunities

    Executive Influence

    • Aligns leaders without relying solely on hierarchy
    • Communicates complex choices simply and credibly

    Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Creates productive operating relationships across Product, Operations, Client Services, Strategy, Media, Analytics, and Finance

    Change Leadership

    • Builds adoption for new commercial systems, positioning, and offerings

    Effective Communication

    Creates clear market narratives and adapts communication to buyers, employees, and executives

 Underscore Marketing is a woman-owned, independent agency specializing in life sciences. Since 2002, we've helped clients gain a competitive edge through bold, data-driven promotional strategies that deliver measurable results.  

Our team comprises media, strategy, and omnichannel analytics experts who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and results. When you join Underscore, you become part of a dynamic environment where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work helps elevate brands in a competitive healthcare landscape.  

If you're passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a team that values integrity, creativity, and results, if that sounds like you, we invite you to share.

jobs.excerpt: About Versapay 🚀Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
jobs.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

Your Impact at Versapay:

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway, you will own Versapay’s payment gateways: the platform every Versapay payment flows through, from authorization to settlement.

You will set the vision and roadmap for a modular, scalable, multi-tenant gateway that connects Versapay’saccounts receivable products to processors, acquirers, and card & bank networks. You ownboth the product and business outcomes for the gateways; authorization and payment success rates, uptime and latency, downgrades, cost per transaction, and more.

This is a platform role. Your customers are Versapay’s product teams, our core processing partners, the developers and ERP partners who integrate with us, and the ledger and finance teams who depend on every payment landing correctly. You will partner directly with engineering on architecture and delivery, work with go-to-market teams on positioning and regularly represent gateway strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment.

This is an opportunity for a product leader who has built/scaled a payment gateway and is ready to grow and modernize a global B2B payments platform.

What You'll Do:

    • Own the gateway strategy and roadmap. Set the multi-year vision for Versapay’s owned gateways across card, bank, and alternative payment methods in every market we serve. Balance near-term improvements with long-term platform investments and make the trade-offs explicit.

    • Drive payment performance. Own the gateway’s core KPIs: authorization and payment success rates, decline and retry performance, uptime, latency, and processing cost. Improve them through connection optimization, failover, smart retries, network tokenization, account updater, 3DS and authentication flows, and B2B card data (Level 2/3).

    • Build the platform others build on. Define the gateway’s APIs, SDKs, hosted payment pages, webhooks, and merchant and MID configuration so Versapay product teams and partners can launch new payment experiences in days, not quarters.

    • Own processor, acquirer, and network connectivity. Lead the evaluation, certification, and launch of processor and acquirer integrations and new network capabilities. Translate network specs and mandates into clear requirements, and keep the gateway compliant with card brand rules, PCI DSS, and regional regulations.

    • Own the transaction lifecycle end to end. Authorization, capture, refunds, voids, disputes and chargebacks, and settlement, including the clean handoff of transaction data to ledger and reconciliation. Partner with risk, compliance, and payment operations to keep money moving safely.

    • Lead engineering teams to deliver. Lead engineering team(s) and oversee execution across pods, from writing requirements to measuring success. Drive trade-off decisions on architecture, reliability, and platform design while keeping the team unblocked and managing the SDLC.

    • Use AI to compound platform value. Apply ML and agentic approaches to retry optimization, decline analysis, anomaly detection, incident triage, and partner integration support. Versapay is rebuilding for an AI-native operating model, and the gateway is core to that.

    • Be the in-house expert. Serve as Versapay’s authority on gateway architecture, payment processing, and network rules. Educate product and engineering teams, brief executives, and represent the platform externally with partners and customers.

What You Bring to the Team:

    • 6+ years in payments or fintech product management, with at least 3 years owning a payment gateway, processing, orchestration, or PSP platform end to end. Senior IC who has driven a roadmap, not just contributed to one.

    • Built or significantly scaled a gateway. You have shipped gateway capabilities in production — not just integrated a third-party gateway — and can speak to what changed and why.

    • Deep transaction lifecycle expertise. You understand authorization flows, network messaging (ISO 8583), tokenization, capture and settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and failover, and how each affects merchants and cost.

    • A record of moving payment performance metrics. You have measurably improved authorization rates, processing cost, uptime, or latency, and can show the data.

    • Global payments expertise. Experience across North America and international markets, including multi-currency processing, local payment methods, and the regimes that govern them (PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, card brand rules).

    • Track record of leading engineering teams in execution. You have overseen engineering pods or squads as the product owner, setting priorities, removing blockers, making architectural trade-offs alongside engineering leadership, and shipping on commitment.

    • AI fluency. Hands-on experience applying LLMs, ML, or agentic systems to payment workflows. You have a clear, defensible point of view on where AI belongs in a gateway and where it must not.

    • Builder mentality. Entrepreneurial, biased to action, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by net-new initiatives where the path is not yet drawn.

Summary:

Join a global leader in electronic materials and help drive innovation across Aerospace & Defense, Wireless/5G, Automotive Radar and Industrial RF applications. This role is based in the AES business unit and develops new business, expands existing medium‑to‑large accounts, and influences early design decisions at OEMs. Using expertise in RF electronics and printed circuit board (PCB) materials & processing, the Sales Engineer identifies opportunities, supports customer applications, and collaborates internally to deliver superior technical and commercial solutions.

Considering remote applicants who reside in the UK/EU: UK, Scandinavia, Germany (north/west), Benelux. Applicants from other states may not be eligible for consideration for this position.

Essential Functions:

1. OEM Program & Design‑In Development

  • Drive early engagement with OEM engineering, procurement, and program teams to influence RF/PCB material selection and gain visibility into customer roadmaps.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities by influencing specifications, driving design-ins, and aligning with customer product roadmaps.
  • Promote Rogers products and technologies; address RF/microwave application challenges.
  • Lead design‑win tracking, funnel management, and opportunity qualification using CRM tools.
  • Present cost‑benefit analyses and value propositions for OEM decision makers.

2. Direct Account & PCB Fabricator Engagement

  • Build, manage, and grow relationships with PCB fabricators to ensure alignment with OEM requirements and material specifications.
  • Support PCB processing topics (lamination, RF stack‑ups, yields, manufacturability).
  • Secure forecasting from fabricators and maintain accurate planning inputs.
  • Oversee quotations, program pricing, order follow‑up, and issue resolution.

3. Key Account Management & Global Coordination

  • Grow key European OEM accounts and coordinate with Asia/US colleagues to align global program execution.
  • Support product qualifications, audits, readiness reviews, and production ramp‑ups.
  • Address lead time or quality incidents with appropriate internal teams

4. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor customer activity, competitor movements, and market trends in RF, microwave, automotive, aerospace, and industrial sectors.
  • Adjust strategic sales plans to reflect evolving technology and competitive dynamics.

5. Internal Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Technical Service, R&D, Product Management, Marketing, and Supply Chain to build tailored solutions aligned to customer needs.
  • Maintain CRM data quality and provide accurate forecasts.
  • Participate in international sales meetings, internal reviews, and exhibitions.

6. Travel & Customer Interaction

  • Conduct regular visits to OEMs and fabricators (30–40% travel).

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or related technical field; equivalent experience considered.
  • 5+ years in RF/microwave electronics and/or PCB design, fabrication, or materials.
  • Strong knowledge of RF systems, PCB stack‑ups, and high‑frequency behavior.
  • Experience managing OEM and fabricator accounts across engineering,
  • procurement, and program functions.
  • Fluent in English; Nordic language a plus.
  • Ability to travel within the region (30–40%).

jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Sontiq is TransUnion's identity protection and cyber safety business, helping consumers affected by identity theft, fraud, and data breaches protect and restore their identities through expert support and guidance. The team works closely with customers, clients, and internal specialists to deliver timely assistance during challenging situations, making a meaningful difference in customers' recovery journeys. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in identity protection and customer support while working in a collaborative, customer-focused environment.

This role reports to the Associate Lead, Customer Support Operations.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

As a Customer Service Incident Coordinator (Dutch Speaking), you will support customers impacted by identity theft, fraud, and data breach incidents, helping them navigate the resolution process and access the support they need. You will play an important role in delivering positive customer outcomes, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and providing reassurance and guidance during sensitive situations.

Night Shift: Monday to Friday, 22:30–07:00

  • Conduct customer interviews by telephone to gather information relating to fraud, data breach, and identity theft incidents.
  • Review and analyse case information to assess the nature and severity of incidents and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Provide professional, empathetic, and high-quality customer support to individuals affected by fraud, identity theft, or data breach events.
  • Manage customer expectations by providing clear updates and guidance throughout the incident resolution process.
  • Act as a key point of contact between customers, clients, and internal subject matter experts.
  • Gather, document, and maintain relevant information and supporting evidence to assist with identity restoration and remediation activities.
  • Prepare correspondence and communicate with creditors, government agencies, and other third parties when required to support case resolution.
  • Clearly explain available services, support options, and recommended actions to customers.
  • Support clients and customers in understanding breach-related incidents and identifying appropriate remediation requirements.
  • Escalate cases requiring specialist support and coordinate communications, meetings, and updates across relevant teams.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and verbal, to support effective communication with customers, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Previous customer service experience, ideally within a fast-paced, customer-facing, or support environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and provide clear guidance during sensitive customer situations.
  • Ability to review information, assess customer needs, and make informed decisions when managing incident-related cases.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple cases and maintain accurate records.

Required Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to accurately document, maintain, and manage customer case information within internal systems.

What’s in it for you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business. As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful. We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don’t let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you’re looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting .

Interview & Hiring Process:

jobs.excerpt: Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach.
jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care
  • Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans
  • Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner
  • Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Choose between 32 or 40 hours per week, with the ability to structure your schedule in a way that works best for you and your patients
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 hours): A condensed schedule option designed to support balance, energy, and sustainability
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) (after 90 days)
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. jobs.excerpt: About the ProgramThe Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI.
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

That work includes finding where models fail, checking whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Scholars take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Each scholar owns a substantial part of a safety research project. You'll work alongside a mentor from the research question through the experiments to deciding what to test next.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide Research Scholars on projects in selected AI safety research areas in select AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AIs, including detecting harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment auditing and evaluations: Building scalable methods to test whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks and evaluations: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: 728 task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: simulating real-world pressure to choose between safe or harmful behavior
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

What You'll Do

Projects are mentor-guided. By default, you will be given a list of research proposals and match you with one based on your research interests and background. You’ll meet weekly with a Scale researcher who sets the direction and gives feedback, and you will drive the day-to-day work.

  • Own research end to end: Turn a high-level safety question into hypotheses, baselines, and controlled experiments, and produce work that others can inspect and build on.
  • Build the measurement: Implement and debug evaluation harnesses, agent environments, datasets, monitoring methods, or post-training experiments.
  • Exercise research judgment: Identify confounds, separate what a model can do from what it tends to do, make sense of negative results, and decide what to try next without step-by-step direction.
  • Make the work legible: Produce reproducible code, experiment logs, analysis, and precise technical writing. External outputs, where appropriate, remain subject to research, security, and communications review. Outputs also include research papers, which will be submitted to top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

Who We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you:

  • are motivated by ensuring the safe and responsible development of advanced AI systems;
  • are interested in technical safety research, such as alignment evaluations, AI control, monitoring, multi-agent safety, or open-weight model safety;
  • are pursuing or have completed a PhD in CS, ML, statistics, mathematics, or a related field (we also encourage researchers with an equivalent track record to apply);
  • can make progress with high-level guidance, including implementing, debugging, getting unstuck, interpreting results, and proposing next experiments;
  • communicate research clearly and handle confidential information and internal systems responsibly.

Application Process

  • Apply: Submit your resume or CV, your Google Scholar profile if you have one, and one research project you substantially owned, with 2–3 sentences on your contribution.
  • Research background discussion: Walk us through a past project, including what you tried, what didn't work, and what you learned.
  • Research design: Work through a research problem with us and propose how you'd approach it.
  • Onboarding: Successful candidates complete the applicable recruiting, work-authorization, security, and project-onboarding steps.

About the Role

  • Location: Remote within the United States, including California and New York
  • Hours: 20 hours per week
  • Term: 3 months, with the option to extend to 6–12 months for exceptional candidates (part-time Internship structure)
  • Compensation: $100/hour

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst& Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. Position Title: Accounting Manager

Location: Remote

Type: Full Time


The Opportunity:

This is a rare opportunity to help build Ohalo's accounting and finance infrastructure and business processes from the ground up, and to be at the forefront of building a best-in-class finance organization. Reporting to the Controller, the Accounting Manager will lead day-to-day accounting operations, develop the Staff Accountant, and own the more technical areas of the close — including stock-based compensation, ASC 842 lease accounting, allocations, and inventory accounting. We're looking for someone who diagnoses the root cause upstream rather than treating symptoms and applying band-aids on the back end.


Responsibilities:

  • Review and approve the work of the Accounting Analyst, including AP processing, cash reconciliations, and journal entries, coaching toward root-cause thinking rather than just correcting the entry
  • Prepare and review complex journal entries, including stock-based compensation, ASC 842 lease accounting, and cost/expense allocations
  • Design and build Ohalo's inventory and manufacturing accounting process from the ground up: Ohalo is transitioning from an R&D-stage plant breeding company to commercial seed production, so there is no legacy process to inherit
  • Design the inventory accounting and costing across the full production chain — from plant material to bioreactor, to greenhouse plugs, to field, to harvesting and processing, to pelletizing and treating seeds, to packaging, storage, and shipment to farmer customers
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial statements
  • Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and flux analyses, ensuring reconciling items are researched and resolved
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls and accounting policies; serve as a key point of contact for external auditors
  • Identify and lead process improvement and automation initiatives — leveraging AI tools and system capabilities (NetSuite, Ramp, Zip, and others) to reduce manual work
  • Partner with FP&A and cross-functional teams on accruals, allocations, and reporting needs, and mentor the Accounting Analyst as the team grows
  • Own oversight of Ohalo's travel & expense (T&E) program — setting and refining expense policy leveraging Ramp’s AI-tools — and periodically audit transactions and card activity for compliance, coding accuracy, and fraud risk


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite, Ramp, and Zip (or a similar procurement/AP automation platform)
  • Deep understanding of US GAAP and technical accounting concepts
  • Self-starter and first-principles thinker who is comfortable building process from scratch and digs into root cause rather than symptoms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Big 4 or public accounting experience
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
  • Experience with manufacturing and/or inventory accounting
  • Track record of using AI tools and process automation to change how accounting work gets done

Marketing Operations Specialist

Department: Marketing Operations | Reports to: Director, Marketing Operations & Analytics | Location: Remote (United States) | Type: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to join our small, high-impact Marketing Operations & Analytics team. You will be a supporting owner of our marketing tech stack (Marketo, Salesforce, RingLead, Demandbase, and Clay), sharing responsibility with the Director and the Marketing Operations Manager for keeping these systems healthy, well-documented, and delivering value. Day to day, you will own campaign execution and data quality, and serve as a backup administrator for each tool.

This is a great role for someone early in their marketing operations career who wants to go deep on enterprise-grade systems, learn how marketing drives pipeline in a B2B technology company, and grow quickly alongside a team that will invest in their development.

What You Will Do

Marketing Tech Stack Ownership with the MarOps Team

  • Act as a supporting owner and backup administrator for Marketo, Salesforce (marketing objects and campaigns), RingLead, Demandbase, and Clay
  • Keep system documentation current, including field definitions, data flows, naming conventions, and other Marketing processes
  • Serve as a supporting point of contact with vendors and help with tool onboarding and training for marketers
  • Contribute to the Marketing Ops charter and a decision framework that defines what each tool is responsible for, where capabilities overlap, and how future tool decisions are made

Marketo Campaign Operations

  • Help service list uploads from events, webinars, and third-party sources: cleanse, normalize, dedupe, and import with correct attribution
  • Build, test, and launch Marketo programs for emails, webinars, events, nurtures, and other Marketing channels
  • Assist with QA of all campaign assets (emails, landing pages, forms, links, and flow steps) before launch
  • Manage program statuses, channels, and period costs so campaign data is accurate for reporting

Salesforce Marketing Funnel Management

  • Troubleshoot lead and contact sync issues between Marketo and Salesforce
  • Support the lead lifecycle by monitoring lead flow, lead status, and handoffs to the SDR team

Lead Scoring & Lifecycle

  • Confirm that existing scoring and lifecycle logic is live and working as designed before new changes are built
  • Implement demographic scoring updates, including fit-based adjustments for ICP, customer tier, and target account weighting
  • Test scoring, matching, and lifecycle changes in shadow mode before they go into production, then roll them out to new leads first
  • Lead the lead lifecycle data cleanup: fix stalled and miscategorized records, apply aged-lead cutoffs, and work down the backlog in batches sized to SDR capacity
  • Monitor lead flow, lead status, and handoffs to Sales Development, and help define and enforce lifecycle SLAs once the data supports them

Persona Segmentation & Data Quality

  • Build and maintain automated persona segmentation in Salesforce that turns raw job titles into standard Job Level, Job Function, and Job Role values
  • Set up and tune title-mapping logic using RingLead, Clay, and AI-native automations to classify new and existing records at scale
  • Regularly review classification accuracy, fix mismatches, and refine mapping rules as new titles appear
  • Run and maintain RingLead deduplication, normalization, and enrichment processes for leads, contacts, and accounts
  • Monitor data quality metrics and proactively fix incomplete, duplicate, or incorrect records

Cross-Functional Partnership: SDR, Sales & RevOps

Work closely with the SDR team, Sales, and RevOps to make sure every lead is matched to the right account and every MQL reaches the right rep quickly.

  • Lead-to-account matching: Maintain and tune RingLead matching rules (e.g., domain, company name, account hierarchy) so leads attach to the correct Salesforce account
  • Match quality: Monitor unmatched and mismatched leads, fix errors, and address root causes
  • Owner assignment: Make sure matched leads inherit the correct account owner and assigned SDR
  • MQL routing: Configure and maintain MQL routing rules in RingLead and Salesforce by territory, segment, and round-robin logic
  • SLA monitoring: Track MQL follow-up speed, and flag stalled or unassigned MQLs to SDR and Sales leadership
  • Territory changes: Partner with RevOps to align on Sales territory change logic, and update matching and routing rules as territories and assignments change
  • Regular syncs: Hold recurring reviews with SDR leadership, Sales, and RevOps on routing accuracy, lead quality, and handoff issues
  • Enablement: Train SDRs and AEs on lead status definitions, the MQL handoff process, and how routing works

Account Intelligence & Enrichment (Demandbase & Clay)

  • Co-own the design and maintenance of Demandbase intent and signal monitoring so Sales and Marketing can see which target accounts are in-market
  • Create Clay workflows that fill data gaps and fix records, complementing RingLead deduplication and normalization

Reporting

  • Build and maintain Salesforce, Marketo, and Demandbase reports and dashboards for campaign performance, list results, and funnel metrics
  • Pull ad hoc campaign results for Field, Demand Gen, and Events marketers
  • Partner with the Director on data accuracy so analytics and attribution reporting can be trusted
  • Follow reporting governance for AI-generated queries and reports, validating results before they are shared broadly

Team Support & Enablement

  • Serve as a supporting point of contact for campaign requests and Marketo/Salesforce questions from the marketing team
  • Document processes, templates, and best practices in team playbooks
  • Contribute to system projects, tool evaluations, and process improvements across the martech stack alongside the Director and Marketing Operations Manager

What You Bring

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, or CRM administration, ideally in B2B technology or SaaS
  • Hands-on experience building campaigns in Marketo (or a similar platform such as HubSpot, Eloqua, or Pardot, with a strong interest in Marketo)
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce objects, including leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, and reports
  • Comfort working with data in Excel or Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, cleansing large lists)
  • Strong attention to detail and a QA-first mindset
  • Clear communicator who can manage multiple requests and deadlines with marketers, SDRs, Sales, and RevOps across regions

jobs.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation.  

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy– The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity – We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights – one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure – We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless – Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency – Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence – We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

Project Manager

About the role:

Evio and the six health plans we represent are uniquely positioned in the market and have demonstrated success in creating innovative partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers. As the regulatory environment for health plans, PBMs/GPOs, and manufacturers rapidly evolves over the next several years, Evio is expanding our direct manufacturer contracting capabilities and growing the team supporting this work.

The Project Manager role will drive execution across the Medication Contracting portfolio and major strategic initiatives. You’ll translate priorities into integrated project plans, coordinate cross-functional dependencies, maintain visibility into milestones, risks, decisions, and commitments, and help move contracting opportunities from strategy and negotiation through health-plan adoption and implementation.

An ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized problem solver who is comfortable creating structure in a fast-moving environment, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, and driving work forward independently. Over time, this role is expected to grow into broader ownership of complex programs, portfolio governance, and operating model improvements.

What you’ll do:

In this role, you will partner closely with the Medication Contracting Chief of Staff, contracting team, health-plan partners, and cross-functional Evio teams to:

  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans for priority Medication Contracting initiatives, including milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, decision points, risks, and target completion dates.
  • Own and continuously improve Medication Contracting portfolio-management processes and support improvements to CRM capabilities, including workflows, opportunity stages, automation, reporting, templates, governance standards, and team practices, in partnership with the Chief of Staff and other system and process owners. Coordinate regular portfolio updates from negotiators and functional owners, identify gaps or emerging risks, and ensure actions and decisions are documented and completed.
  • Partner with Clinical Strategy Leads to connect individual health-plan priorities to the broader Medication Contracting strategy and coordinate the activities required to advance priority opportunities
  • Lead weekly Medication Contracting stand-ups, including preparing agendas, aligning the team on priorities, reviewing milestones and dependencies, surfacing risks and decisions requiring escalation, and tracking commitments through completion.
  • Partner with the Medication Contracting Chief of Staff and Business Analyst to maintain operating metrics and reporting related to portfolio health, milestone performance, contracting cycle time, health-plan adoption, implementation readiness, and value realization.
  • Coordinate the development of QBR, board, and other executive-governance materials by managing timelines, gathering and validating inputs, identifying material risks and decisions for leadership attention, and tracking commitments resulting from governance discussions.
  • Support change management for new Medication Contracting capabilities, including stakeholder coordination, process documentation, training, tool adoption, feedback collection, and reinforcement of new ways of working.
  • Lead selected workstreams and process-improvement initiatives independently, with the opportunity to take on more complex programs, portfolio-management activities, and operating-model improvements over time.

Your skills and experience:

  • Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects or programs, with strong project-management discipline and the ability to translate strategic priorities into clear workplans, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and decisions
  • Experience designing, configuring, and improving CRM capabilities to support unique business processes, including translating workflow needs into fields, stages, automation, reporting, governance, and user requirements rather than simply administering an out-of-the-box platform.
  • Experience applying AI and automation to business workflows to reduce manual work, improve information capture and decision support, and increase team efficiency; comfortable partnering with technical and business stakeholders to implement and refine solutions
  • Comfort working with data, operating metrics, and reporting to understand portfolio performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex business information, data, decisions, and recommendations into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for senior leadership, board, and governance audiences.
  • Experience supporting the implementation of new processes, tools, capabilities, or operating models, including documentation, training, stakeholder engagement, and adoption.

Compensation:

Anticipated annual base pay range: $110,000 - $130,000 plus additional variable compensation.

At Evio, we’re committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract and retain top talent that is aligned with our culture, mission and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunities depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire. Evio also offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidate experience, and market and business considerations.

How we take care of you:

  • Great Health InsuranceThe company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match
    Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off
    We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave

Fraud Notice

We’ve recently learned of fraudulent job postings and individuals falsely claiming to represent Evio. Protecting our candidates is incredibly important to us, and we want to share a few reminders:
  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.
If you believe you’ve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance — we’re grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy notice Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.
