jobs.title: Middle Years Program Lead (Trailblazers)
jobs.excerpt: 👋 About Boundless LifeBoundless Life helps families live, work and learn together while exploring the world.
jobs.description:
👋 About Boundless Life

Boundless Life helps families live, work and learn together while exploring the world. We provide family-friendly homes, an education program that travels with the family, and a community of like-minded families in every destination.

Since our founding in 2021, we've grown to eight locations across Europe, Asia and Latin America, with a team of more than 200 people, and expanded our curriculum to cover children from the age of 18 months to 14 years.

Our Education Centres sit at the heart of it all, combining project-based and place-based learning for families who want more than a traditional school can offer.

🙌 The role

Education at Boundless Life places equal emphasis on academic and social-emotional skills, developing students who know themselves and their passions, can relate to others with empathy and compassion, and are true global citizens ready to make a difference in the world.

Trailblazers is our rapidly expanding Middle Years program, soon to be taught in six destinations globally. The program combines engaging project-based learning (Quests) rooted in the local environment with core academics delivered online, all underpinned by our global framework of standards and competencies.

This unique combination allows students to follow their passions, solve real-world problems, and fully experience the place they're living in, while opening up a new world of flexibility for families wishing to live a more global life.

As Middle Years Program Lead (Trailblazers), you'll be responsible for end-to-end program design, creating both the content and the global systems needed to ensure excellent delivery at scale for our unique community of learners.

Working closely with our Education Centre Directors (ECDs), educators, and other Program Leads, you'll be responsible not only for how students progress academically but also for how they grow as people.

Location & Travel

  • Location: Ideally based in one of our Boundless Life destinations in Europe. Remote candidates will also be considered, provided they can regularly work during European hours.
  • Travel: This role requires significant and regular travel across Boundless Life destinations to support program implementation, collaborate with local teams, and ensure consistent quality across locations.

Primary Responsibilities

Curriculum & Program Design

  • Own end-to-end design and implementation of the Trailblazers curriculum and all associated resources, built from the Boundless 8 competencies outwards.
  • Design unique and engaging project-based and place-based learning experiences that use each destination as a classroom.
  • Ensure the curriculum works as a coherent whole with the rest of the Boundless Continuum, while integrating the unique developmental needs and challenges of the age group.
  • Engage and manage freelance curriculum designers as needed to ensure all program goals are met.

Assessment & Learner Progress

  • Design the assessment approach for Trailblazers, covering both academic progress and social-emotional growth.
  • Capture and use learner data and feedback to identify gaps and continuously improve the design and implementation of the program.
  • Ensure systems are in place to enable consistent communication of student progress to relevant stakeholders across all locations.

Quality & Consistency at Scale

  • Set a clear, shared standard of what excellent Trailblazers delivery looks like.
  • Ensure policies and practices align with accreditation (WASC) requirements and any country-specific legal or regulatory constraints.
  • Design and deliver professional development that equips educators across all destinations to deliver Trailblazers effectively.
  • Collaborate with ECDs and build professional development systems that scale across multiple sites and new launches, ensuring quality does not depend on your direct presence.

Online Academics & Educational Technology

  • Select, evaluate, and manage the online education providers delivering Trailblazers' core subjects.
  • Lead the rollout of new educational technology in classrooms across multiple sites.
  • Collaborate with educational technology developers and internal product teams, providing meaningful input into the design of future in-house learning tools.

Implementation Across Destinations

  • Support ECDs and the Head of Education Excellence in implementing Trailblazers effectively across all aspects of the classroom experience: academic, social-emotional, and behavioural.
  • Support Trailblazers launches in new locations, ensuring consistent experiences for students and families regardless of destination.
  • Travel regularly to destinations to understand our student population, gather on-the-ground feedback, support educators, and strengthen program delivery.
  • Act as the go-to Trailblazers expert for colleagues across Education, Real Estate, Interior Design, Admissions, Sales, and Marketing.

💥 What's in it for you

  • Meaningful impact – Help shape an innovative Middle Years education program that supports children's academic and personal growth.
  • Curriculum innovation – Lead the development of project-based and place-based learning experiences across global destinations.
  • Global collaboration – Work alongside educators, education leaders, and cross-functional teams in an international environment.
  • Professional growth – Play a key role in shaping and scaling a rapidly expanding program.
  • Family benefits – Enjoy discounted tuition for your children at our Boundless Schools.

Take a look at our policies and benefits here.

🫶 About you

Qualifications & Experience

  • Deep expertise in project-based learning, with several years of experience designing and delivering it successfully.
  • Deep expertise in curriculum development, including the successful implementation of new curricula.
  • Experience driving continuous improvement in teaching and learning at scale, across multiple sites or locations.
  • Strong experience selecting online education providers and rolling out educational technology across multiple classrooms or sites.
  • Ideally, experience contributing to the development of online learning tools, such as collaborating with educational technology developers or providing substantial input into product design.
  • Strong understanding of Middle Years learners, both academically and developmentally.
  • Experience designing and implementing High School programs is a significant advantage, as we look to expand into these age groups in the future.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across our global destinations.

How You Work

  • Collaborative – You build programs with people, not for them, working closely with educators, ECDs, designers, and external partners.
  • Cross-functional – You work comfortably across Education, Product, Operations, Admissions, and Marketing, ensuring alignment around the Trailblazers program.
  • Whole-child focused – You care as much about student wellbeing and social-emotional growth as you do about academic achievement.
  • Built for scale – You design systems, resources, and training that work across multiple destinations, not just one.
  • Global start-up mindset – You thrive in a fast-moving environment where building systems and processes from scratch is part of the challenge.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory enhanced criminal records check or equivalent.

✨ What's next?

  • First call with our Recruitment team (30 min).
  • Interview with our Program Learning & Design team (60 min).
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (60 min).
  • Final check-in with senior leadership, if required (60 min).

Our final steps include reference checks and a personality assessment. The assessment isn't used to evaluate your candidacy—it's a tool to help us work well together from day one.

The process might change slightly as we go along, and we'll keep you posted at all times.

Want to know more about working at Boundless Life? Check out our story!

jobs.description:
HKA is a global leader in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, and expert witness services. We tackle complex challenges with our multi-disciplinary expertise.

As trusted consultants and advisors, we deliver solutions in uncertain and disputed situations, ensuring the best outcomes for clients worldwide. Our experts have testified globally on major cases spanning across a wide range of industries and sectors.

As part of the HKA team you can expect:

  • A strong collaborative culture with a mutual pursuit of your success alongside the success of our teams.

  • The opportunity to solve problems creatively, contribute to our innovative direction, and be valued as an individual

  • The ability to leverage HKA’s strong network and presence in various industries and reputation for exceptional expert witnesses to accelerate career development and connections.

The Opportunity

HKA is seeking an experienced forensic mechanical engineering expert witness to provide consulting and testimony on complex engineering and technical disputes across the United States.

This role will independently lead client engagements and forensic investigations involving mechanical systems and equipment, develop and defend expert opinions, and work directly with attorneys and clients throughout litigation, arbitration, and trial.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a mechanical engineering expert witness in litigation, arbitration, and other dispute proceedings.

  • Lead forensic investigations involving mechanical equipment and systems, failures, defects, performance issues, and other disputed technical matters.

  • Conduct site investigations and analyze physical evidence, engineering documents, testing, operating data, maintenance records, and other evidence to determine causation and responsibility.

  • Develop independent expert opinions and prepare clear, defensible expert reports, rebuttals, and exhibits.

  • Provide and defend expert testimony in depositions, arbitration, and trial, including under cross-examination.

  • Work directly with attorneys, clients, and other experts on technical case issues and opposing expert opinions.

  • Evaluate mechanical design, equipment specification, installation, testing, commissioning, operation, and maintenance where relevant to an investigation.

  • Provide expertise involving rotating machinery and mechanical equipment, including turbines, compressors, pumps, motors/drives, fans, blowers, and related systems.

  • Build client relationships and contribute to the continued growth of HKA’s forensic mechanical engineering practice.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.

  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • 10+ years of mechanical engineering experience, including experience with rotating equipment and the design, specification, testing, commissioning, operation, or maintenance of mechanical systems.

  • Experience across power, oil and gas, chemical/process, manufacturing, water/wastewater, or other industrial facilities.

  • Experience in forensic engineering and litigation consulting, including technical investigations and development of independent expert opinions.

  • Expert witness experience, including live testimony in at least one court trial within the past four years. Deposition testimony, expert reports, trial preparation, or designation as an expert without trial testimony do not satisfy this requirement.

  • Experience working directly with attorneys and clients on complex litigation and dispute matters.

  • Experience developing client relationships and contributing to business development.

Our Global Recruitment team is committed to providing an authentic candidate experience for all those who take the time to apply to HKA. We are committed to providing an efficient and insightful recruitment process giving candidates a true reflection of life at HKA.

In this hands-on role, you will run the day-to-day treasury and tax operations of EDB’s global business across multiple entities, banks and currencies, owning payment approval oversight and bank portal access and signatory governance, coordinating US indirect tax compliance with our external providers, and supporting cash management and investments, corporate income tax and transfer pricing. You will partner closely across our Controllership team, as well as FP&A, Legal and our external tax advisors.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with EDB’s senior Finance leadership, with high visibility and a genuine position of influence over critical functions.

The ideal candidate is a controls-minded treasury and tax professional who has personally run payment, banking and indirect tax operations for a multi-entity, multi-currency business, takes ownership without needing direction, and keeps a lean function accurate, secure and audit-ready.

What your impact will be:

Payment Controls & Treasury Operations

  • Oversee the approval workflow for payments across global bank accounts, ensuring payments are in compliance with approval limits, segregation of duties and company policy.
  • Own the payment request process, escalate unusual or out-of-policy requests, and work with banks and internal stakeholders to resolve rejected, delayed or failed payments.
  • Maintain the payment approval matrices and authority limits.
  • Schedule and execute debt service payments, including interest, repayments and agency fees.
  • Support the bank reconciliations process, resolve treasury-related queries, and support internal and external audit requests related to treasury controls.

Bank Administration & Access Controls

  • Process user access updates for bank portals and treasury systems based on leadership approvals, applying role-based permissions on the principle of least privilege.
  • Remove access promptly for leavers and role changes, and perform periodic user access reviews across all banking platforms.
  • Partner with Legal to add or remove authorized signatories, preparing and tracking board resolutions, incumbency certificates and bank mandates.
  • Own day-to-day bank KYC and AML requirements, including account openings, periodic refreshes and lender requests, partnering with Legal on entity documentation.
  • Maintain an up-to-date signatory register across all entities, accounts and banks.

Cash Management & Investments

  • Partner with FP&A on the consolidated 13-week cash flow forecast, reviewing bank data feeds for accuracy and providing insight on cash positioning, timing and opportunities to optimize liquidity.
  • Coordinate intercompany funding across EDB’s global entities, assessing entity-level cash needs, executing funding movements and maintaining the funding log, working with regional accounting teams.
  • Execute approved short-term cash investments, including money market and deposit activity, monitoring yields, liquidity and counterparty exposure.
  • Prepare regular treasury reporting for senior leadership, covering cash position, liquidity, investments and bank counterparty exposure.
  • Champion automation and AI to continuously improve treasury and tax processes, documentation and controls.

Tax Operations

  • Prepare data and coordinate filings for US sales and use tax, including returns, nexus monitoring and new state registrations, and support indirect tax compliance globally.
  • Prepare corporate income tax estimates, and execute and track tax payments, including withholding tax on cross-border payments.
  • Coordinate R&D tax credit claims with our external advisors, gathering qualifying payroll, contractor and project data from Engineering and People.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for our external tax providers, managing data requests and deadlines, and helping us use them more efficiently.
  • Support intercompany settlements in line with our transfer pricing policy.
  • Take a leading role on indirect tax matters for acquisitions and integrations, and support ad hoc tax and transfer pricing projects.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in treasury, tax or a closely related finance role in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  • Strong understanding of payment controls, segregation of duties and user access governance.
  • Experience preparing bank documentation (KYC, mandates, incumbency certificates, signatory changes) across multiple banking partners and jurisdictions.
  • Familiarity with cross-border payments, withholding tax, intercompany settlements and short-term cash investments.
  • Advanced Excel skills; experience with Avalara & NetSuite strongly preferred
  • Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed technology company strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related discipline

What will give you an edge:

  • Hands-on experience overseeing payment approval workflows and administering multi-bank portals; CitiDirect or comparable platforms a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with US sales and use tax compliance, including multi-state registrations and filings; exposure to global indirect tax (VAT/GST) a plus.
  • Experience with Pigment or a comparable planning tool a plus.
  • Professional qualification in treasury (AMCT or CTP), tax (CTA, or IPT’s CMI in sales and use tax) or accounting (CPA, ACA, ACCA or CIMA), completed or in progress, a plus.

jobs.excerpt: FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions.
jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity


Come join our engineering team in a hands-on technical role at the heart of a new discipline: Harness Engineering. As AI coding agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness). As a Senior Harness Engineer you'll independently own whole harness subsystems, set the standards other engineers build to, and be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of turning raw model capability into production-grade engineering.


What You’ll Contribute

  • Design, build, deploy, and support core components of the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role focused on systems and leverage, not hand-writing application code.
  • Own and evolve feedforward guides - agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods - and drive team-wide standardisation so agents get it right the first time.
  • Build feedback sensors - custom linters, static analysis, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers.
  • Own quality gating and release criteria for agent-produced work, defining authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided and the escalation rules for what must route to a human.
  • Establish LLM testing infrastructure and evaluation approaches that ensure AI-generated output meets quality and safety thresholds; apply consumer/contract testing (e.g. Pact) where service integration reliability matters.
  • Run the steering loop - when an agent repeats a mistake, engineer a control so it can't happen again - and treat repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) as the system of record, fighting drift with continuous garbage collection.
  • Decide where each control runs in the path to production - fast checks pre-commit, more expensive checks post-integration, and continuous sensors that scan for drift outside the change lifecycle - keeping quality as far left as is economical.
  • Improve observability into agent work and track the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate - using them to decide where to invest next.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls.
  • Serve as a source of technical expertise and mentor engineers across teams in harness practices and the effective, responsible use of AI tools.

What We’re Seeking

  • Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related disciplines, or relevant commercial experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing.
  • Seasoned software engineer with experience in large, complex codebases and a strong foundation in architecture and design; you care deeply about testing and maintainability.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Proven ability to build engineering tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerised build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - plus familiarity with agent instruction conventions such as AGENTS.md.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - you'd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode "what good looks like" into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Experience owning quality-gating processes and defining release criteria to ensure engineering standards are consistently met.
  • Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails for agent actions - and how to design least-privilege guardrails around them.
  • Experience with consumer/contract testing approaches (e.g. Pact) to validate service integrations across distributed systems.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to articulate design with architects and drive standards across teams.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role:

We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Technology organization. This role sits in the middle of everything. You won't own one corner of one product: you'll work across all of Sword's care solutions, on the experiences members touch every day.

It is deeply member facing. What you ship will be seen, used and felt by our members every day, and it will shape how they experience Sword as a whole, not as a set of separate programs.

AI is the foundation of how we build. You'll shape AI-native experiences that make care feel personal, simple and always there, and you'll use AI every day to discover, prototype and ship faster.

This is a role for an owner. We want someone who treats outcomes as theirs, closes every loop, and communicates so clearly that everyone around them knows where things stand and why.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the outcome, end to end. Define the roadmap and execution for a member-facing area that spans every care solution, and be accountable for the results it delivers;
  • Work across everything. Partner with product, design, engineering, clinical, data and growth teams across all solutions to turn many moving parts into one simple, cohesive member experience;
  • Build AI-native experiences. Use AI as the foundation, not an add-on, to reinvent how members get care, stay engaged and make progress;
  • Stay close to members. Run continuous discovery, read real member conversations and feedback, and let evidence, not opinion, drive priorities;
  • Ship fast and learn faster. Prototype, experiment and iterate quickly, and prove impact with clear metrics such as activation, engagement and retention;

  • Member-first mindset: Deep empathy for users, and the instinct to turn complexity into simple, cohesive experiences;
  • Outcome orientation: Fluency in KPIs like activation, engagement and retention, and the habit of proving impact with data;
  • Bias for action: You thrive in ambiguity, decide fast, and validate assumptions early.

ABOUT CUSO INTERNATIONAL

Cuso International (Cuso) is a Canadian-founded and led global development organization dedicated to addressing poverty and creating opportunities for equity. At Cuso, we believe in the transformative power of collaboration and action. For over six decades, we have worked alongside communities - in Canada and around the world – to create sustainable change, fostering g economic growth, social well-being, and resilience.

Cuso’s partnership model helps build bridges between governments, community organizations, private sector actors, volunteers, investors and equity-deserving groups. Through our innovative programs, dedicated volunteers, and strong partnerships, we support communities with the tools, education, and resources to build brighter futures for everyone.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Cuso International is undergoing a period of renewal and growth. To respond to a rapidly evolving international cooperation landscape, the organization is integrating its program development and implementation functions more closely, strengthening portfolio leadership, and aligning systems for greater impact and scale.

The Program and Partnership Coordinator supports the organization's program development and partnership objectives by conducting opportunity scanning and research, coordinating program initiative development processes, supporting the cultivation of corporate and other partnerships for Cuso’s work, and maintaining pipeline, partnerships and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

The Coordinator proactively manages partnership and funding opportunity pipelines by maintaining accurate CRM records, monitoring engagement progress, tracking follow-up actions and key milestones, and ensuring timely coordination and accountability to advance opportunities.

The role also facilitates coordination across teams and provides administrative and operational support to advance strategic growth and engagement efforts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Proposal Development & Information Management:

  • Assist in compiling, reviewing, and editing proposal components and annexes, ensuring compliance with donor requirements and organizational standards.
  • Maintain donor submission platforms and ensure administrative, due diligence, and organizational documentation remains up to date.
  • Track proposal pipelines, submission schedules, deadlines, and key deliverables.
  • Facilitate information sharing across teams to support timely proposal development and decision-making processes.
  • Manage and update pipeline and corporate engagement decision management systems, ensuring Go No Gos and other processes are well followed, with decisions documented.

Team Coordination & Process Management:

  • Coordinate workflows and timelines across program development, technical, and operational teams.
  • Maintain internal trackers, workplans, dashboards, and reporting tools to support business development and partnership activities.
  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, document action items, and monitor follow-up actions.
  • Support coordination of internal planning sessions, workshops, team meetings and other team processes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, processes, and tools that support program development, and partnership management.

Opportunity Scanning, Research & Market Intelligence:

  • Conduct research on institutional donors, corporations, and other prospective and current partners to identify funding, and partnership opportunities.
  • Monitor emerging opportunities and partnership prospects.
  • Prepare meeting notes, partner profiles, and other materials to support engagement with donors, corporate partners, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Maintain knowledge resources, templates, databases, and trackers.

Partnership & Client Relationship Coordination:

  • Support the identification, cultivation, and stewardship of corporate, institutional, and strategic partners for programming.
  • Maintain accurate records of program partner interactions, engagement plans, opportunities, and follow-up actions.
  • Manage and update CRM and partnership management systems, ensuring information is current, actionable, and supports relationship development.
  • Track partnership pipelines and engagement progress, including prospecting, relationship development, proposal stages, and post-award follow-up.
  • Generate reports, dashboards, and partner intelligence to support decision-making, relationship management, and corporate engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate partner outreach activities, meetings, and communications in collaboration with program development, and leadership teams.

Administrative & Operational Support:

  • Coordinate logistics donor meetings, corporate partner meetings, networking events, workshops, webinars, and partnership engagement activities.
  • Prepare documents, presentations, reports, and other materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide travel administration support, including travel planning, expense tracking, visa coordination, and logistics.
  • Prepare requisitions and supporting documentation for procurement and payment processing.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the Director, Program Development.

QUALIFICATION

  • Minimum three to five years of relevant professional experience supporting program development, business development, partnerships, fundraising, grant management, or related functions in the international development, non-profit, or private sector.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting research, opportunity scanning, partner mapping, and market intelligence.
  • Experience supporting proposal and partnership development processes, including coordinating inputs, compiling documentation, tracking deadlines, and ensuring compliance with donor requirements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining accurate records, pipelines, engagement plans, and reporting tools.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating meetings, workshops, and events.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and CRM tools.
  • English and French bilingualism is essential. Professional proficiency in Spanish is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Overview

Hypori is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform gives users access to enterprise apps and data from any mobile device, with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, we are expanding into new commercial and regulated markets.

Hypori is looking for a hands-on, customer-obsessed Technical Account Manager focused on our federal accounts to join our Customer Success team. You will be the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of commercial customers, owning the technical relationship from deployment through adoption, optimization, and renewal. You will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Support, Sales, and report to the SVP of Customer Success.

Hypori is proven at scale. More than 95,000 Department of War users are on the platform today, the Army runs BYOD on it, and we hold IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, and CMMC 2.0 Level 2. As we grow into financial services, healthcare, and the Defense Industrial Base, the person in this seat makes sure every customer environment is configured right, fully adopted, and ready to expand.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of commercial and federal customers
  • Guide customers through deployment, configuration, and onboarding across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments
  • Advise on identity and access integration, including SSO, SAML, PIV/CAC, and directory services, along with app delivery, device policies, and network configuration
  • Own technical escalations, working with Support, Engineering, and Product to drive issues to resolution and keep customers informed throughout
  • Lead technical check-ins, platform health reviews, and the technical portion of QBRs alongside the Customer Success Manager
  • Monitor usage and environment health to spot risk early, and recommend optimizations that drive adoption
  • Provide the configuration evidence and documentation security officers need for ATO, accreditation, and compliance reviews
  • Plan and coordinate upgrades and new releases within each customer’s change control process
  • Train customer administrators and systems integrator staff so their teams become self-sufficient
  • Bring customer feature requests and technical feedback to Product and Engineering, and advocate for what customers need
  • Identify expansion opportunities and support renewals with Customer Success and Sales
  • Build reusable assets such as runbooks, deployment guides, and knowledge base articles

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering, or a similar post-sale technical role in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise IT and security, including identity and access management (SSO, SAML, MFA), networking, and Linux or Windows administration
  • Experience deploying or supporting cloud-based solutions on AWS, Azure, or government cloud environments
  • Track record of managing escalations across a portfolio of enterprise or government accounts
  • Able to explain technical topics clearly to administrators, security teams, and executives
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence
  • Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship
  • Required active Secret clearance with ability to get TS
  • Location: remote or hybrid with travel up to 20% percent to customer sites

Who You Are

  • Speed: You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week
  • Focus: You spend your time on the issues and accounts that matter most to customer outcomes
  • Extreme ownership: Your customers, your environments, your escalations. No excuses
  • Accountability: You do what you say, when you say. You flag risks early, to your team and your customer
  • Coachability: You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better
  • Humility: You know what you don’t know, and you say so
  • Creativity: You find new ways to solve technical problems and keep customers successful

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience supporting the Department of War, Intelligence Community, or federal civilian agencies
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, DISA STIGs, DoD Zero Trust, or CMMC
  • Experience with mobile, BYOD, VDI, MDM (such as Intune or Workspace ONE), or zero trust deployments
  • Security or cloud certifications such as Security+, CISSP, AWS, or Azure
  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS company

About Us

Compensation: $130,000 – $160,000 base salary (commensurate with experience), 10% annual performance bonus.

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you will provide front-line technical support across Lightspeed’s product suite. You’ll work directly with customers to diagnose issues, guide product configuration, and collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to resolve complex challenges.

jobs.description:
Product Designer (UX/UI + Design Systems | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Mexico
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end product experience across modern web and mobile applications.

This is a product-focused design role that goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, UI design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive, high-performing digital products that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into polished, developer-ready experiences while continuously optimizing products through research, analytics, and experimentation.

If you think in user journeys, product flows, and scalable systems—not just screens—this role is for you.

Responsibilities

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user journeys, workflows, and user flows.
  • Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
  • Leverage product analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to inform design decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to validate assumptions and prioritize user needs.

UX/UI Design

  • Design wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Create responsive experiences across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deliver polished, user-centered designs aligned with modern SaaS design principles.
  • Produce developer-ready assets using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and user insights.

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Establish standards for typography, spacing, color systems, iconography, and interaction patterns.
  • Ensure consistency across products, features, and customer touchpoints.
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through standardized design practices.

Accessibility & User Experience

  • Design accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1 standards.
  • Ensure responsive usability across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Improve navigation, information architecture, and interaction design.
  • Create intuitive experiences that reduce friction and improve engagement.

Product Optimization & Experimentation

  • Conduct A/B testing on user flows, layouts, and interaction patterns.
  • Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics.
  • Optimize conversion, engagement, onboarding, and retention through iterative improvements.
  • Continuously refine designs using analytics, usability testing, and customer feedback.

Collaboration & Developer Handoff

  • Work closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Deliver developer-ready specifications using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools.
  • Create clear interaction documentation, design specifications, and implementation guidance.
  • Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and product discussions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You think like a product designer—not just a visual designer.
  • You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
  • You enjoy solving complex product problems through thoughtful design.
  • You use research and data to guide design decisions.
  • You’re collaborative, organized, and comfortable working in Agile environments.
  • You care deeply about usability, accessibility, and scalable design systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • Product thinking
    • High-quality UI execution
    • Responsive product design
  • Proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Accessibility standards
    • Usability testing
    • Responsive design
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS products
    • Consumer applications
    • Enterprise software
  • Experience building scalable design systems.
  • Basic front-end knowledge of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Product analytics platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • Product experiences are intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly.
  • Design systems remain scalable, consistent, and widely adopted.
  • User friction decreases while engagement and retention improve.
  • Design assets are delivered on time and developer-ready.
  • Product teams collaborate efficiently with minimal implementation issues.
  • User feedback and analytics consistently inform design improvements.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Portfolio Review & Practical Design Task
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive product experiences, enjoy solving user problems through research and thoughtful design, and want to help build scalable SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape digital experiences that users love.

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:

How Will You Make an Impact?

Our Instrument and Enterprise Services organization is externally known as Unity Lab Services, Thermo Fisher Scientific’s integrated service offering that helps customers maximize instrument uptime, improve laboratory productivity, and achieve their scientific and operational goals.

As the Senior Director & General Manager, North America Instrument & Enterprise Services, you will lead the North America Service Organization supporting the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry Division.

This is a high-impact leadership role with accountability for profitable growth, service delivery, operational excellence, customer experience, and organizational development across North America. You will shape the regional service strategy, strengthen customer allegiance, and help ensure Unity Lab Services continues to be recognized as a differentiated, trusted, and essential partner for our customers.

This role is U.S.-based remote, with a preference for candidates located on or near the East Coast. Regular travel across North America and globally will be required, up to approximately 50% of working time, including overnight travel.

This role reports to the Vice President, Global Instrument Service.

What Will You Do?

Strategic & Business Leadership

  • Lead the North America Service Organization supporting the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry Division, with accountability for organic growth, operational performance, customer experience, and full P&L delivery.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans that expand service revenue, improve profitability, increase customer share of wallet, and strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position in Research and Applied markets.
  • Position Unity Lab Services as a strategic differentiator by connecting service performance to customer outcomes such as uptime, productivity, compliance, method readiness, workflow continuity, and lifecycle value.
  • Translate customer insights, market dynamics, competitive trends, and business priorities into clear strategies that enable growth, differentiation, and operational excellence.

Operational Excellence & Execution

  • Lead Field Service, Technical Support, Service Sales, and related service functions to deliver consistent, high-quality service execution across North America.
  • Ensure service operations meet the needs of customers across Research and Applied segments, where responsiveness, technical expertise, and reliability are essential to customer success.
  • Use dashboards, standard work, data-driven management practices, and continuous improvement methods to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.
  • Champion the use of digital, connected, and AI-enabled capabilities to transform service operations, improve productivity, enhance customer experience, and create differentiated value.

Commercial & Customer Excellence

  • Partner closely with Commercial, Divisional, and Business Unit teams to ensure Unity Lab Services offerings are aligned to customer needs, market opportunities, and CMD growth priorities.
  • Strengthen customer allegiance by improving service delivery, responsiveness, quality, and measurable customer experience outcomes.
  • Ensure customer agreements and service commitments are structured for effective, profitable execution while meeting or exceeding customer expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand service attachment, contract penetration, renewal performance, and lifecycle value across the North America installed base.
  • Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services with key customers, including strategic and enterprise accounts, helping build trust, resolve complex business challenges, and reinforce our value as a service partner.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a large, geographically dispersed North America service organization.
  • Build an inclusive, high-performing culture where colleagues feel valued, empowered, and accountable for delivering strong customers and business outcomes.
  • Develop a robust and diverse pipeline of future leaders through talent planning, coaching, succession planning, and career development.
  • Model Thermo Fisher Scientific’s 4i Values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement in daily leadership and decision-making.

How Will You Get Here?

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree such as an MBA, or equivalent leadership and business experience, preferred.

Experience

  • Significant senior leadership experience in a complex service, operations, commercial, or general management environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and delivering P&L performance, including revenue growth, margin expansion, productivity improvement.
  • Experience supporting Research and Applied markets is critical, with a strong understanding of customer needs, workflows, buying behaviors, operational environments, and service expectations across these segments.
  • Knowledge of chromatography, mass spectrometry, analytical instruments, laboratory workflows, or related scientific technologies is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting enterprise, strategic, or multi-site customer accounts.
  • Experience applying PPI, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies to improve operational and commercial outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong strategic thinking and execution skills, with the ability to convert complex business challenges into clear priorities and measurable action plans.
  • Highly developed commercial acumen, including the ability to identify growth opportunities, improve profitability, and strengthen customer value.
  • Data-driven decision maker with the ability to analyze complex issues, synthesize insights, and make confident decisions in ambiguous situations.

jobs.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
jobs.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

About the Social Media Manager at Sword:

Sword recently acquired Headspace!

Headspace helped make mental health something people talk about online. Now we’re looking for a Social Media Manager to write its next chapter. In this role, you’ll own Headspace’s organic social presence end to end. You’ll have real creative freedom to show up for more than 4 million followers across Instagram, TikTok, Threads and LinkedIn, and to bring a brand that’s already strong on social media into a new era.

You’re a strategist and a writer first, as comfortable shaping a quarterly channel strategy and jumping into a trending format the same afternoon, and you love staying close to the work. Reporting to our Brand Marketing Lead, you’ll partner closely with marketing leadership, brand creative, content, comms, product marketing, partnerships, and a small, talented social team.

What you will do:

  • Own organic social channel strategy end to end: the place where millions of people meet our brand for the first time. Set the platform vision, audience goals, and content pillars that support Headspace’s brand and business objectives.
  • Lead Headspace’s voice on social. Concept and write the hooks, captions, scripts, and series that help people through life’s wobbles, and protect voice and tone in partnership with the brand creative team.
  • Tell the story of a digital product. Show how Headspace fits into people’s everyday lives, turning expert insight and research into content that feels useful, human, and trustworthy.
  • Lead monthly editorial planning. Bring themes, evergreen series, cultural moments, and cross-functional priorities together into one channel calendar, and choose focused, brand-defining work over volume.
  • Serve as the organic social channel lead for campaigns. Develop social-first concepts, lead brainstorms, and build content plans and measurement for key campaigns and brand-partner collaborations.
  • Drive cultural participation. Keep a finger on the pulse of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and cultural moments, moving beyond reactive trendjacking toward intentional cultural relevance.
  • Grow community engagement. Design formats that invite participation, turn social listening and comment insights into future content, and test new approaches to deepen engagement. Co-own escalation protocols and safe-messaging standards for sensitive conversations.
  • Set the quality bar. Give final review for craft, voice, and brand consistency, so the grid looks as good as it reads.
  • Drive social analytics and reporting. Own the quarterly social report and partnership benchmarks, turn performance data into clear recommendations, and partner on a small organic boosting budget.

What you will bring:

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in social media strategy and content.
  • Exceptional copywriting skills: you write in a brand’s voice, not a template’s.
  • Strong creative strategy: you develop social-first ideas that ladder up to business goals, and you can sell them to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a brand’s organic social channel, with measurable audience, engagement, or brand impact. Deep fluency in Instagram, TikTok, and Threads, working literacy in LinkedIn, and experience with tools like Sprout Social, Meta Business Suite, and AI tools in creative workflows.
  • Demonstrated horizontal leadership: experience leading through influence and guiding the work of peers, freelancers, or internal teams — and an appetite to grow into people leadership over time. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; thrives in cross-functional, fast-moving environments.
  • Short-form content craft: you’ve concepted and scripted platform-native video that performed.
  • Experience with AI-powered tools to drive efficiency, creative impact, and audience resonance.
  • Strong analytical instincts: you turn channel data into specific, actionable recommendations.
  • Sound editorial judgment on sensitive topics: you know how to talk about mental health with care, and when not to post at all.
  • A genuine belief in Headspace’s mission of a world where everyone is kind to their mind.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience at a consumer health, wellness, or tech brand.
  • Experience telling the story of a digital product and its impact on people’s lives, without a physical product to show.
  • Campaign, product marketing, or content marketing experience.
  • A strong visual eye for craft and grid.
  • Working knowledge of organic-to-paid mechanics.
  • Comfortable on camera, or skilled at directing talent.
  • Experience with creator partnerships or UGC.

Location:This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with a preference for the San Francisco Bay Area.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

jobs.title: Strategy Consultant Pleno
jobs.excerpt: Por que a Valtech?  Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo.
jobs.description:
Por que a Valtech? Somos uma experience innovation company — um parceiro de confiança para as marcas mais reconhecidas do mundo. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreiras internacionais e a chance de moldar o futuro das experiências.

A oportunidade

Na Valtech, você encontra um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto significativo e crescimento profissional.
Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho ajudará a transformar indústrias.

Nós temos orgulho em anunciar:

  • O trabalho que fazemos e a inovação que fomentamos
  • Nossos valores: Compartilhar, Cuidar e Ousar
  • Um ambiente de trabalho que fomenta a criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nossa estrutura global e sem fronteiras permite uma colaboração perfeita

A vaga

Como Strategy Consultant Pleno você fará parte do time de Estratégia da área de CRM & Marketing Automation.

Sua missão será apoiar clientes e equipes técnicas no planejamento e desenho de campanhas e jornadas, trazendo uma perspectiva de marketing e estratégia de negócios para os projetos de automação.

Você vai se destacar nesta função se for:

  • Uma pessoa curiosa, com vontade de melhorar processos e buscar novas soluções
  • Colaborativo, que valoriza trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento
  • Motivado pela interseção entre tecnologia, criatividade e dados
  • Familiarizado com metodologias Ágeis e consultoria (um diferencial)


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com clientes e equipes técnicas nos projetos de CRM & Marketing Automation, com foco em estratégia e performance.
  • Pesquisar benchmarks, realizar brainstormings e desenvolver conceitos e storytelling para campanhas e jornadas.
  • Desenhar estratégias de campanhas e jornadas no Miro, incluindo fluxos e detalhes de documentação, como objetivos principais e segmentação de público.
  • Elaborar briefings para orientar as equipes criativas e revisar textos, layouts e demais materiais de campanha quando estiverem prontos, garantindo que estejam alinhados à estratégia proposta.
  • Analisar performance e boas práticas das jornadas atualmente ativas, gerando insights e propondo otimizações de estratégia, testes A/B e próximos passos.
  • Conduzir sessões de discovery, consultoria e brainstorming com clientes para compreender seus objetivos e necessidades de negócio de curto e longo prazo, além do comportamento e ciclo de vida de seus usuários.
  • Apoiar a criação, o planejamento e a priorização de roadmaps.
  • Apoiar clientes e equipes de desenvolvimento nos processos de implementação, garantindo que a entrega final atenda aos requisitos de estratégia e performance.
  • Apoiar o(a) coordenador(a) de estratégia e as equipes de delivery na criação e atualização de processos de workflow, documentações, templates de briefing, apresentações comerciais e outros materiais relacionados aos projetos de Estratégia de CRM.
  • Apoiar o onboarding e atuar como mentor(a) de estagiários, trainees e analistas juniores de estratégia, compartilhando boas práticas da área.
  • Apoiar as equipes de gestão em atividades comerciais e de parceria, contribuindo com trabalhos estratégicos em cases e apresentações.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação, preferencialmente em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Design ou áreas relacionadas; ou 6+ anos de experiência em posições de marketing.
  • 4+ anos de experiência em projetos de marketing, planejamento e/ou estratégia.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em projetos de CRM Marketing, incluindo automação e/ou campanhas pontuais.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ferramentas de automação similares.
  • Experiência com e-mail, SMS, push notification e/ou WhatsApp.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Visão de negócios e marketing holística, além de excelentes habilidades de escuta.
  • Capacidade de interpretar necessidades implícitas durante reuniões, identificar as principais dores e necessidades reais do cliente e propor estratégias concretas para solucioná-las.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado.
  • Espanhol avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência monitorando e analisando dados do Google Analytics, dashboards do Datorama, PowerBI ou Data Studio, e criando slides para apresentações de relatórios.
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência em outras áreas e canais de marketing digital (por exemplo: conteúdo, mídia social, mídia paga, site, blogs, produtos digitais, etc.)
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência configurando e implementando campanhas de CRM ou Inbound Marketing, HTML, SQL básico ou qualquer outra etapa técnica do processo de automação.
  • Experiência trabalhando em projetos digitais de grandes empresas envolvendo agências ou consultorias (como parte da equipe da agência ou da empresa cliente).

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.

Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.

Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.

Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner. 

Os benefícios

Esta é uma posição em período integral, com base no Brasil.

Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo, oferecemos:

  • Flexibilidade, com opções de trabalho remoto e híbrido (dependendo do país);
  • Desenvolvimento de carreira, com oportunidades de mobilidade internacional e programas de desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento, com acesso a ferramentas de ponta, treinamentos e especialistas do setor.

Nossos benefícios são adaptados a cada localidade. Seu Talent Partner (parceiro de recrutamento) fornecerá todos os detalhes durante o processo seletivo.


Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Quer fazer parte do próximo capítulo? Venha fazer parte do time!

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an AI Adoption & Workforce Enablement Lead to develop and deliver workforce training, practical exercises, proficiency assessments, and adoption measurement supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an AI Adoption & Workforce Enablement Lead to develop and deliver workforce training, practical exercises, proficiency assessments, and adoption measurement supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This senior-level position will help personnel apply approved AI capabilities to their daily work and interpret AI-assisted results appropriately. The lead will translate mission workflows and technical capabilities into practical learning objectives, exercises, user guidance, and measurable demonstrations of proficiency.

The AI Adoption & Workforce Enablement Lead will collaborate with Government mission owners, AI implementation teams, data and reporting specialists, training personnel, and end users. The role will assess learning needs, coordinate training with capability releases, identify adoption barriers, and measure whether personnel can use AI effectively within approved workflows.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The AI Adoption & Workforce Enablement Lead will:

  • Lead workforce AI training and enablement activities aligned with Government priorities and operational needs.
  • Assess workforce learning needs, current proficiency, role-specific requirements, and barriers to AI adoption.
  • Develop learning objectives and training plans tied to approved AI capabilities and mission workflows.
  • Create practical exercises, demonstrations, scenarios, job aids, user guides, and reusable learning materials.
  • Deliver instructor-led sessions, virtual workshops, demonstrations, coaching, and office hours.
  • Develop proficiency checks that assess whether personnel can perform relevant tasks using approved AI capabilities.
  • Establish assessment criteria, scoring guidance, completion measures, and targeted follow-up training.
  • Teach users how to interpret AI-assisted results, review supporting sources, recognize limitations, and identify outputs requiring verification.
  • Develop guidance on human judgment, review checkpoints, escalation paths, and appropriate use of AI-generated information.
  • Prepare exercises involving approved knowledge assistants, retrieval workflows, analytical tools, dashboards, and self-service reporting.
  • Coordinate with technical teams to ensure training materials accurately reflect released functionality and approved operating procedures.
  • Align training schedules and communications with pilots, releases, workflow changes, and operational priorities.
  • Define adoption measures covering participation, proficiency, recurring use, user confidence, workflow integration, and operational outcomes.
  • Establish baselines and track changes in workforce capability and adoption over time.
  • Analyze assessment results, usage information, surveys, and user feedback to identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Distinguish training completion from demonstrated proficiency and sustained operational use.
  • Coordinate targeted interventions for user groups experiencing adoption difficulties.
  • Support peer learning, train-the-trainer activities, and communities of practice.
  • Maintain training records, assessment results, adoption dashboards, feedback logs, and improvement actions.
  • Prepare Government briefings on training progress, proficiency, adoption barriers, and recommended actions.
  • Update learning materials and user guidance as AI capabilities, reporting tools, and mission workflows evolve.
  • Coordinate with the program’s broader training and knowledge management teams to maintain consistent content and delivery practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in education, instructional design, organizational development, information technology, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience developing workforce training.
  • Experience developing practical exercises.
  • Experience developing proficiency assessments.
  • Experience developing adoption measures.
  • Ability to lead workforce AI training, practical exercises, proficiency checks, and adoption measurement.
  • Ability to develop guidance that helps users interpret AI-assisted results.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner or a comparable AI fundamentals certification.
  • Instructional design certification.
  • Change-management certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense workforce training or technology adoption initiatives.
  • Experience applying adult-learning principles to technical or operational training.
  • Experience developing role-based AI learning paths and scenario-based exercises.
  • Familiarity with AI capabilities, limitations, source verification, human oversight, and responsible use.
  • Experience developing guidance for interpreting dashboards, analytical outputs, and self-service reports.
  • Experience measuring learning effectiveness, demonstrated proficiency, sustained adoption, and operational benefits.
  • Experience facilitating train-the-trainer programs, coaching sessions, or communities of practice.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems, SharePoint/Microsoft 365, survey tools, and reporting platforms.
  • Strong facilitation, instructional writing, stakeholder communication, and analytical skills.

Organization/Business Overview:

The sponsoring financial advisor is an independent financial services practice of Thrivent Financial for Lutherans. We take a broad-based approach to helping our members/customers achieve multiple financial goals. The sponsoring financial advisor helps our members analyze their current situation, develop in-depth financial programs, and help them implement an integrated financial strategy.

Meaningful work. Rewarding career.

Thrivent is a different kind of financial services firm, one that puts generosity at the center of saving and investing. Here, you’ll make an impact in the lives of the people you serve, helping them build, grow and protect financial well-being through purpose-based advice, investments, insurance, banking and generosity.

Job Description

As an Associate Financial Advisor, you’ll be a resource for our financial advisors and provide support to the clients of the sponsoring financial advisor including:

Position Roles/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Handle sensitive communications with members/customers, which may include highly confidential information and effectively respond through verbal and written communications to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction
  • Facilitate and/or co-present product specific seminars and/or workshops as necessary
  • Identify criteria for fund selection and track against indexes, specifically for WRAP accounts
  • Participate in business planning for the Practice as needed
