  • Accepting and/or entering securities trade orders from customers, including unsolicited trade orders
  • Explain, discuss or interpret insurance coverage; analyze exposures or policies; provide recommendations
  • Issue certificates of insurance, endorsements, binders, commitments, or insurance contracts
  • Assist financial representatives in the preparation and follow up for the member/customer meetings
  • Collaborate with financial representatives to assist client with product changes
  • Participate and drive marketing services including direct-mail, fraternal activities, seminars, meetings
  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with licensure and business needs

Requirements

  • Associates can be fully licensed, securities licensed, or insurance licensed. Depending on role, the associate must be:
    • Securities registered (series 7 & 66 or 6 & 63) or be willing to do so within 120 days of hire/contract.
    • Appropriately insurance licensed/appointed for sale of all life/health and variable products
  • Must be securities registered/insurance licensed/appointed in all states in which the candidate will be doing support work for the sponsoring financial advisor. Must be willing to complete appropriate state training in order to sell Long Term Care if this is determined to be a part of the position or support needs on the sponsoring financial representative.
  • Demonstrated customer service orientation/experience, 2+ years preferred
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and maintain a high quality of work while experiencing frequent interruptions
  • Ability to maintain integrity of sensitive/confidential information
  • Basic understanding of the sponsoring financial advisor our products and services, and Thrivent Financial
  • Previous administrative/secretarial experience desired

Desired Characteristics

Our culture and our people are special. We’re looking for people who are – or want to become – part of the communities where clients live, work and worship. Our ideal candidate is:

  • Planning/Organizing
  • Analytical thinker
  • Customer Focus
  • Communication
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Adaptability/Flexibility

External/Internal Dependencies

  • Must be able to work with all roles of the sponsoring financial advisor
  • Must be able to represent the organization in work with external clients
  • Must be able to cultivate and maintain relationships with outside organizations

As part of the sponsoring financial advisor recruiting/hiring/contracting process, a verification of a candidate's background will be made to complete the process. Fingerprints will be required as part of FINRA registration process for submission to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for review against nationwide fingerprint records.

About Thrivent
Thrivent is a diversified financial services organization that, with its subsidiary and affiliate companies, serves more than 2.4 million clients, offering advice, insurance, investments, banking and generosity products and programs. For more than 100 years, Thrivent has been helping Christians build their financial futures and live more generous lives. Today, Thrivent is a not-for-profit, membership-owned Fortune 500 company with $194 billion in assets under management/advisement (as of 12/31/24). Thrivent carries ratings from independent rating agencies which demonstrate the strength and stability of the organization, including an A++ rating from AM Best; an Aa2 rating from Moody's Investors Service; and an AA+ rating from S&P Global Ratings. Ratings are based on Thrivent's financial strength and claims-paying ability, but do not apply to investment product performance.

jobs.excerpt: Role type & Location• Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only • Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based Visa• We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role About this Role• Every laboratory and customer site we work with depends on a secure, reliable connection into our platform.
jobs.description:
Role type & Location

  • Full time Remote (Work from home) based either Dublin or UK only
  • Occasional Travel to Dublin office if Ireland based (Glasnevin) or UK (Oxford) if UK based

Visa

  • We regret we cannot offer Irish or UK visa sponsorship for this role

About this Role

  • Every laboratory and customer site we work with depends on a secure, reliable connection into our platform.
  • You will own that connectivity: the AWS infrastructure that links our products to laboratory and customer systems, and the secure network paths our research teams use to reach their compute. It supports a regulated clinical environment, so it must be secure, observable and recoverable
  • You will report to the Principal Engineer - Cybersecurity & DevOps and join a lean team in which each engineer owns a defined area, with no large support structure.

What This Is NOT

  • Not an IT, helpdesk or end-user support role.
  • Not an infrastructure ticket-queue role.
  • Not a product CI/CD ownership role. The DevOps team owns it, and you contribute as part of that team.
  • Not a role with hand-built servers. If it cannot be rebuilt from code, it is not finished.

About our DTO Team

  • Our Digital Trust & Transformation Office (DTO) brings together the teams that keep Deciphex trustworthy and moving forward: information security, cybersecurity, application security, DevOps, IT, data protection and privacy, AI and AI governance, and operational resilience.
  • We work to one aim: our customers, clinicians and patients can trust our systems and the data in them, and our engineers can ship safely and quickly.

Our Technology stack

  • AWS, GCP, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Mirth, Linux/Win/cloud networking/firewalling etc.

What You help us with

  • You work as part of a lean DevOps team
  • Lab Systems engineers own on-premises laboratory applications and you own the connectivity to them. Research and data science teams own their platforms and you own the secure network access to them. Cybersecurity and Data Security engineers set the security standards you implement.
  • This is a senior, hands-on role with real ownership.
  • You will set technical direction, make the design decisions, and be the person others rely on when it breaks.

This includes;

  • Run and scale our customer connectivity services on EKS, with monitoring, firewall rules and certificates.
  • Provide, as code (Terraform and Helm), the connectivity, network policy and secrets that teams need to connect new customers and laboratories. We do not use click-ops.
  • Operate and upgrade our cloud-hosted integration and laboratory platform services with high availability and backup.
  • Run disaster-recovery exercises and keep the evidence.
  • Own secure network access to our GPU and research compute across cloud providers. The research platform and ML tooling stay with the research teams.
  • Shape the shared network and connectivity layer of our AWS multi-account platform (landing zone), as part of the DevOps team.
  • Build the monitoring, flow-log analysis and alerting that finds faults before a laboratory or customer does.
  • Patch and harden the cluster, nodes and images, following the security team's standards.
  • Document the estate as code, join the on-call rota (planned changes happen outside laboratory hours), and mentor colleagues.

What You Bring

  • You will typically have 5/6++ years in DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering.
  • We care more about what you have owned and debugged in production than your job title.
  • Deep Linux/Win networking: iptables / nftables, routing, DNS and TLS. You can reason about a rule set line by line.
  • Site-to-site VPN and private connectivity (IPsec, WireGuard or OpenVPN), and tracing a failing flow with flow logs and packet capture.
  • Kubernetes in production, ideally Amazon EKS: Helm, hardened Docker images, and debugging with kubectl.
  • Infrastructure as code in production, ideally Terraform (or OpenTofu), including injecting secrets as code. We use Terraform, and you will write it from week one.
  • AWS administration at the level of trust to change VPCs, endpoints, RDS and IAM safely.
  • Disciplined production change: peer review, monitoring, runbooks and tested recovery.
  • Knowledge and experience with both Windows and Linux networking, CI/CD, secrets management and SSO or federation.
  • Experience with cloud-based healthcare integration (for example HL7 or FHIR), laboratory connectivity to cloud, GPU or research cloud environments, or a regulated environment helps but is not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • The cloud connectivity a new customer, internal team or laboratory needs is provided as code, through a predictable process, and documented.
  • Faults are found by monitoring before laboratory staff or customers report them.
  • Recovery is tested regularly, with evidence.

What are the benefits of working with Deciphex?

  • 💰 Salary with performance-based annual increases to recognise your contribution.
  • 🩺 Healthcare benefits to support your wellbeing.
  • 🌴 Annual leave plus additional Christmas leave to rest and recharge.
  • 🔬 Meaningful work that helps improve patient outcomes.
  • 🚀 A growing company where you can make your mark.
  • 💡 Varied, challenging projects to keep you learning.
  • 📈 Regular feedback and career opportunities to help you progress.
  • 🤝 A supportive, multicultural team to share ideas and learn from.

About Deciphex

Through the work that we do, the team at Deciphex helps pharma to accelerate the process of essential drug development and helps cancer patients get a timely and accurate diagnosis.

Founded in Dublin (Ireland) in 2017, Deciphex has scaled rapidly to a team of over 230 people and counting who are providing software solutions to address the pathology gap in research pathology and clinical areas. We have offices in Dublin, Exeter, Oxford, Chicago and Toronto, and are expanding our team throughout the world.

We are software developers, clinical specialists, artificial intelligence engineers, operations professionals and so much more, all working as one team to support our customers and patients.

Read more about Deciphex here and more about our team on our Careers Page here.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, religious beliefs, political views, gender identity, affectional or sexual orientation, national origin, family or marital status (including pregnancy), disability, membership of the travelling community or any other classification protected by applicable law.

Sales Executive

The Sales Executive plays a pivotal role in shaping CTC’s sales strategy and driving sustained revenue growth through consistent high value deals. This leader is a seasoned professional with a proven ability to navigate complex sales cycles, foster strong client relationships, and expertly handle objections. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and demonstrates exceptional negotiation and leadership skills

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

YOU SET THE STANDARD

The Sales Executive is responsible for driving CTC’s revenue growth by achieving and exceeding monthly and quarterly net new business targets. This role combines strategic prospecting, disciplined pipeline management, and expert deal execution to deliver consistent results. The Sales Executive sets the pace for high performance across the organization by exemplifying accountability, precision in forecasting, and a relentless focus on client acquisition.

  • Consistently meets or exceeds monthly and quarterly net new business sales goals.
  • Establishes and maintains strong pipeline discipline to ensure predictable revenue performance.
  • Applies innovative, data driven sales strategies that adapt to market trends and buyer behavior.
  • Fosters cross departmental collaboration to accelerate deal cycles and optimize client onboarding.
  • Champions a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and customer centric selling.
  • Prioritizes client needs and satisfaction throughout the sales process.

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

The Sales Executive is accountable for driving CTC’s topline expansion by securing high value, net new client partnerships within the company’s Ideal Client Profile (ICP). This role combines strategic sales acumen, proactive prospecting, and disciplined execution to consistently exceed performance benchmarks and elevate the standard for new business excellence.

  • Consistently closes high value, net new revenue deals aligned with CTC’s Ideal Client Profile (ICP).
  • Drives pipeline growth and lead generation through innovative, data informed outreach and market intelligence.
  • Executes the full sales cycle with precision, ensures strong conversion rates, and predictable revenue outcomes.
  • Embeds a customer centric mindset throughout the sales process, reinforcing CTC’s reputation for partnership, trust, and exceptional client experience.
  • Sets the benchmark for CTC excellence by achieving and surpassing quarterly performance targets.

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

The Sales Executive sets the tone for CTC’s culture of excellence through an unrelenting commitment to strategic deal making, collaboration, and continuous improvement. By demonstrating persistence, intellectual curiosity, and a drive to master their craft, this leader inspires others to elevate their performance and deliver outstanding results.

  • Demonstrates relentless determination in pursuing and closing strategic deals that drive measurable business impact.
  • Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity. Refuses to leave complex problems unsolved and continuously seeks multiple solutions.
  • Proactively refines skills and deepens expertise, consistently raising the bar for performance and professionalism.
  • Inspires peers through consistent excellence, domain mastery, and a commitment to both personal and team growth.
  • Fosters a collaborative, cross functional environment that encourages shared innovation and a customer first mindset.

What Success Looks Like

Position Specific Skills

  • Consistent Closing: Exhibits an unrelenting drive to win mixed with client satisfaction. Approaches every opportunity with focus, urgency, and discipline. Maintains a high close rate through persistence, strategic follow through, and a results oriented mindset that turns qualified prospects into long term clients.
  • Deep Customer Understanding: Demonstrates a comprehensive grasp of each client’s industry, challenges, and goals. Tailors strategies to align with business priorities and establish credibility early in the sales process.
  • Strategic Relationship Building: Cultivates and sustains long term, trust based relationships with key stakeholders, leveraging influence and rapport to drive mutual growth and enduring partnerships.
  • Consultative, Solution Oriented Selling: Goes beyond product pitching to deliver tailored, outcome driven solutions that address critical ecommerce and digital marketing challenges, ensuring measurable client impact.
  • Data Driven Lead Generation & Pipeline Growth: Develops and implements innovative, data driven strategies to uncover new leads, expand prospecting activity, and accelerate qualified pipeline development
  • Sales Strategy, Planning & Execution: Designs and executes comprehensive sales strategies for complex, multi stakeholder cycles balancing strategic planning with agile execution to exceed revenue targets.
  • Operational Excellence & Insight: Continuously refines the sales process, leverages forecasting and performance analytics, and translates insights into actionable improvements that enhance efficiency and close rates.
  • Negotiation & Market Mastery: Leads high value deal negotiations with precision and confidence, staying ahead of market trends, competitive shifts, and evolving customer needs to secure profitable, aligned outcomes.

Proven Track Record: 5-7 years of success in consistently closing high value deals in a competitive sales environment (eCommerce experience preferred)

Technical Skills

  • CRM & Sales Analytics Expertise: Highly proficient in CRM platforms (HubSpot or Salesforce) for pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and performance tracking. Adept at leveraging analytics dashboards to monitor conversion metrics and optimize sales efficiency.
  • Sales Enablement & Automation Tools: Comfortable utilizing tools (like Gong, Hubspot, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to streamline prospecting, personalize outreach, and enhance conversion rates through data backed engagement.
  • eCommerce Data Fluency: Experienced in using eCommerce and performance analytics tools such as Shopify, Triple Whale, Google Analytics, and Statlas to assess client performance, identify growth opportunities, and align sales strategies with measurable business outcomes.
  • Paid Media Platform Familiarity: Working knowledge of key digital advertising platforms including Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and YouTube Ads, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics, understand acquisition economics, and communicate ROI driven value propositions.
  • Proposal & Contract Systems: Proficient in using platforms such as Rightsignature or Google Workspace for proposal creation, legal documentation, and efficient deal execution.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Self Sufficient Deal Maker: Demonstrates the ability to independently generate leads, build relationships, and close deals without heavy reliance on inbound or marketing driven opportunities. Excels at full cycle selling: prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing.
  • Strategic Outbound Execution: Skilled in executing structured outbound campaigns that blend personalized outreach, data analysis, and creative positioning to engage ideal prospects and open new market segments.
  • Consultative Communication: Articulates complex marketing concepts in clear, outcome oriented terms. Balances storytelling with data fluency to build trust and guide executive level decision making.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility: Quickly assimilates new tools, market dynamics, and client verticals. Adjusts strategies in real time to maintain relevance and maximize impact.
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Influence: Partners effectively with internal marketing, creative, and finance teams to develop cohesive, client aligned proposals and ensure smooth post close transitions.
  • Resilience & Ownership Mindset: Operates with persistence, discipline, and accountability. Stays motivated through challenges and maintains a consistent focus on achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • This role will report directly into the VP of Sales with oversight by Chief Revenue Officer

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be primarily client facing, responsible for building and maintaining relationships with key brand stakeholders at the VP and C-Suite level. It will also collaborate closely with internal Common Thread Collective teams to develop proposals and ensure a seamless transition from deal close to account onboarding.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • $90,000 - $110,000 base salary, annually
    • This is prior to any benefits (see the “ABOUT US” Section for additional details)
  • Bonus Structure | OTE: $180,000-$200,000

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard
  2. We Are Driven To Increase Value
  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • 401K | program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
  • MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits that fit your lifestyle and goals
  • WELLNESS | A wellness reimbursement program that inspires 360 degrees of health: mentally, physically, and spiritually

CTC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We Embrace I.D.E.A. and are committed to fostering a culture of performance and inclusivity.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Teladoc Health Inc. seeks Cybersecurity Engineer III at its facility located at 155 E 44th Street, 17th Floor, New York, NY 10017.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Advance Application Security (AppSec) efforts by integrating Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and secrets scanning tools into development workflows. Contribute to DevSecOps efforts by writing basic scripts to automate security checks and monitoring vulnerabilities within the SDLC Maintain endpoint security by monitoring EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) alerts and ensuring application controls, and threat detection are correctly applied across Teladoc Health medical device fleet. Enhance Medical Device Security by assisting with risk assessments, supporting the enforcement of security controls, and participating in the documentation of compliance with safety standards. 100% Telecommuting.

REQUIREMENTS:

This position requires a bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering or a related field plus 4 years of experience as a Cybersecurity Engineer, Security Analyst or occupation involving application security and medical device security within the Healthcare Industry. Additionally, must have employment experience with: (1) Translating security findings into actionable engineering guidance; (2) Working across partner teams (DevOps and application teams to define and implement security related solutions); (3) Providing clear documentation related to design and implementation of security related controls and processes; (4) Related security platforms (AppSec, DevSecOps, and EDR); and (5) Applying security controls within medical device systems.

RATE OF PAY: $149,011.00 - $170,900.00 per year

You will also receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.description:
Come Join Our Team At Anteriad and innovate the way B2B marketers make data-driven business decisions.

About Anteriad

We are not just another B2B solution provider. We're problem solvers. We believe that data is the key to unlocking effective solutions that span a range of marketing challenges - from customer acquisition to demand generation to account-based marketing. Data is at the core of everything we do. Our team works tirelessly to create powerful solutions that drive real results for our clients. Whether it's through innovative technology or deep analysis, we're committed to finding the best path to growth for every one of our customers.

Why Join Our Intelligence & Analytics Team?

Anteriad is seeking aMarketingInsightsLead(MIL) to join our Intelligence and Analytics team.This is a client-facing seat with real ownership.You'll be the person turning their hardest marketing questions into clear, defensible recommendations.

We are trusted by enterprise clients such as IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, SHRM and Forbes, and have been recognized on Inc. 5000’s Fastest Growing Companies in the US four years running.

This is a remote position with required travel to our New York City office and client meetings as needed. Candidates must reside in the East Coast or Midwest regions and will be expected to work Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours.

This position isnot eligible for employer-visa sponsorship, including OPT.

As our MarketingInsightsLead,you'll run your own analytical work streams end-to-end, sit at the table with senior marketing stakeholders, and have the backing of an experienced team of statisticians and strategists. Your work will encompass the following:

  • Frame the problem.Translate ambiguous business questions ("why is performance down YoY?") into structured analyses with a clear hypothesis and a clear answer.
  • Run the analysis.Pull and shape the data in SQL, build the models or tests, and pressure-test your own work before anyone else sees it.
  • Tell the story.Turn statistical output into a narrativethat our clientscan act on.
  • Beatrusted partner.Build relationships with client stakeholders so that when something complex comes up, you're the first call.
  • Raise the bar. Bring better methods, sharper questions, and reusable frameworks back to the team.
  • Operate independently. Prioritize effectively, and bring strategic thinking to every engagement. The ideal candidate is both technically strong andclient-centric.
  • Curiosity, accountability, and intellectual rigor are essential. You should naturally ask “why?” and “what does this mean for the business?”.

Anteriad means “always moving forward” and we apply that to our company culture by tirelessly promoting an environment that allows our employees to thrive:

•Flexible PTO
•Training & development with unlimited access Percipio LMS
•Community outreach via Anteriad Cares - Encouraging staff to take time to volunteer
•Professional mentoring program - Career guidance from leadership
•Employee Resource Groups - Collaborate with others that share your passions!
•Great benefits for you and your family
•Certified Great Place to Work for the three consecutive years.

Benefits We Bring To You:

•Comprehensive medical (choice of 3 plans), dental and vision coverage
•Company paid short-term disability, long term disability and life insurance
•Optional supplemental life, accident and critical illness insurance plans
•401K with company match
•Flexible PTO and generous paid holiday schedule
•Fully paid primary caregiver leave (12 weeks) & parental bonding leave (2 weeks)

What You'll do:

  • Begin your day by scanning what came in overnight: client requests, open questions, flagged deliverables and building your priority list before the first meeting hits. If something urgent surfaced, you're already on it.
  • Spend a midday block building a A/B test read-out, manipulating data in SQL, translating raw outputs into a clean, story-driven deck that a CMO can act on by end of week.
  • Jump on a client call in the afternoon where you're not just presenting findings, you're fielding follow-up questions in real time, pushing back on assumptions, and shaping what comes next.
  • Close out the day triaging two or three active workstreams across different accounts, prioritizing what moves the needle and flagging anything that needs team input before it becomes a fire.
  • Some weeks you're deep in creation of reports and data visualizations (PBI, Domo, Excel); others you're presenting at an executive meeting for a key client.

What You’ll Bring:

•A quantitative degree(statistics, finance, economics, math, engineering, analytics, or similar)
•3–5yearsof hands-on experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or B2B data consulting.
•SQLfluency(complex joins, CTEs, aggregations)
•BI tool proficiencyin Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
•Client presence.You're comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders, pushing back diplomatically, and managing competing priorities across multiple accounts.
•Solid grasp of statistical concepts including A/B testingand predictive modeling concepts

Initiativbewerbung als Führungskraft (m/w/d)

Sie sind eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Gestaltungswillen, hoher strategischer Kompetenz und von nachhaltiger Wirkung? Mit Ihrer Expertise möchten Sie nicht nur führen, sondern Impulse setzen und Strukturen weiterentwickeln — idealerweise im mittleren oder oberen Managementbereich. Sie suchen eine Position, in der Sie Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltig wirken können — auch wenn aktuell öffentlich noch keine passende Vakanz ausgeschrieben ist? Dann sind Sie hier richtig.

Ihre Rolle als Führungskraft

Als visionäre Führungskraft prägen Sie Unternehmenskulturen, steuern komplexe Prozesse und entwickeln Teams zu Höchstleistungen. Ihr Handeln ist geprägt von Weitsicht, Innovationskraft und einem klaren Sinn für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Sie verbinden analytisches Denken mit empathischer Führung und setzen damit neue Standards für nachhaltigen Erfolg.

Requirements

Ihr Profil / Ihre Qualifikationen

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung (z. B. als Bereichsleiter, Geschäftsführer, Direktor, C-Level)

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Umsetzung strategischer bzw. operativer Veränderungen

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und exzellente Kommunikationskompetenz

  • Ausgeprägtes Netzwerk in Ihrer Branche

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Reisebereitschaft und Flexibilität je nach Branche und Geografie

Ihre Motivation / Ihre Perspektive

  • Sie möchten nicht auf vordefinierte Stellenanzeigen reagieren, sondern selbst Möglichkeiten aufzeigen

  • Sie wünschen sich eine differenzierte Abwägung von Optionen durch gezielte Executive-Beratung

  • Sie streben langfristige Führungsperspektiven mit Gestaltungsspielraum an

Was wir (als Executive Search Partner) Ihnen bieten

  • Diskretes Matching Ihrer Qualifikationen mit anspruchsvollen Führungspositionen

  • Zugang zu einem exklusiven Netzwerk aus Unternehmen, Investoren und Entscheiderkreisen

  • Begleitung durch erfahrene Executive-Consultants mit Branchenexpertise

  • Transparenz, Ehrlichkeit und Vertraulichkeit im gesamten Prozess

  • Unterstützung über den gesamten Prozess hinweg – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur Verhandlung

So läuft der Prozess ab

  1. Sie senden uns Ihre Initiativbewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Führungsstationen und Ihrem “Fokusprofil” (Branche, Wunschrolle, Geografie).

  2. Wir analysieren gemeinsam, welche offenen oder zukünftigen Vakanzen aus unserem Mandantenportfolio passen könnten.

  3. Wir führen Sie gezielt in geeignete Auswahlverfahren – inklusive Diagnostik, Interviewverfahren, Executive-Assessments etc.

  4. Wenn beide Seiten überzeugt sind, begleiten wir Sie durch die finale Verhandlungsphase bis zur Vertragsunterzeichnung.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Integration Manager

Job Location: Kiryat Ono

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Crossix Measurement Suite is the industry leader in healthcare marketing analytics. We deidentify large scale healthcare datasets and transform it into actionable insights, allowing life sciences organisations to optimize how they reach and support patients. Crossix operates at the intersection of Big Data and AdTech. We combine the fast paced delivery of a start-up with the long-term security of a global leader.

You will play a key role in ensuring our customers successfully deploy, integrate, and operate our platform. By leading complex technical integrations and solving challenging infrastructure problems, you'll directly impact customer success, platform reliability, and the delivery of critical healthcare data solutions.

Our engineering philosophy prioritizes speed without compromising on quality. You will integrate into a lean and focused team with the encouragement to drive technical decisions and the accountability to execute. We value individuals who want to solve complex problems over following a rigid script, providing the space to influence both architecture, delivery and strategy.

Leadership shares a clear vision of the future, ensuring every sprint contributes to a larger objective. By helping treatments reach the right people, we use our engineering expertise to improve the healthcare landscape and act in the best interest of the patient.

What You'll Do

    • Own end-to-end integrations for large enterprise customers.
    • Work with modern cloud technologies across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
    • Solve unique technical challenges involving infrastructure, security, networking, and automation.
    • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer technical teams.
    • Influence architecture, best practices, and the future direction of our deployment and integration processes.
    • Lead customer onboarding and technical integration projects from planning through production deployment.
    • Design, deploy, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation).
    • Implement and support Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and security configurations across multiple cloud providers.
    • Automate deployment, upgrade, and operational workflows to improve reliability and efficiency.
    • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, performing root cause analysis and driving permanent fixes.
    • Partner with customers and internal engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available solutions.
    • Develop technical documentation, implementation guides, and operational runbooks.
    • Mentor engineers and contribute to improving engineering standards, tooling, and operational excellence.

Requirements

    • Cloud Technologies – proven experience with at least one of the following cloud providers: AWS, Azure, or GCP
    • 5+ years of experience leading or managing integration projects, including timeline management
    • 5+ years of significant customer-facing experience, ability to present to security and compliance customer teams, proven communication skills
    • Experience with REST, SOAP, and other API protocols
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and git version control system

Nice to Have

    • Good understanding of security protocols
    • Experience with Kubernetes-based applications
    • Computer science degree or equivalent
    • Previous Linux System Admin experience

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.
If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

jobs.excerpt: Our MissioniSeatz drives enduring brand loyalty through exceptional, connected experiences.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

iSeatz drives enduring brand loyalty through exceptional, connected experiences. Our digital commerce and technology solutions enable travel and lifestyle bookings for the world’s leading brands in financial services, travel, and hospitality, including American Express, IHG Hotels & Resorts, Qantas, and more.

What We Do

We have a history of long-term trusted relationships and innovation that drives tangible value to our customers through a customizable, scalable, and secure platform, a global third-party marketplace, and loyalty integration. Our proprietary platform processes over $9B per year in transactions.

We aspire to put our customers at the heart of every decision and exceed their expectations with best-in-class solutions and business-value innovations.

What You’ll Do

The Security Engineer reports to the Information Security Manager and works closely with Security, DevOps, Engineering, IT, and Compliance teams to design, build, operate, and continuously improve the technical controls that protect iSeatz systems, applications, and data. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on secure AWS environments, automation, detection and response capabilities, and practical risk reduction across a cloud-native platform.

In this role, you will translate security requirements into durable technical solutions, help engineering teams ship securely, and improve the visibility and resilience of the services our customers depend on.

Your Impact

  • Engineer and maintain security controls across AWS accounts and services, including identity, logging, monitoring, network security, encryption, and configuration assurance.
  • Develop, review, and improve Infrastructure as Code for security controls and cloud infrastructure. Work within existing IaC workflows and help make secure patterns repeatable for engineering teams.
  • Operate and improve the SIEM, including log source onboarding, detection content, alert tuning, investigation support, dashboards, and use cases aligned to real threats and business risk.
  • Administer and strengthen identity and access management controls across the identity provider, cloud environments, and critical SaaS platforms, including SSO, MFA, lifecycle automation, privileged access, and access reviews.
  • Maintain and enhance intrusion detection and prevention capabilities across cloud, endpoint, and network environments. Investigate meaningful detections and partner on containment and remediation.
  • Own key portions of the vulnerability management lifecycle: asset coverage, scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, exception support, and executive or technical reporting.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to secure CI/CD pipelines, application dependencies, secrets, container images, Kubernetes or ECS workloads, and runtime environments.
  • Build security automation, integrations, and tooling using scripting and APIs to reduce manual effort, improve evidence quality, and increase response speed.
  • Support security incident response by conducting technical investigation, collecting evidence, coordinating remediation, and improving controls after incidents and exercises.
  • Perform technical security reviews of infrastructure, architecture, applications, and configuration changes. Document findings, recommendations, standards, and operational runbooks clearly.
  • Stay current on cloud threats, attack techniques, and defensive capabilities, then apply that knowledge in ways that improve iSeatz security without creating unnecessary friction.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, cloud engineering, systems engineering, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, with a working understanding of core AWS security services and multi-account or multi-environment operations.
  • Professional experience using Infrastructure as Code to build or manage cloud infrastructure and security controls.
  • Hands-on experience with a SIEM or cloud security analytics platform, including log analysis, detection engineering or alert tuning, investigation workflows, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience with an identity provider and identity security controls, such as SSO, MFA, SCIM or lifecycle management, access governance, and privileged access.
  • Experience operating or supporting IDS, IPS, EDR, NDR, WAF, or comparable detection and prevention technologies, with a strong grasp of network security fundamentals.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools and processes, including scanning, asset inventory, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, and risk-based communication.
  • Working knowledge of containerization and cloud-native workload security, including Docker, container registries, image scanning, and orchestrated workloads such as Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS.
  • Ability to automate tasks and integrate tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, JavaScript or TypeScript, APIs, and version-controlled workflows.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. You can work across technical and nontechnical teams, explain risk plainly, and move work from finding to resolution.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Security, Engineering, DevOps, IT, and Compliance.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on AWS CDK experience, especially building reusable security guardrails and secure-by-default patterns in TypeScript or Python.
  • Deep penetration testing experience across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, internal networks, or adversary simulation, including the ability to validate remediation and explain practical exploit paths.
  • Experience securing Kubernetes or EKS at scale, including admission controls, workload identity, network policies, secrets management, runtime detection, and image supply chain security.
  • Experience with security automation, SOAR, case management, or custom integrations that enrich, prioritize, or respond to alerts.
  • Experience in a PCI DSS, SOC 2, or other regulated environment, including translating control requirements into technical evidence and sustainable engineering practices.
  • Experience with application security tools and practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, threat modeling, or secure code review.
  • Relevant security or cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC.
Pay Range for this Position:
$111,000—$144,000 USD

Location

This role is remote and can be located anywhere inside the continental United States. iSeatz is a New Orleans-based company with Central Time Zone business hours, but feel free to work from your home office, from the beach, or from the cottage you rented for the summer!

What We Bring To The Table

iSeatz has been honored as an Inc. Magazine Best Workplace for the past three years — recognition based on our commitment to transparency, trust, and open communication, as well as our efforts to foster growth for our team members beyond their current roles and responsibilities.

We trust our team members to use their expertise and creativity to deliver high-quality results — without micromanagement — and support them in building careers that are as dynamic and multifaceted as the work we do.

We believe there's no one-size-fits-all approach to engagement or collaboration. That’s why we strive to provide the tools, autonomy, and support employees need to succeed — while delivering exceptional products and services to our customers.

We recognize that great work deserves meaningful support. At iSeatz, we provide competitive compensation and a comprehensive suite of benefits to match. Our team members enjoy robust health insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, generous paid time off, and up to eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible caregivers. We’re a remote-first company that values flexibility and autonomy, and we invest in continuous learning with an annual professional development allowance. Whether you're growing your skills, your family, or your impact — we’re here to support what’s next.

We Value A Diverse Workplace

We are committed to building and maintaining a culture of support, awareness, and sensitivity about the importance and impact of our differences and leverage these differences to build a stronger iSeatz.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the People Operations Team at .

A Note About Joining Our Workforce

At iSeatz, we're building a team of bold thinkers, innovative builders, and thoughtful collaborators — people who are excited to make an impact, grow their careers, and help shape the future of travel and loyalty tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, passionate about creating exceptional experiences, and ready to bring your unique perspective to a team that values trust, growth, and transparency — we can't wait to meet you.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Social Media Clipper to watch YouTube content from a fast-growing social media creator, identify the best clippable moments, edit them into short-form clips, and run the creator's clipping pages across social platforms.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Social Media Clipper to watch YouTube content from a fast-growing social media creator, identify the best clippable moments, edit them into short-form clips, and run the creator's clipping pages across social platforms. This is a full-time, dedicated role for one creator's content operation.

You will spend most of your time watching videos, finding the moments that hit, clipping and editing them into shareable short-form content, and posting and managing the accounts where those clips live. You do not need to be a professional editor or have a marketing degree. You need good instincts for what makes a YouTube moment worth clipping, the ability to move fast, and the discipline to stay on top of a consistent posting schedule. AI tools for transcription and content review are encouraged. If you are plugged into creator culture, understand what performs on short-form platforms, and want a focused, high-output role inside a growing content operation, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly inside the content operation of a viral social media creator with a large and growing audience
  • High-output, focused role with real creative input into how the creator's content reaches new audiences

What You'll Work On

Content Clipping and Identification

  • Watch YouTube videos and long-form content to identify the best clippable moments including funny, surprising, emotional, controversial, or highly shareable sequences
  • Use AI transcription and review tools to move through content faster and surface moments efficiently
  • Develop a strong instinct for what works on short-form platforms and what will stop the scroll

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit identified moments into polished short-form clips ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Add captions, cuts, pacing adjustments, and light visual treatments to make clips platform-ready
  • Maintain a consistent output of clips without sacrificing quality

Social Page Management

  • Run and manage the creator's clipping pages across relevant platforms
  • Post consistently to a defined schedule and keep accounts active and growing
  • Monitor basic performance metrics and flag what is working to inform future clipping decisions
  • Engage with comments and community interactions on clipping pages as needed

What You Bring

  • Genuine understanding of what makes a YouTube or long-form video moment worth clipping; good instincts here matter more than a formal background
  • Comfortable watching and processing high volumes of video content efficiently, including using AI tools for transcription and review
  • Basic video editing skills with the ability to produce clean, platform-ready short-form clips
  • Active on social media and familiar with what performs on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X
  • Organized and consistent with the ability to maintain a regular posting schedule across multiple platforms
  • Fast and self-directed with minimal need for oversight on day-to-day clipping and posting decisions

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience clipping or repurposing long-form content for a creator, brand, or media account
  • Experience running and growing social media accounts or clipping pages independently
  • Familiarity with AI transcription and video review tools
  • Background in or passion for creator culture, entertainment, or viral content

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or examples showing clips or short-form content you have created or pages you have managed
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience with content clipping or social media management, and explaining what you think makes a YouTube moment worth clipping

Only candidates who submit both examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you have good instincts for viral content, can move fast through long-form video to find the moments that matter, and want a focused full-time role inside a creator's content operation, this role gives you the volume and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.title: Senior Neurodevelopmental Assessor for Children’s ADHD
jobs.excerpt: Senior ADHD Assessor for ChildrenTime commitment: Full-time employment is preferred, though we can also offer part-time (minimum of 3 days per week) Location: Remote Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager About PalomaIn 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments.
jobs.description:
Senior ADHD Assessor for Children

Time commitment: Full-time employment is preferred, though we can also offer part-time (minimum of 3 days per week)

Location: Remote

Reporting to: NeurodevelopmentalTeam Manager

About Paloma

In 2024, our founders, Mark and Darshak, were shocked to find that children needing an NHS autism or ADHD assessment were waiting 4-10 years for these assessments. Delayed assessments result in children being more likely to develop mental health conditions and fall behind in education. Furthermore, the much-needed pre/post-assessment support (outside of ADHD medications) is typically not funded by the NHS.

These long waits have built up due to increased recognition and understanding of neurodevelopmental conditions and a lack of investment and innovation within the NHS to meet the growing demand.

Mark and Darshak, with their 25 years of combined NHS experience, including building services that have treated over 1,000,000 patients in obesity & ophthalmology, founded Paloma to change this. Our mission is to make NHS autism and ADHD assessments and care accessible within 4 weeks of a GP referral, and, in turn, help every child achieve their potential.

As of May 2026, we have successfully reduced waits to 3 months by;

  • Taking a product-first approach to redesign the care pathway to give families a more consumer-like experience of care
  • Our in-house product, engineering and AI team building our own autism and ADHD specific electronic patient record and AI documentation tool to free clinicians from their significant documentation burden to re-focus on supporting families
  • Investing in expanding the clinician workforce and upskilling them in new ways of working.

We are proud that Paloma is:

  • Loved by families, with 4.9 out of 5 Trustpilot and Google ratings
  • Care Quality Commission (CQC) registered and quality-focused
  • Clinically-led, with a team of 130 people, including over 80 clinicians supporting families through their assessment journey. We are hiring 100+ more roles over the next 12 months.
  • A community of passionate, mission-driven and innovative team members who challenge the status quo and test and learn from new ideas and approaches.
  • Backed by leading healthcare investors Triple Point and Heal Capital

What’s next?

  • Whilst we have reduced wait times, it is estimated that up to 500,000 children are still waiting for an NHS autism or ADHD assessment. We won’t rest until this comes down.
  • We want to build new services to support families and children diagnosed with autism or ADHD who feel lost after their assessments when the NHS is no longer there for them.

The Opportunity

Are you an innovative clinician working in children’s ADHD assessments, excited to use software tools that enhance the assessor and family experience of care? This role is for you!

We are not a standard ADHD assessment service; we:

  • Have built our own technology & AI tools to gather the required information from families, and support your documentation, so you can focus on children’s needs
  • Have a Clinical Specialist, who is a senior clinician who works alongside you to ensure all of our ADHD assessments are multidisciplinary in line with NICE guidance.
  • Offer an integrated prescribing service led by our Prescribing Team, ensuring families can get fast access to ADHD medications where required

This role will ensure we deliver a fantastic Children’s ADHD assessment service to families. If you have the appropriate skills, you can work across our Children’s Autism and Children's Dual Autism and ADHD Assessment pathways.

We commit to supporting your development and well-being, including:

  • The Paloma Clinical Academy programme supports all clinicians at all stages of their careers to develop (e.g. to our Senior Assessor role) and cross-skill (e.g. in autism)
  • Regular clinical supervision
  • 1 protected day per month for assessor team training, Continuing Professional Development (CPD), and reflection.
  • Quarterly development conversations with clear career progression pathways.
  • Clear weekly timetables that support a role mix across appointments, administration, development, and team building.

About you

You are a registered nurse, speech and language therapist, occupational therapist, social worker or practitioner psychologist skilled in ADHD assessments.

You want to be part of an always-learning environment that embraces software and AI tools, and you will help us go further and faster with your positive and collaborative attitude.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality Children’s ADHD Neurodevelopmental Assessments
  • Act in accordance with our Safeguarding Policy, including conducting a risk assessment where necessary.
  • Keep up to date with the mandatory training, Continuing Professional Development and professional registration requirements of your professional background.
  • Share ideas for continuing to improve Paloma’s software tools that ensure high-quality, safe, and efficient assessments

Qualifications and experience:

Required:

  • By background, you are either a:
    • NMC-registered Nurse
    • HCPC Registered Speech and Language Therapist, Occupational Therapist, Arts Therapist, or Practitioner Psychologist (including Clinical Psychologists, Educational Psychologists and Counselling Psychologists)
    • Social Work England Registered Social Worker
  • You have at least 4 years of experience in delivering Children’s ADHD assessments, including:
    • Having a sound understanding of typical development through life stages, co-occurring conditions, and differentials.
    • Have a good understanding of normal levels of attention, impulsivity, and hyperactivity in typically developing children and young people, and consider this within the cultural background of the individual being assessed.
    • The ability to present findings which are client-centred and include strengths and needs.
  • You can demonstrate good time management skills, including caseload management, and good parent and child communication skills
  • Passing an enhanced DBS with barred list check, as you will be working with children

Desirable:

  • Experience in conducting risk assessments within Neurodevelopmental assessments
  • Safeguarding training to Level 3 and above
  • Experience in Children’s Autism Assessments and Dual Assessments

Why join Paloma?

You will be part of a mission-driven organisation that’s transforming access to autism and ADHD care in England. For all employees, we offer:

  • A strong and positive culture that prioritises team building, transparency, and career development. This includes protected time and budget for team connection and learning.
  • Comprehensive compensation, including:
    • Total compensation of £62,000 to £64,000 per year, made up of base and variable components for:
      • HCPC-registered Occupational Therapists, Speech and Language Therapists, and Arts Therapists
      • NMC-registered Nurses
      • Social Work England registered Social Workers
    • Total compensation of £68,000 to £70,000 per year, made up of base and variable components for:
      • HCPC-registered Practitioner Psychologists, including Clinical Psychologists, Educational Psychologists and Counselling Psychologists
    • Annual salary reviews, ensuring they are competitive
    • 5% employer pension contribution
    • For employees working at least 0.8 FTE:
      • Equity compensation through Share Options in Paloma Health
      • Optional Private Medical Insurance and Employee Assistance Programme
    • Home Office Equipment Allowance
    • Professional Registration Fees Allowance for clinicians
  • A unique annual leave benefits package which includes:
    • 37 days of annual leave. This is 28 standard days, plus eight bank holidays, plus your birthday off.
    • Option to buy an additional 5 days per year (giving a maximum of 42 days)
    • Where required, 2 days per year of special leave, for events that can happen in life, whether personal or family-related
  • Additional benefits include:
    • A premium performance company laptop
    • NHS discounts, including the Blue Light Card (as we are an NHS provider).

Equality & Diversity

Paloma Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and throughout the application process. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic.

Accommodations

We’re glad to accommodate candidates who need adjustments throughout the hiring process. We encourage you to be open about the adjustments you need, so we can adapt our interview process accordingly.

Safer Recruitment & Pre-Employment Checks

Paloma Health ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation. As part of our pre-employment checks, you will be asked to complete a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Depending on your role within the business, this will be at either an Enhanced, Standard, or Basic level. We are committed to safer recruitment practices and expect all applicants to share our dedication to safeguarding. Our recruitment processes are designed to ensure we appoint individuals who align with our values and will help maintain a safe and supportive environment for everyone we work with.

Application process

Please apply via our website. We understand that applying for a new job requires significant effort, and we appreciate your time. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Join us and be part of our journey to revolutionise access to NHS autism and ADHD care!

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Filipino (Philippines-based) candidates

Job Role: Senior Estimator & Quantity Surveyor

Compensation Range:$2000-$2500 AUD / Month

Engagement Type:Independent Contractor

Work Schedule: 40 hours per week, aligned with Perth business hours (same time zone as Manila).

Who We Are: At Hunt St we help Australian companies directly hire top 5% remote talent in the Philippines. You will be hired directly by the client, typically as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

A full-service design and renovation firm based in Perth, Australia, specializing in luxury home transformations. With nearly two decades of experience, the team is dedicated to crafting timeless, personalized, and refined spaces that elevate and reflect each client's lifestyle. Their philosophy blends creativity with meticulous craftsmanship, intentionally limiting the number of projects taken on each year to ensure every detail receives focused attention.

Role Overview:

The Senior Estimator & Quantity Surveyor will take ownership of construction estimating for
high-end residential renovation projects, ensuring accurate pricing, comprehensive quantity
take-offs and effective cost control throughout the project lifecycle.

This role requires substantial experience working with Australian residential builders and a
strong understanding of local construction practices, trade scopes, material costs and
subcontractor pricing. The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially minded and highly
organised, with the ability to manage the quoting pipeline, identify potential risks early, and
deliver reliable cost estimates with minimal supervision. The Directors and Project Director
remain part of all key decisions, and the Directors review each estimate before it is finalised.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Construction Estimating

  • Prepare accurate quantity take-offs and trade-by-trade estimates from architectural, interior design, structural and joinery drawings and specifications.
  • Build an RFQ package for each trade, including scope markups, site photos and product information.
  • Send RFQs to subcontractors and suppliers, follow them up, compare quotations and build the estimate from the returned pricing.
  • Price high-end finishes, including custom joinery, natural stone, large-format tiling, wet areas, cladding and premium fixtures.
  • Identify documentation gaps and inconsistencies, and raise Requests for Information (RFIs) where needed.
  • Identify cost risks, provisional sums, exclusions and value engineering opportunities before the price goes to the client.
  • Cross-check every estimate through Claude.
  • Revise estimates and markups based on the Directors' on-site review and feedback.
  • Lead an internal pricing meeting with the Directors to review the estimate before they meet the client.
  • Email clients regarding pricing questions when required and review client meeting transcripts afterwards to identify pricing changes.
  • The Estimator is not required to attend client meetings.

2. Project Set-Up

  • Build the job in Buildertrend once the contract is signed, including the master budget, cost codes and purchase orders issued with the relevant subcontractor quote, markup and take-off.
  • Save markups in one folder per trade so the Director (Project or Construction Manager), Project Director and relevant trade can access them.
  • Hand over a clear cost breakdown, risk items and allowance schedules to the Project Director.

3. Variations and Cost Control

  • Price variations within 24 hours of the request, subject to trade pricing, following the same process used for quoting: scope, photos and markups, trade pricing, then the client variation price.
  • Price each variation in Buildertrend Change Orders, including line items against the job's cost codes, trade quote references, margin, GST and variation fee.
  • Complete the Change Order when the change is complex or the Project Director hands it over, ready for the Director's review before it goes to the client.
  • Re-price items when clients upgrade or downgrade selections.
  • Check actual costs against each variation's cost codes once it is included in the budget.
  • Track costs against the budget and update the forecast to complete every fortnight in coordination with the Project Director and Accounts Manager.

4. Pricing Data and Claude

  • Maintain the rate library for materials, labour and trades, reviewing it at least every six months and after major supplier price changes.
  • Load each final estimate back into Claude to improve early design estimates.
  • Manage the quoting pipeline, including live quotes, deadlines, follow-ups and next actions.

Key Deliverables

  • Accurate quantity take-offs, detailed estimates, and timely quotations.
  • Reliable concept-stage cost plans and budget estimates.
  • Proactively managed quoting pipeline and supplier follow-ups.
  • Accurate cost tracking, variation pricing, and budget reporting.
  • Well-maintained pricing records and clear communication of project risks.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • At least five years of estimating and quantity surveying experience working with Australian residential builders, including high-end renovations. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
  • Sound knowledge of Perth and Western Australian trade, supplier and material pricing.
  • Experience pricing custom joinery, natural stone, large-format tiling, wet areas, cladding and premium fixtures.
  • Proficiency in digital take-off software such as Cubit, Buildxact, Databuild, Bluebeam or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards, trade scopes and construction sequencing.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Clear written and spoken English, with confidence communicating with clients by email, designers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Strong organisational skills and a proactive approach to managing competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a small team.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience using Buildertrend, including estimates, purchase orders and Change Orders.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude in estimating.
  • Experience in variation pricing, job costing and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Familiarity with HIA contracts and a design-and-construct environment.
  • Experience using Xero.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO


Security Program Leadership & Operations


  • Develops and implements client information security programs that meet business, regulatory, and industry requirements
  • Advises executive leadership on information security strategy, policies, standards, and procedures
  • Updates client executives on security plan progress, emerging threats, and actual or potential security incidents
  • Develops and maintains security policies and procedures that govern the protection of the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of client systems and data
  • Monitors client security programs and environment changes to keep controls effective and risks minimized
  • Oversees implementation of security solutions to improve overall security posture
  • Develops, maintains, and coordinates testing of disaster recovery and business continuity plans that reflect client system and facility needs
  • Develops, delivers, and monitors security awareness training programs
  • Works within cross-functional teams to develop and deliver secure solutions
  • Leads or participates in client steering committees and working groups as needed
  • Coordinates with client security teams on incident detection, response, and resolution within agreed service-level agreements (SLAs)

Risk & Compliance Support


  • Leads internal, vulnerability, and third-party risk assessments and supports client security audits
  • Conducts security reviews of new and existing systems and recommends improvements to systems, policies, and procedures
  • Ensures appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protect client systems and information
  • Advises clients on control requirements for NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other applicable frameworks and regulations
  • Assesses control gaps and maturity against applicable frameworks and helps clients prioritize remediation
  • Supports client audits, assessments, and certifications by clarifying controls, coordinating evidence, and addressing findings
  • Defines scope and maintains segmentation and protection controls for regulated data environments (e.g., ePHI, cardholder data, CUI)
  • Oversees vulnerability scanning and penetration testing programs aligned with framework and regulatory requirements
  • Maintains cross-framework control mappings and supports compensating-control and risk-acceptance documentation

WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT


  • Communication Proficiency
  • Decision Making
  • Project Management
  • Teamwork Orientation
  • Thoroughness
  • Client Relationship Management
  • Regulatory Compliance Expertise

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR


Information Security Experience


Note: The required qualifications may be satisfied through a combination of the experience areas listed below.

  • At least five years of information security leadership experience, such as CISO, vCISO, or senior security leadership
  • At least three years of experience in security operations, security engineering, vulnerability management, or system administration
  • Consulting or managed services experience supporting multiple clients across regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services, government contracting)

Compliance & Regulatory Experience


  • At least three years of hands-on experience implementing and operating controls for frameworks such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2, or PCI DSS
  • Experience serving as the security point of contact during external audits and assessments (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA)
  • Experience scoping regulated systems and data, identifying required controls, and reducing scope through data classification and network segmentation
  • Knowledge of risk management frameworks and methodologies (e.g., NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO/IEC 27005, ISO 31000, and FAIR), with experience applying them to risk assessment, treatment, and reporting
  • Experience with data protection technologies (encryption, tokenization, data loss prevention, secure coding)

Required Training and Education


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Security Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Required Certifications


Must Have


  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

Highly Preferred


  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
  • CGRC (Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance)
  • Framework-specific credentials such as PCI ISA, HCISPP (HealthCare Information Security and Privacy Practitioner), or CMMC Certified Professional (CCP)

Additional Preferred


  • CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
  • CIPT (Certified Information Privacy Technologist)

COMPENSATION DETAILS


The potential salary range for this role is $105,000 to $120,000 per year, with eligibility for bonus or merit program. About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Contract Opportunity

SANS is seeking a Quality Control Tester to support our Quality team through a contract engagement. This role will focus on testing and validating OnDemand course content, learning platforms, media assets, and related systems to ensure a high-quality student experience. The engagement will support quality assurance activities across course releases, platform enhancements, and special projects.

Estimated Engagement Duration: 12 months, subject to project needs and mutual agreement of the parties.

Scope of Work

The services to be provided under this engagement include:

  • Review functional, content, and technical specifications.
  • Identify testable requirements and clarify ambiguities with SANS OnDemand and WFS stakeholders.
  • Create detailed test cases and test scripts based on requirements, including positive, negative, and edge cases.
  • Perform manual testing across platforms, browsers, devices, and environments.
  • Validate functionality, usability, accessibility, media quality, and performance.
  • Log defects with clear reproduction steps and severity levels based on established guidelines.
  • Perform regression and retesting activities.
  • Ensure new changes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
  • Document findings and provide detailed test reports.
  • Collaborate with Quality team to ensure project objectives and deliverables are met.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations as needed.
  • Perform related project work and deliverables within the scope of the engagement, as mutually agreed upon.

Required Experience

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Experience performing manual quality testing, quality control reviews, or related testing activities.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify, document, and communicate issues clearly and accurately.
  • Experience following documented procedures, test plans, and quality standards.
  • Relevant professional experience in quality testing, content review, education technology, or a related field.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality work within established timelines.
  • Proficiency with common web browsers, online platforms, and productivity tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience testing online learning platforms, educational content, or digital media.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking systems, ticketing platforms, and QC best practices.
  • Technical support experience
  • Technical certifications such as GIAC or other accredited technical training.
  • Experience reviewing audio, video, transcripts, captions, and other multimedia content.
  • Basic knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and terminology.
  • Experience working in a remote, distributed team environment.
  • Familiarity with accessibility, usability, and user experience principles.

Contractor Information

This opportunity is structured as a 1099 independent contractor engagement and is not a W-2 employment position.

Contractors are responsible for their own taxes, insurance, equipment, business expenses, and any other obligations associated with operating as an independent contractor.

Approved business travel required for the engagement may be reimbursed in accordance with SANS travel and expense guidelines and must be approved in advance by a designated SANS representative.
