jobs.title: Senior Director, Compliance & Platform
jobs.excerpt: At AbsenceSoft, we’re transforming the employee experience.
jobs.description:
At AbsenceSoft, we’re transforming the employee experience. Our secure, intuitive technology helps employers bring humanity, certainty, and efficiency to some of the most complex moments in the workplace. Built by HR professionals for HR professionals, we’re proud of where we’ve been and even more excited about where we’re going.

The Senior Director, Product - Compliance & Platform leads the two product foundations AbsenceSoft depends on: the compliance engine that delivers broad coverage of leave and accommodation law, and the enterprise-scale platform it runs on. This role owns strategy, roadmap, and outcomes across both, leads the product managers, domain experts, and platform product leaders who build them, and reports to the Chief Product Officer. The role carries decision rights over a large share of the product and accountability for the retention, expansion, and win-rate outcomes that comes with it. This is a hands-on leadership role that works directly in strategy, prototyping, and customer engagement alongside the team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and results for compliance and platform, including the retention, expansion, and win-rate outcomes they drive.
  • Develop strategy collaboratively with the team, with each product manager and domain expert owning the direction of their area and consolidating those into a single plan the group can stand behind.
  • Extend AbsenceSoft’s compliance coverage as leave and accommodation laws change, keeping the product current across jurisdictions.
  • Set the direction for an enterprise-scale platform that customers and partners rely on: configuration, identity and access, integrations, and data. Own how enterprise customers adopt, extend, and stay on it.
  • Build, coach, and develop a team of product managers, domain experts, and managers, raising standards for product craft, delivery speed, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Maintain high delivery standards in partnership with Engineering and integrate AI into the product with the accuracy and governance that enterprise customers and their legal teams expect.
  • Partner with Engineering, Legal, Customer Experience, Sales, Marketing, and Finance, and represent compliance and platform to executive leadership, the board, and customers.
  • Participate in a highly compliant environment while assisting to maintain company controls and security within your job role.
  • Assist in maintaining applicable organizational security and compliance controls within your department, role, and subordinate’s roles.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • 15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product managers and experience leading managers or multiple product areas simultaneously.
  • Proven experience owning a compliance, regulatory, or rules-engine product at enterprise scale (RegTech, tax, payroll, benefits, healthcare, fintech, or HR compliance). This is a core requirement for the role.
  • Proven experience owning a multi-tenant enterprise platform, including identity and access, configuration, integrations and APIs, or data.
  • Track record of shipping complex products on committed dates for demanding enterprise customers, with a clear personal contribution to holding delivery commitments.
  • Experience shipping AI features into production in an accuracy-critical domain, with rigorous evaluation and governance.
  • Demonstrated ability to set product strategy that improved ARR, retention, or win rate, supported by measurable results.
  • Enterprise B2B SaaS experience with strong data fluency, including scaling a product from mid-market to enterprise.

Preferred:

  • Domain experience in leave and absence, benefits, employment law, or HR tech.
  • Experience working directly with legal and regulatory experts to translate requirements into product.
  • Experience in high-growth, scaling SaaS environment.

Key Skills & Behaviors:

  • Strong bias for action and speed in decision-making and delivery.
  • Communicates with clarity and authority, earning the trust of senior customer stakeholders including CHROs, General Counsel, and CIOs.
  • Highly autonomous, with the ability to set direction in ambiguity with minimal guidance.
  • Builds a deep understanding of the work by learning alongside the people who do it.
  • Customer-obsessed, with deep instincts for product quality.
  • Builds, coaches, and develops high-performing product leaders and teams.

Why join us

At AbsenceSoft, we LEAD with our values:

Lead with Innovation - We create meaningful change through intelligence, focus and passion.We embrace curiosity, data, and insight to shape the future of our industry. Always innovating, learning and evolving.

Elevate Every Voice - Every perspective matters. We listen, learn, and build a culture where diversity of thought and experience drives better solutions and smarter decisions.

Achieve Together - The customer fuels everything we do. We share knowledge, collaborate, celebrate wins, and face challenges as one team because success is always a collective achievement.

Drive Outcome - Every action we take delivers measurable value to our teams, our customers, and the employees they support. Accountability is non-negotiable. We honor our commitments, take responsibility for results, and see every success and setback as a chance to grow stronger.

We offer:

  • Impact that matters. You’ll do work that shapes the future of the modern workplace
  • Flexibility and trust. We’re remote-first and results driven. You’ll have the freedom and flexibility to do your best work, wherever you do it best.
  • Growth and development. We believe the best work happens when people are growing. You’ll have access to learning resources, leadership programs, and real opportunities to take on new challenges and expand your impact.
  • Competitive rewards. We offer comprehensive benefits, a performance-based bonus program, and equity opportunities – because when we grow, you should too.
  • Time for life. Recharge and reconnect with flexible time off, paid holidays, and flexible leave programs designed to support every season of life.
  • Belonging and balance. We’re building an inclusive culture where every voice is valued, collaboration is celebrated, and success is shared.

We’re committed to building a team as diverse as the customers we serve. If your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply you might be exactly what we’re looking for. If this sounds like a fit, apply today, we’d love to meet you!

214,000 - 268,000 USD per year (US National)

jobs.description:
SecurityBridge ist ein schnell wachsendes internationales Softwareunternehmen und führender Anbieter von Cybersecurity-Lösungen für SAP. Unsere Plattform hilft Unternehmen weltweit dabei, ihre geschäftskritischen SAP-Systeme vor Cyberbedrohungen zu schützen – mit Echtzeit-Bedrohungserkennung, Schwachstellenmanagement und Compliance in einer zentralen Lösung.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Account Executive für die DACH-Region, der ein eigenes Named-Account-Gebiet übernimmt und den Ausbau unseres Enterprise-Geschäfts in einem unserer wichtigsten Märkte vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle verantwortest Du den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss – und arbeitest eng mit Presales, Customer Success sowie unserem Partnernetzwerk zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben
  • Du verantwortest das Umsatzziel für Dein DACH-Named-Account-Gebiet.
  • Du baust eigenständig eine qualifizierte Pipeline über Outbound-Aktivitäten, Veranstaltungen, Executive Networking sowie Inbound- und Partner-Leads auf.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Vertriebszyklen – von der Discovery über Business Case und technische Validierung gemeinsam mit unserem Presales-Team bis hin zu Verhandlung und Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du verkaufst an CISOs, SAP- und IT-Verantwortliche sowie an Revision, Compliance und weitere Entscheidungsträger auf Management- und Führungsebene.
  • Du übersetzt technische Funktionen in geschäftlichen Mehrwert, Risikominimierung und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren GSI-, SAP-Beratungs-, MSSP- und Reseller-Partnern neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten (Co-Selling).
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter und identifizierst Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale.
  • Du pflegst Salesforce zuverlässig und stellst eine belastbare Pipeline sowie einen präzisen Forecast sicher.

Das bringst Du mit
  • Fließende bzw. verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung im Enterprise B2B-Softwarevertrieb mit eigener Umsatzverantwortung und nachweislicher Zielerreichung.
  • Erfahrung im Abschluss komplexer Softwareverträge mit mehreren Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Opportunity Management sowie Erfahrung mit modernen Enterprise-Sales-Methoden wie MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale oder Value Selling.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
  • Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken und die Motivation, ein Vertriebsgebiet aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen innerhalb der DACH-Region.

Von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Cybersecurity-, Enterprise-Software- oder SAP-Lösungen.
  • Erfahrung im indirekten Vertrieb sowie im Co-Selling mit Partnern.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Salesforce, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder vergleichbaren Sales-Tools.

Wichtige Informationen
  • Diese Position ist vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Österreichs oder der Schweiz.
  • Visa-Sponsoring und Relocation werden nicht angeboten.
  • Bewerberinnen und Bewerber müssen über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für ihr Wohnsitzland verfügen.

Was wir bieten
  • Ein strategisch bedeutendes Vertriebsgebiet in einem stark wachsenden Cybersecurity-Markt.
  • Attraktives Fixgehalt mit ungedeckelter, leistungsabhängiger Provision.
  • Ein Remote-First-Arbeitsmodell sowie einen modernen Enterprise-Sales-Tech-Stack.
  • Coaching und Mentoring durch erfahrene Enterprise-Sales-Führungskräfte.
  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektiven mit enger Unterstützung durch Presales, Customer Success und unser Partnernetzwerk.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie eine ergebnisorientierte Unternehmenskultur.

Was die Arbeit bei SecurityBridge besonders macht
Bei uns erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Gute Ideen sind unabhängig von Position oder Betriebszugehörigkeit willkommen. Du gestaltest Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel und eigenverantwortlich – entscheidend sind die Ergebnisse, nicht die Anwesenheit im Büro.

Ehrlichkeit, Respekt, Hilfsbereitschaft und Integrität bilden das Fundament unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir sind überzeugt, dass starke Teams die Grundlage für nachhaltigen Erfolg sind. Deshalb schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem sich unsere Mitarbeitenden unterstützt fühlen, sich weiterentwickeln können und gemeinsam wachsen.

Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Schritt?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit Deinem Lebenslauf – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Jede Bewerbung wird von unserem Recruiting-Team sorgfältig geprüft und wir melden uns bei allen Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern zurück.

jobs.description:
Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a Senior Power Apps/Power BI Developer to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. We need a team member who is ready to design, architect, and lead the implementation of innovative Power Platform and business intelligence solutions to support the missions of our customers. We have several large projects, some established, some just getting started, at the Department of Veterans Affairs and we need smart team members to help us deliver.

The successful candidate will be an inquisitive problem solver with the ability to quickly analyze the needs of specific projects and architect and implement effective solutions. In this fully remote role, you will lead the design of Power Apps interfaces and enterprise-scale reporting that leadership uses to measure program performance and contractor accountability, and guide the team toward creative solutions to our customers' challenges. Join our development team and help us positively impact the lives of millions of Veterans through innovative, data-driven, and user-centric solutions.

You will work and collaborate on a team of project managers, business analysts, developers/engineers, and QA staff within an Agile environment. As a crucial member of our team, you will also be expected to interface with client representatives, including product owners, business owners, technical leads, and solution architects.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze customer needs and lead the development of the overall design concept and objectives with an eye to performance, usability, architecture, and security.
  • Design, build, and maintain Power Apps that serve as the user interface for a custom-developed, Azure-hosted enterprise system.
  • Lead the design of new Power Apps capabilities and enhancements to existing interfaces.
  • Architect Power BI data models, reports, and executive dashboards, including complex DAX measures and Power Query transformations.
  • Design local, regional, and national reporting using dashboards, charts, maps, and other visualization formats.
  • Design and oversee the integration and transformation of data from Microsoft SQL Server, enterprise data warehouses, and external partner data sources that refresh daily.
  • Own Power BI data gateway configuration, refresh strategy, and troubleshooting.
  • Lead data quality analysis to identify trends, outliers, and issues requiring upstream remediation, and coordinate remediation with data owners.
  • Define role-based access and row-level security patterns for applications and reports.
  • Ensure applications and reports meet Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • Optimize report and data model performance for large datasets and high user volumes.
  • Lead requirements analysis and estimate level of effort.
  • Participate in quarterly PI Planning and lead backlog refinement with product owners.
  • Establish source control, branching, and deployment practices using Git (e.g., GitHub).
  • Collaborate with product owners, business owners, technical leads, and solution architects to produce software design and architecture documents.
  • Support security and Authority to Operate (ATO) compliance activities.
  • Perform code and design reviews of apps, reports, and data models.
  • Develop documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and analysts.

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in application development, reporting, or business intelligence
  • Minimum of four (4) years of on-the-job experience developing Power Apps
  • Minimum of four (4) years of on-the-job experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards
  • Advanced proficiency with DAX, Power Query (M), and data modeling for enterprise-scale datasets
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), including query performance tuning
  • Experience configuring and managing Power BI data gateways and refresh strategies
  • Experience designing row-level security and role-based access models
  • Experience with Git version control (e.g., GitHub), including branching strategies

jobs.description:
Job Title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)

Status: Part-Time or Full-Time

Reports To: Founding Psychiatrist

About Here Now Health:

Here Now Health is the first virtual healthcare company specifically built for children and families impacted by the child welfare system. We deliver child welfare–informed, high-touch care to Medicaid-covered youth navigating foster care, adoption, kinship placements, and juvenile justice. Our model prioritizes consistency, trust, and accessibility in systems where they are too often missing.

Role Summary

You will be one of the first prescribers in a new psychiatry service designed specifically for youth in and around foster care. You will have direct collaboration with a child and adolescent psychiatrist, a therapy team trained in evidence based psychotherapy , and real influence over how the service works. Psychiatry launches in Virginia in early 2027 and will expand to other HNH states.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical care

  • Conduct 60-minute initial psychiatric evaluations and 30-minute medication management follow-ups by video.
  • Build treatment plans that pair medication with the evidence-based therapy each patient receives from their HNH therapist.
  • Prescribe and monitor psychotropic medications under HNH protocols, including baseline and follow-up labs, metabolic monitoring, and AIMS for antipsychotics.
  • Review and simplify complex medication regimens, which many of our patients arrive with after multiple placements and prescribers.
  • Prescribe electronically, including controlled substances through EPCS where permitted, and check state PDMPs as required.
  • Practice measurement-based care using serial screening instruments, and adjust treatment based on the data.
  • Assess risk at every visit and follow HNH safety protocols, escalating to the Lead Psychiatrist or emergency services when a patient needs a higher level of care.

Working within the child welfare system

  • Obtain informed consent for psychotropic medication from whoever holds legal authority (agency, court, or parent, depending on state and custody status) and obtain the youth’s assent.
  • Work within each state’s psychotropic medication oversight requirements for youth in foster care, including documentation and review processes.
  • Communicate with foster, kinship, and adoptive caregivers, caseworkers, and other members of the child’s team, within the limits of consent and privacy law.
  • Give caregivers clear, practical guidance on diagnoses, medications, side effects, and warning signs.
  • Protect continuity of care through placement changes, including medication reconciliation and timely records transfer.

Team and program building

  • Coordinate closely with each patient’s therapist and attend weekly interdisciplinary team meetings.
  • Complete documentation within 24 hours, with accurate coding.
  • Help build a new service by giving feedback on workflows, templates, and protocols, and taking part in quality improvement and peer review.

Who You’ll Care For

Children ages 6 and older, adolescents, and young adults through age 26 who have been in foster care. Most have histories of complex trauma and multiple placements.Patients who need a higher level of care are referred out and may return after stabilization.

How we work

  • Supervision. You report to the Founding Lead Psychiatrist, a board-certified child, adolescent, and adult psychiatrist, who provides (weekly case review and on-call consultation) and collaborative practice oversight where state law requires it.
  • Team. Psychiatry works alongside HNH therapists and Care Advocates. The full clinical team meets weekly; the medical team meets monthly.
  • Visit cadence. Psychiatry follow-up frequency is set by clinical need and can differ from therapy cadence.
  • Training. All HNH clinicians are trained in engaging youth with complex trauma histories and in our measurement-based care framework.
  • Setup. Fully virtual. HNH provides the EHR, e-prescribing, and telehealth platform.

Qualifications

Required

  • PMHNP-BC
  • Active RN license valid in Virginia (multistate compact license accepted) and active Virginia APRN license, or the ability to obtain both before start
  • Active DEA registration, or eligibility in each state of practice, plus any required state controlled substance registrations
  • 3 or more years of post-certification experience in psychiatric evaluation and medication management of children and adolescents
  • Experience treating youth with trauma histories and complex, multi-medication presentations
  • Telehealth experience or clear comfort with it
  • Eligibility for Medicaid and commercial payer credentialing
  • Ability to pass background checks, including child abuse and neglect registry checks

Preferred

  • APRN licenses in other states, NM, MO, NC.
  • Experience with foster care, kinship care, adoption, or child welfare agencies, including psychotropic consent and oversight processes
  • Experience with young adults transitioning out of care
  • Experience with measurement-based care
  • Experience building a new clinical program or working at an early-stage company
  • Fluency in Spanish or another language spoken by HNH families
  • Lived experience within the child welfare system is highly valued and welcomed in lieu of, or alongside, formal experience within child welfare

Work Environment & Hours

  • 100% remote
  • Must have access to a private, quiet workspace with reliable high speed internet.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation

  • Base Salary: Up to $130,000 - $140,000 annually for Full-Time

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with 100% employer-paid employee-only premiums and significant contributions toward family coverage.
  • Company-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Paid time off (PTO), paid sick leave, company holidays, and floating holidays.
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) for eligible high-deductible health plans.
  • Company-provided laptops and equipment, as applicable.
  • Reimbursement for approved business-related travel expenses.
  • Flexible and remote work arrangements

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification, scheduled hours, plan requirements, and applicable company policies.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Candidates must have current and ongoing authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Windows Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Here at Malwarebytes, we believe that when you’re free from threats, you’re free to thrive.
jobs.description:
Here at Malwarebytes, we believe that when you’re free from threats, you’re free to thrive. It all started in 2008 with one person who needed help with a malware infection, and a community coming together to find solutions. In that moment in time a product was born for all people, with a mission to rid the world of malware. Our product has since grown and evolved, from removing malware, to protecting devices, to ever-changing prevention.

About Malwarebytes Inc.

Malwarebytes began after our founder, Marcin Kleczynski, accidentally infected his parents’ computer while downloading a video game as a teenager. At the time, there was no product that could fully solve the problem, so he set out to build one. That early experience shaped our mission: to create protection that works when people need it most.
Since then, the digital threat landscape has only grown more complex. Attackers are faster, stealthier, and more sophisticated, while traditional solutions often overwhelm people with complicated tools and settings. At Malwarebytes, we believe protection should be both powerful and refreshingly simple because if security feels too hard to use, people will not use it. That is why our aspiration is always to stay one step ahead: cutting through the noise, stopping threats others miss, and delivering peace of mind in an unpredictable digital world.

Malwarebytes is looking for..

Malwarebytes protects millions of people and businesses from online threats. We are looking for a Senior C++ Developer with strong systems programming experience to work on the core of our antivirus engine.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will implement new protection features at both user and kernel space, and help keep our engine fast, stable, and effective on millions of devices.

What You Will Do:

  • Work on the antivirus engine: implement new detection and protection features
  • Build and maintain user and kernel-level components
  • Write safe, efficient C++ code that runs with high privileges on production systems
  • Debug hard system issues using crash dumps, kernel debuggers, and trace tools
  • Work with Research to bring new threat detection ideas into the engine
  • Review code and share knowledge with teammates
  • Use AI tools to speed up development and testing

In Your First Year You Will

  • Implement several new features in the antivirus engine, end to end
  • Contribute to both user mode and kernel mode components
  • Become a reliable owner of your area of the codebase

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of professional C++ development
  • Solid understanding of Windows internals at both user and kernel level
  • Strong debugging skills: WinDbg, crash dumps
  • High standards for code quality: solid grasp of SOLID principles and design patterns, applied consistently in a large codebase
  • Experience shipping software that runs with high privileges on production systems

Nice to Have

  • Experience with antivirus, EDR, or endpoint security products
  • Knowledge of Windows security features: ELAM, PPL, or kernel isolation
  • Experience with driver signing or HLK/WHQL certification
  • Familiarity with threat detection techniques or malware analysis
  • Knowledge of C# and .NET, including common patterns and best practices

Perks & Benefits:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program 
  • Wellness programs  
  • An opportunity to do something great for yourself and the world!

(Benefits and Perks subject to change by country/region)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a hands-on technical lead role.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a hands-on technical lead role. This role has broad scope across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, database, integrations, and hosting, for the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. The role emphasizes autonomy and ownership while setting technical direction, driving platform consistency, and mentoring engineers to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
This position blends day-to-day software engineering with technical leadership. It involves modernizing legacy systems, reducing technical debt, and establishing consistent platform patterns. These efforts span across two independent health plan technology stacks. The role also promotes modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure and security as code, automated testing, and observability) and expects responsible use of Humana-approved AI and code generation tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

The Senior Full Stack Engineer is responsible for design, development, and modernization of applications and platforms that support the Wisconsin Medicaid Market. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and trust, owning solutions end-to-end across the full stack rather than being confined to a single application or technology area.


The Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team functions as a highly empowered, end-to-end technology organization supporting two acquired health plans with independent core administration systems and technology stacks. As a result, this role works across the full spectrum of core platforms and supporting systems—collaborating with peers, enterprise architecture, and platform partners to define technical direction, align to enterprise standards where appropriate, and reduce system complexity and operational burden.


This position regularly wears multiple hats—building and modernizing software across front-end, back-end, database, integration, and hosting layers; contributing architectural vision; addressing technical debt; and improving reliability and scalability across environments. The engineer will lead by example through hands-on delivery, strong code review practices, and mentoring. Additionally, they will drive software-driven automation, focusing on CI/CD, infrastructure, and security as code. Furthermore, they will adopt cloud-native patterns, such as containers and orchestration, where they fit the market's needs. The role will also champion practical, responsible use of Humana-approved AI-assisted development and code generation tools (Google-based tooling in Humana's standard stack) to increase throughput and strengthen code quality.


Success in this role is driven not only by technical outcomes, but also by how the individual shows up: bringing curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and a growth mindset. This role is well suited for a lead engineer who can translate ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs, communicate tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor teammates through design and delivery, and progressively take on broader platform and architecture responsibility while remaining hands-on.


Additional Job Responsibilities


  • Lead hands-on design and delivery of applications and platforms across the Wisconsin Medicaid Market (front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting)
  • Work across multiple insurance core administration platforms and supporting services rather than a single domain
  • Identify and address technical debt and reliability gaps that improve scalability, supportability, and operational outcomes
  • Support modernization efforts (including migration from legacy implementations to modern patterns where applicable), with an emphasis on automation and repeatability
  • Partner with IT leadership, enterprise architects, and platform teams to align decisions with enterprise standards and long-term direction
  • Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and HIPAA requirements, including applying security-as-code and appropriate controls in delivery pipelines
  • Mentor engineers through design discussions and code reviews; coach on delivery practices (testing, CI/CD, observability) and model effective use of Humana-approved AI and code generation tools
  • Balance hands-on delivery with technical leadership (architecture decisions, alignment, and coaching) as priorities evolve

Team Culture & Expectations


On the Wisconsin Medicaid Market IT team, how you show up is as important as what you accomplish. We value ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and a strong desire to learn and make a meaningful difference. Team members are trusted to operate with autonomy, take accountability for outcomes, and work across domains to solve problems end‑to‑end.


A growth mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to continuously learn new technologies and approaches are essential for success in this role—including embracing and effectively leveraging Humana‑approved AI‑assisted development and code generation as a standard part of how the team delivers high‑quality outcomes.


Use your skills to make an impact

Skills & Capabilities


Full Stack Application

Deep experience building and modernizing applications across the full stack, including front-end, back-end, data, integrations, and hosting. Strong experience with the Microsoft technology stack (e.g., .NET, SQL Server, Windows-based services) and cloud-hosted solutions (especially Azure). Comfortable working across application, integration, and platform layers in complex environments.

DevOps, Automation, and Infrastructure/Security as Code

Experience designing delivery pipelines and operational automation (CI/CD), applying infrastructure as code and security as code practices, and improving developer experience through repeatable, self-service patterns.


Cloud-Native Patterns (Containers & Orchestration)

Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration concepts (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes/AKS) and when to apply them to improve scalability, resilience, and consistency across environments, especially Azure.


Reliability, Observability & Operational Excellence

Ability to improve production supportability through monitoring, logging, alerting, and runbook-style documentation; experience reducing incident volume via root-cause analysis, automation, and resilient design.


Cross‑Domain Systems Thinking

Ability to understand and navigate interactions across multiple insurance core systems, platforms, and supporting services, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows and reduce system sprawl.


Modernization, Reliability & Code Quality

Experience modernizing legacy technologies and improving reliability, performance, and operational supportability through thoughtful design, refactoring, and automation.


AI‑Assisted Development & Code Generation

Comfort actively leveraging AI‑assisted development and code generation tools to improve productivity, code quality, analysis, and learning. Expected to use these tools day‑to‑day and model effective practices for the team. Experience with Humana's approved code generation tooling (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium) is highly preferred; strong aptitude and willingness to learn is equally valued.


Ways of Working & Mindset

Thrives in autonomous, high-trust environments. Comfortable wearing multiple hats, collaborating across teams, influencing through expertise, and remaining hands-on while leading technical direction, mentoring teammates, and partnering with leaders on architectural and process decisions.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 5 or more years of experience designing, developing, and testing of software applications and/or infrastructure
  • 2-5 years of hands-on experience with the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, SQL Server, and Windows-based services.
  • Experience developing and supporting cloud-based solutions, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure.
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Working knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Experience within the healthcare industry or healthcare technology environments
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building responsive web applications with React

Additional Information


Work-At-Home Requirements

  • WAH requirements: Must have the ability to provide a high speed DSL or cable modem for a home office. Associates or contractors who live and work from home in the state of California will be provided payment for their internet expense.
  • A minimum standard speed for optimal performance of 25x10 (25mpbs download x 10mpbs upload) is required.
  • Satellite and Wireless Internet service is NOT allowed for this role.
  • A dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$117,600 - $161,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.description:
Malwarebytes is reimagining security to safeguard devices, data, and people — no matter their location, lifestyle, or means. What began in 2008 with one person helping another remove a malware infection has grown into a global leader in online protection, with an all-in-one suite of cybersecurity, privacy, and identity protection solutions that empower millions of people worldwide to enjoy their digital lives, free from threats and scams.

About Malwarebytes Inc.

Our portfolio has grown far beyond malware removal into a full suite of award-winning cybersecurity, privacy, and identity solutions, from the free tools that have long served as a first line of defense to newer options for identity protection and personal data removal. The threat landscape keeps getting faster, stealthier, and more sophisticated, and we believe protection should be both powerful and refreshingly simple — because security that's too hard to use doesn't get used. Built and beloved by experts, we combine world-class threat research with proprietary, AI-powered processes to deliver powerful digital protection that's always by your side.

Malwarebytes is looking for..

Malwarebytes protects millions of people and businesses from online threats. We are looking for a Windows Platform Architect with deep knowledge of Windows internals and performance to shape the core of our Windows product.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a people manager role. You will design and build the low-level parts of our product that run on millions of PCs, and make sure they are safe, stable, fast, and light. You will be the senior Windows technical lead in the US, working with our Windows and Core Technology teams in the US and Europe, as well as Research, Cloud, and Product.

Compensation: $240k - $250k Base with 15% Bonus

What You Will Do:

  • Own the design of core Windows components, from kernel drivers to user mode services
  • Make our product fast and light: cut CPU use, memory use, and startup time
  • Find and fix hard system issues using crash dumps, traces, and kernel debugging
  • Lead driver signing and certification work with Microsoft
  • Help resolve urgent issues during US hours, such as certificate, signing, or false positive problems
  • Review new Windows features and APIs and decide how we should use them
  • Work with Research to bring new protection features down to the OS level
  • Use AI tools to speed up how we design, build, and test
  • Coach engineers on Windows internals and good design
  • Deliver clear gains in memory and CPU use across our Windows product
  • Lead the design of at least one major driver or core component change
  • Become the go-to person for Windows platform issues during US hours

Skills You'll Need to Have:

  • 10+ years building software, with deep focus on Windows internals
  • Hands-on kernel driver work: file system minifilters, kernel callbacks, and the Windows driver model
  • Strong C and C++ skills
  • Experience with C# and .NET performance, including startup time and memory use
  • Skill with performance and debugging tools such as WinDbg, ETW, WPA, and PerfView
  • Experience shipping software that runs with high rights on a large number of PCs, where stability matters most
  • A track record of solving hard problems and shipping production software
  • Clear writing and speaking, and a habit of sharing knowledge with others

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with security products such as antivirus or endpoint protection
  • Knowledge of ELAM, Protected Process Light, or other Windows security features
  • Experience with driver certification (HLK, WHQL, attestation signing)
  • Experience with cloud to endpoint telemetry

jobs.excerpt: We're hiring a senior Search & Relevance Engineer for a fast-growing, US-based B2B SaaS company.
jobs.description:
We're hiring a senior Search & Relevance Engineer for a fast-growing, US-based B2B SaaS company.

You'll own one question: when a user describes who they're looking for, do we give them the right results? You'll measure relevance, find what's broken and ship the fix yourself, working with AI coding agents every day. This is a full-time remote role.

What you'll do

  • Own search quality across filter search (Elasticsearch) and AI search (natural language to filters).
  • Build the measurement: relevance benchmarks, labeled query sets, offline evals and online metrics. Online, that means tracking whether searches end in a saved result, a refined search, or an abandoned search.
  • Tune Elasticsearch: mappings, analyzers, keyword and industry matching, scoring, synonyms, and handling of messy company names and domains.
  • Build semantic and hybrid search: embed company and person profiles, run vector search alongside keyword search, and tune how the two are blended.
  • Use embeddings to classify companies (industry, business type, B2B/B2C), group similar companies, and power companies like this one.
  • Improve AI search through prompts, schema, model choice and evals. For example, Series A fintechs in Berlin with 50 to 200 employees should become the right set of filters.
  • Find where the data is missing or wrong, measure the impact, and recommend what to fix, enrich or buy.
  • Benchmark data coverage, accuracy and freshness against external sources, and turn the results into a roadmap.
  • Ship code, not just reports, across a TypeScript backend and Python analysis tooling. Use AI to label data, analyze queries and run evals at a scale one person couldn't manage by hand.

You may be a fit if

  • You're AI-native. You build with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) every day, run agents for analysis and labeling, and can show how that makes you faster.
  • You have a product mindset. You start from what the user was trying to do and why the search failed them, then pick the fix that changes their outcome and explain the trade-off to product and leadership.
  • You have 4+ years working on search, ranking or recommendations, with production Elasticsearch or OpenSearch experience (Solr or Vespa also count).
  • You have production experience with embeddings. That covers choosing and evaluating models, vector indexes (Elasticsearch dense_vector/kNN, pgvector, Qdrant), hybrid ranking such as reciprocal rank fusion, and managing index size, latency and re-embedding cost at hundreds of millions of rows.
  • You've built relevance evaluations (judgment sets, precision@k, nDCG) and changed a product because of what they showed.
  • You have strong SQL and Python, and you're comfortable shipping in a TypeScript/Node backend with AI agents.
  • You've shipped LLM features: prompting, structured outputs, eval harnesses, and cost and latency trade-offs.
  • You're comfortable with messy entity data: company matching, deduplication, classification and industry taxonomies.

Nice to have

  • Experience on a marketplace, e-commerce or B2B SaaS search team.
  • Entity resolution or learning-to-rank experience.
  • You've evaluated or integrated third-party data vendors.

What we offer

  • A full-time, fully remote role.
  • End-to-end ownership of search quality for a product used at large scale.
  • An AI-native team where shipping with agents is the default.
  • Direct work with product and leadership.

jobs.description:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRONDH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

jobs.description:
Senior Engineer (Ingestion)

TypeScript, Node.js, ClickHouse, Event-Driven Data Pipelines

Why join Levellr

Levellr is the enterprise community intelligence platform for Discord, Reddit and a growing range of community platforms, trusted by major gaming companies like Scopely, Krafton, and Epic, alongside global brands such as Google, YouTube, and SoundCloud to grow and monetise their communities.

With millions of messages generated, turning raw activity into clear insight is difficult. Levellr helps teams understand members, spot trends, improve engagement, and make data-driven commercial decisions.

This depends on reliable data ingestion. Our dashboards, reporting, and AI tools require timely, accurate data processing. As we expand customers and sources, ingestion sits at the core of our platform growth.

What you'll work on

You'll join our ingestion squad as a Senior Engineer owning end-to-end data collection, processing, and storage across our integrations.

As we transition to an event-driven architecture, you will design event flows, queuing, retries, failure recovery, and data consistency at scale.

Handling millions of messages, you'll focus on throughput, latency, deduplication, backfills, schema design, and data-store performance while building pipeline observability.

Collaborating with product and AI teams, you'll identify pipeline bottlenecks and deliver continuous incremental updates in ambiguous problem spaces.

You’ll also help us add new platforms fast (Discord, Reddit, Steam, X and customers’ own sources), building the system that makes each new integration quick and cheap, increasingly with AI agents doing the build.

How we ship

Levellr has a strong bias towards shipping and learning from production. We ship early, iterate rapidly, and learn from production. Core systems like Levellr AI moved from initial concept to shipped foundations in weeks.

For ingestion, this pace requires care. Our transition to event-driven architectures must be incremental to ensure continuous data flow.

This demands strong engineering judgement—knowing when to simplify, invest in core foundations, refactor, or adjust approaches quickly.

The level we're looking for

We need a hands-on Senior Engineer who has owned high-volume production data pipelines and can take immediate system ownership.

You can detail past systems you owned, including throughput volume, load patterns, performance bottlenecks, and structural optimizations.

Production experience with messaging queues, pub/sub, or streams is essential, alongside understanding ordering, idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling.

You proactively address risks, communicate technical trade-offs, and take accountability for operational health in production.

What good looks like in you

  • Solid backend engineering experience with significant focus on data pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js across backend services and database stores.

  • AI-native engineering day to day: you build with coding agents and know where they help and where they bite.

  • Strong data-store skills at scale (schema design, query optimisation, indexing, partitioning), ideally across both relational and analytical stores such as ClickHouse.

  • Hands-on ownership of ingestion edge cases: rate limits, schema drifts, backfills, and partial failures.

  • Focus on pipeline observability, monitoring data freshness, and maintaining strict data quality standards.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, establish technical clarity, and drive progress independently.

  • Preference for incremental delivery based on real-world usage rather than lengthy isolated development cycles.

  • Clear communication through concise PRs, technical docs, and async updates that elevate team performance.

  • Located in European timezones with core overlap with UK business hours.

This role probably isn't right if

  • Your experience centers primarily on standard SaaS features without backend data complexity.

  • Your core focus is building AI applications rather than underlying data ingestion systems.

  • You haven't directly owned high-volume data pipelines in production environments.

  • You haven't worked with data at a scale where schema design, indexing and query optimisation really mattered.

  • You require extensive pre-defined structure to operate and deliver.

  • You prefer extended planning cycles or total rewrites over continuous production deployment.

  • You struggle making quick technical trade-offs under dynamic conditions.

The tools we use

  • TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and React across the product.

  • PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redis and PubSub across data, analytics and messaging.

  • Google Cloud, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions and Cloudflare for infrastructure and delivery.

  • Google Agent Platform (Vertex AI), OpenAI, Anthropic and other LLM platforms across our AI systems.

Nice to have

  • Experience with GCP Pub/Sub, Kafka, or equivalent event-streaming technologies.

  • Familiarity with Temporal or other durable execution frameworks.

  • Hands-on work with third-party platform APIs, handling rate limits and dynamic payloads.

  • Direct experience managing Discord, Reddit, or social media datasets.

  • Exposure to how ingested data feeds downstream AI or search systems.

  • Background in high-growth startup environments driving fast-paced technical decisions.

  • Experience migrating live systems toward event-driven architectures without service interruption.

  • Track record of impactful technical writing, open-source projects, or engineering documentation.

Who we are

Levellr was founded by Tom (CEO) and Ben (CTO), who have experience in both start-ups and large scale companies (YouTube, Eleven Sports). Since 2021 we’ve grown the team to 30+ employees and are backed by a number of successful angels (Mark Pincus, Dylan Collins, Mitch Lasky, Bing Gordon, Frank Gibeau to name a few). The product that we are building is growing in multiple verticals, seeing a 6x growth over the last 3 years and on track to continue.

We believe in substance over hype. We're a product-led company building a sustainable business by solving our customers' most pressing problems. This allows us to create a culture and a company that we're proud to build together. Some of the values we stand for:

We have ownership. We embrace change and take bold risks.

We get shit done. We have a bias for action and love creating value from our code and our conversations.

We disagree and commit. We give radically honest feedback and challenge assumptions, then get behind the result & move on.

We grow in uncertainty. We embrace change, learn from feedback, and continuously improve what we do for our customers.

We care. We care about our team, our customers, and the communities we serve.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive basic salary - full details shared at the initial interview stage

  • 25 days annual leave plus UK public holidays.

  • Remote or hybrid working, with flexible working hours.

  • Co-working space access, including Soho Works locations across London and the US.

  • Stock option plan.

  • Home office budget once you pass probation.

  • Mental health support through Spill.

  • Twice-yearly company meet-ups.

Interview process

  • Screening call with our Talent Partner (Matt)

  • Introductory conversation with our Engineering Manager (Miro): product, technical direction and how the team works

  • A 90-minute async build task, in your own time

  • 60-minute technical follow-up with two of our engineers, on your task and your experience

  • 60 minutes with Ben, our CTO

  • 30 minutes with Isabelle, our Head of People

We aim to complete the process within two weeks and provide clear feedback after each stage.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

What We Are Looking For

COURAGE – AUTHENTICITY – OPENNESS – COMMITMENT – ELEGANCE

Do these words resonate with you? They are our company values.

At Wepoint, we are looking for committed talents who are ready to share their expertise within open and collaborative teams, and who are not afraid to take initiative. We also value people who are able to challenge themselves and continuously improve.

At the heart of relationships at Wepoint are authenticity and the constant pursuit of excellence for our clients — this is what we expect from our future colleagues.

Job Description

The Level III Cybersecurity Analyst position is responsible for providing security expertise to the 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC). The primary objective of this position is to contribute to the coordination and monitoring of cyber incidents affecting the bank’s critical assets by detecting, preventing, and responding to cyber threats targeting the group’s infrastructure. This role provides essential support to the organization’s overall cybersecurity program through close collaboration with the various lines of business across the region, as well as with external clients, partners, and regulatory authorities. As a Production Security Analyst, you will be responsible not only for the real-time monitoring, analysis, and resolution of identified security incidents, but also for the continuous improvement and development of the 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities, which serve as the first line of defense in identifying potential information security incidents.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze security log data from a wide range of heterogeneous security devices and identify trends;
  • Be responsible for the development and validation of use cases;
  • Provide Incident Response (IR) support or escalate when analysis confirms that an incident requires action;
  • Perform threat and vulnerability analysis and provide security advisory services;
  • Develop the Threat Hunting program and capabilities;
  • Analyze and respond to previously undisclosed software and hardware vulnerabilities;
  • Investigate, document, and report on information security issues and emerging trends;
  • Perform Threat Hunting activities to identify potential malicious actors within the network;
  • Perform digital forensic investigations on compromised systems to determine the extent and nature of the compromise and provide recommendations regarding appropriate remediation measures;
  • Provide support and conduct research regarding any security-related questions or incidents;
  • Perform tasks independently with some level of oversight;
  • Integrate and share information with other analysts and teams;
  • Monitor the bank’s various sources for potential security incidents, health alerts related to monitored solutions, and requests for information. This includes monitoring real-time channels or dashboards, periodic reports, email inboxes, help desks or other ticketing systems, telephone calls, and chat sessions;
  • Follow incident-specific procedures to triage potential security incidents, validate them, determine the necessary mitigation measures, and keep these procedures up to date;
  • Escalate potential security incidents to Level IV engineers, implement countermeasures in response to requests, and recommend operational improvements;
  • Accurately document incident information and notes in the case management system;
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the bank’s technology architecture, known vulnerabilities, the architecture of the security solutions used for monitoring, imminent and widespread threats identified through client threat intelligence, and recent security incidents;
  • Continuously improve the service by identifying and addressing issues or knowledge gaps, including analysis procedures, response playbooks, and client network models; tuning false positives; and identifying and recommending new or updated tools, content, countermeasures, or scripts;
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one security-related area, such as a specific anti-malware solution, Python programming, etc.;
  • Actively seek to develop skills through continuous learning and pursue advancement to a Level IV Analyst position;
  • Comply with internal operational security policies as well as other BNP Paribas policies;
  • Perform limited-scope project work as required.

Qualifications

  • Connaissance ou 3 à 5 ans d’expérience avec les technologies suivantes : SIEM, ELK, IDS/IPS, pare-feu réseau et hôte, solutions de prévention des fuites de données (DLP);
  • Expérience pratique avec les logiciels antivirus, les solutions de détection et de réponse sur les terminaux (EDR), les pare-feu et les solutions de filtrage de contenu;
  • Expérience ou connaissances démontrables en réponse aux incidents, analyse de journaux ("logs") et analyse de captures réseau (PCAP);
  • Bonne connaissance des principes fondamentaux des réseaux, notamment : modèle OSI, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S) et SMTP;
  • Bonne compréhension des méthodes utilisées par les acteurs malveillants pour attaquer un réseau, notamment l’hameçonnage ("phishing"), le balayage de ports ("port scanning"), les attaques contre les applications Web, les attaques DDoS et les mouvements latéraux;
  • Connaissance des systèmes d’exploitation Windows et/ou Linux, ainsi que des méthodes permettant de les analyser afin d’identifier des signes de compromission;
  • Réel intérêt pour l’apprentissage et volonté de contribuer au développement continu de l’équipe;
  • Connaissances de base en langages de script ("scripting").
  • Capacité à démontrer une méthodologie rigoureuse dans l’investigation des alertes et/ou des indicateurs de compromission, et à documenter les conclusions de manière à ce qu’elles soient compréhensibles aussi bien par les collègues techniques que par les membres de la haute direction;
  • Bonne compréhension des rôles complémentaires des différentes équipes de cybersécurité et capacité à collaborer avec celles-ci, notamment les équipes de forensique numérique, renseignement sur les menaces ("Threat Intelligence"), tests d’intrusion ("Penetration Testing"), gestion des vulnérabilités, etc.;
  • Capacité à gérer des charges de travail variables, des priorités concurrentes et plusieurs activités simultanément;
  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse;
  • Excellente communication en français et en anglais. L'anglais est requis, le poste demandant de communiquer avec des clients et des partenaires situés à l'extérieur du Québec.

Overview

Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms.

We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model.

You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions.

We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization.

This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics.

What you'll do

  • Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals.
  • Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria.
  • Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk.
  • Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented.
  • Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data.
  • Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments.
  • Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift
  • Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations
  • Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field
  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline
  • Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models.
  • Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems.
  • Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies.
  • Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration.
  • Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift.
  • Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams.
